The simulation goal is to examine how support evolves over time, how agents switch positions across rounds, and how responses differ across survey-grounded personas under changing social and policy contexts.

</details>


### [355] [KumbhDoot: A Scale-Ready, LLM-Bounded Architecture for Mass-Gathering Public-Service Assistants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07520)
*Saurabh Sakalkar,Abhishek Singh,Ramesh Raskar*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文介绍KumbhDoot，一个为印度Nashik Simhastha Kumbh Mela大型宗教集会设计的智能体朝圣者助手。该系统采用"语义优先、LLM受限"的设计原则，以嵌入索引的语义缓存作为核心检索原语，仅在语义相似性检索不足以回答时才调用生成式大语言模型（LLM），从而在规模、延迟、幻觉风险和离线可用性方面显著优于默认的LLM路由方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模宗教集会（如Kumbh Mela）在数周内聚集数千万人，产生密集、重复、多语言且安全关键的信息需求。传统的"所有查询都路由到LLM"的对话助手方案在此场景下存在四大问题：规模化成本高昂、紧急路径延迟高、对可能造成身体伤害的事实性信息容易产生幻觉、断网时不可用。因此需要一种更适配该场景的架构设计。

Method: KumbhDoot采用"语义优先"架构：(1) 以嵌入索引的语义缓存作为唯一检索原语，统一处理意图路由、答案缓存、离线查找和多智能体检索；(2) 仅在语义相似性检索不足以产生正确答案时才调用生成式模型（LLM受限）；(3) 构建自定义三层智能体架构，直接操作语义存储，避免使用通用的多智能体框架（因其会隐式触发逐步骤LLM调用），确保决策路径可审查。

Result: 论文呈现了系统架构、每查询经济性的分析成本模型，并诚实地讨论了语义相似性足以覆盖的场景以及仍需生成式推理的场景。结果表明在有限、高利害、低连接性的公共服务领域，语义优先且LLM受限的设计不仅更便宜，而且在架构上比LLM默认方案更合适。

Conclusion: 对于有界、高风险、低连通性的公共服务领域（如Kumbh Mela这类大规模集会），"语义优先、LLM受限"（similarity-first, LLM-bounded）的设计原则在架构上比"LLM默认"（LLM-default）方案更恰当，兼顾了经济性、可靠性与可审查性。

Abstract: Mass religious gatherings such as the Kumbh Mela concentrate tens of millions of people into a single region over a few weeks, producing intense, repetitive, multilingual, and safety-critical demand for information. The default response, a conversational assistant that routes every query to a large language model (LLM), is poorly matched to this setting: it is costly at scale, slow on emergency paths, prone to hallucination on facts that can cause physical harm, and unusable when connectivity fails. We describe KumbhDoot, an agentic pilgrim assistant for the Nashik Simhastha Kumbh Mela built on a different principle. It operates on a foundational design principle that prioritizes semantic similarity over starting with an LLM. Generative models are invoked only in instances where similarity-based retrieval is insufficient to produce a correct answer. The system utilizes a "semantic cache": an embedding-indexed store as a single retrieval primitive, which handles intent routing, answer caching, offline lookups, and multi-agent retrieval. A custom three-tier agent architecture operates directly on this store, ensuring decision paths remain inspectable and avoiding the use of generic multi-agent frameworks that would trigger implicit per-step LLM calls. We present the architecture, an analytical cost model for its per-query economics, and an honest account of where similarity is sufficient and where generative reasoning remains necessary. We argue that for bounded, high-stakes, low-connectivity public-service domains, a similarity-first and LLM-bounded design is not merely cheaper but architecturally more appropriate than an LLM-default one.

</details>


### [356] [Explainable Machine Learning in Healthcare: Methods, Interpretation, and Applications for Clinical Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07522)
*Krishna Padmanabhan,Minxin Lu,Dai Feng,Natalia KanDobrosky,Sai Konduri,Heather J. Litman,Achilleas Livieratos*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了可解释机器学习（XML）方法，涵盖SHAP、LIME、PDP和ICE等全局与局部解释工具，并使用心脏病数据集展示了这些方法的实际应用、解释指南和局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习模型在临床研究中的应用日益广泛，但其"黑箱"特性阻碍了临床医生对预测结果的理解与信任。作者希望通过结构化综述，弥合先进ML方法与临床适用性之间的鸿沟，帮助提升ML预测的透明度和可问责性。

Method: 对四种常用XML方法（SHAP、LIME、PDP、ICE）进行系统性的结构化综述，从高层机制解释、可视化展示、使用指南和局限性分析四个维度展开，并以公开可用的Heart Disease数据集作为贯穿全文的实践示例。

Result: XML技术能够提供直观的视觉和定量洞见：全局方法可刻画群体层面的特征效应，局部方法可揭示个体患者的风险贡献。实际案例展示了XML如何识别非线性关系、检测交互效应，以及揭示患者间预测风险的异质性。

Conclusion: XML工具为临床研究中的ML模型提供了宝贵的可解释性，有助于更透明、可问责的ML应用。这份基础性综述通过方法论与实践示例结合的方式，为临床研究人员提供了每种方法优缺点的结构化指导，有望促进更好的理解、沟通和批判性评估，最终支持循证临床决策。

Abstract: We present a structured review of commonly used Explainable machine learning (XML) methodologies, including global and local interpretability tools such as SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP), Local Interpretable Model-Agnostic Explanations (LIME), Partial Dependence Plots (PDP), and Individual Conditional Expectation (ICE) plots. For each method, we explain the underlying mechanism at a high level, visualize representative outputs, and provide structured guidance on interpretation, appropriate use, and limitations, illustrated using the publicly available Heart Disease dataset. XML techniques provided intuitive visual and quantitative insights into how predictors influence model predictions. Global methods characterized population-level feature effects, whereas local methods revealed patient-level contributions useful for individualized interpretation. Our worked examples demonstrate how XML outputs can identify nonlinear relationships, detect interaction effects, and reveal heterogeneity in predicted risk across patients, addressing key challenges in translating ML predictions into interpretable outputs for clinical research. XML tools offer valuable interpretability for ML models and support more transparent and accountable ML applications in clinical research. By providing a methodologically grounded overview alongside practical implementation examples and structured guidance on each method's strengths and limitations, this primer helps bridge the gap between advanced ML methodology and clinical applicability. Thoughtful adoption of XML approaches may facilitate better understanding, communication, and critical evaluation of ML predictions in healthcare research, ultimately supporting evidence-based clinical decision-making.

</details>


### [357] [From Evaluated Models to Evaluation Aids: A Multi-Evidence Study of LLM-Based Difficulty Calibration for Programming Examinations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07523)
*Hongfei Yan,Jiangkai Xiong,Yiqing Li,Chong Chen*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究将大语言模型从基准评估目标重新定位为考试难度解释的辅助证据来源，结合AI证据、学生成绩聚合、题目曝光度、在线评测过程数据和教师解读，验证了AI难度评估与真实学生表现的相关性，并明确了其适用范围与边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并行班编程考试之间的难度差异影响课程评估的公平性。传统上LLM仅作为基准测试的评估目标，缺乏利用AI证据辅助解释考试难度的系统性研究。

Method: 1）让十个模型与120名学生同步解答八道期末考试题；2）通过第三方OpenAI兼容端点调用单一结构化评审器（gpt-5.6-sol），对来自11个并行班期末考试共79道题进行难度评定；3）结合学生通过率、非答题率、题目曝光度、在线评测过程数据进行相关性分析；4）进行曝光折扣（0-0.40）和重复题目扰动测试。

Result: AI通过率与学生通过率显著正相关（rho=0.866, p=0.0119）；基于解题的复合难度指数与学生通过率负相关（rho=-0.905, p=0.0046）。在79道题中，AI整体难度与题目级通过率相关为rho=-0.871，与非答题率rho=0.800；DSAB纵向样本相关为-0.829和0.883；但CS101样本题目级相关减弱至-0.552，考试级相关接近零。扰动测试不改变结论方向。

Conclusion: AI证据可作为题目验证、并行班公平性讨论和纵向质量追踪的外部参考，但模型身份边界、单一评审者设计和评审输出不稳定性构成明确限制：AI难度量表不得用于个体学生评估或自动成绩调整。

Abstract: Difficulty differences across parallel-class programming examinations affect the fairness of course assessment. This study repositions large language models from benchmark evaluation targets to auxiliary evidence sources for interpreting exam difficulty, combining AI evidence with aggregated student performance, item exposure, online-judge process data, and teacher interpretation. First, ten models solved an eight-problem final exam synchronously with 120 students: AI pass rate correlated positively with student pass rate (Spearman rho = 0.866, exact p = 0.0119), and a solving-based composite difficulty index correlated negatively with it (rho = -0.905, exact p = 0.0046). A single structured reviewer was then run via auditable API calls on a third-party OpenAI-compatible endpoint whose model label (gpt-5.6-sol) cannot authenticate an official OpenAI upstream model; call metadata and raw responses are archived. Across 79 problems from 11 parallel-class final exams, AI overall difficulty correlated with problem-level pass rate at rho = -0.871 and with non-attempt rate at rho = 0.800; in a 26-problem longitudinal Data Structures and Algorithms B sample, the correlations were -0.829 and 0.883. A 106-problem introductory-course (CS101) sample marks the boundary: the problem-level correlation weakened to rho = -0.552, and the exam-level correlation across 16 exams was near zero, with cohort composition dominating exam-level outcomes. Exposure-discount (0-0.40) and duplicate-problem perturbation tests did not change these directions. AI evidence can thus serve as an external reference for problem validation, parallel-class fairness discussion, and longitudinal quality tracking, while the model-identity boundary, single-reviewer design, and review-output instability set explicit limits: AI difficulty scales must not be used for individual student evaluation or automatic grade adjustment.

</details>


### [358] [AI as a Democratizing Force in Indie Game Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07825)
*Brian Madanamootoo,Jatin Alla*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文研究了2024-2026年视频游戏行业AAA级收缩与独立开发扩张并存的背景下AI的角色，通过四个研究问题（进入壁垒、市场接受度、新浪潮、质量）分析了AI对游戏生产民主化的影响，发现AI将制作规划成本降低了约四个数量级，AI披露游戏数量在18个月内增长8倍，但市场出现结构性供过于求的前兆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频游戏行业正经历历史上前所未有的分化——AAA级游戏深度收缩与独立游戏空前扩张并存。作者希望系统性地理解AI在这一分化中所扮演的角色，特别是在生产成本趋近于零而成熟市场需求收缩的情况下，对行业生态产生的结构性影响。

Method: 研究采用多源数据混合方法：使用公开市场数据、与Steam生成式AI披露记录交叉参考的标题级Steam目录数据集（含9,654到20,000+款游戏）、以及来自智能体AI游戏制作平台的14个月日志。通过四个预注册的收敛测试验证"第三次民主化浪潮"假设，并从七个维度操作化"民主化"概念。

Result: 关键发现包括：制作规划（传统上约59美元/小时的制片人角色）平均仅需5.1分钟、成本0.27-0.58美元；AI披露游戏发行量在18个月内增长8倍；独立游戏数量和单位销量均扩张；从业者情绪在三项调查中全面崩溃；披露游戏在验证子样本中获得目录典型的评价（中位数85.9%正面）；游戏发行量从9,654（2020）翻倍到20,000以上（2025），但仅约300款游戏毛收入超100万美元。

Conclusion: 当前时刻类似于继分发（2008-2012）和构建（2013-2020）之后的第三次民主化浪潮，且市场显示出结构性供过于求的前兆，迫使行业转向新的分发范式。作者强调AI记录的是生产中的使用而非著作权归属，并为开发者、教育者和平台设计提出启示性建议。

Abstract: The video game industry of 2024-2026 shows the deepest AAA-level contraction in its modern history alongside the largest-ever expansion of independent output. We examine AI's role in that divergence across four research questions, using public marketplace data, a title-level Steam catalog dataset cross-referenced with Steam's generative-AI disclosure records, and a fourteen-month log from an agentic AI game-production platform. RQ1 (barriers to entry): production planning, historically a salaried producer role at roughly $59 per hour, is generated in a mean of 5.1 minutes for $0.27-0.58 per plan. We operationalize "democratization" across seven dimensions and claim it for one, coordination cost, repriced by roughly four orders of magnitude; the regional dimension is argued from cost arithmetic, not measured. RQ2 (market acceptance): indie volume and unit sales expanded, AI-disclosed releases rose eightfold in eighteen months, professional sentiment collapsed across three surveys, and disclosed releases received catalog-typical reception (median 85.9 percent positive) in a verified subsample. RQ3 (a new wave): the moment resembles a third democratization wave after distribution (2008-2012) and construction (2013-2020); four pre-registered convergence tests align, and as production cost nears zero while mature-market demand contracts, the market shows preconditions of structural oversupply, forcing a new distribution paradigm. RQ4 (quality): the platform log measures plan generation, not shipped-game quality, so we compare quality signals for AI-disclosed versus non-disclosed titles; disclosure records AI use in production, not authorship. Releases doubled from 9,654 (2020) to over 20,000 (2025) while only about 300 titles grossed above $1 million, and participation in major markets fell below pre-pandemic levels; we close with implications for developers, educators, and platform design.

</details>


### [359] [Hardware is an AI Ethics Problem: Expert Visions for a Sustainable and Equitable Semiconductor Industry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07830)
*Naira Paola Arnez-Jordan,Chiara Ullstein,Michel Hohendanner,Jens Grossklags,Lorenzo Servadei,Alejandro Merino-Madrid,Orestis Papakyriakopoulos*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过参与式未来工作坊，邀请学术界、工业界和政策领域的专家，探讨半导体行业面临的社会、环境和地缘政治挑战。研究发现这些挑战高度相互依存，并揭示了三重核心张力：主权与可持续性的矛盾、供应链不透明、以及知识鸿沟。参与者提出了标准化排放标签、战略相互依存框架和知识再分配等解决方案，主张AI伦理应超越模型与数据，延伸至硬件基础设施。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究往往孤立地、在学科壁垒内审视半导体行业的社会、环境和地缘政治挑战，缺乏从综合社会-技术、跨学科视角理解这些问题的研究，存在显著的知识空白。

Method: 采用参与式未来工作坊（participatory futuring workshop）方法，邀请来自学术界、工业界和政策领域的专家共同参与，通过协作式情景构建和反思讨论来探索半导体行业面临的挑战与未来路径。

Result: 发现挑战之间高度相互依存；识别出三大核心张力（主权-可持续性张力、供应链不透明、知识鸿沟）；参与者构想出以相互依存和包容性获取为中心的未来，并提出标准化排放标签、战略相互依存框架和知识再分配等具体措施。

Conclusion: AI伦理考量必须超越模型和数据层面，延伸至其所依赖的硬件基础设施；将利益相关者反思嵌入预见性治理框架，对于AI物理基础设施的负责任治理至关重要。

Abstract: As the foundation of contemporary AI systems, the semiconductor industry is increasingly shaped by critical social, environmental, and geopolitical challenges. Nonetheless, prior research has often examined these issues in isolation and within disciplinary silos, leaving a gap in understanding them through an integrative socio-technical, cross-disciplinary lens. To address this gap, we conducted a participatory futuring workshop with experts from academia, industry, and policy. The results of our analysis show that the aforementioned challenges are highly interdependent, and participants envisioned interconnected socio-technical pathways linking present frictions to normative goals. Drawing from their perspectives, we highlight three central tensions: the sovereignty--sustainability tension, where national protectionism undermines ecological survival; supply chain opacity, which obscures accountability for labor and environmental harms; and a growing knowledge divide that risks excluding smaller economies from shaping the AI future. Participants envisioned futures centered on interdependence and inclusive access, proposing measures such as a standardized emissions labeling system to translate technical data into public accountability. They also suggested frameworks for strategic interdependence to balance local resilience with global cooperation, and epistemic redistribution initiatives to lower barriers of entry and democratize access to hardware infrastructure. We argue that considerations of AI ethics must extend beyond models and data to encompass the hardware infrastructures on which they depend, and that embedding stakeholder reflection is critical for anticipatory governance in the physical infrastructure of AI.

</details>


### [360] [Beyond "I Can't Help With That": How Child Safety Experts Evaluate AI Chatbot Safety](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07902)
*Hannah Cha,Neha Shukla,Solon Barocas,Alexandra Chouldechova,Eugenia Kim,Jennifer Wortman Vaughan*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文指出现有AI儿童安全评估缺乏对青少年真实世界伤害的落地考量，通过访谈19位直接与高风险青少年打交道的从业者（社工、心理治疗师、心理学家），识别聊天机器人在应对青少年高风险情境时可能造成伤害的行为和有益行为，并据此为AI儿童安全评估与基础设施提供改进建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 青少年日益依赖AI聊天机器人获取社交与情感支持，但现有AI儿童安全评估存在三大局限：缺乏基于青少年真实世界伤害的评估依据、对"适当输出"（如拒答）的假设未经验证、仅关注对抗性提示检测或输出层面的表面伤害，导致无法检测出实际对青少年造成伤害的回应。

Method: 采用质性研究方法，对19位直接与高风险青少年群体工作的从业者（包括社会工作者、心理治疗师和心理学家）进行访谈。访谈中请从业者基于先前实证研究确立的青少年常见风险情境，反思聊天机器人的回应。通过从业者的专业视角识别可能造成伤害的聊天机器人行为、能够有效支持青少年的行为、讨论聊天机器人应/不应扮演的角色，并收集具体改进建议。

Result: 从业者识别出了聊天机器人可能导致伤害的行为以及能在困难时刻有意义地支持青少年的行为，讨论了聊天机器人在这些互动中应（和不应）扮演的角色，并给出了改善聊天机器人回应的具体建议。

Conclusion: 基于研究发现，作者为AI儿童安全评估和基础设施提供了建议，强调将从业者的视角纳入安全工作的必要性。

Abstract: Youth increasingly turn to AI chatbots for social and emotional support, raising concerns about how these systems respond, especially in high-stakes situations. However, existing child safety evaluations of AI lack grounding in real-world harms that youth experience, rely on unvalidated assumptions about what counts as an appropriate output (e.g., refusal), and typically focus on detecting adversarial prompts or surface-level harms in outputs only. Thus, these evaluations can fail to detect responses that pose harm to youth in practice. To better understand the limitations of current evaluation practices, we conducted interviews with 19 practitioners working directly with youth in vulnerable situations, including social workers, therapists, and psychologists, asking them to reflect on chatbots' responses to risky situations commonly faced by youth, as established in prior empirical work. Practitioners identified chatbot behaviors likely to cause harm as well as those that could meaningfully support youth in difficult moments, discussed the role that chatbots should (and should not) play in these interactions, and offered concrete recommendations for improving chatbot responses. Based on these findings, we provide recommendations for AI child safety evaluation and infrastructure, and highlight the need for incorporating practitioners' perspectives into safety work.

</details>


### [361] [Representational Equality in Cross-country Value Simulation: A Systematic Analysis of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08058)
*Xiaowen Jian,Xinyi Mou,Daisong Gong,Chen Qian,Huimin Chen,Maosong Sun*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究系统性地考察了大语言模型（LLM）在模拟人类意见时的国家层面代表性平等问题，覆盖59个国家。研究发现来自更富裕和技术更先进国家的人群被模拟得更为准确，存在显著的系统性不平等。研究比较了情境适应和参数修改两条干预路径，发现准确率的提升并不必然带来代表性平等的改善，并针对不同干预方法给出了具体建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM作为人类意见模拟工具的规模化应用需要同时满足高平均准确率和代表性平等（即在各人群间的模拟准确率相当）。不均匀的模拟准确率可能在下游应用中复制或放大社会偏见，但目前缺乏系统性的国家层面考察。

Method: 该研究在59个国家中系统性地测量了LLM模拟人类意见的国家层面代表性平等程度，并比较了两类干预路径：（1）情境适应（如母语提示、补充信息）；（2）参数修改（如语言特定持续后训练、偏好对齐）。研究分别评估这些方法对平均准确率和代表性平等的影响。

Result: 研究发现：富裕和技术先进国家的人群被模拟得更准确，存在显著的系统性不平等。母语提示通常能提升准确率但依赖模型；补充更多信息通常同时改善准确率和平等性；语言特定持续后训练能提升目标语言群体的准确率但不均衡；偏好对齐未带来系统性改善；人工标注的偏好数据优于AI标注数据。

Conclusion: 研究强调在追求准确率的同时必须关注代表性平等，为构建更具包容性和社会责任感的LLM模拟系统提供了指导。改进平均或目标群体准确率并不一定能转化为更大的代表性平等。

Abstract: Traditional methods for studying human opinions often struggle to support representative and scalable research across countries. Large language models (LLMs) can serve as scalable proxies for simulating human opinions, enabling more efficient opinion analysis. However, this use of LLMs requires not only high average accuracy but also representational equality, that is, comparable simulation accuracy across populations. Uneven simulation accuracy may reproduce or amplify societal biases in downstream applications. This study systematically investigates country-level representational equality across 59 countries and finds substantial, systematic inequality. Populations from wealthier and more technologically advanced countries are simulated more accurately. We further compare two foundational intervention pathways, contextual adaptation and parametric modification, and show that improvements in average or target-group accuracy do not necessarily translate into greater representational equality. For contextual adaptation, native-language prompting generally improves accuracy but remains model-dependent, whereas additional information more often improves both accuracy and equality. For parametric modification, language-specific continued post-training improves accuracy for targeted language groups but unevenly, while preference alignment yields no systematic gains in accuracy or equality. Human-annotated preference data generally preserve accuracy better than AI-annotated data. These findings highlight the need for representational equality alongside accuracy and offer guidance for more inclusive, socially responsible LLM-based simulations.

</details>


### [362] [Abstracted Away: Resisting Alienation and Ungrounded Abstraction in AI Research Communities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08408)
*Vyoma Raman,Isabel O. Gallegos,Neha Srivathsa*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过三位早期职业关键AI研究者的自民族志研究，探讨了计算AI研究中的"抽象"逻辑如何作为社会规范造成研究者的疏离感（alienation），并构建了一个解释疏离感的解释性框架，提出"情感抽象"是可通过情感觉察和集体行动来抵抗的高杠杆机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算AI研究中的抽象逻辑将重要的知识与反思形式边缘化：合法性标准脱离伤害的真实经验、工作目标与实践错位、职业压力挤占批判性反思。尽管已有学术和社区努力试图重新情境化并挑战常见实践，但社会技术伤害和认知不公正仍在持续。研究者本人经历疏离感——在研究社区中感觉像局外人，这促使他们系统性地探究这一现象的根源。

Method: 采用自民族志（autoethnographic）研究方法，三位作者叙述了三段在研究社区中遭遇和抵抗疏离感的个人叙事片段（vignettes），通过跨案例的主题分析，构建了疏离感的解释性框架，将其区分为前置条件（preconditions）、机制（mechanisms）和伤害（harms），并识别出"情感抽象"（affect abstraction）作为关键机制。

Result: 构建了一个疏离感的解释性框架，分类了其前置条件、机制和伤害；识别出"情感抽象"作为高杠杆的疏离机制，可通过保持对情感反应的觉察来抵抗；提出集体行动可作为减少抵抗风险和孤立感的途径；将该框架呈现为一种诠释学资源（hermeneutic resource）供他人反思使用。

Conclusion: 批判性自我反思和意义建构是挑战排他性学科规范、培育更具包容性的AI研究形式的必要步骤。该框架可作为帮助研究者识别和抵抗疏离感的诠释学工具。

Abstract: Logics of abstraction in computational AI research often push important forms of knowledge and reflection aside: dominant standards of legitimacy separate from lived experience of harm; the goals of work misalign with the practices that operationalize them; and career demands crowd out critical reflection. Even as prior academic and community-oriented efforts have sought to recontextualize and challenge common practices, exposure to sociotechnical harms and epistemic injustice persists. As three early-career critical AI researchers, we experienced this as alienation: feeling like outsiders in our research communities. This alienation has involved having some aspects of our backgrounds overlooked and others tokenized. We argue our alienation occurred through mechanisms that mirror abstraction by creating distance from relevant material realities. Beyond abstraction's role in computational AI research as a foundational practice structuring complex computational tasks, we have encountered it as a social norm in computational research spaces, illustrated through an autoethnographic inquiry into our alienation. We narrate three vignettes describing how we encountered and resisted alienation in our research communities. By analyzing themes across these accounts, we construct an interpretive framework of alienation categorizing its preconditions, mechanisms, and harms. Finally, we identify affect abstraction, one of the mechanisms of alienation we describe, as a high-leverage mechanism that is resistible by staying attuned to our affective responses, and collective action as a way to reduce risk and isolation when engaging in resistance. To assist others with similar reflection, we present our framework as a hermeneutic resource. Critical self-reflection and meaning-making are necessary steps toward challenging exclusionary disciplinary norms and cultivating more inclusive forms of AI research.

</details>


### [363] [Rethinking Higher Education: From Fixed Curricula to Learnity Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08543)
*Smadar Szekely,Judith Gal-Ezer,David Harel*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个终身学习框架，将学术学习、专业学习与个人学习相整合，并引入了"learnity graphs"这一核心概念——将学习表示为知识、技能、经验和实际工件相互连接的结构化图谱，同时提供相应的呈现与利用方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在人工智能日益普及、知识获取日益便捷的时代，传统高等教育课程模式的价值值得重新审视。大学在提供基础知识、理论深度和概念根基方面仍然不可或缺，但需要在此基础上拓展学习环境，以培养创造力、跨学科整合、动手实践能力和长期发展能力。

Method: 提出一个终身学习框架，将学术、职业和个人学习三个维度整合为一体；引入"learnity graphs"概念，将学习视为相互连接的知识、技能、经验和实际工件单元的结构化表示；并配套提供一种呈现和利用该图谱的方法。

Result: 论文提出了一种概念性框架（learnity graphs）及其应用方法，旨在扩展传统高等教育模式，融合多元化学习维度，但摘要中未提供具体的实验验证或定量结果。

Conclusion: 作者主张高等教育不应取代传统学术学习，而应通过引入终身学习框架和learnity graphs来延伸教育范畴，营造能够促进创造力、跨学科整合、实践经验和长期发展的学习环境。

Abstract: Higher education stands at a turning point. In an era where knowledge is increasingly accessible and which is, more often than not, mediated by advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI), the value of traditional curricula models warrants reconsideration. This does not imply that one should replace thorough academic studies. Universities remain essential in providing foundational knowledge, theoretical depth and conceptual grounding. The challenge is to extend these educational facets with learning environments that foster creativity, interdisciplinary integration, hands-on experience, and especially long-term development. In this paper, we introduce a lifelong learning framework that integrates academic, professional, and personal learning, centered on a new concept that we term learnity graphs, a structured representation of learning as interconnected units of knowledge, skills, experience, and actual artifacts, coupled with a method for presenting, and leveraging it.

</details>


### [364] [Qualifying and Quantifying Risk under the EU AI Act](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08564)
*Gustavo Gil Gasiola,Sarah H. Cen,Frederike Zufall*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文探讨欧盟《人工智能法案》(EU AI Act)中风险定义的内在张力——即"风险"作为概率与严重性组合的概念暗示量化，但法案聚焦于基本权利风险又偏向定性视角。作者提出一个两步框架来平衡基本权利保护、提供者与部署者的合法目的以及监管措施的影响，并建议采用"严重性优先"(severity-first)方法，最后警示风险量化可能被操纵导致"风险黑客"问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 欧盟AI法案采用基于风险的分级监管方法，但其"风险"概念（概率×严重性）隐含量化需求，而法案聚焦基本权利风险又天然具有定性特征。这种量化与定性之间的张力需要澄清，以避免监管实践中的混乱和操纵漏洞。

Method: 提出一个两步框架：（1）在基本权利保护、提供者/部署者的合法目的与监管措施影响之间进行平衡；（2）针对风险概念的核心组件（概率、严重性及其组合方式）展开讨论，并提出"严重性优先"方法——先评估损害的严重性，再考虑其发生概率。

Result: 研究表明，基本权利保护与风险量化可以在所提出的框架内实现对齐。该框架有助于厘清AI法案的风险分级方法，并能为技术和实施选择提供指导。同时，文章指出了"风险黑客"风险——如果风险量化由AI提供者和部署者自主进行，他们可能操纵评估导致AI系统被低估分类，从而规避监管。

Conclusion: 欧盟AI法案的风险方法需要整合量化与定性视角，采用"严重性优先"的平衡分析框架是可行路径。监管设计必须警惕提供者和部署者对风险量化的操纵，防止风险分类漏洞削弱法案的保护效力。

Abstract: The EU AI Act uses a risk-based approach to regulate AI systems, calibrating the intensity of regulation according to the risks they pose. While the AI Act's definition of 'risk' (as the combination of the probability and severity of harm) implies quantification, the AI Act focuses on risks to fundamental rights, thereby engaging a typically qualitative perspective. In this piece, we address this tension using a two-step framework under which the EU AI Act balances the protection of fundamental rights, the legitimate purposes of providers and deployers, and the impacts of regulatory measures on providers, deployers, and regulators. We discuss this framework against the backdrop of potential approaches to quantifying risks, with a specific focus on defining and measuring the main components of the concept of risk: 'probability', 'severity', and their 'combination'. We suggest that the protection of fundamental rights and risk quantification can be aligned within the proposed framework. In particular, the AI Act implies a balancing analysis that uses what we call a 'severity-first' approach in which the severity of a harm is considered before the harm's probability of occurring. The integrated framework not only helps to clarify the AI Act's risk-based approach, but can also inform technical and implementation choices. Finally, we discuss the potential for 'risk hacking' if risk quantification is left to AI providers and deployers, who may manipulate the approach, which could lead to the underclassification of AI systems and subsequent regulatory shortcuts.

</details>


### [365] [Automating Freshman Course Placement and Registration: A Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08776)
*Bharathwaj Vijayakumar,Samyukta Alapati,Sahana Varadaraju*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文报告了Rowan大学将新生课程分班和注册流程自动化的实施案例。面对十年间新生入学人数57%的增长，该校跨部门团队开发了一套自动化系统，整合Banner学生信息系统、Google Sheets等数据源，实现新生批量课程分类、分班和注册，服务了超过3500名新生，每年节省350多个工时，减少了人工错误，使员工从行政工作转向战略性指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Rowan大学传统的新生课程分班和注册依赖人工执行，需要Testing Services、University Advising和Registrar's Office投入大量时间。由于十年间新生入学人数激增57%，人工流程变得越来越不可持续，亟需自动化解决方案来应对不断增长的注册需求。

Method: 跨部门团队开发了一套全面的自动化流程，主要包括：整合Banner（学生信息系统）、Google Sheets（由Advising维护）及其他来源的数据；根据项目分组对学生进行分类；确定主要和次要课程分班；实时检查Banner中的可用性和约束条件；并以批量方式完成新生课程注册。

Result: 该系统成功处理了超过3500名新生，每年节省超过350个工时，降低人为错误的可能性，并使员工能够将工作重心从行政事务转向战略性的学生指导。

Conclusion: 该报告阐述了实施背景、设计架构、技术整合、评估方法、经验教训以及对面临类似挑战的高校的实际启示，为其他院校提供了可借鉴的自动化分班与注册流程参考。

Abstract: This implementation report explores Rowan University's effort to automate the process of freshman course placement and registration. Historically, Freshman Instructional Guides (FIGS) at Rowan was manually executed, requiring significant time from Testing Services, University Advising, and the Registrar's Office to evaluate placement needs and assign students to courses. Given the 57% surge in first-time degree-seeking student enrollment over a decade, the manual processes became increasingly unsustainable. In response, a cross-departmental team developed a comprehensive automated process to integrate data from Banner (Student Information System), Google Sheets maintained by Advising, and other sources. This automated process classifies students based on program groupings, determines primary and secondary course placements, checks for real-time availability and constraints in Banner, and completes course registration for freshmen in bulk. The resulting system processed over 3500 incoming students with over 350 hours in annual time savings, reduced the potential for human error, and enabled staff to shift focus from administrative work to strategic advising. This report outlines the implementation context, design architecture, technical integration, assessment methods, lessons learned, and practical implications for institutions with similar challenges.

</details>


### [366] [Data Findability, Governance, and Community Engagement for Māori Research Data Sovereignty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08905)
*Paul T. Brown,Kiri West,Maree Sheehan,Hana Rapata,Te Taka Keegan*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出了"毛利研究数据主权"(MRDSov)概念，将毛利数据主权(MDSov)原则扩展到研究数据及研究数据生命周期的具体情境中，并提出三个相互依存的要素（数据可发现性、数据治理、社区参与）来操作化这些原则，为研究机构提供了一条将研究数据实践与《怀唐伊条约》义务和原住民数据治理期望对齐的实际路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 毛利数据主权原则已经确立，但相对较少关注这些原则如何在研究机构中操作化。研究机构在日常运作中收集和使用毛利数据，需要具体的概念框架来指导实践。

Method: 借鉴原住民数据主权学术研究和研究数据管理文献，定义毛利研究数据，提出MRDSov作为MDSov原则在研究数据情境中的应用，并论证操作化所需的三个相互依存要素：数据可发现性、数据治理和社区参与。

Result: 提出了一个概念框架，展示了三个要素如何共同在机构研究环境中实现MDSov原则，为大学和其他研究组织嵌入毛利权威、问责制和关系提供了实践路径。

Conclusion: MRDSov为研究机构提供了将毛利数据主权原则贯穿于整个研究数据生命周期的概念工具，有助于满足《怀唐伊条约》义务和原住民数据治理期望。

Abstract: Māori data sovereignty (MDSov) has established important principles for recognising Māori rights and interests in data. Relatively little attention has been given to how these principles can be operationalised within research institutions who, as a function of their operations, collect and use Māori data. This paper introduces the concept of Māori Research Data Sovereignty (MRDSov), extending existing understandings of MDSov into the specific context of research data and the research data lifecycle. Drawing on Indigenous Data Sovereignty scholarship and research data management literature, we define Māori research data and position MRDSov as the application of MDSov principles to research data produced by, about, or for Māori. We argue that operationalising MRDSov requires three interdependent elements: data findability, data governance, and community engagement. Data findability enables Māori research data to be identified and contextualised; governance provides mechanisms through which Māori authority over research data can be exercised; and community engagement grounds both in enduring relationships with Māori communities. We further demonstrate how these elements collectively enact the principles of MDSov within institutional research settings, providing a practical pathway for aligning research data practices with Te Tiriti o Waitangi obligations and Indigenous data governance expectations. The paper contributes a conceptual framework for universities and other research organisations seeking to embed Māori authority, accountability, and relationships throughout the research data lifecycle.

</details>


### [367] [AI-AI co-creation outperforms human pairs in creative tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09023)
*Yingyue Luna Luan,Luning Sun,Yeun Joon Kim,Jindong Wang,Xing Xie*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文挑战了以往研究中"AI创造力有限"的结论，通过实验证明结构化、迭代的多智能体AI共创（尤其是互补角色分工）在创造力和新颖性上能超越单AI和人类配对。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往研究发现AI创造力受限，单系统很少超越人类，人机协作也不优于人类产出。作者认为这些结论低估了AI潜力，因为大多数研究未允许迭代的多智能体交换，而这类机制正是人类创造力的社会性基础。

Method: 设计了四种条件的对照实验：(i) AI-AI互补角色共创（生成者-评估者）、(ii) AI-AI相同角色共创、(iii) 单AI创作、以及(iv) 人类-人类共创。在三个开放式任务中，由训练有素的评审对1,212个创意进行创造力、新颖性和有用性评分。

Result: 两种AI-AI共创条件在创造力和新颖性上均一致优于单AI创作和人类配对。有用性因任务而异：在范围最广、社会复杂度最高的任务中，互补角色产生了最有用的解决方案，表明当问题需要兼顾想象性构思和实用性完善时，角色分化具有优势。人类配对表现最差，符合群体创造中的生产损失现象。

Conclusion: 结构化、迭代的多智能体AI共创可以超越单AI和人类-人类构思，揭示了AI创造力的更大潜力，并强调了角色分工与迭代交互机制的重要性。

Abstract: Prior research often finds that AI creativity is limited: single systems rarely outperform humans, and human-AI collaboration does not exceed human output. We argue these conclusions underestimate AI's potential because most studies do not allow iterative, multi-agent exchanges that mirror the social processes underpinning human creativity. We conducted an experiment comparing four conditions: (i) AI-AI co-creation with complementary generator-evaluator roles, (ii) AI-AI co-creation with identical roles, (iii) single-AI creation, and (iv) human-human co-creation. Across three open-ended tasks, 1,212 ideas were rated by trained judges on creativity, novelty, and usefulness. Both AI-AI co-creation conditions consistently outperformed single-AI creation and human pairs on creativity and novelty. Usefulness varied by task: complementary roles yielded the most useful solutions in the broadest and most socially complex task, suggesting role differentiation is advantageous when problems require both imaginative ideation and practical refinement. Human pairs performed worst, consistent with production losses in group creativity. These findings indicate that structured, iterative multi-agent AI co-creation can exceed single-AI and human-human ideation.

</details>


### [368] [Foundational values for foundation models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09377)
*John S. H. Baxter,Elodie Germani*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文探讨了研究价值观如何影响医学影像机器学习中基础模型（foundation models）的技术决策，通过苏格拉底式方法分析研究人员在其出版物中为使用或放弃使用基础模型所提供的详细论证，旨在阐明基础模型如何融入医学机器学习的哲学框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解研究价值观如何直接和间接地影响技术研究，特别是在医学影像机器学习领域，有助于解释研究人员为何在出版物中做出特定技术决策，以及为何某些技术（如基础模型）在文献和临床中变得普遍或不被采用。

Method: 本文采用苏格拉底式（Socratic approach）研究方法，对医学影像机器学习中基础模型这一特定技术决策进行研究，分析研究人员为使用或弃用基础模型所提出的详细论证和理由，从而揭示其背后的研究价值观。

Result: 研究发现基础模型的使用和放弃使用都有详细的论证依据，这些论证反映了不同的研究价值观，并最终影响了该技术在文献和临床中的普及程度。

Conclusion: 本文通过阐明基础模型在医学机器学习哲学中的定位，揭示了价值观如何驱动技术决策，为理解特定技术在科学文献和临床实践中的兴衰提供了哲学视角。

Abstract: Research values, properties with a distinctive normative dimension, often affect how technological research is performed in both direct and indirect ways by influencing how technical decisions are made. In machine learning for medical imaging, understanding these values can be important for understanding why particular researchers justify the decisions made in their publications and explain why certain technologies become ubiquitous (or not) in the scientific literature and in the clinic. This article explores one of these technologies, foundation models, finding detailed justifications both for their use and abstention from their use. By taking a Socratic approach to research values arising from this specific technical decision, this article aims to better illustrate how foundation models fit into the philosophy of machine learning in medicine.

</details>


<div id='math.OC'></div>

# math.OC [[Back]](#toc)

### [369] [The cosine measure of a function at a point](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07716)
*Warren Hare,Gabriel Jarry-Bolduc,Chayne Planiden*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究了向量集合余弦测度在非光滑函数或梯度为零情形下的推广，提出了"函数的余弦测度"这一新概念，并给出了相应的数学理论、计算算法及示例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的余弦测度刻画了向量集合覆盖方向的程度，其大于零等价于对任意光滑函数（梯度非零处），集合中必含下降方向。然而当函数不可微或梯度为零向量时，该框架失效，需要新的理论工具来分析。

Method: 引入"函数的余弦测度"这一新概念，定义为保证集合包含函数在给定点下降方向所需的向量集合余弦测度的下确界。在此基础上建立数学理论，证明光滑函数的余弦测度可取[-1,1]中任意值，并提出计算算法，同时应用于光滑和非光滑函数示例。

Result: 建立了函数余弦测度的完整数学理论；证明了该概念可推广至非光滑情形；给出光滑函数余弦测度可达任意值[-1,1]的示例；提出了计算算法并在光滑与非光滑函数上进行了演示；该研究还揭示了无限集合和非凸锥的余弦测度性质。

Conclusion: 函数的余弦测度概念的提出，将余弦测度的应用从逐点光滑、梯度非零的框架推广到了更一般的情形，丰富了优化算法收敛性理论的分析工具，并为理解无限集合与非凸锥的几何性质提供了新视角。

Abstract: The cosine measure of a set of vectors in $\mathbb{R}^n$ measures how well the set covers all directions in $\mathbb{R}^n$. It identifies the direction furthest, in angle, from the set. It is used in the convergence theory of various optimization algorithms, but also highlights interesting geometric properties of sets. For example, the cosine measure of a set $S$ is greater than zero if and only if given any $\mathcal{C}^1$ function $f$ at a point $\mathbf{x}$ where the gradient is nonzero, $S$ must contain a descent direction of $f$ at $\mathbf{x}$. In this paper, we examine the question of what can be said when the function $f$ is non-differentiable or if it has a gradient equal to the zero vector. To examine these cases, we introduce the novel concept of the {\em cosine measure of a function} at a point. This value provides an infimum on the value of the cosine measure that a set of vectors requires to guarantee it contains a descent direction of the function at the point of interest. We present mathematical theory around this concept, including examples showing that the cosine measure of a smooth function can have any value in $[-1,1]$. We further present algorithms to compute the cosine measure of a function, and examples demonstrating the algorithm on smooth and nonsmooth functions. These results also shed light on the the cosine measure of infinite sets and nonconvex cones.

</details>


### [370] [Universal Birkhoff Method for Computing Extremals in the Elliptic Restricted Three-Body Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07815)
*Michael J. Dixon,Isaac M. Ross*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究了椭圆限制性三体问题中有限推力极值弧的计算问题。利用Chebyshev-Gauss-Lobatto点采样状态向量的快速傅里叶变换，将平动点轨道近似到近机器精度。通过庞特里亚金原理推导了最小时间和时间约束最小推进剂问题的可检验最优性条件，包括最优出发和到达点的判据。将通用Birkhoff轨迹优化理论与快速无猜测谱算法相结合生成候选最优解，并通过哈密顿量最小化条件和横截条件验证解的极值性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 椭圆限制性三体问题中的有限推力轨迹优化是一个具有挑战性的问题，传统方法通常需要动力学系统理论的初始猜测或辅助。作者希望开发一种无需初始化即可生成可验证极值解的算法。

Method: 1) 使用Chebyshev-Gauss-Lobatto点采样和FFT近似平动点轨道至近机器精度；2) 应用庞特里亚金原理推导最小时间和最小推进剂问题的最优性必要条件；3) 采用与比冲无关、呈余弦项平方反比变化的推进剂消耗计算模型；4) 结合Birkhoff轨迹优化理论和快速无猜测谱算法生成候选解；5) 通过哈密顿量最小化条件和横截条件验证极值性。

Result: Birkhoff理论谱算法能够在没有任何动力学系统理论辅助或初始化的情况下生成可验证的极值解，并通过哈密顿量最小化条件和横截条件成功验证了解的极值性。

Conclusion: 该研究表明Birkhoff理论谱算法是一种强大且自足的工具，能够在无初始猜测的情况下为椭圆限制性三体有限推力轨迹优化问题生成可验证的极值解，为深空任务轨迹设计提供了新的计算途径。

Abstract: The computation of finite-thrust extremal arcs in the elliptic restricted three-body trajectory optimization problem is considered. Libration-point orbits are approximated to near-machine precision using a fast Fourier transform of the sampled values of the state vector at Chebyshev-Gauss-Lobatto points. Checkable optimality conditions are derived by applying Pontryagin's principle to minimum-time and time-constrained minimum-propellant problems. These necessary conditions include criteria for optimal departure and arrival points. For propellant consumption, a recently developed computational model is employed. This model is agnostic to the specific impulse of the propellant and varies as the inverse quadratic of a cosine term. Candidate optimal solutions are generated by combining the universal Birkhoff theory for trajectory optimization with the fast, guess-free spectral algorithm. The extremality of the Birkhoff-computed solution is validated against the Hamiltonian minimization condition and the transversality conditions. It is shown that the Birkhoff-theoretic spectral algorithm can generate verifiable extremals without any assistance or initialization from dynamical systems theory.

</details>


### [371] [The Rank-Collapse Principle for Quadratic Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07828)
*Mojtaba Soltanalian,Ahmad Mousavi*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出"秩坍塌原理"（rank-collapse principle），统一解释了当二次型矩阵为正半定且秩固定时，许多看似困难的二次优化问题可被精确多项式时间求解的现象。该原理表明最优解在低维影子空间中表现为自生成的线性曝光方向，并进一步区分了投影影子散射与活动结构坍塌两种情形，建立了与现有多种方法（zonotope、凸组合、边骨架、投影法锥、固定秩稀疏PCA）的明确联系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二次优化问题在矩阵曲率不利或可行集非凸/离散时通常变得困难，但已有观察表明当二次型矩阵秩较小时，某些看似困难的问题在固定秩下存在精确多项式时间算法。然而这一现象背后的统一几何本质此前缺乏系统化的阐明，作者旨在寻找并建立其共同的正半定几何框架。

Method: 作者将正半定矩阵分解为Q=BB^⊤，利用目标函数仅通过秩空间影子y=B^⊤x依赖于x这一关键性质提出秩坍塌原理。该原理断言每个最优影子y*在其自身方向上唯一最大化线性泛函，并满足定量二次余量。作者据此划分投影影子散射与活动结构坍塌两种情况，并通过后者获得有限候选集以实现精确优化，同时给出方向稳定性和近似低秩证书。

Result: 建立了统一且严谨的分析框架，明确阐述了秩坍塌原理，将其与已有的zonotope、凸组合、边骨架、投影法锥和固定秩稀疏PCA等经典方法建立显式关联，并为二元/有限相位向量、基数约束、拟阵基和稀疏PCA推导出了安全的全等（tie-safe）结论，还提供了方向稳定性与近似低秩证书以及可复现的实验。

Conclusion: 本文的贡献在于提供一个统一的框架和一组定量的推论，而非声称原创这些已知的固定秩可处理性结果。该框架增进了对低秩二次优化可处理性的几何理解，并为未来设计算法与理论分析提供了新的视角。

Abstract: Quadratic optimization becomes hard as soon as either the matrix in the quadratic form has an unfavorable curvature or the feasible set is discrete, combinatorial, or otherwise nonconvex. A complementary phenomenon is also well known in the signal-processing and optimization communities: when the matrix in the quadratic form has small rank, some hard-looking quadratic programs admit exact polynomial-time algorithms for fixed rank. We study the common positive-semidefinite geometry behind this phenomenon. If $Q=BB^\top$ is positive semidefinite, the objective depends on $x$ only through the rank-space shadow $y=B^\top x$. Every optimal shadow $y^*$ uniquely maximizes the linear functional defined by its own direction and satisfies a quantitative quadratic margin. Thus nonlinear optimality collapses to a low-dimensional, self-generated linear exposure direction. We call this the rank-collapse principle. The principle alone does not imply a finite candidate set: efficient exact optimization additionally depends on the projected or active geometry of the feasible family. We organize this distinction through projected-shadow scattering and active-structure collapse, relate it explicitly to established zonotope, convex-combinatorial, edge-skeleton, projected-normal-fan, and fixed-rank sparse-PCA methods, and derive tie-safe consequences for binary and finite-phase vectors, cardinality constraints, matroid bases, and sparse PCA. We also give directional-stability and approximately low-rank certificates, together with reproducible experiments. The paper's contribution is a unified, careful framework and a set of quantitative consequences, rather than a claim to originate the known fixed-rank tractability results that motivate it.

</details>


### [372] [Zeroth-Order Langevin Monte Carlo via SPSA under Noisy Function Measurements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07837)
*Hongbo Li,James C. Spall*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出LMC-SPSA with noise，一种在梯度不可用且函数评估含噪声场景下的采样方法，通过每次迭代仅用两次含噪函数评估来近似目标对数密度的梯度，并在Wasserstein距离下证明其收敛性，将维度依赖从O(p⁴)改进到O(p²)，总噪声oracle复杂度为O(p/ε²+δ²p³/ε³)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 梯度类采样方法（如LMC）混合速度更快，但现实问题中（如随机模拟器或黑箱模拟器）梯度往往不可用且函数评估含噪声，需要一种无需梯度的采样方案，同时保证收敛性和效率。

Method: 提出LMC-SPSA with noise，利用同步扰动随机逼近（SPSA）思想，通过每次迭代两次含噪函数评估来近似梯度。证明在含噪梯度估计下Wasserstein距离收敛；构造递减步长调度以扩展到常数步长之外的收敛保证；改进Wasserstein误差的维度依赖性。

Result: 将Wasserstein误差的维度依赖从O(p⁴)改进到O(p²)；实现W₂精度ε的总噪声oracle复杂度为O(p/ε²+δ²p³/ε³)，改进了ZO-LMC方法的噪声依赖精度缩放；在递减步长和扰动序列下建立渐近收敛的Wasserstein误差及显式收敛率；数值实验验证了在相同函数评估预算下比ZO-LMC有更小的经验采样误差。

Conclusion: LMC-SPSA with noise为黑箱/含噪采样问题提供了高效且理论完备的解决方案，在维度依赖和噪声容忍性上均优于现有零阶LMC方法，并通过oracle预算匹配的实验验证了其实用优越性。

Abstract: In sampling problems, gradient-based schemes such as Langevin Monte Carlo (LMC) mix faster than non-gradient-based methods, but their applicability is limited by access to the gradient of the target log-density. In practice, gradients are often unavailable and function evaluations are noisy, e.g., stochastic simulators or black-box simulators, so we propose LMC-SPSA with noise, which approximates the gradient of the target log-density using two noisy function evaluations per iteration. We prove, under noisy gradient estimates, that LMC-SPSA converges in distribution by proving the convergence in Wasserstein distance. Furthermore, we construct a diminishing step-size schedule that still drives the Wasserstein error bound to convergence, extending convergence guarantees beyond the constant-step setting. Further, we sharpen the dominant dimension dependence of the Wasserstein error from $O(p^4)$ to $O(p^2)$ (with $p$ denoting the dimension), and support this analysis with numerical results. We show that LMC-SPSA achieves $W_2$-accuracy $\varepsilon$ with total noisy-oracle complexity of $O(p/\varepsilon^2+δ^2p^3/\varepsilon^3)$, where $δ$ is the paired-noise level. This improves the noise-dependent accuracy scaling relative to the ZO-LMC method of Roy et al. We further establish asymptotically vanishing Wasserstein error as the number of iterations $\to\infty$ under diminishing step-size and perturbation sequences and derive an explicit convergence rate for a balanced schedule under noisy zeroth-order feedback. Empirical experiments are conducted to verify the performance of LMC-SPSA with noise. We provide an oracle-budget-matched comparison with the ZO-LMC method, showing smaller empirical sampling errors under the same function-evaluation budget.

</details>


### [373] [Computing the Maximal Controlled Invariant Set for Neural Network Control Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07908)
*Tianxiao Ye,Hang Zhang,Xiangru Xu*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究神经网络控制系统（NNCSs）中最大控制不变集（MCIS）的计算问题，提出了一种基于区间的方法来构造控制仿射包含函数，并利用输入空间中的超平面排列将无限控制搜索简化为有限代表性评估，进而通过验证引导的迭代算法构建MCIS的内外近似。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络控制系统（NNCSs）中，计算最大控制不变集（MCIS）对于安全验证至关重要。然而，由于神经网络非线性动力学的复杂性，MCIS的精确计算通常涉及无限控制搜索，难以直接求解。

Method: 提出一种基于区间的方法：首先为NNCS动力学构造控制仿射包含函数，利用输入空间中诱导的超平面排列，将控制不变性的验证从无限控制搜索简化为有限个代表性评估；基于这一有限刻画，设计验证引导的迭代算法来构造MCIS的内逼近和外逼近，且算法天然可并行化。

Result: 数值实验表明所提出方法的有效性，能够成功计算神经网络控制系统的最大控制不变集的内外近似。

Conclusion: 通过区间方法与超平面排列的结合，本文成功将NNCS中MCIS的无限验证问题转化为有限评估问题，并提供了可并行化的迭代算法实现内外逼近，为神经网络控制系统的形式化安全验证提供了有效工具。

Abstract: This article studies the computation of the maximal controlled invariant set (MCIS) for neural network control systems (NNCSs) with a nominal plant model and a neural network residual model. An interval-based method is developed to construct a control-affine inclusion function for the NNCS dynamics and to exploit the induced hyperplane arrangement in the input space, which reduces the verification of controlled invariance from an infinite control search to a finite set of representative evaluations. Based on this finite characterization, verification-guided algorithms iteratively construct inner and outer approximations of the the MCIS, which are naturally parallelizable. Numerical examples demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

</details>


### [374] [Queueing Analysis and Cost Optimization in a Diagnostic--Treatment Hospital Queue with Heterogeneous Referred Patients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07967)
*Shobha Rani,Rohit Dehru,Raghu Nandan Sengupta*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本研究针对包含初诊患者（需诊断+治疗）和转诊患者（仅需治疗）的医院共享服务系统，构建了基于马尔可夫相位型队列的分析与决策框架。针对两种治疗方案推导了概率生成函数，针对任意n种治疗方案开发了矩阵解析方法，设计了一种负载触发控制机制来确定满足目标利用率所需的最小容量增量，并通过数值实验验证。最后证明总成本问题在倒数服务时间变量下具有严格凸重构和唯一全局最小值，并使用PSO、SA和SCA三种启发式算法作为独立求解器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医院服务系统面临两类患者（初诊和转诊）混合的复杂场景，现有研究缺乏统一的解析与决策框架来同时处理诊断-治疗流程差异、多种治疗方案并存下的性能分析与容量规划问题。

Method: 将系统建模为马尔可夫相位型队列；对两种治疗方案情形推导概率生成函数，对任意n种治疗方案采用矩阵解析方法；设计负载触发控制确定最小容量增量；将总成本问题转化为倒数服务时间变量的严格凸优化问题，并用PSO、SA、SCA三种启发式算法独立求解。

Result: 推导并解释了关键性能指标；数值实验验证了解析结果的正确性；总成本问题被证明可在倒数服务时间变量下严格凸重构并存在唯一全局最小值；三种启发式算法作为独立求解器提供了有效的补充求解方案。

Conclusion: 该研究为混合患者群体的医院池化服务系统提供了完整的解析分析与优化决策框架，兼具理论严谨性和实际可用性，可用于指导医院在多元治疗模式下的容量配置与成本控制。

Abstract: This study develops an analytical and decision framework for a pooled hospital service comprising first-time patients who require diagnosis followed by treatment and referred patients who require only their prescribed treatment mode. The system is represented as a Markovian phase-type queue. probability generating functions are derived for two-treatment cases, while a matrix-analytic method is developed for an arbitrary number $n$ of treatment modes. The key performance measures are derived and interpreted. A load-triggered control is designed to determine the minimum capacity increment required to achieve a prescribed utilization level. Numerical experiments are conducted to validate the analytical results. Furthermore, the total-cost problem admits a strictly convex reformulation in reciprocal service-time variables and has a unique global minimum. Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Simulated Annealing (SA), and the Sine Cosine Algorithm (SCA) are additionally used as independent heuristic solvers.

</details>


### [375] [A Computable Stochastic Riccati Equations Framework for Mean--Variance Portfolio Selection with Multifactor Stochastic Volatility Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07977)
*Zhecheng Huang,Guojiang Shao,Lei Wang,Qi Zhang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出一个可计算且可实证的连续时间均值-方差最优投资组合选择框架，该框架基于多因子随机波动率市场模型，利用随机Riccati方程和基于BSDE的迭代算法（结合Deep BSDE和DBDP方法）求解最优控制，并通过对数变换消除奇异性。实证结果表明该策略在回撤控制和下行风险保护方面优于基准策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续时间均值-方差最优投资组合选择问题在随机市场系数下计算困难，现有方法难以兼顾理论可计算性和实证可实现性。多因子随机波动率模型能捕捉状态依赖的风险溢价、随机波动率及动态跨资产相关性，但相应的最优控制问题涉及随机Riccati方程（SRE）的求解，该方程存在奇异性且难以直接数值求解，因此需要设计高效且稳定的计算方法。

Method: 1) 构建可处理的多因子随机波动率市场模型，将最优控制刻画为随机Riccati方程（SRE）；2) 设计迭代的BSDE-based程序，通过对SRE从上界和下界进行逼近，初始上下界由求解两个线性BSDE获得；3) 采用对数变换消除SRE中的奇异性；4) 使用Deep BSDE和DBDP两种方法求解变换后的方程；5) 利用线性BSDE边界作为初始值估计，提升Deep BSDE求解器的收敛速度和训练稳定性；6) 基于行业ETF数据进行实证验证。

Result: 基于行业ETF数据的实证实验表明，所提出的多因子均值-方差策略能够产生平滑的目标收益财富动态，在回撤控制和下行风险保护方面相较于基准策略有显著改进。这也证明了将随机Riccati方程、神经BSDE求解器和多因子市场建模相结合用于动态资产配置的实用潜力。

Conclusion: 该研究展示了随机Riccati方程、神经BSDE求解器与多因子市场建模三者结合的实用潜力，为连续时间均值-方差投资组合选择提供了可计算且可实证的完整框架，在风险管理和动态资产配置方面具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: We investigate a computable and empirically implementable framework for continuous-time mean--variance optimal portfolio selection with random market coefficients. The market model is built on a tractable multifactor stochastic volatility structure, which captures state-dependent risk premia, stochastic volatility, and dynamic cross-asset dependence. The optimal control is characterized by stochastic Riccati equations. On the computational side, we design an iterative BSDE-based procedure to approximate the stochastic Riccati equation from above and below, where the initial upper and lower bounds are obtained by solving two linear BSDEs. We then apply a logarithmic transformation to remove the singularity in the SRE, and solve the resulting transformed equation using both Deep BSDE and DBDP methods. The linear BSDE bounds also provide effective initial-value estimates, improving the convergence speed and training stability of the Deep BSDE solver. Empirical experiments based on sector ETF data show that the proposed multifactor mean--variance strategy produces smooth target-return wealth dynamics, with improved drawdown control and downside-risk protection relative to benchmark strategies. These results demonstrate the practical potential of combining stochastic Riccati equations, neural BSDE solvers, and multifactor market modeling for dynamic asset allocation.

</details>


### [376] [A Game-Theoretic Characterization of Feedback Capability for Fully Coupled Vector-Valued Nonparametric Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08028)
*Zhaobo Liu*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究离散时间系统中未知非线性函数与有界扰动下的反馈镇定问题。通过引入响应历史逃逸博弈，作者证明了在广义Lipschitz不确定性下，任意有限维耦合向量系统的反馈能力存在一个尖锐阈值 Γ_d，并识别出该阈值。标量系统的阈值为 3/2+√2，高维系统通过维度单调性与标量理论建立联系，且显式最近邻反馈律给出 Γ_d ≥ 2/√3 的下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标量系统在广义Lipschitz不确定性下的反馈镇定阈值已被精确刻画为 3/2+√2，但对于全耦合的向量值系统，由于缺乏标量序结构和区间递推工具，且坐标耦合阻碍了逐坐标降维，该问题一直悬而未决。本文旨在为任意有限维耦合系统建立严格的反馈能力阈值。

Method: 作者将镇定问题转化为一个响应历史逃逸博弈，其获胜条件要求状态在给定斜率下具有有限包络且状态半径无界。利用Borel决定性和斜率单调性定义独立博弈值 Γ_d。通过均匀次临界响应博弈控制器证明 L<Γ_d 时存在统一的因果反馈律镇定一切系统；通过基于Kirszbraun–Valentine扩张定理的Hilbert空间实现引理证明 L>Γ_d 时的不可能性。还构造了显式最近邻反馈律。

Result: 证明了任意有限维耦合向量系统存在有限严格反馈能力阈值并等于 Γ_d。标量情形 Γ_1=3/2+√2，维度单调性给出 Γ_d≤Γ_1，最近邻反馈律给出 Γ_d≥2/√3（如 Γ_2≥2/√3），保证任意有限维下阈值严格大于1。

Conclusion: 本文完整刻画了全耦合向量值离散时间系统在广义Lipschitz不确定性和有界扰动下的反馈镇定性临界条件，将标量理论推广到任意有限维，建立了博弈论与反馈镇定之间的深刻联系，并给出了具体维度下的数值下界。

Abstract: We study feedback stabilization for the discrete-time system $x_{t+1}=f(x_t)+u_t+w_{t+1}$ in $\mathbb{R}^d$ with unknown $f$ and arbitrary bounded disturbances. For scalar plants, the sharp feedback capability threshold under generalized Lipschitz uncertainty is $3/2+\sqrt{2}$. We treat fully coupled vector-valued systems, where scalar order and interval recursion are unavailable and coupling precludes a coordinatewise reduction. We introduce a response-history escape game whose winning condition requires a finite envelope at the prescribed slope and an unbounded state radius. Borel determinacy and slope monotonicity give an independently defined game value $Γ_d$. We prove that the plant problem admits a finite strict feedback capability threshold and identify it with $Γ_d$. If $L<Γ_d$, one causal feedback law stabilizes every plant in the uncertainty class against every bounded disturbance sequence. If $L>Γ_d$, then for every causal feedback law there exist a plant in the same class and a bounded disturbance sequence such that the closed-loop state sequence is unbounded. The threshold equivalence is proved through a uniform subcritical response-game controller and a Hilbert-space realization lemma based on the Kirszbraun--Valentine extension theorem. An explicit nearest-neighbor feedback law yields a lower bound strictly above one in every finite dimension, including $Γ_2\ge 2/\sqrt{3}$. Dimension monotonicity gives $Γ_d\leΓ_1$, and comparison with the scalar theory yields $Γ_1=3/2+\sqrt{2}$.

</details>


### [377] [Optimal cost of fast boundary controls for the one-dimensional heat equation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08041)
*Pierre Lissy*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究了热方程在(0,L)区间上的最优L2零控制成本，一端为齐次Dirichlet条件，另一端为Dirichlet边界控制。证明了当T趋近于0时，最优控制成本C_H(T,L)的渐近行为为exp(κ_*L²/T)，其中精确常数κ_*=Γ(1/4)⁴/(8π³)≈0.696601964842838，从而弥合了Lissy(2015)的下界与Dardé和Ervedoza(2019)的上界之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 热方程的最小时间零控制问题在最优控制理论中具有重要意义。此前，Lissy给出的下界常数与Dardé和Ervedoza给出的上界常数之间存在间隙，本文旨在精确确定最优控制成本的渐近常数，消除这一不确定性。

Method: 通过将Dardé和Ervedoza的上界常数从一个收敛级数表达式化简为闭式常数κ_*=Γ(1/4)⁴/(8π³)，并结合Lissy的下界结果，证明上下界重合，从而精确刻画了最优控制成本的指数渐近行为。常数通过Gamma函数表达，显示出与椭球面调和分析问题的深刻联系。

Result: 证明了当T→0⁺时，最优零控制成本满足C_H(T,L)=exp((κ_*L²+o(1))/T)，其中精确常数κ_*=Γ(1/4)⁴/(8π³)≈0.696601964842838。该常数与Dardé和Ervedoza的上界常数一致，且下界与上界吻合，完全解决了该问题。

Conclusion: 本文成功确定了热方程边界零控制问题在短时间范围内的精确渐近常数，闭合了此前文献中上下界之间的差距。该常数以闭式表示形式给出，为后续研究短时控制问题提供了精确的基准。

Abstract: We consider the heat equation on $(0,L)$ with homogeneous Dirichlet condition at one endpoint and a Dirichlet boundary control at the other. If \(C_{\mathrm H}(T,L)\) denotes the optimal \(L^2\) null-control cost for initial data in \(H^{-1}(0,L)\), we prove that \[
  C_{\mathrm H}(T,L)
  =
  \exp\left(\frac{κ_*L^2+o(1)}{T}\right),
  \qquad
  κ_*
  =
  \frac{Γ(\frac14)^4}{8π^3}
  \simeq
  0.696601964842838,
  \qquad T\to0^+. \] The constant \(κ_*\) coincides with the upper-bound constant obtained by Dardé and Ervedoza (2019, ANPDE), which was expressed there through a convergent series. This closes the gap between the lower bound obtained in by Lissy (2015, JDE) and the upper bound established by Dardé and Ervedoza.

</details>


### [378] [Learning under Opponent Unawareness in Linear-Quadratic Stochastic Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08268)
*Dantong Chu,Xuefeng Gao,Yufei Zhang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究无限时域、非零和线性二次随机博弈中，在"激进解耦"信息结构下（玩家互不知晓对方，只观察共同状态和自身行动历史），每个玩家独立运行单智能体ε-贪心迭代最小二乘算法的异步去中心化学习过程。证明尽管无法识别系统参数，学习动态仍几乎必然收敛到完全信息纳什均衡，并刻画了收敛速率。将该框架应用于动态古诺竞争（粘性价格），数值实验验证理论结果，并发现有限信息学习降低企业利润，高价格粘性下总剩余下降、市场集中度上升；公开披露总产出可加速收敛并缓解福利损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着企业越来越多地将机器学习用于战略决策，理解算法间的相互作用已成为运筹学和经济学的核心问题。现有文献大多假设玩家了解对手信息或采用耦合信息结构，而现实中企业往往是战略性地忽略对手，只基于自身观察进行学习。本文旨在回答：在极简信息条件下，去中心化学习能否收敛到完全信息纳什均衡？

Method: 本文采用动态博弈理论框架，研究无限时域非零和线性二次随机博弈。每个玩家在激进解耦信息结构下独立运行单智能体ε-贪心迭代最小二乘算法（异步去中心化学习），通过分析该学习动态的收敛性来证明其几乎必然收敛到完全信息纳什均衡，并刻画收敛速率。随后将框架应用于带粘性价格的动态古诺竞争模型，并通过数值实验验证。

Result: 1) 证明在无法识别系统参数的情况下，玩家的学习动态几乎必然收敛到完全信息纳什均衡，并给出了收敛速率刻画。2) 在动态古诺竞争中，数值实验表明有限信息学习在低和高价格粘性下均降低企业利润；高价格粘性下总剩余下降且市场集中度上升。3) 公开披露市场总产出的信息能显著加速收敛并缓解福利损失。

Conclusion: 本文从理论和数值两方面证明了即使在极端弱化信息条件下，简单去中心化学习算法也能实现纳什均衡收敛，为理解算法时代市场均衡提供了新视角。同时揭示了信息结构对市场福利的重要影响，并指出信息披露（如公开总产出）可作为缓解福利损失、加速收敛的干预手段，对市场设计具有政策启示。

Abstract: As firms increasingly deploy machine learning for strategic decision-making, understanding algorithmic interactions has become central to operations research and economics. This paper studies learning in infinite-horizon, nonzero-sum linear-quadratic stochastic games under a radically uncoupled information structure, where players are either unaware of opponents or strategically oblivious, observing only a common state and their own action history. Under this minimal information, we analyze an asynchronous decentralized learning process in which each player independently runs a single-agent $ε$-greedy iterated least-squares algorithm. We prove that, despite being unable to identify the system parameters, players' learning dynamics converge almost surely to the complete-information Nash equilibrium and characterize the convergence rate. We then apply the framework to a dynamic Cournot competition with sticky prices. Numerical experiments validate the theoretical results and show that learning under limited information reduces firm profits under both low and high price stickiness, while total surplus declines and market concentration increases when price stickiness is high. Publicly revealing aggregate market output substantially accelerates convergence and mitigates these welfare losses.

</details>


### [379] [Stability of MIMO PID With Backward Differences Under Fast Sampling: An Exact Spectral Criterion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08318)
*Zhaobo Liu,Yanyi Wu,Peng Zhang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文证明了对多变量状态空间被控对象，PID控制中采用后向差分实现微分作用时，无论采样周期多小，闭环系统都可能不稳定。精确的提升（lifting）模型揭示了由存储的上一个输出采样所创造的快特征值。在远离边界谱的条件下，稳定性等价于理想回路稳定性加上输出、输入和微分增益矩阵乘积的Schur稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后向差分是PID控制中实现微分作用的标准数字方法，但此前对其在多变量系统中的应用稳定性缺乏严格分析。本文旨在揭示这种看似合理的离散化方法在多变量情况下可能导致的本质不稳定性问题。

Method: 采用提升（lifting）技术分析精确离散化模型，考察后向差分实现所引入的额外动态，特别是由存储的上一输出采样产生的快特征值，并推导稳定性的充要条件。

Result: 证明即使采样周期趋于零，基于后向差分的PID实现仍可能不稳定。不稳定的根源在于提升模型中出现的快特征值。给出了远离边界谱时稳定性的等价条件：理想闭环稳定性加上三矩阵乘积（输出矩阵、输入矩阵和微分增益矩阵）的Schur稳定性。

Conclusion: 后向差分实现PID微分作用在多变量系统中存在固有的稳定性风险，不能仅通过减小采样周期来消除。实际应用中需检查所给出的矩阵乘积的Schur稳定条件，以确保闭环系统稳定。

Abstract: Backward differences are a standard digital realization of derivative action in proportional-integral-derivative control. This note proves that, for multivariable state-space plants, this implementation can be unstable no matter how small the sampling period is. The exact lifted model reveals fast eigenvalues created by the stored previous output sample. Away from boundary spectra, stability is equivalent to ideal loop stability plus Schur stability of the product of the output, input, and derivative gain matrices.

</details>


### [380] [Output tracking: an application for irrational SISO transfer functions and a survey for MIMO systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08342)
*Lucas Davron*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究了有限维线性时不变MIMO系统和无理SISO传递函数的输入-输出映射值域刻画问题，收集了有限维情形的主要结果，并改进了无理SISO传递函数跟踪问题的近期成果，使得可以完全描述系统在L²(0,∞)输入下的输出，并给出了多项式系数热方程的应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有限维系统输入-输出映射值域的理论虽然令人满意但文献分散稀少，缺乏系统性的整理；同时无理SISO传递函数的跟踪问题在L²(0,∞)输入下的输出描述尚不完整，需要进一步改进。

Method: 对于有限维MIMO系统，论文系统收集和整理了关于输入-输出映射值域刻画的主要结果；对于无理SISO传递函数，论文改进了已有的跟踪问题结果，通过新的技术手段使得能够对L²(0,∞)空间中的输入完全描述系统的输出。

Result: 有限维情形：完成了相关理论的系统性综述。无理SISO情形：实现了对L²(0,∞)输入下系统输出的完整描述，并成功将该方法应用于具有多项式系数的热方程。

Conclusion: 论文一方面为有限维系统的值域刻画提供了全面的理论汇编，另一方面在对无理传递函数系统输出描述方面取得了实质性进展，并通过热方程的实例验证了方法的有效性。

Abstract: In this paper we consider (MIMO) finite dimensional linear and time-invariant systems and irrational single-input single-output (SISO) transfer functions. In both cases our aim is to describe as best as possible the range of the input-output map $u(\cdot) \mapsto y(\cdot)$. The theory in finite dimension is quite satisfying but rather scarce, the first aim of this paper is to collect the main results in this direction in a comprehensive way. Our second aim is to improve a recent result on the tracking problem for irrational SISO transfer functions, allowing one to completely describe the outputs of such system for inputs $u \in L^2(0,\infty)$. An application is given for a heat equation with polynomial coefficients.

</details>


### [381] [Halpern Iteration Achieves $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(ε^{-1/p})$ $p$th-Order Oracle Complexity for Monotone Variational Inequalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08463)
*Lesi Chen,Xinliang Zhang,Hengyu Wang,Chengchang Liu,Yongchao Chen,Jingzhao Zhang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出Halpern-NPE方法，通过大步长不精确Halpern迭代解决光滑单调变分不等式（MVI）问题，达到$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{-2})$的收敛速度；并推广到p阶方法（ATM结合Halpern迭代），达到$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{-p})$的收敛率，优于所有p≥2的已有结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Monteiro和Svaiter提出的二阶方法NPE收敛率为$\mathcal{O}(T^{-1.5})$，Chen等人对凸凹极小极大优化（MVI的子集）改进到$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{-1.75})$，但MVI的猜想复杂度是否能进一步改进仍是开放问题。本文旨在突破这一上限。

Method: 提出一种新颖的Halpern-NPE方法，利用大步长不精确Halpern迭代来加速收敛。进一步给出p阶推广：首先引入锚定张量方法（ATM）达到$\mathcal{O}(T^{-(p-1)})$的收敛率，然后将其与Halpern迭代结合实现$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{-p})$的更快收敛速度。

Result: Halpern-NPE方法对MVI达到$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{-2})$的收敛率；p阶泛化方法达到$\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{-p})$，改进了所有p≥2的先前结果，并在p=1时与经典外梯度法（extragradient method）相匹配。

Conclusion: 本文通过Halpern迭代与高阶方法的结合，显著推进了光滑单调变分不等式求解的理论上限，尤其在高阶方法（p≥2）上实现了突破性改进。

Abstract: We study second- and higher-order methods for solving smooth monotone variational inequalities (MVI). Monteiro and Svaiter (SIAM J. Optim., 2012) showed that a second-order method, NPE, converges at the rate of $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1.5})$. For convex-concave minimax optimization, a subset of MVI problems, Chen, Liu, Luo, and Zhang (COLT 2025) recently improved the complexity to $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}( T^{-1.75})$ . However, it is open whether the conjectured complexity for MVI can be improved. In this paper, by using a large-step inexact Halpern iteration, we propose a novel Halpern-NPE method that achieves an even faster rate of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{-2})$ for solving MVIs. We also provide the $p$th-order generalization of our method. We first introduce an Anchored Tensor Method (ATM) that achieves the rate of $\mathcal{O}(T^{-(p-1)})$, and then combine it with the Halpern iteration to achieve a faster convergence rate of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(T^{-p})$. This improves all prior results for $p \ge 2$ and matches the classical extragradient method for $p=1$.

</details>


### [382] [Max-$k$-Cut via Node Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08499)
*Avinash Bhardwaj,Hritiz Gogoi,Vishnu Narayanan*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文从节点特征视角研究Max-k-Cut问题，其中每个顶点带有特征向量，边权由内积定义。文章推导了Frieze-Jerrum半定松弛精确性的充分条件（在特征平衡和特征支配两种结构下成立），并将Max-k-Cut目标转化为最小化各部分聚合特征向量范数平方和，从而与向量平衡问题建立联系。基于此，提出贪心特征平衡算法，保留了经典1-1/k最坏情况近似比，且在特征支配下能恢复最优划分。对于非负特征的一阶特征图，Chandra和Wong的经典界可提供计算性的后验最优性间隙证书。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统Max-k-Cut问题通常从图论角度研究，但许多实际应用（如图神经网络、聚类）中节点带有特征信息。本文旨在利用节点特征结构来深入理解Max-k-Cut问题的半定松弛精确性，并设计利用特征结构的高效算法，同时建立与向量平衡理论的联系。

Method: 1) 利用正规锥（normal-cone）论证推导Frieze-Jerrum半定松弛精确性的一般充分条件；2) 识别两种满足该条件的特征结构：完美特征平衡（各部分聚合特征向量相等）和特征支配（少量大非负特征向量决定最优划分结构）；3) 证明Max-k-Cut目标等价于最小化k个部分聚合特征向量范数平方和；4) 设计贪心特征平衡算法并分析其理论保证；5) 对秩1非负特征图，利用Chandra和Wong的贪心负载平衡经典界推导可计算的后验最优性间隙证书。

Result: 该算法在特征支配结构下能够恢复最优划分；贪心特征平衡算法保持了经典的1-1/k最坏情况近似保证；针对秩1非负特征图，获得了仅依赖返回划分的计算性后验最优性间隙证书，无需知道最优解。对于完美特征平衡和特征支配两种特征结构，半定松弛的精确性条件均得到满足。

Conclusion: 本文通过将Max-k-Cut问题与节点特征结构和向量平衡理论联系起来，不仅加深了对半定松弛精确性的理论理解，还提供了基于特征结构的高效算法以及实用的最优性验证工具，展示了节点特征视角为经典组合优化问题带来的新洞见。

Abstract: We study the Max-$k$-Cut problem from a node-feature perspective, where each vertex is associated with a feature vector and edge weights are given by pairwise inner products. We first examine the semidefinite relaxation of Max-$k$-Cut from this perspective. Using a normal-cone argument, we derive a general sufficient condition for exactness of the Frieze--Jerrum relaxation and show that it is satisfied in two feature-structural regimes: perfect feature balance, where the aggregate feature vectors of the parts are equal, and feature dominance, where a small set of large nonnegative feature vectors determines the structure of an optimal partition. We then show that the Max-$k$-Cut objective is equivalent to minimizing the sum of squared norms of the aggregate feature vectors assigned to the $k$ parts, thereby connecting the problem to vector balancing. Motivated by this observation, we show that a greedy feature-balancing algorithm retains the classical $1-1/k$ worst-case approximation guarantee and recovers an optimal partition under feature dominance. For rank-$1$ feature graphs with nonnegative features, classical bounds of Chandra and Wong for greedy load balancing yield a computable \emph{a posteriori} optimality-gap certificate that depends only on the returned partition and requires no knowledge of the optimum.

</details>


### [383] [A Unified Maximum-Margin Framework for Data Envelopment Analysis: Theoretical Foundations and Numerical Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08530)
*Teruki Akahoshi,Hiroki Ueda,Tomonari Kitahara*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种最大间隔数据包络分析（MM-DEA）模型，通过引入机器学习中的"间隔最大化"概念解决经典CCR模型在高维场景下判别力不足的问题。MM-DEA排除目标DMU并对其评分设置上界，确保评分始终在[0,1]范围内，同时被证明是CCR模型的广义扩展，可通过线性规划高效求解。数值实验表明其在CCR完全无法区分的合成数据上实现了唯一排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典的CCR模型在输入输出变量数量相对DMU数量较多时，会产生大量评分为1的"CCR有效"DMU，导致判别力不足，难以对顶尖绩效单元进行排序和区分。现有超效率模型虽然能解决该问题，但其评分可能超过1，超出了标准区间。因此需要一种既能增强判别力、又能保持评分在标准[0,1]区间内的新方法。

Method: 提出MM-DEA模型，核心思想是将机器学习中的结构风险最小化和"间隔最大化"概念融入效率测量框架。模型像超效率模型那样将目标DMU从参考集中排除，但额外对目标DMU自身评分施加显式上界（通过权衡参数α控制），确保评分不超出[0,1]。作者从理论上证明了MM-DEA是CCR的广义扩展（α=0时退化为CCR），并将其分数规划形式转化为等价的线性规划问题以保证计算效率。

Result: 在一个高维合成数据集上，CCR模型无法区分任何DMU，而MM-DEA则成功生成了唯一排名。数值实验验证了MM-DEA在高维场景下的判别能力和实用性。

Conclusion: MM-DEA有效解决了CCR模型在高维条件下的判别力不足问题，所引入的"间隔"指标可作为衡量管理韧性和竞争优势的关键度量。该模型兼具理论严谨性（CCR的广义扩展）和计算效率（LP可求解），为DEA领域提供了新的研究方向。

Abstract: Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) is a widely used non-parametric method for evaluating the relative efficiency of decision-making units (DMUs). However, the classic Charnes-Cooper-Rhodes (CCR) model often suffers from a lack of discriminatory power, particularly when the number of input and output variables is large relative to the number of DMUs. Under such conditions, many DMUs are evaluated as "CCR-efficient" with a score of unity, making it difficult to rank or distinguish between top performers. To address this limitation, we propose a novel Maximum-Margin DEA (MM-DEA) model that integrates the concept of "margin maximization" -- inspired by structural risk minimization in machine learning -- directly into the efficiency measurement framework. Like the traditional super-efficiency model, the proposed MM-DEA model excludes the target DMU from the reference set used to evaluate it; unlike the super-efficiency model, however, MM-DEA imposes an explicit upper bound on the target DMU's own score, ensuring that every score remains within the standard $[0,1]$ range rather than potentially exceeding one. We theoretically demonstrate that the MM-DEA model is a generalized extension of the CCR model, reducing to the latter when the trade-off parameter $α$ is zero. Furthermore, we show that the fractional programming formulation of MM-DEA can be rigorously transformed into a linear programming (LP) problem, ensuring computational efficiency. In our numerical experiments, MM-DEA produced a unique ranking for a high-dimensional synthetic dataset on which the CCR model failed to discriminate among any of the DMUs. Our results suggest that the "margin" serves as a critical metric for managerial resilience and competitive advantage.

</details>


### [384] [Integrated Learning and Robust Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08718)
*Cheng Tan,Yuchen Mao,Shuming Wang,Huan Xu*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出ILRO框架，将鲁棒决策问题同时用于训练损失函数（RSPO损失）和部署决策，从而同时实现鲁棒性与学习-决策对齐，并开发了凸代理RSPO+、一阶计算方法及有限样本超额风险界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多运营决策需要在线性规划中预测未知成本向量，但预测与决策之间只有弱对齐。虽然集成学习与优化（ILO）范式通过下游问题训练预测器，但预测不可避免存在不精确性，因此需要在决策阶段引入鲁棒性。现有方法未能同时兼顾鲁棒性与学习-决策对齐。

Method: 提出ILRO框架，用鲁棒决策问题同时定义训练问题（RSPO损失问题）和部署决策；开发凸代理RSPO+并刻画其Fisher一致性条件；利用RSPO损失的信息梯度设计一阶计算方法；推导RSPO与RSPO+预测器的有限样本超额风险界。

Result: 在运输和投资组合问题的数值实验中，与多个基准方法对比，ILRO框架在决策质量上具有优势，且在样本量有限、决策维度高和模型误设场景下优势更为显著。

Conclusion: ILRO框架通过将鲁棒优化嵌入训练过程，同时实现了决策的鲁棒性与学习-决策对齐，为不确定环境下基于上下文信息的线性规划决策提供了有效且理论上有保障的方案。

Abstract: Many operational decisions require solving a linear program whose cost vector is unknown at decision time and must be predicted from contextual information. Because prediction and decision are only weakly aligned, the emerging integrated learning and optimization (ILO) paradigm trains the predictor through the downstream problem, judging a prediction by the decision it induces. However, predictions are inevitably imprecise, so robustness often enters the decision stage. To address this issue, we propose an integrated learning and robust optimization (ILRO) framework, where a robust decision problem is used both to define the training problem (termed the RSPO loss problem), and to produce the deployed decision. Thus, this framework simultaneously achieves both robustness and learning-decision alignment. To tackle its computational challenges, we develop a convex surrogate, RSPO+, and characterize when it is Fisher consistent. Moreover, the RSPO loss possesses informative gradients, allowing us to develop first-order computational methods. We also derive finite-sample excess risk bounds for both RSPO and RSPO+ predictors. Numerical experiments on transportation and portfolio problems, in comparison with multiple benchmarks, show the advantage in decision quality of the proposed framework. The gain is more pronounced for scenarios with limited samples, high-dimensional decisions, and model misspecification.

</details>


### [385] [Simultaneous Group-Envelope Bounds for $Γ$-Robust Multiple-Choice Knapsack Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08861)
*Zi Yuan Eric Shao*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对多选择背包松弛问题的区间边界方法，通过取消阈值特定基线并将每组贡献简化为两个包络，可在所有不确定性阈值上同时求解边界，实现2.37倍几何平均加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多鲁棒规划问题通过检查一族普通优化问题（每个不确定性阈值对应一个）来求解，但重复构建和求解这些松弛问题会主导运行时间，需要更高效的批量处理方法。

Method: 当决策从每组中恰好选择一个选项时，利用取消操作移除阈值特定基线，将每组的贡献简化为两个简单包络；排序后，一个乘数在所有阈值上的求值时间为阈值数量的线性时间及选项数量的近线性时间。

Result: 在相同条件的自适应搜索中，该方法赢得所有60个实例级中位数比较，实现2.37倍几何平均加速；额外的消融实验、独立的线性规划检查和九个来自公开存档的转换实例验证了机制有效性。

Conclusion: 该方法产生的区间边界有效，在单一可行阈值上与普通松弛匹配，且至少与匹配的组团比较器同样强；但整数审计显示边界：当整数搜索占主导时，更快的松弛边界不一定有帮助。

Abstract: Many robust planning problems are solved by checking a family of ordinary optimization problems, one for each uncertainty threshold. Repeatedly building and solving those relaxations can dominate runtime. We show that, when a decision chooses exactly one option from each group, the entire threshold family of multiple-choice knapsack relaxations can instead be bounded together. A cancellation removes threshold-specific baselines and reduces each group's contribution to two simple envelopes. After sorting, one multiplier is evaluated across all thresholds in time linear in their number and nearly linear in the number of options. The resulting interval bound is valid, matches the ordinary relaxation on a single feasible threshold, and is at least as strong as the matched group-clique comparator. A certified one-dimensional search controls multiplier error, while exact checks resolve numerically ambiguous feasibility and comparison cases. In an otherwise identical adaptive search, the method wins all 60 instance-level median comparisons and achieves a 2.37-fold geometric-mean speedup. Additional ablations, independent linear-program checks, and nine instances transformed from a published archive test the mechanism beyond the internal generator. A separate integer audit shows the boundary: faster relaxation bounds need not help when integer search dominates.

</details>


### [386] [Regional factors determine the feasibility of an elimination strategy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08956)
*George Adu-Boahen,Troy Day,Michael J Plank,Amy Hurford*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提供了一个显式的数学模型来描述区域特征及其流行病学后果，用以评估通过针对性措施（如病例隔离和接触追踪）实现消除或抑制策略的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在大流行期间，各国需要决定采用消除、抑制还是缓解策略，但缺乏一个显式的数学模型来评估区域特征（如公共卫生能力、传播率、旅行者到达率）如何决定这些策略的可行性。

Method: 构建一个流行病模型，其中社区成员可被旅行者或其他社区成员感染，并考虑支持隔离到达旅行者和感染社区成员的公共卫生资源约束。通过数学证明最优控制策略是立即以最大力度实施公共卫生措施。

Result: 消除或抑制策略在公共卫生能力高、传播率低或感染旅行者到达率低时是可行的。旅行措施通过直接效果仅防止少量社区感染，但通过保护接触追踪能力，间接防止疫情复燃并大幅减少感染人数。

Conclusion: 区域特征的组合决定了消除、抑制或缓解策略（无复燃）是否可行。低旅行者到达率加上能够实施和执行隔离/检疫能力的地区不太可能超出其接触追踪和隔离社区成员的能力上限。

Abstract: We provide an explicit mathematical characterization of regional characteristics and the resulting epidemiology to evaluate whether elimination or suppression is feasible using targeted measures, such as case isolation and contact tracing. We derive an epidemic model where community members can be infected by either travellers or other community members, and with constraints on the public health resources available to support isolation of arriving travellers and infected community members. We prove that the optimal controls are to immediately implement public health measures at their maximum levels. We find that elimination or suppression strategies are feasible with targeted measures if public health capacity is high, the transmission rate is low, or if the arrival rate of infected travellers is low. Our results illustrate that a particular country that implemented a mitigation strategy during the pandemic may not necessarily have achieved better outcomes if it had instead implemented elimination because elimination may not have been feasible in countries with low public health capacity to support control measures, high transmission rates, or high traveller arrival rates. Combinations of regional characteristics determine whether an elimination, suppression or mitigation strategy without resurgence is feasible. We find that regions with the low traveller arrival rates and the capacity to implement and enforce isolation or quarantine of arriving travellers are less likely to exceed their capacity to contact trace and isolate community members. Travel measures prevent only a small number of community infections via their direct effect, but indirectly, by protecting contact tracing capacity, travel measures can prevent epidemic resurgence and substantially reduce the number of people infected during a pandemic before a vaccine or therapy is developed.

</details>


### [387] [Direct Search Methods for Online Nonconvex Optimization Under Inexact Bandit Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08979)
*Gaspar Robert,Gianluca Bianchin*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于非凸时变优化问题的随机两点直接搜索算法，在常数和递减探测比下推导迭代复杂度界限，并在时不变场景恢复现有零阶方法的复杂度，同时扩展到动态系统最优（均衡选择）控制问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有零阶（bandit）优化方法多是对时不变或一阶优化方法的改编，梯度替代量未能充分利用零阶信息的结构，无法适应现代应用中随时间演化的优化问题（如在线控制和在线学习）。

Method: 提出随机化两点直接搜索算法（randomized two-point direct-search），针对非凸时变优化问题，在常数和递减探测比（probing ratios）两种设置下推导迭代复杂度界限，分析中显式考虑问题时间变化性和可能的oracle误差。

Result: 复杂度界在时不变设置下恢复现有零阶方法的复杂度，同时将直接搜索方法扩展到动态设置。在动态系统最优（均衡选择）控制应用中，获得了以问题时间变化性（通过plant dynamics和外生扰动变化衡量）表达显式驻点界。

Conclusion: 该算法能充分利用零阶信息结构，为时变非凸优化提供理论保证，并天然适用于动态系统的最优（均衡选择）控制问题。

Abstract: Optimization under zeroth-order (i.e., bandit) feedback is central to many engineering problems where the analytic forms of objectives and/or constraints are unavailable. In modern applications, such as online control and online learning, optimization problems often evolve with time, requiring adaptive optimization methodologies. Yet, existing methods in this seting are largely confined to adaptations of methodologies developed for time-invariant or first-order optimization, and thus often rely on gradient surrogates that fail to fully exploit the zeroth-order structure of the available information. In this paper, we propose a randomized two-point direct-search algorithm for nonconvex time-varying optimization and derive iteration-complexity bounds under both constant and diminishing probing ratios. The resulting analysis yields explicit stationarity bounds in terms of the temporal variability of the problem and possible oracle errors. Our complexity bounds recover the complexity of existing zeroth-order methods in the time-invariant setting, while extending direct- search methods beyond static settings. As an illustrative application, we show that the methodology is naturally suited to solve optimal (equilibrium-selection) control problems for dynamical systems. In this setting, the analysis yields explicit stationarity bounds in terms of the temporal variability of the problem, measured through the effects of plant dynamics and exogenous disturbance variations.

</details>


### [388] [A Tight Lower Bound for Smooth Nonconvex Stochastic Optimization with Bounded Gradient Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09004)
*Jikai Jin*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文证明了光滑非凸随机优化在梯度噪声一致有界情况下的尖锐下界。在K=1新鲜样本模型中，任何随机自适应算法都需要Ω(ΔL/ε² + ΔLσ²/ε⁴)次查询才能找到期望梯度范数不超过ε的点，这与标准上界匹配，解决了Arjevani等人提出的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者旨在回答Arjevani等人于2023年提出的开放问题：在几乎必然有界的oracle误差条件下，是否可以获得比有界方差更好的收敛速率。此前该问题尚不清楚，本文通过证明匹配的尖锐下界来回答这一问题。

Method: 作者通过构造下界证明的方式，针对光滑非凸随机优化问题，在梯度噪声一致有界（而非仅仅有界方差）的假设下，证明任何随机自适应算法在下界意义上的查询复杂度下界。证明由GPT-5.6 Sol在Codex Ultra模式下生成，人类作者负责验证和修改。

Result: 得到了下界Ω(ΔL/ε² + ΔLσ²/ε⁴)，该下界与标准上界匹配，表明几乎必然有界的oracle误差并不能带来比有界方差更好的速率。下界是尖锐的。

Conclusion: 本文解决了Arjevani等人提出的开放问题，证明了在梯度噪声一致有界的假设下，非凸随机优化的查询复杂度下界与标准上界匹配，从而表明一致有界噪声假设不会带来速率的提升。

Abstract: We prove a sharp lower bound for smooth nonconvex stochastic optimization with uniformly bounded gradient noise. In the \(K=1\) fresh-sample model, every randomized adaptive algorithm requires $$Ω\left( \frac{ΔL}{ε^2} + \frac{ΔLσ^2}{ε^4} \right)$$ queries to find a point with expected gradient norm at most \(ε\). This matches the standard upper bound and, to the best of our knowledge, resolves the question raised by [Arjevani et al. 2023] of whether almost-surely bounded oracle error permits a better rate than bounded variance. The proof was independently generated with GPT-5.6 Sol in Codex's Ultra mode during a two-hour session. The human author supplied the prompt and was responsible only forchecking the proof and revising and polishing the manuscript.

</details>


### [389] [Radial-type error bounds for semidefinite feasibility problems without strict feasibility: qualitative estimates and asymptotic tightness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09013)
*Mitsuhiro Nishijima,Guoyin Li,Bruno F. Lourenço*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文为半定可行性问题发展了一个系统框架，在不假设Slater条件（严格可行性）的情况下推导显式误差界。主要贡献是引入径向型Hölder误差界，通过结合面约简和面残差函数，获得无需约束规格的显式模函数描述，补充了Sturm的经典工作。进一步分析了维度增长时的渐近行为，并将其应用于半定规划最优性系统的误差界，在严格互补条件下无需唯一性假设即可推导径向型误差界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的半定可行性问题误差界结果通常需要严格可行性（Slater条件）假设，而许多实际场景（如半定规划的最优性系统）中该条件自然失效。已有文献（如Sturm的工作）虽然提供了局部Hölder误差界，但缺乏对常数项的显式估计，限制了理论结果的实际应用。

Method: 1) 引入径向型Hölder误差界概念，误差界常数通过径向模函数显式依赖于参考矩阵的范数。2) 将面约简技术与新发展的面残差函数相结合，获得模函数的显式描述。3) 分析维度增长时误差界的渐近行为。4) 将半定规划的最优性系统重构为可行性问题，利用严格互补条件推导径向型误差界。

Result: 在不施加任何约束规格的条件下获得了定性径向型Hölder误差界；为Sturm的局部Hölder误差界提供了显式常数估计；识别了误差界渐近紧（至多差一个维度无关常数）的机制；在半定规划最优性系统中，在严格互补条件下（无需解唯一性）建立了径向型误差界，并给出了渐近紧性的显式例子。

Conclusion: 该框架填补了半定可行性问题在无Slater条件下误差界理论的关键空白，不仅提供了理论上的显式估计，还通过半定规划应用展现了实际价值，为后续在更广泛优化问题中扩展此类误差界奠定了基础。

Abstract: In this paper, we develop a systematic framework for deriving explicit error bounds for semidefinite feasibility problems without assuming strict feasibility (Slater's condition), a setting in which existing results are limited. Our main technical contribution is the introduction of radial-type Hölder error bounds, where the error bound constant depends explicitly on the norm of the reference matrix through radial modulus functions. By combining facial reduction with recently developed facial residual functions, we obtain explicit descriptions of these modulus functions, yielding qualitative radial-type Hölder error bounds without imposing any constraint qualifications. Our results complement the classical work of Sturm by providing explicit estimates for the constants involved in Sturm's local Hölder error bounds over bounded sets with a given size. We further analyze the asymptotic behavior of these bounds as the dimension of the underlying matrix space grows, identifying regimes in which they can be asymptotically tight up to a dimensional-free constant.
