As an application, we establish explicit error bounds for the optimality system of semidefinite programs by reformulating them as feasibility problems, a setting where Slater's condition typically fails. Under the generically satisfied strict complementarity condition, we derive radial-type error bounds without assuming the usual solution uniqueness requirement, and demonstrate their asymptotic tightness through an explicit example.

</details>


### [390] [Provable Parameter-Free Fixed-Point Algorithms with Linear Convergence Rates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09022)
*Quoc Tran-Dinh,Pham Ngoc Anh,Ha Manh Tien*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文针对压缩映射提出了可证明的参数无关与自适应不动点算法，无需预先知道压缩因子，涵盖Halpern迭代的无参数变体、自适应Halpern方法，并扩展到Tikhonov正则化求解co-coercive方程以及Nesterov加速方案，数值实验表明其具有竞争力和优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的不动点迭代方法（如Halpern方法）通常需要预先知道或估计压缩因子，这在实际应用中往往难以获得。本文旨在设计参数无关的自适应算法，自动利用隐藏的压缩性而不需先验知识，从而提升算法的实用性和收敛效率。

Method: 本文提出了两种主要算法：1) 完全参数无关的Halpern不动点迭代变体，无需线搜索、二分法或压缩因子先验估计；2) 自适应Halpern方法，仅需压缩因子上界，在非扩张情形下退化为现有自适应方案。此外，将上述方案与Tikhonov正则化结合求解co-coercive方程，并利用Halpern迭代与Nesterov加速方案的关系推导参数无关的Nesterov加速变体。

Result: 为两种算法建立了针对不动点残差和到唯一不动点距离的显式线性收敛率；在co-coercive方程求解上获得O(ε⁻¹ln(ε⁻¹))的迭代复杂度；数值实验表明所提算法在压缩场景下能有效利用压缩性，在非扩张问题上仍保持有效，且往往优于现有自适应方法。

Conclusion: 本文提出的参数无关与自适应不动点算法在理论和实践上都表现优异，不仅消除了对压缩因子先验知识的需求，还保持了与传统算法相当的每步计算成本，并为更广泛的优化问题（如co-coercive方程和加速变体）提供了统一且高效的求解框架。

Abstract: In this paper, we develop provable parameter-free and adaptive fixed-point algorithms for contractive mappings, with an emphasis on automatically exploiting hidden contractivity without requiring prior knowledge of the contraction factor. Our first method is a completely parameter-free variant of the Halpern fixed-point iteration. It requires no line search, bisection, or prior estimate of the contraction factor, while retaining essentially the same per-iteration computational cost as classical fixed-point schemes. We establish explicit linear convergence rates for both the fixed-point residual and the distance to the unique fixed point. The second algorithm is an adaptive Halpern method that requires only an upper bound on the contraction factor and reduces to an existing adaptive Halpern scheme in the nonexpansive case. This method also enjoys explicit linear convergence guarantees. We further extend these ideas in two directions. First, by combining the proposed fixed-point schemes with Tikhonov regularization, we obtain a parameter-free method for solving co-coercive equations and establish an iteration complexity of $\mathcal{O}({ε^{-1}\ln(ε^{-1})})$ for computing an $ε$-solution. Second, using the relation between Halpern iterations and Nesterov's accelerated fixed-point schemes, we derive parameter-free Nesterov's accelerated variants that inherit linear convergence in the contractive setting. Numerical experiments on several examples demonstrate that the proposed algorithms are competitive with, and often outperform, existing adaptive fixed-point methods. In particular, the methods successfully exploit contractive behavior when it is present while remaining effective on nonexpansive problems.

</details>


### [391] [GPU-Accelerated Conic Quadratic Programming with Local Linear Convergence under Strict Complementarity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09159)
*Hongpei Li,Yicheng Huang,Huikang Liu,Dongdong Ge,Yinyu Ye*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出PDHCG-CQP，一个GPU加速的一阶求解器，用于大规模锥凸二次规划。该求解器支持仿射约束及多种锥体的笛卡尔积，基于重启平均原始-对偶混合梯度（PDHG）方法，在严格互补条件下建立了局部线性收敛性证明，并在实验中展示了跨8个GPU扩展到4.4×10^8个原始坐标的卓越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模锥凸二次规划问题在许多实际应用中至关重要，但现有的一阶求解器在处理大规模问题时面临鲁棒性和可扩展性的双重挑战。GPU的并行计算能力为解决这类问题提供了新的机遇，但需要设计适配GPU架构的数值优化算法。

Method: 核心是重启平均PDHG方法，其原始更新通过投影梯度迭代非精确求解锥二次近端子问题。实现层面结合了无矩阵线性代数、批量锥投影、自适应内迭代、反射-Halpern加速以及全设备端KKT残差计算，并通过二维数据分区支持多GPU执行。

Result: 在标准及大规模QP、QCQP、SOCP和准线性Fisher均衡基准上，PDHCG-CQP在一阶求解器中达到了最先进的鲁棒性，能高效扩展到8个GPU，处理多达4.4×10^8个存储的原始坐标的实例。

Conclusion: PDHCG-CQP展示了GPU加速一阶方法在大规模凸锥规划中的巨大潜力，通过精心的算法设计与硬件适配，在保持理论收敛保证的同时实现了卓越的工程性能和可扩展性。该工具已开源发布。

Abstract: We present PDHCG-CQP, a GPU-accelerated first-order solver for large-scale conic convex quadratic programming. PDHCG-CQP supports affine constraints and Cartesian products of nonnegative, second-order, rotated second-order, exponential, and three-dimensional power cones. At its core is a restarted averaged primal-dual hybrid gradient (PDHG) method, whose primal update is computed inexactly by solving a conic quadratic proximal subproblem with projected gradient iterations. We establish local linear convergence of the restarted averaged scheme with both exact and inexact primal proximal evaluations under a uniform local quadratic-growth condition on the smoothed primal-dual gap. We further show that this condition holds under strict complementarity by exploiting a rotated second-order-cone lifting together with local primal and dual regularity conditions. Our C/CUDA implementation combines matrix-free linear algebra, batched cone projections, adaptive inner solves, reflected-Halpern acceleration, and fully device-resident KKT residual computations. It also supports multi-GPU execution through a two-dimensional partitioning of the problem data. Extensive experiments on standard and large-scale quadratic programming (QP), convex quadratically constrained quadratic programming (QCQP), second-order cone programming (SOCP), and quasilinear Fisher equilibrium benchmarks demonstrate that PDHCG-CQP achieves state-of-the-art robustness among first-order solvers while scaling efficiently to 8 GPUs and instances with up to $4.4\times10^8$ stored primal coordinates. PDHCG-CQP is open source and available at https://github.com/Lhongpei/PDHCG.

</details>


### [392] [Plant-Wide Hierarchical Electricity-Heat Coordination for Large-Scale Cold-Region ReP2H Plants via Bidirectional Thermal Coupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09170)
*Yiwei Qiu,Baiping Zhu,Tao Wu,Shi Chen,Buxiang Zhou,Kaigui Xie*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文针对寒冷地区大型可再生能源制氢（ReP2H）工厂在频繁启停操作中面临的长启动时间和反复热应力问题，提出了一种全厂热拓扑结构和分层电-热管理框架，通过电解槽集群与厂级热力系统的双向热耦合实现预热、热备用和废热回收，案例研究表明该框架可消除全年冷启动、提高氢气产量1.50%、提升能量和㶲效率分别0.99和4.33个百分点，并降低平准化制氢成本3.22%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 寒冷地区大型ReP2H工厂在频繁启停操作中遭受长启动时间和重复热应力，且碱性电解槽堆、配套系统（BoP）、厂级热力系统（PTUS）和厂房建筑之间缺乏协调的热管理，导致问题恶化。

Method: 提出全厂热拓扑结构和分层电-热管理框架：堆集群与PTUS之间的双向热耦合实现预热、热备用和废热回收；将分钟级生产调度与秒级热调节相协调。

Result: 基于中国北方80 MW工厂的案例研究显示：消除全年冷启动，氢气产量提高1.50%，能量效率提升0.99个百分点，㶲效率提升4.33个百分点，平准化制氢成本降低3.22%，同时减少热疲劳损伤和启停引起的电压退化。

Conclusion: 该分层电-热管理框架能有效解决寒冷地区ReP2H工厂的启动与热应力问题，提升整体运行性能和经济性，并延长设备寿命。

Abstract: Large-scale renewable power-to-hydrogen (ReP2H) plants in cold regions suffer from prolonged startup and repeated thermal stress during frequent startup-shutdown operation. The situation becomes worse due to the lack of coordinated heat management among the alkaline electrolysis stacks, balance of plant (BoP), plant thermal utility system (PTUS), and plant building. This paper presents a plant-wide thermal topology and a hierarchical electricity-heat management framework to address the issues. Bidirectional thermal coupling between the stack cluster and PTUS enables preheating, thermal standby, and waste heat recovery, while minute-scale production scheduling is coordinated with second-scale thermal regulation. Case studies based on an 80 MW plant in Northern China show that the proposed framework eliminates cold startups in year round, increases hydrogen yield by 1.50, improves energy and exergy efficiencies by 0.99 and 4.33 percentage points, respectively, and reduces the levelized cost of hydrogen by 3.22%. It also reduces thermal fatigue damage and startup-shutdown-induced voltage degradation.

</details>


### [393] [A primal--dual interior-point method for nonsymmetric conic optimization with conjugate-free scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09206)
*Rui-Jin Zhang,Wenhao Fu,Yu-Hong Dai*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于无共轭缩放矩阵的原始-对偶内点法，用于解决非对称锥优化问题。该缩放由原始障碍Hessian的单割线BFGS更新获得，无需共轭障碍导数。方法嵌入齐次自对偶预测-校正框架，并利用分裂中心路径邻域证明缩放矩阵与原始障碍Hessian一致可比，最终达到O(√ν log(1/ε))的迭代复杂度，优于现有方法，数值实验表明与专用求解器QICS具有竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非对称锥优化中，现有的多割线BFGS缩放需要计算共轭障碍导数，而在高维非对称锥中这些导数可能没有闭式解或计算代价高昂。因此需要一种无需共轭障碍导数的缩放方法，以提高实用性和可扩展性。

Method: 采用单割线BFGS更新原始障碍Hessian获得共轭无关缩放矩阵；将缩放嵌入齐次自对偶预测-校正框架；通过分裂中心路径邻域分别控制锥变量和标量齐次变量，证明缩放矩阵与障碍Hessian的一致可比性并保持邻域性质。

Result: 获得O(√ν log(1/ε))的迭代复杂度，优于Badenbroek和Dahl的O(ν log(1/ε))界，匹配内点法已知最优复杂度阶。在算子透视epigraph锥和量子相对熵锥的实例上，与专用量子信息求解器QICS表现相当。

Conclusion: 该方法通过消除对共轭障碍导数的依赖，成功扩展了内点法在高维非对称锥优化中的适用性，同时在理论和实践上都达到了最优或竞争性的性能，为非对称锥优化提供了更实用的求解途径。

Abstract: We develop a primal--dual interior-point method for nonsymmetric conic optimization based on a conjugate-free scaling matrix. The scaling is obtained from a single-secant BFGS update of the primal barrier Hessian. In contrast to multi-secant BFGS scalings, it does not require conjugate-barrier derivatives. This feature is important for high-dimensional nonsymmetric cones, where conjugate-barrier derivatives may be unavailable in closed form or expensive to compute. We embed the conjugate-free scaling in a homogeneous self-dual predictor--corrector framework. Using a split central-path neighborhood that separately controls the conic variables and the scalar homogeneous variables, we prove that the scaling matrix remains uniformly comparable to the primal barrier Hessian. This comparison bound is used to prove neighborhood preservation and to show that the complementarity measure and the linear residual decrease at a uniform rate. Consequently, the method attains an iteration bound of $\mathcal{O}(\sqrtν\log(1/\varepsilon))$, improving the $\mathcal{O}(ν\log(1/\varepsilon))$ bound of Badenbroek and Dahl [Optim. Methods Softw., 37 (2022), pp. 1027--1064] and matching the best-known complexity order for interior-point methods. Numerical experiments on instances involving the operator perspective epigraph cone and the quantum relative entropy cone show that the method is competitive with QICS, a specialized solver for conic models arising in quantum information.

</details>


### [394] [Entropic Partial Optimal Transport and Partial Gromov--Wasserstein Distance between Gaussian Mixtures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09265)
*Toshiaki Yachimura,Xiaocheng Zou*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文针对高斯混合模型提出了熵正则化部分最优传输和部分混合Gromov-Wasserstein距离，解决了传统平衡最优传输强制匹配全部质量、对离群点和缺失数据过于敏感的问题。作者证明了有限熵部分最优传输问题解的存在唯一性，建立了大惩罚定量估计，分析了连续部分传输映射的极限行为，并验证了所提距离的度量性质和对离群点的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统最优传输和Gromov-Wasserstein距离的平衡公式要求所有质量都被匹配，这一约束对于含有离群点、缺失部分或仅有部分重叠的数据过于严格。因此需要开发部分最优传输方法来处理这种不完整或不完全对齐的数据场景。

Method: 1) 为高斯混合模型建立熵正则化部分最优传输（entropic partial optimal transport）框架；2) 定义部分混合Gromov-Wasserstein距离（partial mixture Gromov-Wasserstein distance）；3) 证明有限问题解的存在唯一性并推导大惩罚定量估计；4) 通过高斯最优映射将熵部分分量耦合诱导为连续部分传输计划；5) 分析大惩罚和零熵极限行为，构造位移插值和重心投影映射；6) 将每个高斯混合视为高斯分量的有限度量测度空间，证明度量性质和大惩罚极限。

Result: 理论结果包括：熵部分最优传输问题最小化解的存在唯一性、大惩罚定量估计、连续部分传输计划的极限行为分析。实验结果表明该方法对离群点具有鲁棒性，并展示了惩罚参数和熵正则化对匹配效果的影响。

Conclusion: 所提出的部分最优传输框架有效克服了平衡公式的局限，为高斯混合模型和度量测度空间的鲁棒匹配提供了理论严谨且计算可行的方案，尤其适用于含离群点和不完整数据的实际场景。

Abstract: Optimal transport and Gromov--Wasserstein distances are useful tools for comparing probability measures and metric measure spaces, but their balanced formulations force all mass to be matched. This constraint is often too strong for data with outliers, missing parts, or only partial overlap. In this paper, we develop entropic partial optimal transport for Gaussian mixture models and define a partial mixture Gromov--Wasserstein distance. For the finite entropic partial optimal transport problem, we prove the existence and uniqueness of the minimizer and establish quantitative large-penalty estimates. Moreover, the resulting entropic partial component couplings induce continuous partial transport plans through Gaussian optimal maps. We analyze their large-penalty and subsequent zero-entropy limits and construct the associated displacement interpolations and barycentric projection maps. In addition, by identifying each Gaussian mixture with a finite metric measure space of Gaussian components, we establish the metric property and large-penalty limit of the partial mixture Gromov--Wasserstein distance. Finally, numerical experiments on synthetic Gaussian mixtures and point clouds illustrate the effects of the penalty and entropic regularization and the robustness of partial matching to outliers.

</details>


### [395] [On the Hautus test for exact observability of normal semigroups](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09407)
*Jannik Daun,Birgit Jacob*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文通过构造反例否证了修改后的Russell-Weiss猜想（即Hautus检验加上T相似于压缩半群的假设可推出精确可观测性），并证明了在自伴算子及正规算子加紧观测算子的情况下，Hautus检验确实蕴含精确可观测性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Russell和Weiss最初猜想无穷维Hautus检验蕴含精确可观测性，但被反例否定后，猜想被修改为额外假设T相似于压缩半群。本文旨在检验这一修改后的猜想是否成立。

Method: 构造一个反例：A为正规算子，X具有A的特征向量构成的标准正交基，C:X_1→Y为Hilbert-Schmidt算子，满足Hautus检验但不满足精确可观测性。同时分别针对自伴算子和正规算子加紧观测算子的情形给出正面的充分性定理。

Result: 1) 构造了一个正规算子A的反例，其中T是指数稳定的压缩半群（因A正规且指数稳定），且C为Hilbert-Schmidt，满足Hautus检验但不可精确观测，从而否证了修改后的猜想。2) 证明对自伴A，Hautus检验蕴含精确可观测性。3) 证明若A正规且C:X_1→Y紧，则Hautus检验蕴含A具有紧预解式；由此推出当Y有限维且A正规时，Hautus检验蕴含精确可观测性。

Conclusion: 修改后的Russell-Weiss猜想仍然不成立，即使A是正规算子、T是压缩半群且C是Hilbert-Schmidt也是反例。但对自伴算子或正规算子加紧观测算子的情形，Hautus检验足以保证精确可观测性，说明这些额外结构条件可以提供足够的保证。

Abstract: Let $T$ be an exponentially stable strongly continuous semigroup on a Hilbert space $X$, $A$ its generator, $X_1$ the domain of $A$ with the norm $\|v\|_1 := \|Av\|$, and $C$ an admissible observation operator taking values in a Hilbert space $Y$. Russell and Weiss conjectured that if $(A,C)$ satisfies the infinite-dimensional Hautus test, then $(A,C)$ is exactly observable. After a counterexample was found their conjecture was modified to include the additional assumption that $T$ is similar to a contraction semigroup. We disprove this modified conjecture by constructing a counterexample in which $A$ is normal, $X$ has an orthonormal basis of eigenvectors of $A$ and $C: X_1 \to Y$ is Hilbert-Schmidt. Since $A$ is normal and $T$ is exponentially stable, it follows that $T$ is a contraction semigroup. In contrast, we prove that the Hautus test implies exact observability for self-adjoint $A$. Finally, we show that if $A$ is normal and $C:X_1 \to Y$ is compact, then the Hautus test implies that $A$ has compact resolvent. Consequently, for normal $A$ and finite-dimensional $Y$ the Hautus test implies exact observability.

</details>


### [396] [Linear Convergence of a Frank-Wolfe-type Method over the Spectrahedron without Strict Complementarity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09569)
*Dan Garber*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种确定性的、无参数的Frank-Wolfe类型算法，用于谱面体上的光滑凸最小化问题。该方法仅基于极端特征向量计算，在二次增长和所有最优解同秩的假设下，实现了全局环境维度无关的线性收敛速率，消除了先前工作的随机性、烧入阶段、严格互补性假设及对光滑度常数依赖等限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前工作虽然首次实现了谱面体上Frank-Wolfe方法的维度无关线性收敛速率，但存在多项局限：需要严格的互补性假设、方法是随机化的、线性速率仅在烧入阶段之后以期望形式成立，并且需要目标函数的光滑度常数。本文旨在消除这些限制。

Method: 提出一种确定性的、无参数的Frank-Wolfe类型方法，仅依赖极端特征向量计算。所依赖的假设是二次增长条件以及所有最优解具有相同秩，替代了之前的严格互补性假设和随机化策略。

Result: 在二次增长和所有最优解同秩的假设下，该确定性方法实现了全局环境维度无关的线性收敛速率。

Conclusion: 本文成功消除了先前Frank-Wolfe方法在谱面体优化中的多项限制（随机性、烧入阶段、严格互补性假设、参数依赖），以更简洁的确定性和无参数形式实现了同样强的收敛保证。

Abstract: We consider smooth convex minimization over the spectrahedron using Frank-Wolfe-type methods based only on extreme-eigenvector computations. In our recent work \cite{garber2026randomized} we presented the first ambient-dimension-independent linear convergence rate under quadratic growth. However, the method makes an additional strong strict complementarity assumption, it is randomized, its linear rate holds only after a burn-in phase and in expectation, and it requires the objective smoothness constant. We show that these limitations can be removed. Assuming quadratic growth and that all optimal solutions have the same rank, but without assuming strict complementarity, we give a deterministic and parameter-free Frank-Wolfe-type method with a global ambient-dimension-independent linear convergence rate.

</details>


### [397] [Input convex neural networks as surrogates in mathematical optimisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09707)
*Yu Liu,Jan Kronqvist,Fabricio Oliveira*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文主张在优化问题中，当底层响应函数近似凸或凹时，使用输入凸神经网络（ICNN）作为比前馈ReLU网络（FNN）结构更优的代理模型。ICNN具有更紧的LP松弛、可基于epigraph表示构造LP重组的优势，并提出了基于凸包的强连续松弛及分支定界算法，在多个案例中实现了与FNN相当的精度和更优的求解效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有做法常采用ReLU激活的前馈神经网络（FNN）作为优化问题中的代理模型，虽然其分段线性结构可精确转化为MIP，但随着网络规模增大求解计算量巨大。当底层响应近似凸或凹时，缺乏结构上更优的替代方案，需要探索能提升计算效率的代理架构。

Method: 1）主张使用输入凸神经网络（ICNN）替代FNN作为凸/凹响应的代理；2）提出ICNN-MIP式具有更紧的LP松弛，且在有利情形下无积分间隙；3）利用ICNN的epigraph表示构造LP基重组，不完全精确时构建箱域上凸包（介于epigraph与凹包络之间）的最强连续松弛；4）开发分支定界算法，在每个节点构建此松弛，直接对输入变量分支（而非MIP中的中间变量），并在epigraph嵌入有效时于根节点终止。

Result: 在人类食品援助、油井路线规划、葡萄酒调配等案例研究中，ICNN代理在精度上与FNN相当，同时在求解时间和可扩展性上带来收益，支持ICNN作为凸、凹或可近似为凸凹函数时的默认代理选择。

Conclusion: ICNN作为代理模型在凸/凹响应场景下具有计算优势：松弛更紧、可构造强连续松弛、支持高效分支定界算法，是优于FNN-MIP的默认选择。

Abstract: Embedding trained neural networks as surrogates within optimisation problems is an established practice in operations research. The prevailing approach uses feedforward neural networks (FNNs) with ReLU activations, whose piecewise-linear structure admits an exact but computationally intensive mixed-integer programming (MIP) reformulation as the networks grow. We advocate input convex neural networks (ICNNs) as structurally superior surrogates when the underlying response is approximately convex or concave. The convex architecture offers two computational advantages. First, the ICNN-MIP formulation tends to yield a tighter linear programming (LP) relaxation than its FNN-MIP counterpart, with no integrality gap in favourable instances. Second, ICNNs uniquely admit an LP-based reformulation via epigraph representations of ReLU activations, though this embedding is not always exact. When it is not, we exploit the properties of ICNNs to construct the strongest continuous relaxation over box domains, namely, the convex hull of the ICNN's graph, bounded below by the epigraph and above by the concave envelope; this construction is tractable under input convexity but hard for general ReLU networks. On this basis, we develop a branch-and-bound algorithm that builds this relaxation at each node, branches directly on input variables rather than intermediate variables as in MIP reformulations, and terminates at the root node whenever the epigraph embedding is valid. Case studies on humanitarian food aid, oil well routing, and wine blending show that ICNN surrogates match FNN accuracy and deliver gains in solve time and scalability, supporting ICNN as the default surrogate when the underlying function is convex, concave, or well-approximated as such.

</details>


### [398] [Stochastic Multistage Constellation Reconfiguration Problem: Stochastic Dual Dynamic Integer Programming Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09738)
*Brycen D. Pearl,Hang Woon Lee*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种随机多阶段星座重配置问题（Stochastic MCRP），利用随机对偶动态整数规划（SDDiP）求解，以应对观测目标的不确定性，并通过两组计算实验（随机轨道目标和模拟飓风）验证了SDDiP方法优于其他随机求解方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 卫星观测任务调度对行星现象观测、轨道碎片监测和空间态势感知至关重要。现有星座重配置研究多基于确定性任务环境，假设已知环境先验信息，但观测目标本质上存在不确定性。因此需要一种能够考虑不确定性的调度方法，以确保充分的观测任务分配。

Method: 提出了随机多阶段星座重配置问题（Stochastic MCRP）的随机变体，采用随机对偶动态整数规划（SDDiP）进行求解，并探索其他随机问题求解技术进行解质量比较。实验设计包含两组：第一组为随机轨道目标，第二组为模拟飓风场景。

Result: 计算实验结果表明，SDDiP求解方法在随机目标属性场景下优于其他随机问题求解方法，能够有效处理目标随机性，同时满足可见时间窗口和机动可行性约束。

Conclusion: 随机MCRP框架在考虑目标随机性的同时遵守可见时间窗口和机动可行性约束，SDDiP方法被证明是解决该随机调度问题的有效途径，为卫星编队动态响应提供了更贴近实际的不确定性感知解决方案。

Abstract: Observation tasking is critical to satellite operations, enabling observation of planetary phenomena, orbital debris monitoring, and space domain awareness. To improve the effectiveness of satellite operations, orbital maneuverability is introduced as a leading-edge concept of operations within constellation reconfigurability for response to dynamic events. Previous investigations regarding constellation reconfigurability consist of deterministic mission environments, in which the formulations consider a priori knowledge of the environment; however, observation objectives inherently involve uncertainty at any given time. As such, scheduling satellite operations must account for uncertainties to ensure adequate observation tasking. In response, we present a stochastic variant of the Multistage Constellation Reconfiguration Problem (MCRP) which is solved using Stochastic Dual Dynamic Integer Programming (SDDiP). We additionally explore other stochastic problem-solving techniques for solution quality comparison. To demonstrate each solution method, two computational experiments with stochastic target properties are conducted. The first concerns random orbital targets, and the second concerns simulated hurricanes. The results of the experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the SDDiP solution approach over other stochastic problem-solving methods. Overall, the stochastic MCRP accounts for target stochasticity while obeying visible time windows and maneuver feasibility.

</details>


### [399] [A globally and superlinearly convergent QO-free method for nonlinear optimization on Riemannian manifolds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09755)
*Chunming Tang,Hao He,Wen Huang,Jinbao Jian,Ruyun Li*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种流形上的QO-free方法，用于求解带等式和不等式约束的非线性优化问题，通过三线性系统和降维最小二乘子问题求解搜索方向，结合黎曼弧搜索，证明了全局收敛、强收敛和超线性收敛性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: QO-free方法在欧氏空间中是求解非线性约束优化问题的有效算法，但尚未被推广到流形上的优化问题。现有相关文献中假设Maratos效应不会出现，这限制了方法的实际应用。因此，需要将该方法扩展到流形设置，并显式处理Maratos效应以提高算法的实用性和理论完备性。

Method: 在流形上提出QO-free算法：(1) 每次迭代求解三个共享相同线性算子的线性方程组确定主搜索方向；(2) 通过求解降维线性最小二乘子问题获得高阶校正方向，以规避Maratos效应；(3) 在当前迭代点的切空间内执行黎曼弧搜索生成新迭代点。

Result: 在适当假设下，建立了算法的全局收敛性和强收敛性；证明了单位步长最终会被弧搜索接受，进而建立了算法的超线性收敛性；数值实验表明该方法与其他现有方法相比具有很强的竞争力。

Conclusion: 该工作成功将QO-free方法推广到流形优化场景，并通过高阶校正方向解决了Maratos效应问题，从理论和数值两方面验证了方法的有效性和优越性。

Abstract: The quadratic optimization-free (QO-free) method is a class of powerful and effective algorithms for solving nonlinearly constrained optimization problems in Euclidean spaces. The aim of the present work is to extend this method to solve optimization problems on manifolds with additional equality and inequality constraints. We first present a specific algorithm in the manifold setting. At each iteration, three linear systems sharing a common linear operator are solved to determine the master search direction. In addition, a higher-order correction direction is obtained by solving a reduced linear least squares subproblem to circumvent the Maratos effect which is assumed not to arise in existing related literature. A Riemannian arc search is then performed within the tangent space of the current iterate to generate the new iterate. Under appropriate assumptions, we establish the global and strong convergence of the proposed method. Moreover, we prove that the unit step size will eventually be accepted by the arc search, upon which the superlinear convergence of the algorithm is established. Finally, numerical results demonstrate that the proposed method is very competitive compared with other existing approaches.

</details>


### [400] [ADPSO-ERLS: A Hybrid Discrete PSO with Enhanced Local Search for the Traveling Salesman Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09786)
*Anier Soria-Lorente,Jean-Marie Vilaire,Junior Michel,Lázaro Alvarado-Barrios*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出ADPSO-ERLS，一种针对旅行商问题（TSP）的离散群智能算法，将探索与局部强化之间的搜索预算分配作为显式可调设计变量。该方法受PSO启发但摒弃了速度、惯性和加速度系数，结合记忆引导的交换变异、异构初始化、候选受限2-opt和改进的最终精炼。在五个对称TSPLIB实例上，ADPSO-ERLS在所有实例上取得最低最佳和平均成本，并通过Friedman检验和Wilcoxon比较证明其统计优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TSP是研究基于种群的方法如何在探索与逐步增强的局部强化之间分配固定搜索预算的经典场景。现有方法对这一分配通常是隐式的而非显式可调的设计变量，作者希望将其显式化以更好地理解和管理搜索策略。

Method: ADPSO-ERLS是将探索与强化预算分配作为显式可调设计变量的离散群算法。核心组件包括：(1)记忆引导的交换变异（利用个体与全局记忆）；(2)异构初始化；(3)进化过程中的选择性候选受限2-opt；(4)仅对当前最优解进行最终精炼，结合候选受限和可选完整2-opt及双桥扰动。方法受PSO启发但移除速度、惯性和加速度系数。所有六个算法用Rust实现，在相同硬件上运行，严格限制在100,000次候选解评估内。

Result: 在五个对称TSPLIB实例（整数EUC_2D约定）上的50次运行中，ADPSO-ERLS在每个实例上均取得最低最佳和平均成本，最佳线路Gap为1.93%-4.17%，相对误差为3.04%-5.50%。在Friedman检验中排名第一，25个经多重性控制的Wilcoxon比较均利于该方法且分布分离接近完全。配对消融实验表明初始化、进化内局部搜索和最终精炼对质量提升有贡献，而候选限制主要减少运行时间（最多约38倍）。扩展到16,862个城市时最佳Gap仍低于6.7%，最大实例在11分钟内求解。

Conclusion: ADPSO-ERLS通过显式设计探索与强化的预算分配，在严格的评估预算约束下取得优于其他五种算法的性能。候选限制策略在保持解质量的同时大幅减少运行时间，验证了将搜索预算分配作为可调设计变量的有效性。该方法展示了PSO思想在离散组合优化中的适配方式不必然依赖传统速度更新机制。

Abstract: The Traveling Salesman Problem is a canonical setting for studying how a
  population-based method should allocate a fixed search budget between
  exploration and progressively stronger local intensification. We propose
  ADPSO-ERLS, a discrete swarm algorithm that treats this allocation as an
  explicit, tunable design variable. It couples memory-guided swap mutation,
  heterogeneous initialization, selective candidate-restricted 2-opt during
  evolution, and an incumbent-only final refinement combining candidate-restricted
  and optional full 2-opt with double-bridge perturbations. The method is
  PSO-inspired, using personal and global memories yet dispensing with velocity,
  inertia, and acceleration coefficients. All six algorithms are implemented in
  Rust, run on identical hardware, and stopped at a strict, recorded limit of
  100,000 candidate-solution assessments, so that programming language, hardware,
  and evaluation budget are held common across methods; wall-clock time is
  reported separately because equal assessment counts need not correspond to
  equal arithmetic work. Over 50 runs on five symmetric TSPLIB instances under the integer
  \texttt{EUC\_2D} convention, ADPSO-ERLS attains the lowest best and mean cost on
  every instance, with best-tour Gap of $1.93$--$4.17\%$ and relative error of
  $3.04$--$5.50\%$. It ranks first under the Friedman test, and all twenty-five
  multiplicity-controlled Wilcoxon comparisons favor it with large, near-complete
  distributional separation. A paired ablation with common seeds links
  initialization, in-run local search, and final refinement to quality gains,
  while candidate restriction chiefly cuts runtime, by up to a factor of roughly
  $38$. Further experiments up to $16{,}862$ cities keep best-tour Gaps below
  $6.7\%$, solving the largest case in under eleven minutes.

</details>


### [401] [A Singular Control Problem for Data Center Electricity Cost Minimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09794)
*Rene Carmona,Xiaoyu Cui*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文对一个涉及受控状态过程运行最大值的随机控制问题进行了完整分析，该问题源自数据中心面临重合峰值电费和需求响应计划的成本最小化场景。作者证明了值函数的局部Lipschitz连续性，导出了动态规划原理和粘性公式，证明了HJB方程粘性解的存在性和比较定理，并提供了数值结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据中心在面临重合峰值电费（coincident peak charges）和参与需求响应计划时，其成本最小化问题可建模为包含运行最大值（running maximum）的随机控制问题。数学上，运行最大值进入系统状态会迫使原问题成为一个有界闭楔域上的奇异随机控制问题，并伴有边界反射，这在数学分析上具有挑战性。

Method: 1) 利用耦合反射负荷的间隙单调性估计和两个运行最大值差异的确定性全变差界，证明值函数在空间上的局部Lipschitz连续性；2) 对普通逐步可测控制推导动态规划原理和粘性公式；3) 推导包含负载方向下边界反射Neumann条件和域对角线部分斜边界条件的HJB方程；4) 证明粘性意义下解的存在性以及提供条件唯一性的比较定理；5) 提供数值结果说明预期成本中两个相互冲突激励之间的权衡。

Result: 成功证明了值函数的局部Lipschitz连续性；建立了动态规划原理和粘性表述；证明了HJB方程粘性解的存在性和比较定理（给出对应粘性类中的条件唯一性）；通过数值实验展示了数据中心面临的两个冲突激励（重合峰值电费与需求响应收益）之间的权衡关系。

Conclusion: 该论文为含运行最大值的奇异随机控制问题提供了完整的数学分析框架，填补了该方向的理论空白，并为数据中心电力成本优化问题提供了严格的理论基础和数值验证，展示了理论结果在实际场景中的应用价值。

Abstract: The goal of the paper is to provide a complete analysis of a stochastic control problem when the cost to minimize involves the running maximum of the underlying controlled state process. The model is motivated by the electricity cost minimization of a data center facing coincident peak charges and possibly benefiting from participation in a demand-response program. From a mathematical standpoint, the main challenge comes from the inclusion of the running maximum in the state of the system forcing the original problem into a singular stochastic control problem on a closed wedge in the plane with reflection on parts of the boundary. We prove that the value function is locally Lipschitz continuous in space using a gap-monotonicity estimate for coupled reflected loads and a deterministic total-variation bound for the difference of two running maxima. The dynamic programming principle and viscosity formulation are then derived for ordinary progressively measurable controls. The corresponding HJB equation includes a reflecting Neumann condition on the lower boundary for the load direction as well as an oblique boundary condition on the diagonal part of the boundary of the domain due to the effect of the running-maximum process. We prove existence of a solution in the viscosity sense as well as a comparison theorem providing conditional uniqueness in the corresponding viscosity class. Finally we provide numerical results illustrating the trade-off between the two conflicting incentives comprising the expected cost of the data center.

</details>


### [402] [Vehicle Platooning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09864)
*Zhi-Long Chen,Nicholas G. Hall*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了道路网络上车辆编队排序与重排序问题，目标是最小化总能耗或最大单车辆能耗。针对常见的车辆与道路特征组合，提供了完整的计算复杂度分类，设计了多项式时间算法、近似方案和启发式算法，并通过计算实验验证了启发式算法的平均解在最优解的1%以内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 车辆编队行驶可显著降低能耗、减少排放、提升道路利用率并增强安全性。随着智能驾驶技术发展，编队规模将大幅增加，高效的车辆排序与重排序变得日益重要，但该问题在复杂道路网络上的计算特性尚未被系统研究。

Method: 对车辆编队排序与重排序问题进行形式化建模，在两种目标函数（总能耗最小化与最大单车辆能耗最小化）下，对车辆与道路特征的各种组合进行计算复杂度分类；对难解情形设计全多项式时间近似方案（FPTAS）和具有可证明性能保障的多项式时间启发式算法；还处理了仅有限位置相关能耗信息可用的情况，以及只允许有限位置变换的实时道路重排序问题。

Result: 给出了完整计算复杂度分类，为不可解情形设计了FPTAS和带性能保证的启发式算法；计算实验表明所提启发式平均解在最优解的1%以内；还开发了有限信息和有限重排约束下的有界最坏情况性能算法。

Conclusion: 该研究为节能型车辆编队排序与重排序提供了全面的算法框架，涵盖多种现实约束和不同信息可用性场景，为实际应用奠定了理论基础。

Abstract: Vehicle platooning offers significant benefits, including reduced energy consumption, lower emissions, improved road utilization, enhanced safety, and reduced driver fatigue. As intelligent driving technologies continue to advance, platoon sizes are expected to increase substantially, making the efficient sequencing and resequencing of vehicles increasingly important. We study the vehicle platoon sequencing and resequencing problem on road networks with varying segment lengths under two fundamental objectives: minimizing total energy consumption and minimizing the maximum energy consumption of any vehicle. For the typically encountered combinations of vehicle and road characteristics, we provide a complete computational complexity classification, either developing polynomial-time algorithms or proving computational intractability. For several intractable cases, we design fully polynomial-time approximation schemes and polynomial-time heuristics with provable performance guarantees. A computational study demonstrates that the proposed heuristics achieve average solutions within 1\% of optimal. We also consider settings in which only limited information about position-dependent energy savings is available and develop a heuristic with bounded worst-case performance. In addition, we present an efficient algorithm for on-road vehicle resequencing when only limited position changes are permitted. Together, these results provide a comprehensive algorithmic framework for energy-efficient vehicle platoon sequencing and resequencing.

</details>


### [403] [Safe Start: Configuring Optimization Algorithms for Decision-Making under Extreme Risks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09872)
*Henry Lam,Wasin Meesena*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究随机优化问题，目标不仅是优化平均情况目标，还要缓解稀有灾难性事件的发生。作者指出在有仿真模型的情况下，即使以合理自适应方式将方差缩减整合进优化，使用常见SGD算法时在保证实际运行时间上仍面临根本性挑战，因为基于尾部目标对决策变量极度敏感，导致无论选择什么步长都会出现收敛的二分式失败。作者提出"安全起点"（safe start）新概念作为补救措施，实现高效有限时间误差控制，并证明安全起点与方差缩减结合时采样复杂度可有利地缩放。方法在投资组合优化和神经网络鲁棒分类等实例中得到验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全感知决策和AI训练需要同时优化平均表现并缓解稀有灾难性事件。这类尾部目标对决策变量极度敏感，使得标准优化方法（如SGD）无法在合理时间内收敛，存在根本性的算法挑战。

Method: 提出"安全起点"（safe start）的新概念，使得优化过程可以从一个保证不会导致灾难性事件的初始点开始，从而实现高效的有限时间误差控制；在此基础上结合方差缩减技术，以有利的采样复杂度处理尾部目标优化。

Result: 证明了在安全起点与方差缩减结合下，采样复杂度能够有利地缩放；并在投资组合优化和神经网络鲁棒分类问题上展示了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 尾部风险目标优化需要新的方法论，单纯整合方差缩减到SGD无法保证实际运行时间；安全起点概念为这类问题提供了可行且高效的优化框架。

Abstract: We consider stochastic optimization where the goal is not only to optimize an average-case objective, but also to mitigate the occurrence of rare catastrophic events. This problem is motivated by safety-aware decision-making and AI training. We first argue that, in the presence of a simulation model, natural attempts to integrate variance reduction into optimization, even executed in a reasonable adaptive fashion, encounter fundamental challenges in guaranteeing realistic runtime when using common stochastic gradient descent algorithms. This challenge arises from the extreme sensitivity of tail-based objectives with respect to the decision variables, which renders a dichotomic failure of convergence regardless of what step size we select. We offer remedies based on a new notion of safe start that allows for efficient finite-time error control, and show how the sampling complexity scales favorably under the combination of safe start and variance reduction. We illustrate our methodologies on examples in portfolio optimization and robust classification with neural networks.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [404] [Application of Artificial Intelligence for Fraudulent Banking Operations Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07471)
*Bohdan Mytnyk,Oleksandr Tkachyk,Nataliya Shakhovska,Solomiia Fedushko,Yuriy Syerov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究利用机器学习算法识别银行欺诈交易，重点开发了基于人工神经网络和多种预处理技术的欺诈检测模型，实验结果表明堆叠泛化方法取得了最佳AUC值（0.954）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新冠疫情期间银行欺诈案件显著增加，大量业务转向线上平台以及慈善基金的滥用为犯罪分子提供了可乘之机，亟需有效的自动欺诈识别方法。

Method: 采用多种机器学习算法进行欺诈交易识别，并处理高度不平衡数据集、特征变换和特征工程以提升检测精度；提出了基于人工神经网络的模型，并与逻辑回归等算法进行对比，同时采用堆叠泛化集成方法。

Result: 逻辑回归算法表现最佳，AUC值约为0.946；堆叠泛化方法进一步提升了性能，AUC达到0.954；各算法结果均进行了可视化展示。

Conclusion: 利用人工智能算法识别银行欺诈是当前数字社会的重要议题，所提出的机器学习模型能够有效改进欺诈交易检测的准确性。

Abstract: This study considers the task of applying artificial intelligence to recognize bank fraud. In recent years, due to the COVID19 pandemic, bank fraud has become even more common due to the massive transition of many operations to online platforms and the creation of many charitable funds that criminals can use to deceive users. The present work focuses on machine learning algorithms as a tool well suited for analyzing and recognizing online banking transactions. The study`s scientific novelty is the development of machine learning models for identifying fraudulent banking transactions and techniques for preprocessing bank data for further comparison and selection of the best results. This paper also details various methods for improving detection accuracy, i.e., handling highly imbalanced datasets, feature transformation, and feature engineering. The proposed model, which is based on an artificial neural network, effectively improves the accuracy of fraudulent transaction detection. The results of the different algorithms are visualized, and the logistic regression algorithm performs the best, with an output AUC value of approximately 0,946. The stacked generalization shows a better AUC of 0.954. The recognition of banking fraud using artificial intelligence algorithms is a topical issue in our digital society.

</details>


### [405] [Hybrid Neural-Classical Correction for Frozen Time Series Foundation Models: A Comprehensive Ablation Study on High-Frequency Stock Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08825)
*Kasun Dewage,Suranadi De Silva,Shankhadeep Mondal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了将冻结的TimesFM（2亿参数）基础模型通过神经-经典混合校正方法适配到高频金融场景（开盘时段的股票收益预测）。比较了两种神经校正架构（AttnCorrect约47.1万参数，GatedLinear约4.9万参数）并结合随机森林残差学习，在10只科技股、200万数据点上取得了0.597的合并相关系数，相比冻结TimesFM实现了6.4倍的日均相关性提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型在通用场景下具有良好的零样本泛化能力，但在高频金融等专业领域中表现欠佳。作者希望探索如何有效适配冻结的基础模型到专业金融预测场景，并回答神经组件与经典方法在适配中各扮演何种角色。

Method: 采用"冻结TimesFM + 神经校正 + 经典残差学习"的混合架构。神经校正部分对比了两种架构：AttnCorrect（多头自注意力，约47.1万参数）和GatedLinear（低秩双线性投影+门控，约4.9万参数）；经典部分使用随机森林进行残差学习。在10只主要科技股上进行了系统消融实验。

Result: 混合方法实现0.597合并相关性和6.4倍日均相关性提升；随机森林经典残差学习是贡献最大的单一组件；去除经典残差学习后，简单神经架构反而优于复杂架构；自注意力在纯神经方案中贡献最大。GatedLinear+RF以比AttnCorrect+RF少9倍的神经参数取得了最佳综合性能。

Conclusion: 有效的基础模型适配需要神经与经典组件的精心整合，经典方法在基础模型适配中扮演着至关重要的互补角色。论文提供了实用指导：在资源受限的金融场景中，轻量门控线性架构结合经典残差学习是更优的选择。

Abstract: Foundation models for time series forecasting demonstrate impressive zero-shot generalization but often underperform on specialized domains such as high-frequency finance. We present a comprehensive study of hybrid neural-classical correction for adapting frozen TimesFM (200M parameters) to stock return prediction during the volatile opening trading hour. We compare two neural correction architectures - AttnCorrect (multi-head self-attention, approximately 471K parameters) and GatedLinear (low-rank bilinear projection with gating, approximately 49K parameters) - each augmented with Random Forest residual learning. Through systematic ablation across 10 major technology stocks (NVDA, MSFT, AAPL, GOOG, GOOGL, AMZN, META, AVGO, TSLA, NFLX) spanning 2 million data points, we reveal critical insights: (1) The hybrid neural-classical approach achieves 0.597 pooled correlation and 6.4x mean per-day correlation improvement over frozen TimesFM; (2) Classical residual learning (Random Forest) provides the largest single-component contribution, matching or exceeding the neural correction component; (3) Simpler neural architectures surprisingly outperform complex ones when classical residual learning is removed; (4) Self-attention provides the largest neural-only contribution. GatedLinear+RF achieves best overall performance with 9x fewer neural parameters than AttnCorrect+RF. We report three complementary correlation metrics - mean per-day, cross-day cumulative, and pooled - to provide a complete picture of predictive quality. Our results provide practical guidance: effective foundation model adaptation requires careful integration of neural and classical components, with classical methods playing a crucial complementary role.

</details>


### [406] [Data-Driven Fire-Zone Segmentation for Improved Short-Term Wildfire Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07472)
*Nicolas Caron,Christophe Guyeux,Hassan Noura,Benjamin Aynes*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文挑战了野火预测中均匀网格划分的传统范式，提出一种基于流域检测和K-means聚类的无监督火灾区域分割方法，直接从历史火灾模式定义预测单元。在法国六个省和六种预测模型上的实验表明，该方法相比网格方法持续提升性能（平均IoU提升3-6%），且计算轻量（<10秒）并完全可并行化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统野火预测模型将研究区域离散化为均匀网格，但忽略了火灾点位的异质性空间分布。作者质疑这一范式，认为数据离散化方式比选择何种模型更为关键，因此需要一种更好的空间划分策略。

Method: 提出一种无监督火灾区域分割算法，结合流域检测（watershed detection）与K-means聚类，直接从历史火灾模式中定义预测单元，替代传统的均匀网格划分。

Result: 在法国六个省、六种预测模型上的实验表明，火灾区域分割方法始终优于基于网格的方法，平均IoU提升3-6%（取决于空间尺度）。该方法计算轻量（每个配置<10秒）且完全可并行化。

Conclusion: 优化空间离散化策略能带来显著且可复现的短期野火预测性能提升，为野火预测提供了一种新的高效思路。

Abstract: Wildfire prediction models typically discretize study areas into uniform grids, ignoring the heterogeneous spatial distribution of ignitions. We challenge this paradigm by showing that how data is discretized matters more than which model is used. We propose an unsupervised fire-zone segmentation algorithm combining watershed detection with K-means clustering to define prediction units directly from historical fire patterns. Experiments across six French departments and six forecasting models show that fire-zone segmentation consistently outperforms grid-based approaches, with mean IoU improvements of +3--6% depending on spatial scale. The method is computationally lightweight (<10s per configuration) and fully parallelizable. Our results demonstrate that optimizing spatial discretization yields significant, reproducible performance gains for short-term wildfire forecasting.

</details>


### [407] [Evolving Safety Landscape of Multi-modal Large Language Models: A Survey of Emerging Threats and Safeguards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07535)
*Xi Li,Shu Zhao,Xiaohan Zou,Fei Zhao,Fuxiao Liu,Yusen Zhang,Cheng Han,Yushun Dong,Jiaqi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统性地综述了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的安全态势，提出了多模态安全威胁的分类体系，分析了从单模态到多模态场景下威胁模型的演变，并总结了相应的安全策略及未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLMs通过模态对齐与融合整合异构模态，增强了理解与推理能力，但同时也重塑了机器学习的安全格局。模型复杂度和跨模态交互带来了新的威胁（如模态整合受损、模态错位、融合安全风险），而现有基于单模态学习的框架无法捕捉这些新约束，亟需系统性分析。

Method: 本文采用结构化调研方法：首先提出一个多模态接地（grounded）的安全威胁分类体系，分析威胁模型从单模态到多模态的转变；随后总结更新后的安全假设，并据此组织梳理近期MLLM安全策略的研究进展；最后讨论开放挑战和未来方向。

Result: 该综述覆盖了对抗攻击、数据投毒、越狱（jailbreaks）和幻觉（hallucinations）等威胁类型，系统整理了多模态安全策略的近期进展，并指出了当前框架在应对多模态安全挑战方面的不足。

Conclusion: MLLM安全研究需要从单模态思维转向多模态视角，建立更原则性、更可扩展的安全机制，以应对跨模态交互带来的独特安全挑战。

Abstract: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) integrate heterogeneous modalities through modality alignment and fusion, enabling stronger understanding and reasoning. However, this architectural shift reshapes the safety landscape of machine learning. Increased model complexity and cross-modal interactions give rise to novel threats, including compromised modality integration, modality misalignment, and fused safety risks, reflecting shifts in threat modeling beyond uni-modal assumptions. These shifts, in turn, impose new constraints on safety solutions not captured by existing frameworks rooted in uni-modal learning. Motivated by these challenges, this survey provides a systematic analysis of the evolving safety landscape of MLLMs. We first propose a multimodal grounded taxonomy of safety threats and analyze shifts in threat models, covering adversarial attacks, data poisoning, jailbreaks, and hallucinations. We then summarize updated safety assumptions and organize recent advances in MLLM safety strategies accordingly. Finally, we discuss open challenges and future directions to inform the development of more principled and scalable safety mechanisms for multimodal systems.

</details>


### [408] [Tracing sources of epistemic uncertainty in deep learning predictions: homo- and hetero-scedastic linearized estimators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07630)
*Pierre Nodet,Thomas George*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文改编两种经典统计估计器用于深度学习中的不确定性量化，区分偶然不确定性（aleatoric）和数据稀缺引起的不确定性，利用近似Fisher信息矩阵实现架构级扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习模型的不确定性量化通常难以区分两种来源：数据本身的偶然不确定性与数据稀缺导致的认知不确定性。传统估计器无法直接扩展至现代深度网络架构。

Method: 将两种经典统计估计器引入深度学习框架，结合近似Fisher信息矩阵的最新进展，实现对实际架构的可扩展不确定性量化，分别估计偶然不确定性与局部数据稀缺性带来的不确定性。

Result: 实验表明每个测试点受到两种不确定性来源的影响各不相同，验证了估计器在实际应用中的实用性，有助于提升模型的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 所提方法能够有效区分并量化深度学习中两种不同来源的不确定性，为提升真实世界应用的鲁棒性提供了实用工具。

Abstract: We adapt two classical statistical estimators for quantifying uncertainty to modern deep learning, in order to provide clearer insights into uncertainty attributable to two sources : aleatoric uncertainty, or locally scarce data. Our approach leverages recent advances in approximate Fisher Information Matrices, to enable scaling to actual architectures. Experimental results demonstrate how each test points is differentially impacted by both sources, highlighting the practical utility of our estimators in improving the robustness of real-world applications.

</details>


### [409] [SkillConsist: Detecting Inconsistencies in Agent Skills via Bidirectional Graph Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07639)
*Chaofan Meng,Yuhang Zheng,Yingnan Zhou,Sihan Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SkillConsist，一种通过双端行为图构建与双向图对齐来检测LLM Agent技能声明与实现不一致的方法，在633个技能基准上达到87.93%的F1分数，比最佳基线提升20.43个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent技能的不一致可能暴露未披露的危险行为或导致错误的技能选择。现有方法依赖预定义类别或声明范围进行评估，但声明与实现行为可能混杂在文本和代码中，且简洁声明可能对应多个连接的实现步骤，使得一致性检测面临挑战。

Method: SkillConsist包含三个核心步骤：(1) 利用LLM将声明和实现内容分离为行为记录，并用静态分析补充实现记录；(2) 分别构建声明端和实现端行为图；(3) 从任一端的行为记录出发，通过双向图对齐搜索另一端的候选子图并沿行为关系扩展，最后通过图差异分析识别冲突并输出检测结果。

Result: 在包含319个不一致和314个一致技能的633个技能基准上，SkillConsist在包级检测上达到86.85%的精确率、89.03%的召回率和87.93%的F1分数，F1比最佳基线提升20.43个百分点；在定位任务上达到67.60%精确率、58.14%召回率和62.52%的F1。

Conclusion: SkillConsist通过行为图建模和双向对齐机制有效解决了Agent技能声明与实现不一致的检测问题，显著优于现有基线方法，为Agent技能安全性与可靠性提供了有力保障。

Abstract: Agent Skills provide reusable capabilities to LLM agents. Agent Skill inconsistencies can expose undisclosed dangerous behavior or cause wrong Skill selection. Recent Agent Skill research has increasingly examined Agent Skill consistency detection. Existing methods evaluate behaviors or security-property graphs against predefined categories or declared scopes. More recently, PL-HCL uses an LLM-based model to learn consistency across metadata, instructions, and resources. However, declaration and implementation behavior can be mixed across text and code, and a concise declaration can correspond to multiple connected implementation steps. We present SkillConsist to address both challenges. An LLM separates declaration and implementation content into behavior records on the implementation and declaration sides, while static analysis supplements implementation records. These records form declaration and implementation behavior graphs, respectively. Starting from a behavior record on either side, bidirectional graph alignment searches the other graph for a candidate subgraph and expands it along behavior relations until it completely expresses the source-side behavior. Graph differencing identifies conflicts between aligned subgraphs and outputs the detection results. We construct a 633-Skill benchmark from ClawHub's 500 most-downloaded public Skills and 133 Skill-Inject packages. The benchmark contains 319 inconsistent and 314 consistent Skills and 442 localized inconsistency annotations. On this benchmark, SkillConsist achieves 86.85% precision, 89.03% recall, and 87.93% F1 for package-level detection, improving F1 over the best baseline by 20.43 percentage points. For localization, it achieves 67.60% precision, 58.14% recall, and 62.52% F1.

</details>


### [410] [PhysAttNet: Enhancing Predictive Performance in Industrial and Astrophysical Time Series via Physics-Informed Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07681)
*Amal Saadallah,Julia Tjus,Petra Wiederkeher,Wolfgang Rhode*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PhysAttNet，一个物理信息引导的注意力框架用于时间序列预测。它通过三种正则化约束（对齐、平滑、稀疏）引导轻量级CNN预测器的注意力机制遵循物理信号的结构特性，在铣削力预测和耀变体耀斑预测两个应用中提升了预测精度、泛化能力和重要事件预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CNN在时间序列预测中广泛使用，但其学习到的时序表征常表现出不稳定或物理上不一致的注意力模式，导致鲁棒性、泛化性和可解释性下降。现有方法缺乏物理知识的引导，无法确保模型关注物理上有意义的时间结构。

Method: PhysAttNet在轻量级CNN预测器上增加一个注意力头，并通过三种可微的正则化项在训练中引导注意力：1) 对齐正则化——鼓励注意力遵循输入信号中平滑、峰值中心的时间结构；2) 平滑正则化——强制注意力的时间演化连续；3) 稀疏正则化——促进对信息丰富区间的选择性聚焦。这些正则化项引入物理引导的归纳偏好，无需人工标注解释或手动监督。

Result: 在铣削切削力预测和耀变体时间序列耀斑预测两个不同应用中，PhysAttNet相比基线方法提升了预测精度、泛化能力，并在结构上重要的事件上取得了更好的预测性能。

Conclusion: 通过将物理结构属性编码为可微正则化约束，PhysAttNet在不增加监督成本的前提下有效改善了CNN时序预测模型的鲁棒性、泛化性和可解释性，验证了物理信息引导注意力机制的可行性。

Abstract: Accurate and robust time series forecasting is essential in many applications involving physical processes, such as manufacturing monitoring and astrophysical event detection. In these settings, predictive models must remain reliable under noise, variability, and measurement uncertainty while capturing temporally localized structures corresponding to physically meaningful events. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are widely used for such tasks due to their computational efficiency and strong representational capacity. However, their learned temporal representations often exhibit unstable or physically inconsistent attention patterns, reducing robustness, generalization, and interpretability. This paper introduces PhysAttNet, a physics-informed attention framework for time series forecasting. PhysAttNet augments a lightweight CNN forecaster with an attention head guided by domain-informed regularization reflecting the structural properties of physical signals. Specifically, three complementary constraints are imposed during training: an alignment regularization that encourages attention to follow smooth, peak-centered temporal structures derived from the input signal, a smoothness regularization that enforces continuous temporal evolution, and a sparsity regularization that promotes selective focus on informative intervals. These differentiable regularization terms introduce physics-guided inductive bias without requiring annotated explanations or manual supervision. Experiments on two distinct applications, namely predicting cutting forces during milling and forecasting flares in blazar time series, demonstrate that PhysAttNet improves forecasting accuracy, generalization, and prediction performance on structurally important events.

</details>


### [411] [CODS: Iterative Bellman-Residual Data Selection for Reusable Offline Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07719)
*Ibne Farabi Shihab,Sanjeda Akter,Abu Sa-Adat Mohamed Moon-Im Al Ahsan,Md Najmus Swaqeeb,Anuj Sharma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CODS，一种由评论家引导的离线强化学习数据选择方法，通过交替进行算法匹配的评论家拟合与高残差转移获取，冻结可复用于集。在10%数据预算下，D4RL任务保留96.6%性能，在19/20单元上超越ReDOR与OPER，并扩展到ALFWorld与GSM8K等场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线强化学习从固定转移池中重复训练策略，跨种子和超参数时冗余数据代价高昂；而朴素子采样可能移除长时程信用分配所需的稀有转移。需要一种既能降低数据成本、又不破坏关键稀有样本的数据选择方法。

Method: CODS作为评论家引导的选择器，交替执行两个步骤：(1) 拟合与算法匹配的评论家；(2) 获取高残差（high-residual）转移样本，直到冻结一个可复用的子集。与优先回放不同的是，CODS生成静态产物；与一次性残差选择不同的是，它会在评论家变化时刷新残差分数。采用多轮获取策略，并进行了机制与污染干预分析。

Result: 在10%预算下，CODS在20个有效的D4RL任务-算法单元中保留了96.6%的合格池性能。在19/20单元上超过ReDOR和OPER，在20/20上超过所有其他子集基线；六个子集优势在预声明分层推断和Holm校正下仍显著。固定选择器更新总数时，5轮获取比1轮提升11.23分。等通行证与等小时评估表明计算优势来自复用而非单次运行加速。整轨迹扩展在ALFWorld保留95.4%成功率、GSM8K保留96.5%精确匹配。机制与污染干预揭示了有用的稀疏奖励富集效果以及对异常值的敏感性。

Conclusion: CODS是一种可复用的选择程序，而非正式的coreset保证。其核心价值在于通过评论家引导的迭代残差选择生成静态、可跨种子与超参数复用的数据子集，从而将计算优势建立在复用之上。

Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning repeatedly trains policies from a fixed transition pool, making redundant data costly across seeds and hyperparameters, while naive subsampling can remove rare transitions needed for long-horizon credit assignment. We introduce CODS, a critic-guided selector that alternates between fitting an algorithm-matched critic and acquiring high-residual transitions before freezing a reusable subset. Unlike prioritized replay, CODS produces a static artifact; unlike one-shot residual selection, it refreshes scores as the critic changes. At a 10\% budget, CODS retains 96.6\% of eligible-pool performance across 20 valid D4RL task--algorithm cells. It exceeds ReDOR and OPER on 19/20 cells and every other subset baseline on 20/20; all six subset advantages remain significant under predeclared hierarchical inference with Holm correction. Holding total selector updates fixed, five acquisition rounds improve four representative cells by 11.23 points over one round and saturate thereafter. Equal-pass and equal-hour evaluations clarify that reuse, rather than a single-run speedup, creates the compute advantage. Mechanism and corruption interventions expose both useful sparse-reward enrichment and sensitivity to outliers. Finally, a whole-trace extension retains 95.4\% of pooled ALFWorld success and 96.5\% of pooled GSM8K exact match. CODS is therefore a reusable selection procedure, not a formal coreset guarantee.

</details>


### [412] [Neural Operators for Immersed-Boundary Soft Swimmers Locomotion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07722)
*Mohammad Sadegh Eshaghi,Yizheng Wang,Navid Valizadeh,Xiaoying Zhuang,Timon Rabczuk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究开发了神经算子代理模型，用于预测鳗鱼游泳者产生的流体动力学场。平面模型和体积模型分别在不可见轨迹上实现了3.51%和3.44%（速度）、5.58%（涡度）、19.2%（压力）的全域相对L2误差，证明了移动边界游泳者流场神经代理的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高保真浸没边界模拟能够解析变形游泳者与其周围流场的耦合运动，但计算成本极高，限制了其在工程设计、参数研究和控制中的重复评估使用。因此需要开发高效的代理模型来加速这些重复性计算。

Method: 开发神经算子代理模型，用于时间预测游泳者产生的流体动力学场。代理模型在自适应流固耦合模拟导出的规则网格场上训练，并以游泳者几何形状和雷诺数为条件。平面模型联合预测两个速度分量、标量涡度和压力；体积模型使用三个目标特定模型（分别预测三维速度、涡度和压力），共享多通道输入。

Result: 平面模型在5条高雷诺数轨迹上实现3.51%的全域相对L2误差。体积模型在5条范围内轨迹上的全域相对L2误差分别为：速度3.44%、涡度5.58%、压力19.2%。

Conclusion: 结果证明了对移动边界游泳者流场进行场分辨神经代理是可行的，同时指出压力预测精度和物理一致性是未来发展的优先方向。

Abstract: High-fidelity immersed-boundary simulation resolves the coupled motion of a deforming swimmer and its surrounding flow, but the resulting cost limits repeated evaluations for engineering design, parameter studies, and control. We develop neural-operator surrogates for temporal prediction of the hydrodynamic fields generated by planar and volumetric eel swimmers. The surrogates are trained on regular-grid fields exported from adaptive fluid--structure simulations and are conditioned on swimmer geometry and Reynolds number. The planar model jointly predicts two velocity components, scalar vorticity, and pressure. On five held-out high-Reynolds-number trajectories, its full-domain global relative L^2 error is 3.51 %. The volumetric formulation uses three target-specific models with a common multichannel input: one model predicts three-dimensional velocity, one predicts vorticity, and one predicts pressure. Their full-domain global relative L^2 errors on five held-out within-range trajectories are 3.44 %, 5.58 %, and 19.2 %. Together, the results demonstrate the feasibility of field-resolved neural surrogates for moving-boundary swimmer flows while identifying pressure accuracy and physical consistency as priorities for further development.

</details>


### [413] [Finite Constant Frontiers and Auditable Regret Certificates for Average-Reward Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07725)
*Ibne Farabi Shihab,Abu Sa-Adat Mohamed Moon-Im Al Ahsan,Md Najmus Swaqeeb*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个常数感知的比较协议用于平均奖励强化学习遗憾界，推导了通信MDP的显式有限下界证书（通过两状态块的二叉树构造），将下界系数从0.015提升至最高0.0291（提升94%），极限系数为1/32·√((A-3)/A)，并给出了上界的可审计组合规则与期望转换形式化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平均奖励强化学习的遗憾界虽然在对数因子意义上已知，但由于概率模式、结构参数、对数归一化、先验信息和规划假设不同，已发表的界难以直接比较数值内容。作者希望通过常数感知的比较协议和显式有限下界证书，实现公平且可审计的性能对比。

Method: 构造两状态块组成的二叉树作为下界证据结构；利用精确的轨迹级Bernoulli KL散度进行证明，并显式保持行动预算、直径、占用率、导航成本和终端偏置等参数。同时提出封闭形式包络改善系数，为上界给出跨度约束乐观学习者的可审计组合规则。

Result: 将已发表的系数0.015在有限前沿上改善为：中等条件下0.0200，更强行动、直径和时域条件下最高0.0291（提升94%）；极限系数为1/32·√((A-3)/A)。并通过控制诊断测试了直径依赖、宽度奖励交互、跨度误设和精确族上的有限下界证书。

Conclusion: 建立了常数感知的遗憾比较协议，提供了显著改善的下界系数与可审计的上界组合规则，同时坦诚指出自适应方向方差和规划证书仍未解决，未在上界方面宣称系数。

Abstract: Average-reward reinforcement-learning regret is known up to logarithmic factors, but the numerical content of published guarantees is difficult to compare because probability mode, structural parameter, logarithmic normalization, prior information, and planning assumptions differ. We introduce a constant-aware comparison protocol and derive an explicit finite lower certificate for communicating MDPs. The construction is a binary tree of two-state blocks; its proof uses exact trajectory-level Bernoulli KL divergence and keeps action budget, diameter, occupancy, navigation cost, and terminal bias explicit. A common closed-form envelope improves the published coefficient $0.015$ across a finite frontier: $0.0200$ in a moderate regime and up to $0.0291$ under stronger action, diameter, and horizon conditions, a $94\%$ increase. The limiting coefficient is $\frac1{32}\sqrt{(A-3)/A}$. For upper bounds, we give an auditable composition rule for a span-constrained optimistic learner, but do not claim a coefficient while adaptive directional-variance and planning certificates remain open. We also formalize valid expectation conversion and constant comparability. Controlled diagnostics test diameter dependence, bonus-by-width interactions, span misspecification, and the finite lower certificate on its exact family.

</details>


### [414] [LUCID: Latent-Skill Unified Control via Imagined Dynamics for Long-Horizon Humanoid Loco-Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07746)
*Cheng Guo,Mingzhe Ni,Angelo Cangelosi,Arash Ajoudani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LUCID是一个层级模型强化学习框架，通过想象Rollout学习可复用技能来解决长时间跨度的类人机器人操作与运动组合任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖脚本化规划器、有限状态机或任务特定的无模型策略来协调预训练技能，难以处理复杂的任务序列，缺乏高层的通用决策能力。

Method: 两阶段训练：先通过对抗模仿学习训练结构化的潜在条件低层策略；然后冻结低层策略，联合学习高层策略和宏动力学世界模型。世界模型预测潜在决策引起的时间延伸状态转移，使高层策略通过想象Rollout进行优化。

Result: 在多种模拟多物体重排场景中，LUCID相比基线方法在完整任务成功率和部分完成率上均有提升。

Conclusion: LUCID展示了层级模型强化学习在复杂的序列化运动-操作任务中的有效性，通过可复用技能和想象规划实现更好的长期任务执行能力。

Abstract: Long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation requires composing versatile whole-body skills and reliable high-level decision making. Existing methods often coordinate pretrained skills with scripted planners, finite-state machines or task-specific model-free policies, restricting their ability to handle complex task sequences. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{LUCID}, a hierarchical model-based reinforcement learning framework that plans over reusable skills through imagined rollouts of a learned dynamics model. LUCID first trains a structured latent-conditioned low-level policy via adversarial imitation and then freezes it while jointly learning a high-level policy and macro-dynamics world model. The world model predicts the temporally extended state transitions induced by latent decisions, enabling high-level policy optimization through imagined rollouts. We evaluate our framework across various simulated multi-object rearrangement scenarios. Experimental results show that LUCID improves the full-task success and partial-completion rates compared to prior baseline methods, demonstrating its effectiveness in complex sequential loco-manipulation tasks.

</details>


### [415] [From Benchmark Performance to Tool Deployment: Human-in-the-Loop Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07770)
*Mike Szklarzewski,CJ George,Gavin Smithson,Christopher Stokes,Dakota Fulp,William M. Jones,Benjamin Wynn,Alexander Ur,Agit Yesiloz,Clint Kallenbach,Mark Swartz,Nathan DeBardeleben,Sharmistha Chakrabarti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文评估了19种无监督异常检测模型在BowTie制造数据集上的表现，发现其性能远不如在MVTec AD等标准基准上稳定，对预处理高度敏感且跨条件下不一致。基于此发现，作者开发并部署了一个结合图像标注、AI辅助缺陷检测和集成验证引擎的人机协同框架，用于制造零件检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化异常检测方法在学术基准上表现强劲，但在真实工业条件下的行为尚不明确。作者旨在填补这一认知空白，评估模型在实际制造场景（反射表面、细微缺陷、轮廓变异）中的真实表现，并解决基准性能与部署现实之间的差距。

Method: 首先在BowTie制造数据集上系统评估19种无监督异常检测模型，并与MVTec AD基准结果对比。随后基于评估发现，开发并初步部署了一个统一的人机协同检测框架，包含：图像标注、AI辅助缺陷检测、集成验证引擎，以及热图引导的缺陷审查、SAM优化的候选区域（供检验员接受/拒绝/调整边界）、掩码评估和审查历史记录等模块。

Result: 发现模型在BowTie数据集上性能不如基准稳定，对预处理高度敏感，跨条件不一致，没有单一方法能统一保持稳健；共识审计表明标称数据质量影响部署。初步部署的人机协同框架有效替代了此前的人工目视检测和文档记录流程。

Conclusion: 研究凸显了基准性能与部署现实之间的显著差距，并提供了一个实用的人机协同框架来弥合这一差距，为工业异常检测的实际部署提供了重要参考。

Abstract: Automated anomaly detection methods often report strong performance on curated academic benchmarks, but their behavior under real-world industrial conditions is less clear. In this work, we evaluate 19 unsupervised anomaly detection models on the BowTie dataset, a challenging manufacturing dataset with reflective surfaces, subtle defects, and profile-specific variation. In contrast to benchmark results, we observe that model performance is less stable than typically reported on standard benchmarks such as MVTec AD, highly sensitive to preprocessing, and inconsistent across conditions, with no single approach emerging as uniformly robust; a consensus audit further indicates that nominal-data quality affects deployment.
  Motivated by these findings, we developed and initially deployed a unified human-in-the-loop framework for manufactured-part inspection that combines image annotation, AI-assisted defect detection, and an integrated validation engine, replacing a prior manual visual inspection and documentation workflow. The system supports heatmap-guided defect review, SAM-refined candidate regions for inspector acceptance, rejection, or boundary adjustment, mask evaluation where annotations exist, and review history for inspector consistency and onboarding. Together, the results highlight the gap between benchmark performance and deployment reality, and provide a practical framework for addressing it.

</details>


### [416] [The Sample Complexity of Policy Learning with Mu-Resets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07772)
*Gene Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了在μ-resets交互协议下基于策略的强化学习，解决了策略可实现性在样本复杂度中的作用问题，并证明了在有限全策略集中度下样本复杂度下界为exp(Ω(H))，而在有限推前向集中度下，对horizon的依赖被精确刻画为exp(Θ(√H))。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者旨在回答KLS25提出的关于策略可实现性在μ-resets交互协议下强化学习样本复杂度中所扮演角色的开放问题，并进一步探究horizon H在不同覆盖假设下对样本复杂度的影响。

Method: 在Kakade和Langford提出的μ-resets交互协议框架下，针对两种不同的覆盖假设（有界全策略集中度与有界推前向集中度），分别建立样本复杂度下界和紧密的上下界刻画。

Result: 在有限全策略集中度下，证明了exp(Ω(H))的样本复杂度下界；在有限推前向集中度下，证明了horizon依赖被严格刻画为exp(Θ(√H))。

Conclusion: 覆盖假设的选择对horizon依赖至关重要，不同覆盖假设会导致截然不同的样本复杂度行为；推前向集中度下horizon的平方根指数依赖是紧密的。

Abstract: We study policy-based reinforcement learning under the $μ$-resets interaction protocol of Kakade and Langford [KL02]. This interaction protocol enables the learner to sample trajectories from a given exploratory reset distribution $μ$, in addition to the starting distribution. We resolve the question raised by [KLS25] on the role of policy realizability for the sample complexity of this problem. Critically, the dependence on horizon $H$ is governed by the notion of coverage assumed of the reset distribution. Under bounded all-policy concentrability, we show a $\exp(Ω(H))$ sample complexity lower bound; with bounded pushforward concentrability, we show the dependence on horizon is tightly characterized as $\exp(Θ(\sqrt H))$.

</details>


### [417] [Shape Mutating Expert Compression:LorExperts and BTExperts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07814)
*Inesh Chakrabarti,Sourjya Roy,Bowen Bao,Thiago Crepaldi,Spandan Tiwari,Ashish Sirasao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LorExperts，一种保留路由器的MoE模型压缩方法。它利用专家功能共激活社区结构，在每个聚类中保留一个全精度主导专家，其余专家表示为对局部主导专家的低秩修正，从而避免传统delta分解方法在专家数增长时的性能退化问题，在~50%压缩率下优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE语言模型虽然计算效率高，但大量专家权重矩阵导致部署成本高。现有的专家剪枝/合并方法牺牲精度且需要重训路由器，而低秩delta分解方法（如D^2-MoE）虽然保留所有专家和路由器，但由于单一共享组件无法近似众多近正交专家，在专家数量增加时性能急剧退化。

Method: LorExperts的核心发现是：MoE专家虽然权重近正交，但功能上会组织成与权重相似性解耦的共激活社区。基于此，该方法：1) 对专家进行聚类；2) 每个聚类保留一个全精度主导专家；3) 将聚类内其他专家表示为对该主导专家的低秩修正。该方法保留所有专家和原始路由器，无需路由器重训练。此外还提出重建微调流程以及BTExperts树形组织以支持推理时共享计算的摊销。

Result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B和Gemma-4-26B-A4B上，约50%专家压缩率下，LorExperts在大多数任务上比基线更好地保留了下游准确率和困惑度，其中相对D^2-MoE的优势随专家数量E增长而扩大。

Conclusion: LorExperts通过利用专家的功能共激活社区结构，在保留路由器的前提下实现了更好的MoE压缩效果，克服了传统delta分解方法随专家数量扩展性差的局限，并提供了微调程序和树形组织结构等进一步的优化方案。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models deliver high capacity at low per-token compute, but deploying them cheaply requires compressing their many expert weight matrices. Expert pruning (e.g., REAP) and merging reduce cost but sacrifice accuracy and require retraining the router; low-rank delta decomposition of experts (e.g., D^2-MoE) preserves all experts and the router, but degrades sharply as the expert count grows because a single shared component cannot approximate many near-orthogonal experts.
  Because MoE expert weights are near-orthogonal, a single shared component (as in prior delta decomposition) scales poorly with the expert count; we show that experts nonetheless organize into functional co-activation communities that are decoupled from weight similarity. Building on this, we introduce LorExperts, a router-preserving compression method that clusters experts, keeps one full-precision dominant per cluster, and represents the remaining members as low-rank corrections to their local dominant. LorExperts retains all experts and the original router (no router retraining). At ~50% expert compression on Qwen3-30B-A3B and Gemma-4-26B-A4B, LorExperts preserves downstream accuracy and perplexity better than the baselines on most of the tasks; the margin over D^2-MoE grows with expert count E. We further give a reconstruction fine-tuning procedure for LorExperts, and BTExperts, a tree organization of dominants and corrections that enables inference-time amortization of shared computation.

</details>


### [418] [From token probabilities to calibrated confidence: An empirical study of mathematical question answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07827)
*Avery Ma,Lorne Schell,Vin Bhaskara,Leila Pishdad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型在数学问答任务中的置信度估计与校准问题。研究发现，虽然单个token概率往往过度自信，但聚合整个序列的token概率能捕捉正确与错误生成之间的细微差异。多遍估计方法（如自验证和Monte Carlo Dropout）能产生校准良好的置信度估计，而Platt缩放和保序回归两种事后校准方法能显著降低域内校准误差，但校准映射在不同数据集和模型间的迁移具有不对称性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究表明大语言模型的token概率往往过度自信，作者希望探究这些现成可用的信号是否仍能为数学问答提供良好校准的置信度估计，从而更好地判断模型生成答案的可靠性。

Method: 比较了单遍估计器（复用原始生成的token概率）与多遍估计器（通过验证或随机前向传递获取额外置信度信号）。多遍方法包括自验证（通过重新提示，含低成本原位变体）和Monte Carlo Dropout（从随机前向传递的变异中推导置信度）。同时评估了Platt缩放和保序回归两种事后校准方法。

Result: 聚合全序列的token概率能捕捉正确与错误生成之间微小但一致的差异，比单个token概率更具信息量。多遍方法能产生校准良好的置信度估计。两种事后校准方法均大幅降低域内校准误差，但数据效率随数据集难度变化，且校准映射在不同数据集和模型间往往不对称迁移。

Conclusion: 现成的token概率信号经过适当聚合仍可用于置信度估计，多遍估计方法和事后校准方法可进一步提高校准效果，但校准映射的跨域迁移能力存在局限，需谨慎应用。

Abstract: Confidence estimation for large language models (LLMs) aims to estimate the probability that a generated answer is correct, while calibration aligns these estimates with empirical accuracy. Prior work has shown that token probabilities are often overconfident, we investigate whether these readily available signals can nevertheless provide well-calibrated confidence estimation for mathematical question answering. We compare single-pass estimators, which reuse token probabilities from the original generation, with multi-pass estimators, which obtain additional confidence signals through verification or stochastic forward passes. While individual token probabilities can be highly saturated, we find that aggregating token probabilities over the full sequence captures small but consistent differences between correct and incorrect generations, yielding more informative confidence estimates. Multi-pass methods can yield calibrated confidence estimates. We study two such approaches: self-verification through re-prompting, including a lower-cost in-situ variant, and Monte Carlo Dropout, which derives confidence from variation across stochastic forward passes. We further evaluate two post-hoc calibration methods, Platt scaling and isotonic regression, both of which substantially reduce in-domain calibration error. However, their data efficiency varies with dataset difficulty, and the calibration mappings often transfer asymmetrically across datasets and models.

</details>


### [419] [TEMPER: Tensorized Efficient Manifold-constrained Parameterization for Expressive Residual Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07851)
*Yuxuan Gu,Wuyang Zhou,Huijun Xing,Danilo Mandic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TEMPER方法，利用张量网络对流形约束超连接（mHC）中的密集生成器进行结构化低秩参数化，在保持token相关流形约束路由接口的同时大幅减少参数量，并在语言建模和常识推理任务中达到与现有方法相当或更优的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有超连接方法（HC/mHC）虽能提升残差路由的表达性和稳定性，但其生成器（用于分支前聚合、残差混合和分支后重分配）是密集无结构的，导致参数随残差流数量快速增长，存在生成器层面的瓶颈。

Method: 将生成器表示为张量多路形式（输入流、特征、输出流三个模式），并使用张量网络进行参数化，实现结构化低秩表示。张量秩控制路由子空间的维度，全秩可恢复密集路由；同时生成器近似误差可界定路由logits及路由块输出的差异。

Result: TEMPER在语言建模和常识推理任务上匹配或超越现有方法，在8个残差流时达到最佳CORE分数，同时相比mHC减少约84%的额外参数，展现出更强的性能-参数效率权衡。

Conclusion: 张量网络参数化是解决残差路由生成器参数爆炸问题的有效途径，能在保持流形约束路由接口的同时大幅提升参数效率，并增强方法的可解释性。

Abstract: Residual connections rely on a static residual pathway, and are essential for training deep neural networks. Hyper-connections (HC) increase the expressivity of residual routing by incorporating multiple residual streams and learning dynamic information flow, while manifold-constrained (mHC) variants stabilize training through doubly stochastic residual mixing. However, a generator-level bottleneck remains in existing methods: they use dense, unstructured generators for pre-branch aggregation, residual mixing, and post-branch redistribution, which results in parameter count growing rapidly with the number of streams. To address this issue, we propose \underline{\textbf{T}}ensorized \underline{\textbf{E}}fficient \underline{\textbf{M}}anifold-constrained \underline{\textbf{P}}arameterization for \underline{\textbf{E}}xpressive Residual \underline{\textbf{R}}outing (\textbf{TEMPER}), which represents these generators as multi-way tensors over the input-stream, feature, and output-stream modes, and parameterizes them using tensor networks. Such a structured low-rank formulation is shown to preserve token-dependent manifold-constrained routing interface while substantially reducing parameter growth. It also promotes interpretability and intuition, as: i) tensor ranks control the dimensionality of the learned routing subspace, with full ranks recovering dense routing; while ii) the generator approximation errors bound differences in routing logits and, consequently, in the routed-block outputs. Comprehensive experiments show that TEMPER matches or outperforms existing methods across language modeling and commonsense reasoning tasks, while requiring substantially fewer additional parameters. At eight residual streams, TEMPER achieves the best CORE score while using about $84\%$ fewer additional parameters than mHC, thus showing a stronger performance-parameter efficiency trade-off.

</details>


### [420] [CommitKV: Lifecycle-Aware KV Cache Compression via Commit Transitions for Multi-Turn Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07855)
*Weizhong Huang,Jinchao Zhang,Xiawu Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CommitKV是一种针对多轮推理-行动（ReAct）智能体的KV缓存压缩方法。它通过识别"提交转换"（commit transitions）来区分暂时休眠的信息与已完成其角色、可安全删除的信息，从而在不牺牲准确性的前提下减少内存使用并加速推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于快照的KV缓存压缩方法仅依据当前轮次的注意力分数进行驱逐，但低注意力并不意味着未来不相关——暂时不活跃的信息可能在后续变得重要。现有方法无法明确区分"暂时休眠"的信息与"已完成角色"的信息，导致可能错误删除未来有用的状态或保留过多冗余信息。

Method: CommitKV通过以下机制实现：(1) 将已完成的智能体事件划分为token页面，在工具调用提交前后分别测量每个候选页面的删除效果（配对测量）；(2) 基于配对测量区分休眠页面与高到低完成度候选；(3) 应用贪婪联合测试，仅当组合的后提交效果保持有界时才接受候选退役；(4) 在后续压缩检查点，排除已接受退役的页面、保护等待后提交测量的有界页面集合，并在缓存预算内以相同的token索引保留其余KV状态（键、值、绝对位置）。

Result: 在多种基准测试上的实验表明，CommitKV能够减少智能体内存使用、加速端到端推理，并且比现有的KV缓存压缩方法实现更高的准确性。

Conclusion: CommitKV通过利用工具调用提交转换作为生命周期界定的关键信号，成功区分了暂时休眠与已完成角色的信息，实现了更优的KV缓存压缩效果，兼顾了内存效率和模型准确性。

Abstract: Multi-turn Reasoning-and-Acting (ReAct) agents accumulate growing trajectories of reasoning, tool calls, and observations. Their key-value (KV) caches grow accordingly, increasing memory use and attention cost during model inference. Existing KV cache compression methods reduce these costs by evicting states with low attention scores. However, low attention in the current turn does not imply future irrelevance, as temporarily inactive information may become important later. Snapshot-based eviction methods therefore do not explicitly distinguish temporarily dormant information from information that appears to have completed its role. In this paper, we present CommitKV, which identifies KV lifecycles through commit transitions. Specifically, CommitKV first divides completed agent events into token pages and compares each eligible page's deletion effect before a tool-call commit and after the commit's returned observation has been incorporated. Based on these paired measurements, CommitKV distinguishes dormant pages from high-to-low completion candidates. It then applies a greedy joint test, accepting candidates for retirement only when their combined post-commit effect remains bounded. Finally, at a later compression checkpoint, accepted pages are excluded, a bounded set of pages awaiting post-commit measurement is protected, and the remaining KV states are retained within the cache budget using the same token indices for keys, values, and absolute positions. These mechanisms ensure that CommitKV can distinguish dormant information from information that has completed its observed role and can be safely removed. Experiments on various benchmarks show that CommitKV reduces agent memory use, accelerates end-to-end inference, and achieves higher accuracy than existing KV cache compression methods.

</details>


### [421] [Adaptive KappaSharp: Condition-Number Shaping for Preferential Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07859)
*Ketong Shao,Jialu Wang,Xuekai Pei,Ali Mesbah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出KappaSharp方法，解决偏好贝叶斯优化（PBO）中由于EUBO采集函数产生孤立比较对而导致的似然Hessian矩阵秩亏缺和病态问题。该方法通过对Hessian施加对角修正来降低条件数，修正量随先验不确定性增大而增大，且仅在模型拟合阶段应用，不影响查询选择。同时提出自适应变体，仅在代理模型对近期比较有信心时激活修正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准PBO方法（PairwiseGP+EUBO）中，EUBO每次查询产生与前序查询无共享候选的新配对，导致比较图形成孤立组件，使似然Hessian产生结构性秩亏缺。现有解决方案要么浪费查询预算强制连接，要么使用均匀正则化干扰已良好约束的方向，因此需要更精细的修正策略。

Method: 提出KappaSharp：对Hessian施加对角修正以降低条件数，修正强度与先验不确定性成正比（不确定性越高的方向修正越大）；修正仅在模型拟合步骤应用，不影响查询选择。另提出自适应变体Adaptive KappaSharp，当代理模型对近期比较有信心（问题良态）时自动停用修正。

Result: 在11个基准（5-20维）上测试，包括16维等离子体医学控制器调优问题，Adaptive KappaSharp优于标准PBO基线，最高提升达+10.9%（p=0.003）。

Conclusion: KappaSharp通过自适应、不确定性加权的Hessian对角修正有效解决PBO中Hessian秩亏缺问题，在保持查询选择不变的情况下提升了优化性能，尤其在高质量、高维问题中表现突出。

Abstract: Preferential Bayesian optimization (PBO) optimizes objectives accessible only through pairwise user comparisons. The standard approach fits a Gaussian process surrogate for observed pairwise comparisons (PairwiseGP) using the Laplace approximation and selects queries with the Expected Utility of Best Option (EUBO) acquisition function. EUBO queries new candidates at each step, producing pairs that share no candidates with previous queries. Each such pair forms an isolated component in the comparison graph, removing one degree of freedom from the likelihood Hessian and making it rank-deficient. This deficiency is structural and cannot be resolved by changing the surrogate modeling approach. Existing approaches to remedy this issue either waste query budget by forcing comparisons to stay connected, or apply uniform regularization that also perturbs directions already well-constrained by the observed comparisons. We propose KappaSharp that enables a diagonal correction to the Hessian to reduce its condition number, with larger corrections where the prior uncertainty is higher. The correction is only applied in the model fitting step, not query selection. An adaptive variant of KappaSharp is also presented that activates the correction only when the surrogate is confident about recent comparisons, avoiding unnecessary corrections when the problem is well-conditioned. On 11 benchmarks (5--20 dimensions), including a 16-dimensional controller tuning problem in plasma medicine, Adaptive KappaSharp outperforms the standard PBO baseline, with up to +10.9% ($p{=}0.003$).

</details>


### [422] [CONFER: Conflict-Aware Evidence Negotiation for Regime-Calibrated Weak Supervision in Multimodal Emotion Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07867)
*Bojing Hou,Ruohao Li,Yitong Zhu,Luwen Yu,Yuyang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CONFER，一种基于图的冲突感知证据协商框架，用于弱监督多模态情感识别。CONFER将每个模态专家表示为节点，包含预测信念、边界不确定性和运行时可靠性，通过迭代消息传递协商并利用三种模式（共识、异议、歧义）进行样本级弱标签校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态情感识别通常将自我报告标签视为可靠监督，忽视了自我报告的不可靠性以及跨模态冲突问题。需要一种能够感知冲突并协商模态间不一致的框架。

Method: 1) 将每个模态专家建模为图节点，包含预测信念、边界不确定性和从历史折外性能及当前样本不确定性估计的运行时可靠性。2) 使用不确定性感知的兼容性和可靠性导向的非对称边权重来驱动迭代消息传递协商。3) 采用同伴支持的预测读出。4) 通过冲突减少、残余分歧和平均模态不确定性划分三种机制（共识、异议、歧义）进行样本特定的弱标签校准。

Result: 在AMIGOS、MAHNOB-HCI和DEAP数据集上，在subject-dependent 10折和严格LOSO协议下达到竞争性性能。在AMIGOS-V上达到0.873准确率，在MAHNOB-V上达到0.854准确率（严格LOSO评估）。高冲突样本上协商收益更大，对弱标签损坏的鲁棒性更强。

Conclusion: 跨模态冲突不仅是有害噪声，还能为模态方向协调和监督可靠性估计提供有用信息。CONFER通过有效的图协商机制显著提升了弱监督多模态情感识别的性能与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Multimodal emotion recognition often treats self-reported labels as reliable supervision while overlooking self-report unreliability and cross-modal conflict. We propose \textbf{CONFER}, a graph-based conflict-aware evidence negotiation framework for weakly supervised multimodal emotion recognition. CONFER represents each modality expert as a node with a predictive belief, boundary-based uncertainty, and runtime reliability estimated from historical out-of-fold performance and current-sample uncertainty. Uncertainty-aware compatibility and reliability-directed asymmetric edge weights govern iterative message-passing negotiation, followed by peer-supported prediction readout. Conflict reduction, residual disagreement, and mean modality uncertainty further characterize three regimes---Consensus, Dissent, and Ambiguity---for sample-specific weak-label calibration. We evaluate CONFER on AMIGOS, MAHNOB-HCI, and DEAP under subject-dependent 10-fold and strict leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) protocols. CONFER achieves competitive performance, reaching \textbf{0.873} accuracy on AMIGOS-V and \textbf{0.854} accuracy on MAHNOB-V under strict LOSO evaluation. Further analyses show larger negotiation gains on high-conflict samples and improved robustness to weak-label corruption, indicating that cross-modal conflict provides useful information for both directional modality coordination and supervision-reliability estimation.

</details>


### [423] [Information Routing across Batch Boundaries: Memory--Batch Tradeoffs in Lipschitz Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07922)
*Zicheng Lyu,Zengfeng Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究随机Lipschitz bandit问题中"状态宽度"（保留的奖励相关状态位数W）与"更新深度"（提交批次数量B）之间的权衡，给出了直至对数因子的极小极大期望伪悔恨的完整刻画，并揭示了一个新的信息路由惩罚项。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应学习既需要保留观测所蕴含信息的状态，也需要在该状态上采取行动的机会。现有的顺序bandit和批量bandit研究分别处理了这两个极端，但缺乏对宽度-深度权衡的系统分析。理解状态保留量与批次数目之间是否可互换，对实际系统设计至关重要。

Method: 在随机Lipschitz bandit框架下，要求学习者在每次拉动后最多保留W位奖励相关状态，并将拉动组织为最多B个提交批次。对于W不小于d阶log(eT)的情形，给出了极小极大期望伪悔恨的完全刻画：通过构造下界证明对所有W成立，并通过匹配的策略（流式擦除验证统计量，同时保留安全活动集的掩码）实现上界。分析利用了信息路由约束：在区域尺度s下，低悔恨要求提交的动作转录编码Theta_d(s^{-d})个区域决策，而收集的边界状态至多携带(B-1)W位熵。

Result: 得到了新的惩罚项T^{(d+2)/(d+3)}(1+(B-1)W)^{-1/(d(d+3))}，证明状态宽度与更新深度不可互换。该定理恢复了全维最坏情形批量唯一边界，并在完全顺序特例下实现对数内存可达成性；静态批次边界与可预测的自适应边界等价。

Conclusion: 状态宽度和更新深度之间存在本质的信息路由约束，二者不能简单互换。核心发现是边界状态携带的熵(B-1)W与提交动作转录所需的区域决策数之间的张力，决定了悔恨的最终代价。匹配策略表明流式擦除验证统计量并保留安全活动集掩码即可达到最优。

Abstract: Adaptive learning needs both a state that preserves what observations imply and opportunities to act on that state. We study this width--depth tradeoff in stochastic Lipschitz bandits. After each pull, the learner retains at most $W$ bits of live reward-dependent state and organizes its pulls into at most $B$ committed batches. For $W\gtrsim_d\log(eT)$, we characterize minimax expected pseudo-regret up to logarithmic factors; the lower bounds hold for every $W$. Besides the classical sequential and unrestricted-memory batch costs, the frontier contains the new penalty \[
  T^{\frac{d+2}{d+3}}
  \bigl(1+(B-1)W\bigr)^{-\frac1{d(d+3)}}, \] proving that state width and update depth are not interchangeable. The interaction is an information-routing constraint: at regional scale $s$, low regret forces the committed action transcript to encode $Θ_d(s^{-d})$ regional decisions, while the collected boundary states carry at most $(B-1)W$ bits of entropy. Matching policies stream and erase verification statistics while retaining a mask of a safe active set, either in memory or fragment by fragment. The theorem recovers the full-dimensional worst-case batch-only frontier and logarithmic-memory achievability in the fully sequential specialization; static batch boundaries match predictable adaptive ones.

</details>


### [424] [V-Simba: Unleashing the Architectural Potential of RL in Visual Continuous Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07870)
*Donghu Kim,Youngdo Lee,Hojoon Lee,Johan Obando-Ceron,Byungkun Lee,Aaron Courville,Pablo Samuel Castro,Jaegul Choo,Clare Lyle*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: V-Simba是一个简单而有效的视觉RL架构，受状态基RL中Simba架构启发，在SAC基础上添加归一化层和逐点卷积，在DMC、Adroit和Meta-World基准上匹配或超越SOTA方法，且比DrQ-v2计算效率更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉强化学习中的样本效率挑战尤为突出，因为高维输入常掩盖学习信号。虽然先前工作专注于算法层面（如更好的动力学模型或探索策略），但近期状态基RL研究表明仅靠架构设计就能显著提升样本效率。作者希望探究这些架构原则能否迁移到视觉RL中。

Method: 基于Soft Actor-Critic (SAC)和数据增强构建，借鉴状态基RL中的Simba架构，通过添加归一化层来稳定训练，并使用逐点卷积来减少计算量，实现一个简单但有效的视觉RL架构。

Result: V-Simba在DMC、Adroit和Meta-World基准上匹配或超越了现有最先进方法，同时在计算效率上优于DrQ-v2。

Conclusion: 架构设计本身可以作为一种有效的杠杆来提升视觉强化学习的样本效率，且这种简单架构具有广泛适用性和计算优势。

Abstract: Improving sample efficiency remains a core challenge in reinforcement learning (RL), especially in real-world settings like robotics, where data collection is costly. This challenge is pronounced in visual RL, where high-dimensional inputs often obscure learning signals. While prior work in visual RL has focused on algorithmic solutions, such as better dynamics models or exploration strategies, recent advances in state-based RL show that architectural design alone can lead to significant gains in sample efficiency.
