This raises an important question: Can these architectural principles transfer to visual RL? In response, we introduce V-Simba, a simple yet effective visual RL architecture inspired by the Simba architecture from state-based RL. Built on top of Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) with data augmentation, V-Simba modifies the architecture by adding normalization layers to stabilize training and using pointwise convolutions to reduce computation. Despite its simplicity, V-Simba matches or outperforms the state-of-the-art methods across the DMC, Adroit, and Meta-World benchmarks, while being more computationally efficient than DrQ-v2. We make our code publicly available at https://github.com/DAVIAN-Robotics/V-Simba.

</details>


### [425] [Causal State-Space Model for Causal Inference: Estimating Longitudinal Individual Treatment Effects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08288)
*Abisoye Abidakun,Mingjun Zhong,Georgios Leontidis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对纵向观测数据中的反事实结局估计问题，指出现有基于域混淆（对抗训练）的方法存在互信息冲突——即抑制治疗相关协变量信号会损害结局预测精度。作者通过Jensen-Shannon散度界形式化此张力，并提出两个互补模型：CSSD（因果状态空间模型+直接解码器）和CSSPD（在CSSD基础上加入对比预测编码与局部信息最大化）。在MIMIC-III和Cancer Simulation数据集上验证了方法与互信息冲突分析的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有反事实结局估计方法依赖域混淆（对抗训练）使表征对治疗分配不变，但这种不变性会抑制治疗相关协变量信号，而这些信号对准确预测结局是必需的，形成互信息冲突，目前尚无人正式形式化此冲突。

Method: 1) 通过Jensen-Shannon散度界形式化反事实预测误差与互信息冲突的关系；2) CSSD：采用选择性状态空间模型配合并行多步直接解码器，单次前向传播同时生成所有预测时域，消除累积滚动误差；3) CSSPD：在CSSD基础上引入对比预测编码（CPC）和局部信息最大化（LIM），增强平衡表征的时间可预测性并恢复被域混淆破坏的局部协变量信息。

Result: 在MIMIC-III上，CSSPD在所有时域τ≥2均优于Causal Transformer（CT），反事实RMSE降低0.02（2步）至0.07（6步），编码器代价为O(T)。在Cancer Simulation上（混淆强度γ∈{0,1,2,3,4}），CSSPD在γ≤3时优于CT（提升25.9%–37.0%），CSSD取得最低平均RMSE（较CT降低12.7%），验证了互信息冲突分析。

Conclusion: 这是首个形式化平衡-预测互信息冲突的工作，并通过互补的预测性与信息论训练目标提供了结构化解决方案，证明域混淆并非无代价，需在表征不变性与可预测性之间寻求平衡。

Abstract: Estimating counterfactual outcomes over time from longitudinal observational data is central to clinical decision support. Existing methods rely on domain confusion -- adversarial training that renders representations invariant to treatment assignment -- yet this invariance creates a mutual information conflict: it suppresses treatment-correlated covariate signals necessary for accurate outcome prediction. We formalise this tension via a Jensen-Shannon divergence bound on counterfactual prediction error and develop two complementary models. CSSD (Causal State-Space model with Direct decoder) adapts selective State Space Models with a parallel multi-step decoder that eliminates accumulated rollout error by producing all prediction horizons simultaneously in a single forward pass. CSSPD (Causal State-Space model with Predictive regularisation and Direct decoder) augments CSSD with Contrastive Predictive Coding and Local Information Maximisation to reinforce temporal predictability in the balancing representation and recover local covariate information destroyed by domain confusion. On MIMIC-III, CSSPD achieves lower counterfactual RMSE than the Causal Transformer at every horizon tau >= 2 at O(T) encoder cost, with gains from 0.02 (2-step) to 0.07 (6-step). On Cancer Simulation across confounding strengths gamma in {0,1,2,3,4}, CSSPD outperforms CT at gamma <= 3 (margins 25.9%--37.0%), and CSSD achieves the lowest overall average RMSE (12.7% reduction over CT), confirming the MI conflict analysis. To our knowledge, this is the first work to formalise the balancing-prediction MI conflict and propose a structured resolution through complementary predictive and information-theoretic training objectives.

</details>


### [426] [Router Sensitivity Under Lightweight Fine-Tuning Identifies Prunable Experts in Mixture-of-Experts Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07890)
*Ali Janati,Kaoutar El Maghraoui,Xinyi Luo,Wenyuan Shen,Owen Zou,Yankai Mao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出在轻量级参数高效微调（LoRA）下，通过路由器权重的l2变化量来评估专家重要性并进行一次性的专家剪枝，在Mixtral-8×7B-Instruct和Qwen1.5-MoE上验证了该方法在不损失太多性能的前提下大幅减少内存和延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE模型虽能解耦总参数与单token计算量，但部署仍需存储所有专家。先前理论表明基于路由器范数变化最小剪枝可保持精度，但假设全量微调，成本高昂。作者希望探究轻量级适配能否恢复这一信号，使专家剪枝在实际规模上可行。

Method: 先用参数高效适配器（如router-only LoRA）短暂微调模型，按诱导的l2路由器变化量对专家排序，一次性剪掉变化最小的专家。对比了router-only LoRA、全模块LoRA、IA3和未约束的加性适配器等不同适配策略对信号质量的影响。

Result: 在Mixtral-8×7B上，router-only LoRA仅训练0.002%参数，移除一半专家后MMLU-Pro达27.54%，优于全模块LoRA的24.42%；随LoRA秩增加性能提升至28.76%。剪枝后内存减少49%，延迟减少37%，性能为幅度剪枝或随机剪枝的1.8倍。在Qwen1.5-MoE上保留50%专家仍保持49.7%平均准确率，而随机剪枝降至个位数。

Conclusion: 轻量级微调下的路由器敏感性指标能够使理论上可证明的专家剪枝在实际规模上变得实用，这表明路由器导向的剪枝信号在低维参数空间中依然存在且有效。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models decouple total parameters from per-token compute, but deployment still requires storing every expert. Recent theory shows that pruning experts with the smallest router-norm changes during fine-tuning can preserve accuracy, but assumes full fine-tuning. We test whether lightweight adaptation can recover this signal. We briefly fine-tune with a parameter-efficient adapter, rank experts by the induced $\ell_2$ router change, and prune the least-changed experts in one shot. On Mixtral-8$\times$7B-Instruct (44.83% MMLU-Pro), router-only LoRA trains 0.002% of parameters and outperforms all-module LoRA at matched rank with half the experts removed (27.54% vs. 24.42%); signal quality declines as adaptation spreads to attention and expert weights. Accuracy improves monotonically with LoRA rank, reaching 28.76%. IA3, which leaves router weights frozen, matches direct router adaptation, whereas unconstrained additive adapters degrade the signal. Router-guided MMLU-Pro accuracy decays quasi-linearly rather than collapsing, remains nearly 1.8 times that of magnitude-based or random pruning at maximal compression, and reduces memory by 49% and per-token latency by 37%. At 25% compression, retention is competitive with methods using full activation statistics. The criterion also transfers to Qwen1.5-MoE fine-tuned for mathematics, retaining 49.7% mean accuracy over eleven benchmarks with half the experts removed while random pruning falls to single digits. Router sensitivity under lightweight fine-tuning therefore makes provably motivated expert pruning practical at scale.

</details>


### [427] [Exact Rank and Convex Calibration Dimension Lower Bounds for the Multi-Label F1 Loss](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08399)
*Mingyuan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文确定了多标签分类中实例级F₁度量的精确秩，并通过分析其贝叶斯几何结构，建立了凸校准代理维度的二次下界，最终证明CCdim(L^F₁)=Θ(s²)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: F₁度量是多标签分类的核心性能指标，但之前只知道其仿射表示和移位低秩表示的上界（s²+1维），精确秩未知。更重要的是，精确秩本身并不能为任意凸校准代理的维度提供下界，因此需要直接分析F₁的贝叶斯几何来建立校准维度的下界。

Method: 1) 通过子集关联矩阵和正定柯西矩阵分解非空得分矩阵，证明F₁得分矩阵、移位损失矩阵和未移位损失矩阵的秩均为s²-s+2，列仿射维度为s²-s+1。2) 直接分析F₁的贝叶斯几何，构造一种分布使得恰好所有包含固定核心标签集的超集都是贝叶斯最优的，并证明在支撑集上活动损失列的仿射维度为hn（其中n=s-⌊s/3⌋，h=⌈(s⌊s/3⌋)^{1/2}⌉-1）。3) 应用可行子空间凸校准维度的下界方法。

Result: 确定了F₁相关矩阵的精确秩（s²-s+2），并得出CCdim(L^F₁) ≥ (2/(3√3)-o(1))s²，结合已知的二次上界，建立了CCdim(L^F₁)=Θ(s²)的精确渐近阶。

Conclusion: F₁度量的凸校准代理维度确认为二次阶Θ(s²)，这是对多标签分类F₁度量理论和凸校准理论的重要精确刻画。

Abstract: The instance-wise $F_1$ measure is a central performance measure for multi-label classification. For a problem with $s$ labels, it defines a $2^s\times 2^s$ loss matrix. Previous work exhibited $s^2+1$-coordinate affine and shifted low-rank representations and used them to construct quadratic-dimensional convex calibrated surrogates. We determine the exact rank. Under the convention $F_1(\varnothing,\varnothing)=1$, the $F_1$ score matrix, the shifted loss matrix, and the unshifted loss matrix all have rank $s^2-s+2$, while the column-affine dimension of the loss is $s^2-s+1$. The proof factors the nonempty score matrix through subset-incidence matrices and a positive-definite Cauchy matrix.
  Exact rank does not, by itself, lower-bound the dimension of an arbitrary convex calibrated surrogate. We therefore analyze the Bayes geometry of $F_1$ directly. We construct a distribution for which precisely all supersets of a fixed core label set are Bayes optimal, and show that the corresponding active loss columns, restricted to the witness support, have affine dimension $hn$, where $n=s-\lfloor s/3\rfloor$ and $h=\lceil(s\lfloor s/3\rfloor)^{1/2}\rceil-1$. Applying the feasible-subspace lower bound for convex calibration dimension gives \[
  \operatorname{CCdim}(L^{F_1})
  \ge \left(\frac{2}{3\sqrt{3}}-o(1)\right)s^2. \] Together with the quadratic upper bound, this establishes $\operatorname{CCdim}(L^{F_1})=Θ(s^2)$.

</details>


### [428] [LLM-Based Embeddings for Program Analysis and Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07894)
*Calvin Higgins,Marco Alvarez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次将LLMCompiler（在中间表示代码上大规模预训练的LLM）生成的程序嵌入应用于程序分析与优化任务。通过将程序分块嵌入并聚合的简单方法，结合源代码和IR代码嵌入，在算法分类任务上达到1.54%的误差率，比当前最优方法提升12%，并在异构设备映射任务上取得有竞争力的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近年来机器学习（尤其是大语言模型）在程序分析和优化领域展现出巨大潜力，但此前尚未有研究系统地探索从IR代码中提取程序嵌入并应用于下游任务的效果。作者旨在验证基于IR代码的程序嵌入能否提升程序分析与优化任务的性能。

Method: 使用LLMCompiler模型，采用简单方法生成程序嵌入：先将程序切分为多个块（chunks），用预训练LLM独立嵌入每个块，再将块嵌入聚合成单一的程序嵌入。实验中同时使用源代码和IR代码的嵌入，并将其组合用于下游任务。

Result: 结合源代码和IR代码嵌入后，算法分类任务误差率为1.54%，较当前最优方法提升12%；在异构设备映射任务上取得有竞争力的准确率。

Conclusion: 实验结果表明，训练一个性能感知的LLM用于嵌入IR代码，可能在不同代码优化任务中取得最优结果，为后续基于IR的程序嵌入研究提供了方向。

Abstract: Recent advances have highlighted the potential of machine learning, particularly Large Language Models (LLMs), for analyzing and optimizing programs. We present the first application of program embeddings from LLMCompiler---an LLM massively pretrained on intermediate representation (IR) code---to representative program analysis and optimization tasks. We generate program embeddings directly from source and IR code using a simple approach: split programs into chunks, independently embed each chunk with pretrained LLMs, and then aggregate the chunk embeddings into a single program embedding. Our experiments show that combining source and IR code embeddings achieves an error rate of 1.54\% in algorithm classification, a 12\% improvement over the current state-of-the-art, and a competitive accuracy on heterogeneous device mapping. These findings suggest that training a performance-aware LLM for embedding IR code might yield state-of-the-art results in code optimization tasks.

</details>


### [429] [Constrained Learning with Universally Learnable Concept Classes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08414)
*Herlock SeyedAbolfazl Rahimi,Spyridon Pougkakiotis,Dionysis Kalogerias*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了无限维假设类上的约束统计学习问题，在完全非凸设定下建立了对偶算法的普适PACC（约束上概率近似正确）可学习性，同时保证最优性和约束满足。通过引入Tikhonov复杂度与闭包-实现间隙两个新概念，作者弥合了泛化与强Lagrangian对偶性之间的张力，证明了当间隙为零时达到精确可学习性，否则为带残差的近PACC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统近PACC结果存在可行性残差，无论多少数据都无法消除；而非凸设定下最优性与约束满足之间存在内在张力——泛化由Rademacher复杂度控制倾向于小假设类，而强Lagrangian对偶性依赖Lyapunov凸性和可分解性，倾向于大假设类。作者希望在无限维非凸设定下统一解决这一矛盾。

Method: 将总体问题置于一个普适RKHS H_K上，该空间在可分解包络中稠密，并在半径增长的范数球上进行学习。引入Tikhonov复杂度（达到ε-最优Lagrangian水平集所需的最小RKHS范数）与闭包-实现间隙（刻画H_K从对偶化中恢复可行解的能力），以此刻画学习的样本复杂度与可行性。

Result: 证明了Tikhonov复杂度有限，获得了最优值的精确可学习性，并在源条件下使样本阈值显式且关于1/ε为多项式。当闭包-实现间隙为零时（特别是对偶可微情形下）可学习性精确成立，否则为残差恰好等于该间隙的近PACC。此外证明了无分布自由阈值的下界，确立了普适性是大型假设类对偶算法的规范框架。

Conclusion: 该工作为无限维非凸约束学习提供了完整的理论框架，首次实现了精细的最优性-可行性权衡刻画。闭包-实现间隙作为问题本身而非建模选择的固有属性，为理解对偶方法在非凸情境下的可行性上限提供了新视角。

Abstract: We study constrained statistical learning over infinite-dimensional hypothesis classes in the fully nonconvex setting, and establish universal PACC learnability of the solutions of dual algorithms: Probably Approximately Correct on Constraints, guaranteeing optimality and constraint satisfaction at once. This strengthens near-PACC results, whose feasibility residual no amount of data can remove. Optimality is caught between generalization, governed by Rademacher complexity and favoring small classes, and strong Lagrangian duality, which rests on Lyapunov convexity for vector measures and needs decomposability, a demand pulling the other way. We reconcile the two by posing the population problem over a universal RKHS $\mathcal{H}_K$, dense in a decomposable envelope, and learning over norm balls of growing radius. This yields the Tikhonov complexity $\mathfrak{T}^{\varepsilon}_{n}$, the least RKHS norm reaching an $\varepsilon$-optimal Lagrangian level set; we prove it finite, obtain exact learnability of the optimal value, and make the sample threshold explicit and polynomial in $1/\varepsilon$ under a source condition. Feasibility is harder: absent convexity the Lagrangian may not attain its infimum, and dual information pins down only an averaged constraint-risk vector, not the risks of any returned predictor. We introduce the closure-realization gap $\varepsilon^\star_\infty$, an index of how well $\mathcal{H}_K$ retrieves feasible solutions from dualization; it is a property of the problem, not of a modeling choice. Learnability is exact when $\varepsilon^\star_\infty=0$, in particular under dual differentiability, and near-PACC with residual exactly $\varepsilon^\star_\infty$ otherwise. Finally, no distribution-free threshold exists already in the unconstrained specialization, so universality is the canonical frame for dual algorithms over large hypothesis classes.

</details>


### [430] [When Does Trace-Driven Evaluation Mislead MoE Expert Caching? Replay Semantics, Workload Contamination, and Operating Regimes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07911)
*Yu Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过轨迹驱动的、事件原子级的模拟器，对三个MoE模型（40/64/128专家）进行测量，发现专家缓存管理的评估指标非常脆弱。三个评估轴（重放语义、工作负载污染、运行体制）会改变结论而非仅改变数字。修正后，与离线最优的稳定差距仍有44.2-45.9%，其中84.3-96.6%归因于"知道哪个常驻专家未来最晚被使用"。但因果性下一使用预测器作为驱逐规则仅恢复-11.4%的差距，表明大型离线最优差距大幅高估了轻量级因果机制可获得的实际收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE模型已超出加速器内存，将专家权重卸载到主机内存已成为标准做法，因此专家缓存管理成为关键优化杠杆。但由于评估测量问题脆弱，不同评估方式会导致截然不同的结论，需要系统性地隔离和修正这些测量偏差。

Method: 构建了轨迹驱动的、事件原子级的模拟器，在三个MoE模型上隔离三个评估轴：1) 重放语义（融合事件vs逐访问重放）；2) 工作负载污染（指令模板匹配对渲染干预）；3) 运行体制（归一化未命中率跨模型转移、时间顺序置换）。同时使用强制准入预言机和因果性下一使用预测器来分解离线最优差距。

Result: 1) 不一致的逐访问重放使基于最近性的策略虚增27-29%，而频率基和静态策略仅偏差4%以内，导致策略排名反转；2) 匹配对渲染干预使测量到的早期窗口效应移动19.4-31.9个百分点；3) 仅置换相同事件流的时间顺序使离线最优差距从44.9%变为30.8%；4) 修正后稳定差距44.2-45.9%，84.3-96.6%归因于未来最晚使用知识；5) 因果预测器仅恢复-11.4%差距，最优受害者选择率仅3.4%对比LRU/LFRU的20.6-22.1%。

Conclusion: 在评估的设置中，离线最优的较大差距实质上高估了代表性轻量级因果机制可恢复的收益。作者立场狭窄但明确：测量必须修正，且简单的因果预测机制无法显著缩小与离线最优的差距，需要更深入理解专家使用模式的根本结构。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have outgrown accelerator memory, and offloading expert weights to host memory is now standard. This makes expert cache management an attractive lever: a policy that raised the hit rate would cut expert traffic per token. Evaluating that is a measurement problem, and we find the measurement fragile.
  With a trace-driven, event-atomic simulator over three MoE models (40, 64, 128 experts), we isolate three evaluation axes that change conclusions, not just numbers. Replay semantics: under a fused-event traffic contract, an inconsistent per-access replay inflates recency-based policies by 27-29% while leaving frequency-based and static ones within 4%, inverting the policy ranking. Workload contamination: probe sets using one instruction template per category produce verbatim-identical generation prefixes; a matched-pair rendering intervention moves the measured early-window effect by 19.4-31.9 points and reverses which workloads look most cache-friendly. Operating regimes: normalized miss fractions do not transfer across models, so the per-step expert union relative to per-layer capacity must be reported -- yet permuting only the temporal order of an identical event stream moves the offline-optimal gap from 44.9% to 30.8%, so it is not sufficient.
  Corrected, a stable gap to the offline optimum remains (44.2-45.9% over 13 frozen workload compositions). A forced-admission oracle attributes 84.3-96.6% of it to knowing which resident expert is used furthest in the future. A causal next-use predictor, used as an eviction rule, recovers -11.4% of the gap; it picks an optimal victim 3.4% of the time, against 2.4% for a random resident block and 20.6-22.1% for LRU and LFRU. Our position is narrow: in our evaluated settings a large offline-optimal gap substantially overstates the gains recovered by representative lightweight causal mechanisms.

</details>


### [431] [No Unique Minimizer, No Problem: On the Consistency of Robust Neural Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08489)
*Subhabrata Majumdar,Anand Deo,Partha Pratim Saha,Abhik Ghosh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对深度学习中非可辨识神经网络参数的鲁棒分类一致性问题，提出了基于S-divergence族的理论框架，证明经验S-divergence最小化器能收敛到总体最优等价类，并验证了三种网络架构的条件，实验表明该方法在保持干净数据精度的同时具备竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交叉熵训练的神经网络对标签噪声和对抗污染高度敏感，现有鲁棒替代方法虽具鲁棒性，但由于神经网络参数化的非可辨识性（population loss最小化器是等价类而非唯一点），其在深度学习环境中的统计基础不足。

Method: 将训练建模为非可辨识参数空间上的随机优化问题，基于S-divergence族发展无需可辨识性假设的鲁棒神经分类器一致性理论，证明经验S-divergence最小化器在温和正则条件下收敛到总体最优等价类，并验证三种架构的条件；同时证明鲁棒训练算法的极限点是经验目标的平稳点。

Result: 在视觉和语言基准数据集上的实验表明，S-divergence训练在保持干净数据精度的同时，性能与现有鲁棒方法相当。

Conclusion: S-divergence族为深度鲁棒分类器提供了无需可辨识性假设的统计一致性基础，兼具理论保障与实践竞争力。

Abstract: Neural network classifiers trained by cross-entropy minimization are highly sensitive to label noise and adversarial contamination. While robust alternatives offer bounded influence and resistance to corruption, their statistical foundations in the deep learning setting are insufficient due to a fundamental difficulty: neural parameterizations are non-identifiable, so the population loss minimizer is an equivalence class of parameters, not a unique point. We develop a consistency theory for robust neural classifiers based on the S-divergence family that requires no identifiability assumption. Casting training as stochastic optimization over a non-identifiable parameter space, we prove that empirical S-divergence minimizers converge to the population-optimal equivalence class under mild regularity conditions, and verify these conditions for three architecture choices. We further establish that limit points of the robust training algorithm are stationary points of the empirical objective. Experiments on vision and language benchmark datasets confirm that S-divergence training maintains clean-data accuracy while exhibiting performance competitive with existing robust methods.

</details>


### [432] [SPECTRA: Pushing the KV Cache Beyond the 2-Bit Cliff via Spectral Transform Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07915)
*Jiamu Zhang,Liang Wu,Kelly Wan,Hanjie Chen,Liangjie Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SPECTRA是一种无需训练、即插即用的KV缓存压缩编码器，通过将缓存旋转到由其自身统计量计算出的坐标系中，消除通道间相关性后，将比特预算集中在少数信息量大的通道上，从而突破2-bit量化悬崖，实现最高12倍压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在长上下文场景下，KV缓存占用大量GPU内存，现有量化方法将每个值压缩到相同低精度，但在约2比特处遭遇质量急剧下降的"2-bit悬崖"——由于缓存中存在异常值(outliers)，四个量化级别不足，少数大值耗尽级别而其余值坍缩为噪声。尝试按通道重要性分配比特时，原始缓存通道强相关，无法区分重要性。

Method: SPECTRA首先将KV缓存旋转到一个由其自身统计量计算出的坐标系中，消除通道间相关性。在这个新坐标系下，只有一小部分通道承载几乎所有信息，因此可以将比特预算集中分配给这些关键通道，而非均匀分配。

Result: 在Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen2.5-7B的长上下文基准测试中，SPECTRA在4倍压缩时接近无损，在均匀量化已失效的8倍压缩下仍具竞争力，并可达12倍压缩，将可用压缩率推过2-bit悬崖。

Conclusion: 通过旋转坐标系打破通道相关性，SPECTRA成功突破了2-bit量化悬崖，使相同的GPU能够承载更长的上下文和更大的批次，大幅提升长上下文推理的GPU内存效率。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly read long inputs in the agentic era, from whole documents and codebases to conversations across many turns. Their inference memory is then dominated by the key-value (KV) cache, the stored attention keys and values of every token the model has read and generated. Because the cache grows with context length and is re-read in full at every generated token, a longer context means more GPU memory.
  To reduce this cost, most existing methods compress the KV cache by lowering every stored value to the same low precision, a technique known as quantization. They can push this to nearly two bits per value, but rarely further, because quality drops sharply at this 2-bit cliff: four levels are too few for the cache's outlier-heavy values, where a few large entries consume the levels and collapse the rest into noise. A natural remedy is to spend more bits on the channels (feature dimensions) that matter and fewer on the rest, but the raw cache offers no handle: its channels are strongly correlated, so none stands out as more important.
  Our analysis shows that this handle appears once the cache is rotated into a coordinate system computed from its own statistics, removing these correlations. There, a small fraction of channels carries almost all the information, and spending the budget on those few is far more accurate than spreading it evenly.
  Guided by this analysis, we develop SPECTRA, a training-free, drop-in codec that re-encodes the cache into this coordinate system and concentrates the bit budget on the channels that carry the signal. On Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B over long-context benchmarks, SPECTRA is near-lossless at 4x compression, competitive at 8x where uniform quantization has collapsed, and reaches up to 12x, pushing usable compression past the 2-bit cliff so the same GPU holds longer contexts and larger batches.

</details>


### [433] [When Can Fraud Operations Authorize Automation? A Decision-Support Framework for Fresh Audit Evidence and Review Workload](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08577)
*Jie Deng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出新鲜度约束审计容量（FCAC）框架，将欺诈交易处理的自动化视为受行动风险、证据新鲜度和共享审查容量约束的授权决策。通过成熟随机审计与预设时间窗口评估候选行动区域，支持的区域自动化，不支持的区域保留人工审查，并实现零漂移自动化率约67%-84%及可控的总审查工作量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 欺诈运营需要在自动批准、分析师审查和自动阻止之间分配事件，但用于评估这些行动的标签具有选择性和延迟性。预测分数只能对案件排序，无法判断证据是否足够新颖且具有代表性以将决策委托给模型，因此需要一种考虑证据新鲜度和审查容量的决策支持框架。

Method: 提出FCAC框架：1) 将自动化建模为受行动风险、证据新鲜度和共享审查容量约束的授权决策；2) 从成熟的随机审计和预设时间窗口评估候选行动区域；3) 支持的区域自动化，不支持的保留人工审查；4) 推导同时有限样本控制不安全授权的条件，包括代表性随机审计、标签无关证据窗口及链接历史与当前行动风险的预设条件。

Result: 在IEEE-CIS、ULB-Worldline和Elliptic++数据集上，采用模拟审计的时序评估分别取得84.4%、67.4%和81.3%的零漂移自动化率，总审查工作量分别为24.1%、46.0%和43.1%。实验揭示审计容量权衡：稀疏审计延迟授权，密集审计增加工作量。BAF压力测试表明回退阈值应反映候选特定证据而非风险限额的固定比例。

Conclusion: 研究发现审计新鲜度和分析师容量是欺诈决策支持中的联合设计考量。在无法识别未观察标签演化的情况下，当前行动风险不可识别，必须在代表性随机审计、标签无关证据窗口及预设条件约束下才能实现对不安全授权的统计控制。

Abstract: Fraud operations must allocate events among automatic approval, analyst review, and automatic blocking even though the labels needed to evaluate these actions are selective and delayed. Predictive scores order cases, but they do not show whether the evidence is current and representative enough to delegate an action to the model. We develop freshness-constrained audit capacity (FCAC), a decision-support framework that treats automation as an authorization decision constrained by action risk, evidence freshness, and shared review capacity. It evaluates candidate action regions from mature randomized audits and a prespecified temporal allowance. Supported regions are automated; unsupported regions remain in review. The resulting decision record reports evidence age, audit demand, total review workload, value exposure, and compatible temporal change. We show that current action risk is unidentified without restricting unobserved label evolution. Under representative randomized audits, label-independent evidence windows, and a prespecified condition linking historical and current action risk, we derive simultaneous finite-sample control of unsafe authorization. Chronological evaluations with simulated audits on IEEE-CIS, ULB-Worldline, and Elliptic++ yield zero-drift automation rates of 84.4%, 67.4%, and 81.3%, with total review workloads of 24.1%, 46.0%, and 43.1%. The experiments reveal an audit-capacity trade-off: sparse auditing delays authorization, whereas intensive auditing eventually increases workload. A separately specified BAF stress test further indicates that fallback thresholds must reflect candidate-specific evidence rather than a common fraction of the risk limit. These findings identify audit freshness and analyst capacity as joint design considerations for fraud decision support.

</details>


### [434] [Beyond Aggregate Calibration: Decomposing Income-Conditional Recall Disparities in Automated Credit Default Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08202)
*Sai Srikar Boddupalli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在大型消费贷款数据集（LendingClub，N=134万）上评估数据为中心的清洗管道中常用的置信度过滤方法，发现高收入违约者被不成比例地标记为标签噪声。通过equal opportunity视角分析，发现高、低收入借款人的真正例率（召回率）存在16.86个百分点的差距。通过序列特征遮蔽方法，将这种差异归因于三个机制：对自报收入的直接依赖、算法吸收机构定价中的制度性偏见，以及即使剔除收入和利率后仍存在的残余差异。SHAP分析表明贷款金额和房屋所有权状态等结构性代理变量维持了这一残余差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据清洗管道广泛依赖模型置信度分数来标记和过滤噪声或错误标注的训练样本，但这一传统做法可能隐含人口统计维度上的不公平性。研究者希望揭示置信度过滤在金融信贷场景中的潜在偏见，并深入分析其在equal opportunity框架下的严重程度及产生机制。

Method: 在LendingClub大规模消费贷款样本上评估置信度过滤的公平性；采用equal opportunity框架量化真正例率差距；实施序列特征遮蔽方法（sequential feature-blinding）将差异分解为三个独立机制（收入、利率、残余），并利用出样本的SHAP值分析残余差距的结构性代理驱动因素。

Result: 置信度过滤导致高收入违约者被过度标记为噪声（Cramer's V约0.03-0.07）；equal opportunity下高、低收入违约者召回率差距达16.86个百分点；剔除收入和利率后仍存在显著残余差异（交叉验证3.55pp，测试集2.56pp，Z=-4.04, p<0.0001）；贷款金额和房屋所有权等代理变量维持残余差距。

Conclusion: 仅仅对算法屏蔽敏感属性（如收入）并不能保证公平性，因为机构定价决策和行为代理变量会共同重构被移除的遗漏信号。该发现对受监管金融机构中审计数据为中心AI工作流的实践具有重要启示。

Abstract: Data-centric curation pipelines frequently rely on model confidence scores to flag and filter noisy or mislabeled training instances. Evaluating this filtering convention on a large-scale consumer lending sample (LendingClub, N = 1,344,936) uncovers an underlying demographic asymmetry: high-income defaulters are disproportionately classified as label noise relative to low-income defaulters (Cramer's V approximately 0.03-0.07). Re-examining this behavior through the lens of equal opportunity [Hardt et al., 2016] reveals a far more severe discrepancy: a 16.86 percentage point gap in true positive rate (recall) between high- and low-income borrowers who ultimately defaulted. Implementing a sequential feature-blinding methodology allows us to isolate the drivers of this disparity across three distinct mechanisms: (1) direct reliance on self-reported applicant income; (2) algorithmic absorption of upstream institutional bias encoded within origination interest rates; and (3) a residual disparity (3.55 percentage points in cross-validation; 2.56 percentage points on a held-out test partition, Z = -4.04, p < 0.0001) that remains even after purging both income and interest rates from the model. Out-of-sample signed SHAP valuations demonstrate that this residual gap is maintained by structural proxies, most notably loan amount and home ownership status. These empirical findings show that simply blinding an algorithm to sensitive attributes fails to ensure fairness when institutional pricing decisions and behavioral proxy variables collectively reconstruct the omitted signals. We outline the practical implications of these findings for auditing data-centric AI workflows within regulated financial institutions.

</details>


### [435] [Spectral Outliers Reveal Dominant Learned Structure in Transformer Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07921)
*Kasun Dewage,Marianna Pensky,Suranadi De Silva,T. H. Bandara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文运用Marchenko-Pastur随机矩阵理论分析预训练注意力权重，将投影矩阵分解为随机噪声体（bulk）和谱离群值（signal）。通过对Mistral-7B的因果验证实验，证明零化MP识别的离群值会使模型性能降至随机水平，而零化同等数量的bulk奇异值仅造成较小退化。在11个预训练Transformer中发现五种规律性模式，并为参数高效微调和结构化剪枝提供启示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解预训练Transformer中注意力权重所编码的结构信息，区分信号与噪声，从而为模型压缩和高效微调提供理论依据。

Method: 采用Marchenko-Pastur随机矩阵理论将注意力投影矩阵分解为随机体（bulk）与谱离群值（outliers），并通过因果干预实验（零化离群值或bulk奇异值）验证分解的有效性；在11个预训练Transformer上进行系统分析。

Result: 零化MP识别的离群值使Mistral-7B在HellaSwag、MMLU和PIQA上接近随机水平；bulk零化导致较小但不可忽略的退化。发现五种模式：离群值编码主要学习结构；Q投影离群值最多；分组查询注意力的V投影缺乏清晰信噪分离；Q中的行带和O中的列带条目级离群值；K和O中特定残差流维度跨层持续形成带离群值。

Conclusion: 谱离群值是模型学习结构的主要载体，该分解方法可指导参数高效微调和结构化剪枝策略。

Abstract: We apply Marchenko-Pastur (MP) random matrix theory to pre-trained attention weights in order to separate each projection matrix into a random-like bulk and a set of spectral outliers. We validate this decomposition causally: zeroing the MP-identified outliers (signal) in Mistral-7B drives HellaSwag, MMLU, and PIQA close to random-chance performance, whereas zeroing a count-matched subset of bulk singular values causes smaller but non-negligible degradation. Across 11 pre-trained transformers we identify five recurring patterns: spectral outliers encode a dominant component of the learned structure; Q projections carry the most outliers; V projections under grouped-query attention lack a clean signal/noise separation; entry-level outliers form structured row-bands in Q and column-bands in O; and specific residual-stream dimensions persist as band outliers across layers in K and O. We close by outlining how these observations could inform parameter-efficient fine-tuning and structured pruning.

</details>


### [436] [Second Order Drifting Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07924)
*Drake Brown,Yuhao Huang,Shih-Hsin Wang,Bao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出二阶漂移模型（Second-Order Drifting Models），通过将漂移模型提升到相空间并引入人工速度变量，实现加速的密度动力学。该模型将漂移模型与优化理论中的Nesterov加速联系起来，缓解了传统一阶漂移模型在频域中的谱刚度问题，同时保持了一步推理的特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一阶漂移模型虽然避免了迭代推理，但其基于核的漂移场导致频率相关的训练动力学——在线性化机制下，密度残差的每个傅里叶模式以由核谱决定的速率衰减，导致细粒度结构的恢复缓慢（即谱刚度问题）。

Method: 将漂移模型提升到相空间，为生成的样本引入人工速度变量；推导出密度扰动在傅里叶空间中满足加速的二阶动力学；将该过程与优化理论中的Nesterov加速建立联系；设计实用的半隐式训练算法。

Result: 在合成分布匹配、序列数据生成和机器人控制三个场景下进行了评估。二阶漂移模型改善了收敛行为，并在性能上达到或超越了一阶漂移基线模型。

Conclusion: 二阶漂移模型提供了一种原理性机制来缓解一阶漂移的谱刚度问题，同时保持一步推理的优势，为漂移模型类生成模型提供了改进路径。

Abstract: Drifting models are a recent class of one-step generative models that evolve the model distribution during training using a predefined sample-based drift field. Although they avoid iterative inference, their kernel-based drift fields induce frequency-dependent training dynamics: In the linearized regime, each Fourier mode of the density residual decays at a rate determined by the kernel spectrum, leading to slow recovery of fine-scale structure. We propose Second-Order Drifting Models, which lift drifting dynamics into phase space by augmenting generated samples with artificial velocity variables. We show that the resulting density perturbations obey accelerated second-order dynamics in Fourier space, connecting drifting models to the celebrated Nesterov acceleration from optimization theory. This provides a principled mechanism for mitigating the spectral stiffness of first-order drifting while preserving one-step inference. We derive a practical semi-implicit training algorithm and evaluate it on synthetic distribution matching, sequential data generation, and robotic control. Across these settings, the second-order drifting model improves convergence behavior and achieves competitive or superior performance over first-order drifting baselines.

</details>


### [437] [Online Learning of Scale Parameters in Score-Driven Filters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09218)
*Fabrizio Lillo,Giulia Livieri,Gianluca Palmari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究得分驱动滤波器中增益参数的在线学习问题，将增益视为决策变量，通过KL散度目标下的镜像下降法进行动态学习，并给出了动态遗憾界；模拟和股市波动率数据验证了有界镜像增益优于常数增益且避免极端尖峰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 得分驱动滤波器（如GAS模型）中的增益参数传统上被视为固定或需离线调优的超参数，缺乏在线自适应学习机制。本文将增益选择形式化为条件预测决策问题，旨在通过在线学习实现增益的动态调整，提升预测性能并增强模型对多变市场环境的适应性。

Method: 将增益视为决策变量，以KL散度作为损失目标。推导出标量无缩放增益下连续得分乘积的负值为该损失的随机梯度；采用单调可微增益链接诱导镜像下降几何，通过持久性实现Bregman拉向参考增益；在凸性、紧致性和正则性条件下建立投影和折扣镜像更新的动态遗憾界。

Result: 在模拟中验证了缩放、链接几何、持久性和坐标传输率的作用。在股权指数波动率面板的样本外测试中，有界镜像增益通常匹配或优于常数增益，并能避免无界指数链接的极端尖峰，在多危机市场中改进最为显著。

Conclusion: 增益的在线学习是可实现的且理论上有保障的；有界镜像增益提供了稳健的性能改进，尤其在市场波动剧烈的多危机环境中表现突出，为得分驱动滤波器的自适应增益选择提供了理论与实证支持。

Abstract: Score-driven filters multiply a scaled log-likelihood score by a gain that controls the update magnitude. We treat this gain as a decision variable and study its online learning. Conditional on the current state, observation, score, and scaling rule, each admissible gain induces a reachable next state and a one-step-ahead predictive density: scalar gains govern distance along a line, while diagonal gains govern coordinatewise transmission. Gain selection is therefore a conditional predictive decision problem with a Kullback-Leibler objective. For a scalar unscaled gain, the negative raw product of consecutive scores is the stochastic gradient of this loss; positive aGAS scaling only rescales the effective step. Monotone differentiable gain links induce mirror-descent geometries on bounded gain domains, while persistence yields a Bregman pull towards a reference gain. Under convexity, compactness, and regularity conditions, we establish dynamic-regret bounds for projected and discounted mirror updates relative to time-varying, current-information comparators. Simulations illustrate the roles of scaling, link geometry, persistence, and coordinatewise transmission rates. An out-of-sample panel of equity-index volatilities shows that the bounded mirror gain generally matches or outperforms a constant gain while avoiding the extreme spikes of a nominally unbounded exponential link, with the strongest improvements observed in multi-crisis markets.

</details>


### [438] [Adaptive Supervised Anchoring for On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07935)
*Meilin Yang,Zixuan Ding,Jianhao Nie,Weite Zhang,Yuxin Zhang,Zhiming Shao,Li Yu,Zhe Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种统一训练框架，通过分离" rollout 条件下的分布匹配"和"规范上下文监督"两条互补路径，解决 on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) 中因学生轨迹偏离导致的 "rollout-conditioned signal degradation" 问题，在不同模型规模和任务上取得更好的塑性-稳定性权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPSD 的有效性严重依赖学生采样轨迹的质量。当学生 rollout 偏离目标轨迹时，教师基于偏离前缀的条件化会显著削弱任务相关监督信号，作者通过受控前缀破坏实验揭示这一失败模式，将其称为 "rollout-conditioned signal degradation"。

Method: 提出统一训练框架，分离两条互补监督路径：(1) 保留 rollout 条件下的分布匹配，对学生在实际访问状态上提供指导；(2) 在规范真实上下文中应用监督交叉熵，避免将目标 token 强加于错误 rollout 前缀。通过 token 级 rollout-target 对齐调整规范上下文锚的强度——冷启动时加强，rollout 质量改善时放松。

Result: 在多种模型规模、两类任务族和通用推理基准上，所提方法相比 OPSD 提升了任务习得能力，同时保持通用能力，获得更有利的经验性塑性-稳定性权衡。

Conclusion: 上下文质量是 OPSD 的核心瓶颈，分离 rollout 条件指导与规范监督具有明确价值，为后续改进 on-policy 自蒸馏方法提供了新的设计原则。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) adapts a language model by distilling guidance from a frozen teacher on trajectories sampled from the student. Its effectiveness, however, depends critically on the quality of those trajectories. We show that when student rollouts drift from target trajectories, conditioning the teacher on off-target prefixes substantially weakens its task-relevant supervision. Controlled prefix-corruption experiments expose this failure mode, which we term rollout-conditioned signal degradation. To address this problem, we propose a unified training framework that separates two complementary supervision pathways. The first retains rollout-conditioned distribution matching, providing guidance on states the student actually visits. The second applies supervised cross-entropy on canonical ground-truth contexts, avoiding the incompatibility of imposing target tokens on erroneous rollout prefixes. Token-level rollout-target alignment is used to adapt the strength of the canonical-context anchor, emphasizing it during cold start and relaxing it as rollout quality improves. Experiments across multiple model scales, two task families, and general-reasoning benchmarks show that the proposed approach improves task acquisition over OPSD while preserving general capabilities, resulting in a more favorable empirical plasticity-stability trade-off. These findings identify context quality as a central bottleneck in on-policy self-distillation and demonstrate the value of separating rollout-conditioned guidance from canonical supervision.

</details>


### [439] [Persistent Semantic Entities in Tool-Augmented LLM Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07952)
*Zhaohui Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文形式化定义了持久语义实体（PSEs）——工具增强型LLM代理中跨越会话、事件触发并跨代理边界传播的隐式状态污染，并在11个家族的24个模型中系统评估了其特性与防御方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具增强型LLM代理可以携带隐式状态，这些状态跨会话持续存在、通过事件激活并在代理边界间传播，而标准调试方法对此几乎不可见，构成严重的安全与可靠性隐患，亟需系统化的形式化与评估。

Method: 形式化定义PSEs的三个核心机制：名称绑定（name binding）、事件触发（event triggering）和跨边界传播（cross-boundary propagation）；在24个模型（1.5B-1T参数）上评估污染持久性；提出上下文隔离的自验证方法作为防御手段，并与基于关键字的检测方法对比。

Result: 所有测试模型均易受污染（20-100%），名称绑定是必要且主导机制（无此机制污染为0%）；偏好污染在所有模型上100%持续存留，指令污染在被采纳时持续存在，个性化风格注入部分衰减（90%→10%），事实注入依赖模型自校正；上下文隔离自验证实现20-79%（中位数36.5%）的污染降低，而关键字检测产生系统性误报；污染在四阶段代理管道中呈1.9倍复合增长（40%→75%）。

Conclusion: 偏好和指令污染具有持久性、缺乏自校正且标准监测难以捕获，代表了对已部署代理系统特别令人担忧的攻击面。规模或部署方式不是持久性的决定因素，污染类型才是关键。

Abstract: Tool-augmented LLM agents can harbor implicit state that persists across sessions, activates through events, and propagates across agent boundaries---largely invisible to standard debugging. We formalize this as Persistent Semantic Entities (PSEs): constructs defined by name binding, event triggering, and cross-boundary propagation, and evaluate them across 24 models from 11 families (1.5B--1T parameters). First, every tested model is susceptible (20--100% on the 20-model susceptibility panel), with name binding as the necessary and dominant mechanism: without it, contamination is 0%. Second, persistence depends on contamination type rather than scale or deployment: preference contamination persists undecayed on every model probed (100% at t=10) and instruction contamination persists wherever adopted, persona-style injection decays partially (90%$\to$10%), while factual injection is model-dependent---self-corrected on Llama-3.1-8B and GPT-4o-mini but held at ceiling on both Qwen2.5-coder variants, so we do not claim it self-corrects in general. The preference and instruction results hold across providers in our controlled setting. Third, context-isolated self-verification achieves 20--79% reduction (median 36.5%) without oracle references while keyword-based detection produces systematic false positives, and contamination compounds 1.9$\times$ along a four-stage agent pipeline (40%$\to$75%). Preference and instruction contamination---persistent, lacking self-correction, and poorly captured by standard monitoring---represent a particularly concerning attack surface for deployed agent systems.

</details>


### [440] [Test-Time Augmentation for LLMs: When Input Diversity Beats Output Diversity at Matched Compute](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09351)
*Nikita Kozodoi,Zainab Afolabi,Jack Butler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了测试时增强（TTA）这一策略，即在保持计算预算匹配的前提下，通过对输入进行扰动（语义改写、词汇扰动、视觉变换）来替代或补充自我一致性（仅对输出采样多次推理路径）的方法。实验表明，语义改写策略在六个数据集上的五个任务中优于自我一致性，且成本效益高出约1.8倍，尤其对中等规模模型最为划算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时计算扩展虽然能提升LLM准确率，但推理成本倍增，因此在部署中每单位计算获得的准确率提升才是关键指标。现有的自我一致性方法仅在输出侧投入预算（多次采样推理路径），作者想知道输入侧的多样性（TTA）是否比输出侧多样性更高效地将计算转化为准确率。

Method: 在匹配计算量（matched-compute）的条件下，系统比较了三种简单的输入侧策略（语义改写、词汇扰动、视觉变换）与思维链提示和自我一致性。实验覆盖六个数据集，包括通用和多语言知识、数学推理、多模态问答和情感分类。进一步分析了增强次数、多模态策略和基础模型规模的影响。

Result: 语义改写策略在六个任务中的五个上优于自我一致性，且具有统计显著性；每美元产生的准确率约为自我一致性的1.8倍，实现了Pareto支配。TTA对中等规模模型（无法获得或负担不起更强模型的情况）性价比最高。

Conclusion: 对于当前的中等规模LLM，改变输入比仅改变推理路径能更高效地将推理计算转化为准确率。这一发现为测试时计算扩展的策略选择提供了新视角，并开源了TTA实现。

Abstract: Test-time scaling improves LLM accuracy but multiplies inference cost, making the accuracy gained per unit of compute the metric that matters in deployment. Self-consistency is one of the established approaches, which spends this budget entirely on the output side by sampling repeated reasoning paths. We study Test-Time Augmentation (TTA), which extends self-consistency by also perturbing the input, aggregating predictions across transformed versions of the input, and ask whether input-side diversity converts compute into accuracy more efficiently than output-side diversity. We perform a systematic, matched-compute comparison: we evaluate three simple input-side strategies (semantic rephrasing, lexical perturbations, and visual transformations) across six datasets covering general and multilingual knowledge, mathematical reasoning, multi-modal question answering, and sentiment classification, against chain-of-thought prompting and self-consistency. Semantic rephrasing delivers consistent and statistically significant accuracy gains while Pareto-dominating self-consistency on cost-effectiveness, delivering roughly 1.8X more accuracy per dollar and outperforming it on five of six tasks. We further analyze the number of augmentations, multi-modal strategies, and base model scaling, finding that TTA is most cost-effective for mid-tier models where a stronger model is unavailable or too expensive. Our findings indicate that for current mid-tier LLMs, varying the input converts inference compute into accuracy more efficiently than varying the reasoning path alone. The TTA implementation is available at https://github.com/aws-samples/sample-genai-reflection-for-bedrock.

</details>


### [441] [From Uncertainty to Failure Attribution: Self-Diagnosing Models for Failure Attribution under Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07953)
*Yiyao Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的问题设定——分布偏移下的故障归因（failure attribution），并提出了自诊断模型（self-diagnosing models），该模型不仅能够检测OOD样本，还能识别出模型失败的四种原因：协变量偏移、语义偏移、噪声污染和对抗扰动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的分布偏移解决方案仅能检测OOD样本或预测不确定性水平，无法解释模型失败的根本原因。作者希望从标量不确定性预测走向结构化故障识别，帮助模型理解"为什么失败"。

Method: 提出自诊断模型，联合学习预测输出、预测不确定性和故障归因信号。利用神经网络产生的故障归因向量来区分四种失败类型。引入一致性正则化器，鼓励不确定性与故障归因预测之间的一致性。同时构建了具有预定义分布偏移机制的多个基准数据集用于评估。

Result: 通过构建带有预定义分布偏移机制的基准数据集，验证了自诊断模型能够有效完成故障归因任务，不仅能检测OOD样本，还能准确识别失败的具体原因。

Conclusion: 该工作将不确定性预测从标量推向结构化故障识别，为分布偏移下的模型鲁棒性提供了更深入的解释性诊断能力。

Abstract: Distribution shift poses a significant challenge to the robustness of machine learning models, but the current solutions only aim to detect out-of-distribution (OOD) samples and predict uncertainty levels. We introduce a problem setting for failure attribution under distribution shift, which enables the models not only to detect OOD samples, but also to find out the reason for their failure. The solution we propose is called self-diagnosing models, which are capable of jointly learning predictive output, predictive uncertainty, and a failure attribution signal. In particular, we use the failure attribution vector, produced by a neural network, which provides a structured representation of predictive unreliability by distinguishing four different types of failures: covariance shift, semantic shift, noise corruption, and adversarial perturbation. In other words, we move from scalar uncertainty towards failure identification. For training the model, we introduce a consistency regularizer that encourages consistency between uncertainty and failure attribution predictions. Moreover, to be able to evaluate the model on its ability to find the reasons for failure, we construct several distribution shift benchmarks with predefined mechanisms for generating distribution shifts.

</details>


### [442] [SR-OPSD: Self-Referenced On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09745)
*Zhuo Sun,Entong Li,Yanlong Zhao,Xiaoyuan Cheng,Wenxuan Yuan,Kaiyu Li,Che Liu,Huihang Liu,Harrison Bo Hua Zhu,Li Zeng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出自参考在线自我蒸馏（SR-OPSD），通过变分表征识别蒸馏目标为自教师策略与参考策略的几何插值，并使用Rényi散度族泛化投影几何，从而解决在线自我蒸馏中移动目标导致的优化不稳定和分布过度集中问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线自我蒸馏（OPSD）将反馈转化为稠密的token级监督，是对稀疏结果奖励强化学习的有效补充。然而，OPSD中的自教师策略与学生的上下文分布共同演化，使用固定投影目标匹配这种移动目标会导致优化不稳定或过度的分布集中，现有方法缺乏对这一问题的系统性解决。

Method: SR-OPSD方法包含两个关键组件：1）在固定的学生生成上下文下，通过token级变分表征将有效蒸馏目标识别为自教师策略与参考策略之间的几何插值，插值系数控制底层目标的放置位置；2）使用Rényi散度族泛化投影几何，其中Rényi阶数控制投影几何及其对token级密度比的敏感性，从而分离"目标放在哪里"与"学生如何投影向目标"两个维度。

Result: 在科学评估、数学推理和代码生成任务上，使用多种大型语言模型的广泛实验表明，SR-OPSD在多种设置下达到了最先进或具有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: SR-OPSD通过将目标放置与投影几何解耦，有效解决了OPSD中移动目标带来的优化不稳定问题，并在多个领域的LLM任务上验证了其有效性，为在线自我蒸馏提供了更稳健的框架。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) converts feedback into dense token-level supervision on trajectories generated by the policy to be optimized, providing a useful complement to reinforcement learning with sparse outcome rewards. However, the self-teacher policy used in OPSD is typically a stop-gradient or exponential-moving-average copy of the policy conditioned on additional context information, and thus co-evolves with both the student policy and its on-policy context distribution. Directly matching such a moving target with a fixed projection objective can lead to unstable optimization or excessive distributional concentration. This nature of OPSD motivates the proposed \emph{Self-Referenced On-Policy Self-Distillation (SR-OPSD)}. At fixed student-generated contexts, a token-level variational characterization identifies the effective distillation target as a geometric interpolation between the self-teacher policy and a reference policy. Meanwhile, we use the Rényi divergence family to generalize the projection geometry. This formulation separates \emph{where} the adaptive target is placed from \emph{how} the student is projected toward it: the interpolation coefficient controls underlying target, while the Rényi order controls the projection geometry and its sensitivity to token-level density ratios. Extensive experiments across scientific evaluation, mathematical reasoning, and coding generation tasks with multiple large language models show that SR-OPSD achieves the state-of-the-art or competitive performance across various settings.

</details>


### [443] [EasyBalance: Cross-Layer Load Balancing in Distributed MoE Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07964)
*Yize Wu,Ke Gao,Ling Li,Yanjun Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EasyBalance提出了一种跨层负载均衡策略，通过将其他层的专家视为当前层的天然冗余，并联合执行跨层MoE工作负载来缓解负载不均衡。该方法无需修改专家-设备映射，可即时适应且几乎无额外开销，实验表明能减少GPU空闲40%以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在MoE模型的专家并行分布式推理中，路由分布通常偏斜，导致承载轻负载专家的设备需要在专家计算期间等待最重的专家，造成效率低下。现有的负载均衡方法主要依赖层内的专家复制或迁移，这会引入额外开销并限制灵活性和可扩展性。

Method: EasyBalance利用两个关键洞察：(1) 其他层的专家可被视为当前层的天然冗余资源；(2) 跨层MoE工作负载可以联合执行以缓解各自的负载不均衡。基于此，EasyBalance在每个MoE步骤贪婪地调度一部分跨层工作负载执行，并将剩余工作负载推迟到未来进行负载均衡，通过跨层不均衡缓解来有效利用并行机会。

Result: 在多个模型、任务和配置上的广泛实验表明，EasyBalance能够持续加速分布式MoE推理，减少GPU空闲时间大部分超过40%。

Conclusion: EasyBalance通过跨层负载均衡策略有效解决了MoE专家并行推理中的负载不均衡问题，无需修改专家-设备映射，具有即时适应性和几乎零开销的优势，显著提升推理效率。

Abstract: Load Balancing has emerged as a critical problem in expert-parallel distributed inference of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. As routing distributions are typically skewed across experts, devices hosting lighter-loaded experts must idle to wait for the heaviest during expert computing, leading to inefficiency. Existing load-balancing approaches primarily rely on expert replication or migration within each layer, which introduce additional overhead and limit their flexibility and scalability. To address this problem, we propose EasyBalance, a cross-layer load balancing strategy that requires no modifications to the expert-device mapping, enabling instant adaptability and incurring essentially no additional overhead. Our key insights are that (1) experts of other layers can be viewed as naturally redundant for the current layer, and (2) cross-layer MoE workloads can be jointly executed to mitigate their individual imbalance. Based on these observations, EasyBalance greedily schedules a subset of cross-layer workloads to run at each MoE step and defers the remaining workloads for future balancing opportunities, effectively leveraging cross-layer imbalance mitigation. Extensive experiments across models, tasks, and configurations demonstrate that EasyBalance consistently accelerates distributed MoE inference, reducing GPU idling by mostly over 40%. Code is available at https://github.com/yize-wu/EasyInfra.

</details>


### [444] [ZeroLock: Concurrent Memory-Efficient LLM Training via Modular Update Decoupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07974)
*Wentao Dai,Xuanran Li,Yuxiang Zhang,Ming Tang,Chao Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ZeroLock，一种无反向传播（BP-free）的联邦/边缘大模型微调算法，通过局部目标构造将模型更新解耦为独立的分块更新，打破BP的更新锁定限制，从而在算法层面提升吞吐量并降低内存占用。文章首次为这种局部目标构造方法在通用模型分块下提供了理论收敛框架，证明其收敛率为Õ(1/√T)，与BP仅差多项式对数因子。在真实原型上，ZeroLock相比BP基线降低内存26.5%，提升吞吐量4.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘设备上的大模型微调面临内存和算力限制，现有方案多依赖流水线并行和BP训练，但BP存在更新锁定（update locking）的根本缺陷，导致吞吐量瓶颈和过高的激活内存开销。作者旨在提出一种无BP的算法，从根本上解除更新锁定的限制。

Method: ZeroLock通过构造局部目标函数，将模型更新解耦为多个独立的分块更新，每个分块可独立计算和更新，无需等待全局反向传播。论文为此类局部目标构造方法提供了首个通用模型分块下的理论框架，将局部目标映射到全局目标并证明等价性。同时设计了配套系统，包含早期转发（early forwarding）和故障恢复（failure recovery）等机制。

Result: 理论证明ZeroLock的收敛率为Õ(1/√T)，与BP相比仅存在多项式对数因子差异。在真实原型实验中，相比BP基线，ZeroLock内存占用降低26.5%，吞吐量提升4.9%。

Conclusion: ZeroLock证明了在边缘设备上进行无BP的大模型微调是可行且高效的，通过打破更新锁定在算法层面实现更优的吞吐和内存表现，同时提供了坚实的理论收敛保证，为边缘LLM微调提供了新的技术路径。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) fine-tuning at the edge adapts the model to scenario-specific data while preserving privacy. Although existing studies proposed pipeline parallelism to address the limited memory and computing resources of edge devices, they commonly rely on backpropagation (BP) training, which has a fundamental limitation of update locking and could experience severe throughput and memory bottlenecks. In this work, we propose a BP-free algorithm, called ZeroLock, that decouples the model updates into independent chunk updates by local objective construction. It breaks the update locking of BP and hence can improve throughput at the algorithm level and lower memory usage by reducing activation storage. To the best of our knowledge, we provide the first theoretical framework for such local objective construction-based approaches under general model chunk division by mapping local objectives to the global objective. We prove that ZeroLock has a convergence rate of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/\sqrt{T})$, which differs from BP only by polylogarithmic factors. We design a system for ZeroLock and build real-world prototypes, incorporating techniques such as early forwarding and failure recovery for efficient and robust implementation. Experiments on the prototype show that compared to BP-based baselines, ZeroLock reduces the memory by 26.5% and improves throughput by 4.9%.

</details>


### [445] [Evaluator Ensembles Under Reward Hacking: Covariance Geometry and Finite-Search Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08002)
*Fariya Afrin,Ibne Farabi Shihab*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过协方差几何刻画了语言模型裁判/奖励模型集成在有限优化中的系统性失败：校准裁判的集成均值沿全一方向保留共同模式误差，而交叉裁判分歧仅捕获正交误差，导致分歧高并不代表聚合稳健、分歧低也可能存在共享误差。作者证明共同模式误差无法从内部裁判分数中识别，并在联合亚高斯模型下给出了best-of-K选择高估和目标质量遗憾的界，扩展至条件校准下的可预测自适应搜索，界随√log K缩放且对高斯投影误差渐近紧。论文还证明噪声质量代理会引入秩一协方差但不改变分歧，并提出有界双锚Bernstein证书用于有限搜索误差与遗憾。通过120个(J, ρ, K)配置的固定种子高斯压力测试和真实模型审计验证了理论，同时揭示了高搜索压力下基于分歧的诊断的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型裁判和奖励模型可实现可扩展监督，但有限优化会利用评估器误差而非提升响应质量。现有研究缺乏对这种失败的严格刻画，特别是评估器集成中共同模式误差与交叉评估器分歧之间的结构性关系尚未被理论揭示。

Method: 作者使用协方差几何来形式化评估器集成中的误差结构；证明共同模式误差的不可识别性；在联合亚高斯模型下推导best-of-K选择高估和目标质量遗憾的理论界，并扩展至条件校准下的可预测自适应搜索；提出有界双锚Bernstein证书；通过固定种子高斯压力测试和真实模型审计进行验证。

Result: 共同模式误差沿全一方向不可通过内部分数识别；搜索项随√log K缩放且对高斯投影误差渐近紧；噪声质量代理引入人工秩一协方差但不改变分歧；120个配置的高斯测试和真实模型审计验证了理论，并揭示了搜索压力增大时分歧诊断的失效边界。

Conclusion: 基于分歧的评估器诊断在高搜索压力下存在根本性局限，共同模式误差无法从校准裁判集成中识别。这提示需要超越内部分数的手段（如外部锚定或不同范式的验证）来缓解优化中评估器误差被利用的问题。

Abstract: Language-model judges and reward models enable scalable supervision, but finite optimization can exploit evaluator errors rather than improve response quality. We characterize this failure through the covariance geometry of evaluator ensembles. For calibrated judges, the ensemble mean retains common-mode error along the all-ones direction, whereas cross-judge disagreement captures only orthogonal error. Consequently, disagreement can be high despite robust aggregation, or low while shared response-dependent errors persist. We prove that common-mode error is not identifiable from internal judge scores alone. Under a joint sub-Gaussian model, we bound best-of-K selection overstatement and target-quality regret, extending the guarantees to predictably adaptive search under conditional calibration. The resulting search terms scale as the square root of log K and are asymptotically tight for Gaussian projected errors. We further show that noisy quality proxies introduce artificial rank-one covariance without changing disagreement, and propose a bounded two-anchor Bernstein certificate for finite-search error and regret. Fixed-seed Gaussian stress tests over 120 (J, rho, K) configurations and real-model audits validate the theory while revealing the limits of disagreement-based diagnostics under increasing search pressure.

</details>


### [446] [Quality-Diversity Stress Tests for Process Reward Models:What Archive Coverage Can and Cannot Certify](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08008)
*Ibne Farabi Shihab,Fariya Afrin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将过程奖励模型（PRM）的压力测试形式化为一个质量-多样性（quality-diversity）搜索问题，使用MAP-Elites算法在行为空间的各区域中保留最严重的"正确转错误"编辑，并据此建立可证明的修复界限。在真实PRM上发现了Qwen2.5-Math-PRM-7B中与聚合方式相关的漏洞（padding在均值池化下产生44个严格利用，最大增益0.294），并提出成对LoRA修复协议，将利用率从0.148降至0.037再降至0.074，同时不损害下游性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PRM广泛用于搜索、排序和训练，但优化过程可能利用这些学习到的代理评分（proxy）——通过增加奖励分数却将正确推理转变为错误推理。现有方法缺乏系统性、可证明的压力测试方法来发现和修复此类漏洞。

Method: 1) 将PRM压力测试形式化为质量-多样性搜索问题，采用MAP-Elites在行为空间各区域保留最严重的正确性翻转编辑，分离搜索覆盖与利用覆盖；2) 建立归档可证明性质：有限单元修复界、覆盖单元尾部风险与平均残差严重性，以及基于Lipschitz连续性和度量覆盖审计的残差上界；3) 提出预先声明的成对LoRA修复协议。

Result: 在受控地形上验证了证书有效性及仅凭覆盖比例无法保证最坏情况的不可能性。在真实PRM上，在Qwen2.5-Math-PRM-7B中发现padding在均值池化下产生44个严格利用（最大增益0.294），而在最小读取下仅1个；RLHFlow价值头模型呈现类似定性效果。LoRA修复协议将利用率从0.148降至0.037再至0.074，最坏攻击从0.333降至0.177再至0.212，提升排序AUROC且不降低best-of-4准确性，独立非配对复现确认了结果。

Conclusion: 质量-多样性搜索为PRM压力测试提供了可证明且有原则性的框架；成对LoRA修复能够有效减少PRM的可利用漏洞并提升鲁棒性，同时保持甚至改善下游性能。该工作揭示了PRM中聚合方式依赖的脆弱性，并为PRM的安全发布和部署提供了方法论基础。

Abstract: Process reward models (PRMs) score intermediate reasoning steps and are widely used for search, ranking, and training, but optimization can exploit these learned proxies by increasing reward while turning correct reasoning into incorrect reasoning. We formulate PRM stress testing as a quality-diversity search problem using MAP-Elites, retaining the most severe correctness-flipping edit in each behavior-space region while separating search coverage from exploit coverage. We characterize what such archives certify: finite-cell repair bounds covered-cell tail risk and average residual severity but cannot bound the worst remaining cell from covered fraction alone; under Lipschitz post-repair loss and metric-cover auditing, the residual is bounded by archive fitting error plus the Lipschitz constant times the covering radius. A controlled landscape validates this certificate and the impossibility of any fraction-only worst-case guarantee. On real PRMs, the search reveals an aggregation-dependent vulnerability in Qwen2.5-Math-PRM-7B: padding yields 44 strict exploits with maximum gain 0.294 under mean pooling versus one exploit under minimum readout; a matched syntactic control isolates the mechanism, and an RLHFlow value-head model shows the same qualitative effect with maximum gain 0.005. A predeclared paired LoRA repair protocol reduces exploit rates from 0.148 to 0.037 to 0.074, lowers the worst attack from 0.333 to 0.177 to 0.212, improves ranking AUROC without degrading best-of-4 accuracy, attributes gains to adversarial fine-tuning rather than archive diversity, and is confirmed by independent unpaired replications (44 to 1, clean-split worst gain 0.0092, MATH-500 41 to 0, clean ranking 40/40).

</details>


### [447] [Ground-Truth Neighborhood Regularization for Reinforcement Learning Post-Training of Time Series Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08010)
*Jianqi Zhang,Xingyu Zhang,Zeen Song,Changwen Zheng,Fanjiang Xu,Wenwen Qiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于时间序列基础模型（TSFM）强化学习（RL）后训练的正则化方法GTN-R，以解决RL后训练中出现的"次优坍缩"（suboptimal collapse）现象——即模型输出分布逐渐偏离真实值的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型在预训练后，通过RL后训练可进一步提升下游任务性能。但作者发现RL后训练在某些预测区域会导致模型输出分布逐渐偏离真实值（次优坍缩），限制性能提升。分析表明，初始阶段难以采样到接近真实值的高质量轨迹是重要原因。

Method: 提出Ground-Truth Neighborhood Regularization (GTN-R)：以真实值为参考定位高质量区域，引导模型的概率质量向真实值邻域集中，从而增加采样到高质量轨迹的概率，缓解次优坍缩问题。该方法可灵活集成到各种RL方法中。

Result: 大量实验表明GTN-R在多种RL方法上均能有效提升TSFM的性能，缓解次优坍缩现象。

Conclusion: GTN-R通过向真实值邻域引入正则化，有效解决了RL后训练中的次优坍缩问题，为TSFM的RL后训练提供了可推广的改进方案。

Abstract: Time series forecasting (TSF) plays an important role in a wide range of real-world applications. Recently, time series foundation models (TSFMs), pretrained on large-scale datasets, have demonstrated strong generalization capabilities and emerged as an important paradigm for TSF. Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has consequently attracted growing attention as a means of further improving their performance on downstream tasks. However, we find that, in certain forecast regions, RL post-training may gradually shift the output distributions of TSFMs away from the ground truth, thereby limiting their performance. We refer to this phenomenon as \textbf{suboptimal collapse}. Our analysis suggests that difficulty in initially sampling high-quality trajectories near the ground truth is an important contributing factor to suboptimal collapse. To address this issue, we propose Ground-Truth Neighborhood Regularization (GTN-R) for RL post-training of TSFMs. GTN-R uses the ground truth as a reference for locating high-quality regions and guides the model's probability mass toward the ground-truth neighborhood. This increases the probability of sampling high-quality trajectories, mitigates suboptimal collapse, and improves performance. Moreover, GTN-R can be flexibly integrated into various RL methods for TSFMs. Extensive experiments show its effectiveness.

</details>


### [448] [Do All LLMs Know When They're Being Harmful? A Reproducibility Study of Latent-Space Safety Probes Across Model Families](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08029)
*Alizishaan Khatri,Dun Li Chan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文复现了Khatri等人(2026)在LLaMA-3.1-8B上使用轻量级MLP探针检测有害提示的工作，并将其扩展到不同模型架构（Gemma-4-E4B、Mistral-7B-v0.3、Qwen2-7B）和三个基准测试。结果显示探针方法可跨模型泛化，F1分数与原始结果差距在1分以内；同时发现最终token的潜在向量在不同随机种子下保持不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始研究仅在一个8B模型上验证了MLP探针检测有害提示的有效性，未探索该方法是否适用于其他模型架构和规模，也未评估推理过程中的非确定性对性能的影响。本文旨在填补这两个空白。

Method: 端到端复现原始MLP探针管线，并在两个方向上进行扩展：(1) 在Gemma-4-E4B、Mistral-7B-v0.3和Qwen2-7B上训练相同架构的探针，使用WildJailbreak、BeaverTails和AEGIS 2.0三个基准；(2) 在5个随机种子下重复提取测试，测量F1分数的方差。

Result: (1) 在原始LLaMA模型上复现成功，F1分数与原始结果差距在0.37个百分点以内（BeaverTails上差距0.2分以内）；(2) MLP探针架构可泛化到其他模型家族，F1分数与LLaMA-3.1-8B报告值差距在1分以内；(3) 所有测试架构的最终token潜在向量在不同种子下保持不变。

Conclusion: MLP探针检测有害提示的方法具有跨模型架构和规模的鲁棒性，且该方法的性能不受推理非确定性影响，验证了原始研究的结论并扩展了其适用范围。

Abstract: Khatri et al. (2026) [DOI: 10.1109/DSN-W70714.2026.00027] show that lightweight MLP probes on final-layer activations of a single 8B model (LLaMA-3.1-8B) detect harmful prompts at F1 competitive with guard models 1000x larger, using one probe per benchmark. We reproduce this pipeline end-to-end and extend it along two axes the original study leaves open. First, we test whether the result generalizes across other model architecture and scale by training identical probes on activations from models like Gemma-4-E4B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, and Qwen2-7B, using the three benchmarks (WildJailbreak, BeaverTails, AEGIS 2.0). Second, we test how much of the reported performance is affected by non-determinism during inference by repeating extraction under five random seeds and measuring the variance of F1 scores. Our results reproduce the original LLaMA model benchmarks within 0.37 percentage points of the original F1 scores (and within 0.2 points on BeaverTails). We find that the original MLP probe architecture extends to other model families with F1 scores within a point of the values reported for LLaMA-3.1-8B. Our experiments varying seed values reveal an interesting observation: final token latent vectors remained the same for all tested architectures irrespective of the seed values used.

</details>


### [449] [PRISM: A Predictive Protocol for Permutation Optimization via Landscape Diagnostics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08344)
*Blessings Mambwe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PRISM协议，一种用于排列优化问题的预测性框架，通过廉价的景观诊断（如一步移动自相关和适应度-距离相关性）在搜索开始前预测优化策略的有效性。该协议能预测有用的变异算子、判断结构化搜索是否优于随机采样，并识别搜索收益甚微的情况。实验涵盖合成排列景观、神经架构基准、科学机器学习流水线和LLM指令排序等场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 排列优化问题广泛存在（系统组件固定但顺序影响性能），然而在实际开始优化之前，缺乏系统性的方法来预判：是否值得进行排列搜索、应该采用何种表示和算子、以及何时简单方法已足够。作者希望解决这种"盲目优化"的问题。

Method: PRISM协议包含三步：(1)使用廉价的景观诊断工具测量适应度景观特征；(2)基于诊断结果预测合适的变异算子和搜索策略；(3)在多个场景（合成排列景观、神经架构搜索、科学ML流水线、LLM指令排序）中进行验证性实验。协议定位为"预测框架"而非通用最优优化器。

Result: 实验表明：排列本身可导致显著的性能变化（指令排序实验中验证）；有用排序结构可以跨模型家族和任务难度迁移；在提示词措辞优化后，指令排序仍然重要，说明内容优化与顺序优化是互补的。PRISM能做出可检验的搜索行为预测。

Conclusion: PRISM并非追求普遍优于现有优化器，而是提供一个决策框架：何时排列搜索有用、应选用哪种表示和算子、何时更简单替代方案更佳。其价值在于将排列优化的"该不该做、怎么做"转化为基于景观诊断的可预测决策过程。

Abstract: Permutation optimization arises whenever the components of a system are fixed but their ordering affects performance. We introduce PRISM, a predictive protocol for permutation optimization that measures a fitness landscape before selecting a search strategy. PRISM uses inexpensive landscape diagnostics, including one-step move autocorrelation and fitness-distance correlation, to predict useful mutation operators, identify when structured search is likely to outperform random sampling, and detect regimes in which search provides little advantage. Across synthetic permutation landscapes, neural architecture benchmarks, scientific machine learning pipelines, and large-language-model instruction ordering, the protocol makes testable predictions about search behavior before optimization begins. Exhaustive instruction-ordering experiments reveal substantial performance variation induced solely by permutation, while cross-model experiments show that useful ordering structure can transfer across model families and task difficulty. Additional experiments demonstrate that instruction ordering remains consequential after prompt wording is optimized, indicating that content optimization and ordering optimization are complementary. The results position PRISM not as a universally superior optimizer, but as a framework for determining when permutation search is useful, which representation and operator should be used, and when simpler alternatives are preferable.

</details>


### [450] [CLAM: Causal Spatial Disaggregation to Infer Local Effects From Coarse Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08064)
*Gerrit Großmann,Sumantrak Mukherjee,Sebastian J. Vollmer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CLAM是一种从粗粒度观测数据中估计局部因果效应的方法，通过利用高分辨率上下文协变量来调制效应，并联合学习因果机制与分解映射，支持局部效应估计、反事实推理和结果分解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从粗分辨率数据中学习细粒度空间模式具有挑战性，尤其在因果场景下，需要从聚合干预和结果中推断高分辨率效应。将问题独立处理会遗漏关键交互信息。

Method: CLAM联合学习因果机制和分解映射（disaggregation mapping），利用高分辨率上下文协变量来调制局部因果效应，实现从粗观测到细粒度效应的推断。

Result: CLAM支持局部效应估计、反因果推理和原则性的结果分解，并在多种不同设置下可靠捕捉空间变化的因果效应。

Conclusion: 该方法对公共卫生和环境政策等在大尺度上决策但存在显著局部异质性的应用场景尤为相关，且代码已开源。

Abstract: Learning fine-grained spatial patterns from coarse-resolution data is challenging, especially in causal settings where high-resolution effects must be inferred from aggregated interventions and outcomes. We introduce CLAM, a method for estimating localized causal effects from coarse observations by exploiting high-resolution contextual covariates that modulate these effects. By jointly learning the causal mechanism and a disaggregation mapping, CLAM captures interactions that are missed when addressing these problems independently. The method supports localized effect estimation, counterfactual reasoning, and principled outcome disaggregation, and reliably captures spatially varying causal effects across diverse settings. This is particularly relevant for applications such as public health and environmental policy, where decisions are made at broad scales despite substantial local heterogeneity. Code is available at https://github.com/gerritgr/clam

</details>


### [451] [Adaptive Symmetry Discovery for Dynamical System Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08091)
*Behrooz Tahmasebi,Melanie Weber*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究动力学系统辨识中的自适应对称性发现问题，证明已知对称性可将单轨迹辨识所需的轨迹长度显著缩短并精确刻画该改进，并提出从单条轨迹自动学习对称群并融入辨识流程的方法，达到与已知对称情况相同的最优轨迹长度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动力学系统辨识中，真实物理系统往往具有由物理定律强加的对称性（等变性），但如何在对称群未知的情况下利用对称性来缩短辨识所需的轨迹长度，是一个尚未解决的关键问题。

Method: 首先对已知对称性的情况进行理论分析，刻画单轨迹辨识所需长度的精确改进；然后提出自动对称性发现方法，直接从单条轨迹学习对称群并将其融入辨识流程；分析工具基于群表示论和Cayley图的扩张性质。

Result: 证明了已知对称性可将单轨迹辨识所需长度显著缩短并给出精确刻画；提出的自动对称性学习方法在未知对称群的情况下达到了与已知对称性情形相同的最优轨迹长度。

Conclusion: 对称性发现可以自动化并有效融入动力学系统辨识，使得在未知对称群约束下也能获得最优的样本效率；所用群表示论与Cayley图扩张工具对其他对称动力学研究具有独立参考价值。

Abstract: Dynamical systems model trajectory data generated by fixed underlying dynamics, with applications ranging from biology to physics. Especially in scientific settings, dynamical systems are not generic but often exhibit symmetries imposed by physical laws, formalized through equivariance with respect to group actions. The identification problem concerns recovering the parameters of a system from observed trajectories. In this work, we study adaptive symmetry discovery for dynamical system identification and address how a system can be identified from a single trajectory when it is equivariant with respect to an unknown symmetry group. To this end, we first show that for known symmetries, the system can be identified from a significantly shorter single trajectory than in the generic setting, and we precisely characterize this improvement. We then consider the automatic symmetry discovery setting, proposing a method to learn the symmetry group directly from a single trajectory and incorporate it into the identification procedure, achieving the same optimal trajectory length as in the known-symmetry case. Our analysis relies on tools from group representation theory and the expander properties of Cayley graphs, and may be of independent interest for the study of symmetries in dynamical systems.

</details>


### [452] [Exact Rank-Space KL Projection for Shared-Marginal Low-Rank Factors: Application to Doubly Stochastic Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08642)
*Enliang Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究低秩分解的精确KL投影问题，其中两个非负因子具有指定的行边际和共享的列边际。作者证明该联合KL投影可精确简化为仅含r-1个有效变量的严格凸规范固定对偶问题，其Hessian可分解为分类协方差项之和，支持O((n+m)r)的无矩阵Hessian-向量乘积。作者将该几何专门应用于双随机（DS）图学习，通过W=U Diag(g)^{-1} V^⊤结构，行单纯形因子配合共同列质量可在不生成n×n优化变量的情况下精确产生DS图。结合观测边稀疏拟合、随机锚点约简流形正则化和Bregman回溯，所提镜像下降方法在每一步都保持精确可行性。在非零潜在质量条件下，该方法满足充分下降和O(1/N)镜像驻点界，且严格正累积极限点为KKT驻点。匹配聚类实验显示竞争性精度、接近数值精度的可行性残差，以及无需稠密学习图的良好实时表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双随机（DS）图学习在聚类和图信号处理中具有重要意义，但传统的DS图学习方法通常需要直接优化n×n的变量，计算复杂度高且难以保持精确可行性。作者希望通过低秩分解来规避这一问题，同时保持精确的KL投影性质和可行的优化保证。

Method: （1）将联合KL投影问题精确简化为严格凸的规范固定对偶问题，仅需r-1个有效变量，并推导出Hessian的协方差结构和O((n+m)r)的无矩阵Hessian-向量乘积；（2）利用W=U Diag(g)^{-1} V^⊤结构构造精确DS图，其中行单纯形因子具有共同列质量；（3）结合观测边稀疏拟合、随机锚点约简流形正则化和Bregman回溯，设计镜像下降优化方法。

Result: 在非零潜在质量条件下，方法满足充分下降性质和O(1/N)镜像驻点收敛界；严格正累积极限点达到KKT驻点。匹配聚类实验中展示出竞争性精度、接近机器精度的可行性残差，以及无需稠密图学习的良好实时性能。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一种目标无关的KL投影定理，并成功将其应用于DS图学习，在保持精确可行性和理论收敛保证的同时，避免了高维稠密图变量，为大规模图学习提供了高效且理论上健全的框架。

Abstract: We study exact Kullback--Leibler (KL) projection for low-rank factorizations whose two nonnegative factors have prescribed row marginals and a shared, learned column marginal. For arbitrary positive row marginals of equal total mass, the joint KL projection reduces exactly to a strictly convex gauge-fixed dual with only $r-1$ effective variables; its Hessian is a sum of categorical covariance terms and admits $O((n+m)r)$ matrix-free Hessian--vector products. The projection theorem is objective-independent. We then specialize this geometry to doubly stochastic (DS) graph learning through $W=U\operatorname{Diag}(g)^{-1}V^\top$, where row-simplex factors with a common column mass induce an exactly DS graph without materializing an $n\times n$ optimization variable. Combined with observed-edge sparse fitting, a stochastic anchor-reduced manifold regularizer, and Bregman backtracking, the resulting mirror-descent method preserves exact feasibility at every accepted step. Under a nonvanishing latent-mass condition, it satisfies sufficient decrease and an $O(1/N)$ mirror-stationarity bound, while strictly positive accumulation points are KKT stationary. Matched clustering experiments show competitive accuracy, feasibility residuals near numerical precision, and favorable anytime behavior without a dense learned graph.

</details>


### [453] [Support Selection Beyond Smooth DAG Exactness: Completion Geometry,Score Margins, and Selective Certificates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08103)
*Rui Wu,Zongyuan Chen,Hong Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从光滑精确性（smooth exactness）本身出发，系统分析DAG边界处的退化现象，证明最小环补全生成平方自由单项式理想，推导出隔离环的精确选择时间律，并通过320条NOTEARS/DAGMA轨迹的实验验证了预测选择时间的统计量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分析仅针对特定约束公式建立退化性，未隔离出光滑精确性本身带来的后果。作者希望厘清DAG可行性、基于评分的支撑选择与因果识别三者之间的根本区别。

Method: 理论层面：在DAG边界证明最小环补全生成包含精确表示所有受限Taylor jets的平方自由单项式理想；推导隔离环的精确选择时间，区分可行性时间与带评分边距的动力学；实验层面：在320条NOTEARS/DAGMA轨迹上验证选择时间律，并用父集置信族与强制对立查询对骨架和未屏蔽碰撞标签进行审计。

Result: 最小补全为q条边时，向量残差的首次响应阶为q，非负标量为2q。可行性时间满足T₀(ε)=Θ(ε^{-(2ν+1)})；评分边距在ν>0时于T₀^{-1}尺度改变主导动力学，ν=0时存在对数边界层。Spearman相关性-0.52和-0.66（置换p<10^-4）。审计中3042个骨架和2396个碰撞标签均与oracle评分最优一致，但分别有4.4%和5.5%与生成图不一致。

Conclusion: DAG可行性、评分驱动的支撑选择与因果识别是三个可分离的层面：可行性判断受光滑约束退化影响，支撑选择受边界非线性动力学支配，而因果标签的可靠性可独立于生成图进行审计。这为结构学习算法的理论性质提供了更精确的刻画。

Abstract: Smooth acyclicity constraints answer whether a weighted support is a DAG, whereas structure learning asks which support change should be made. Existing analyses establish degeneracy for particular constraint formulas but do not isolate what follows from smooth exactness itself. At a DAG boundary, we show that minimal cycle completions generate a squarefree monomial ideal containing every restricted Taylor jet of an exact representation. If the smallest completion has $q$ edges, the first possible response has order $q$ for a vector residual and $2q$ for a nonnegative scalar. Exponentially many constant-scale cyclic manifolds exhibit the same lack of ranking away from the boundary for NOTEARS and DAGMA. We derive the exact selection time for an isolated cycle. When $Ψ'(h)\asymp h^ν$, the feasibility-only time is $T_0(\varepsilon)=Θ(\varepsilon^{-(2ν+1)})$; a score margin changes the leading dynamics at scale $T_0^{-1}$ for $ν>0$, while $ν=0$ has a logarithmic boundary layer requiring $γT_0\log(1/\varepsilon)\to0$. Experiments verify this law, and a truth-free separation statistic predicts selection time on 320 official NOTEARS/DAGMA trajectories (Spearman $-0.52$ and $-0.66$, permutation $p<10^{-4}$). For finite samples, a parent-set confidence family and forced-opposite queries certify skeleton and unshielded-collider labels shared by every population optimum of a frozen score. Across 320 runs, every regret bound covers an independent oracle-score audit. None of 3,042 certified skeleton or 2,396 collider labels disagrees with the oracle-score optimum, although 4.4% and 5.5%, respectively, disagree with the generating graph. These results separate DAG feasibility, score-based support selection, and causal identification.

</details>


### [454] [TSDS-Toolbox: A Toolbox for Measuring Time-Series Dataset Similarity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08119)
*Yen-Ku Liu,Hongjie Chen,Ryan A. Rossi,Franck Dernoncourt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了TSDS-Toolbox，一个统一的时间序列数据集相似性工具箱，用于系统化、可复现地比较时间序列数据集相似性方法，支持灵活扩展和一致评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI在时间序列分析中的快速发展使得数据集相似性对基础模型的源数据集选择至关重要，但现有的时间序列数据集相似性方法基准测试实现碎片化且难以扩展。

Method: 构建统一框架TSDS-Toolbox，支持：(1)系统化和可复现的相似性方法比较；(2)灵活扩展自定义数据集、相似性方法和下游任务；(3)通过集成的时间序列数据集缩减器对数据集级和序列级相似性方法进行一致评估。

Result: 通过多种实验设置下的综合实验验证了TSDS-Toolbox的有效性，工具箱已公开可用。

Conclusion: TSDS-Toolbox提供了一个统一、可扩展且可复现的时间序列数据集相似性评估平台，填补了该领域工具缺失的空白。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) has significantly accelerated research in time-series analysis, particularly in forecasting, classification, and generation tasks. Recent models, especially foundation models, benefit from time-series dataset similarity due to its significant role in source dataset selection for fine-tuning. However, many existing implementations for benchmarking time-series dataset similarity methods are fragmented and difficult to extend. To address this, we present a unified framework, the Time-Series Dataset Similarity Toolbox (TSDS-Toolbox). Our work enables (1) systematic and reproducible comparisons of time-series dataset similarity methods; (2) flexible extensibility for users to add customized datasets, similarity methods, and downstream time-series tasks; and (3) consistent evaluation of both dataset-level and series-level similarity methods through integrated time-series dataset reducers. The effectiveness of TSDS-Toolbox is validated through comprehensive experiments under diverse experimental settings. Our toolbox is publicly available.

</details>


### [455] [Trajectory Design and Budgeted Querying for Digital Twin Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08631)
*Vladyslava Spitkovska,Dmytro Kuzmenko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了数字孪生校准中的数据采集两大决策：轨迹生成与特权参数测量预算分配。通过将激励导向RL控制器、带有预测不确定性的循环参数估计器与预算化查询策略相结合，在Pendulum和Waterworld环境中验证了该方法能显著降低校准误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字孪生校准需要昂贵的交互数据，而当前方法未将轨迹设计（何时生成什么轨迹）和查询分配（何时花费有限预算测量参数）作为显式设计变量来优化，导致数据利用效率低下。

Method: 提出一个耦合框架，包含三个组件：1）激励导向的强化学习控制器，用于生成信息量丰富的轨迹；2）具有预测不确定性的循环参数估计器（GRU）；3）预算化查询策略，决定何时支出有限的测量预算。在部分可观测场景下还测试了多控制器混合训练。

Result: 在Pendulum中，GRU在激励导向轨迹上达到MAE 0.0066（零查询）；在三次查询预算下终末误差0.0092，远优于未校准孪生的0.2031。在Waterworld中，五控制器混合训练的估计器达到在线归一化误差约4-5%。

Conclusion: 轨迹设计与查询分配应作为数据稀缺环境下校准的显式设计变量。该框架展示了激励导向轨迹对参数可辨识性的显著提升，但研究属于探索性案例分析而非受控消融实验，需要进一步验证。

Abstract: Digital-twin calibration requires interaction data that is expensive to collect. We study two acquisition decisions: which trajectories to generate, and when to spend a limited budget on privileged parameter measurements. Our framework couples an excitation-oriented reinforcement learning controller, a recurrent parameter estimator with predictive uncertainty, and a budgeted query policy. In Pendulum, a Random Forest diagnostic recovers gravity only weakly from task-oriented trajectories and does not recover mass or length, while a GRU trained on excitation-oriented trajectories reaches a mean absolute error of 0.0066 with no queries. We then withdraw continuous oracle access partway through an episode, so that the twin must run on the estimator's output for the remainder. The estimator-plus-policy pipeline achieves a terminal error of 0.0092 under a three-query budget, against 0.2031 for an uncalibrated twin. In partially observable Waterworld, five controllers produce different observed error profiles across three hidden parameters, and an estimator trained on a five-controller mixture reaches online normalized errors of roughly 4-5%. These exploratory case studies are not controlled ablations, but they motivate treating trajectory design and query allocation as explicit design variables in data-scarce calibration.

</details>


### [456] [Accurate Ensembles, Fragile Narratives: Multi-Scale Stacking and a Fidelity Audit of LLM-Generated Explanations for Credit Risk](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08126)
*Gregorius Reynaldi Pratama,Kuo-Kun Tseng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个端到端的信用评分系统，结合多尺度堆叠集成模型（四种梯度提升器+残差网络+神经元学习器）与LLM生成解释文本。预测层面取得ROC-AUC 0.9539的领先性能，但操作收益有限；叙事层面被发现存在严重问题——LLM生成的解释与属性归因实际不符，且提示工程无法单独修复此缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 信用评分模型日益复杂，决策逻辑无法直接从参数读取，与监管机构要求不利决策可解释的期望相冲突。常见方案是用LLM生成解释文本，但这一方案的第二半承诺（叙事层）是否真的成立尚未被验证。

Method: 构建两阶段系统：1) 预测组件采用四种不同正则化的梯度提升模型与残差网络融合，通过神经元学习器在袋外预测上训练；2) 叙事组件将特征归因（SHAP/LIME）交给LLM生成解释。使用32,581条公开信用数据测试，并对归因一致性、校准度、扰动稳定性进行系统测量。

Result: 预测端：ROC-AUC 0.9539，PR-AUC 0.9137，比最佳单模型高出0.0143（p=0.016），但操作上仅避免6例额外漏判，成本加权损失降幅不足2%。叙事端：LLM解释存在严重错误——将风险降低因素称为风险增加，遗漏主导因素，引入从未提供的特征。SHAP与LIME特征排序相关性仅tau=0.43（p=0.18），最强输入特征符号近似抛硬币（模态0.53），校准（ECS=0.117）和扰动稳定性（DPD=0.078）均不达标。

Conclusion: 性能提升真实但操作收益有限；LLM生成解释不可靠且提示工程无法治愈根本问题。核心教训：生成后的接地验证（grounding verification）必须成为流程的一部分，而非在生成前假定其成立。"受约束提示"是必要条件但非充分条件。

Abstract: Credit scoring increasingly relies on models whose decision logic cannot be read off their parameters, in tension with supervisory expectations that adverse decisions be explainable. A common proposal closes that gap with a language model: compute feature attributions, hand them to an LLM, and let it write the rationale. We build such a system end to end and test whether the second half of the promise holds. The predictive component is a multi-scale stacking ensemble fusing four differently regularised gradient-boosting learners with a residual network through a neural meta-learner trained on out-of-fold predictions. On a public 32,581-application credit dataset it reaches test ROC-AUC 0.9539 (95% CI [0.9462, 0.9616]) and PR-AUC 0.9137, beating the best single model by Delta-AUC = 0.0143 (p = 0.016 under a conservative independence assumption). Our central finding is asymmetric. The ranking gain is real but operationally small: at the F1-optimal threshold the ensemble avoids only six additional missed defaults out of 1,422 against a tuned random forest, cutting cost-weighted loss by under 2%. The narrative layer fails in a way prompt engineering alone does not fix. In an audited case the model named three factors as risk-increasing that the supplied attributions scored as risk-reducing, omitted the dominant driver, and introduced a feature never given to it. We trace this to properties we measure rather than assume: SHAP and LIME agree on which features matter (overlap@10 = 0.80) but not on their order (tau = 0.43, p = 0.18), and the attribution sign for the model's most sensitive input is near a coin flip across applicants (modal-sign share 0.53). Calibration (ECS = 0.117) and perturbation stability (DPD = 0.078) both fall short of our own thresholds. Constrained prompting is necessary but not sufficient: grounding must be verified after generation, not assumed.

</details>


### [457] [DoGMA: A Central-Dogma-Guided Foundation Model for Multi-Omics Alignment and Multi-Task Learning in Oncology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08148)
*Junfei Ling,Bangzheng Pu,Bingsen Xue,Tianle Li,Ruying Hu,Cheng Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DoGMA，一个以中心法则为指导的泛癌多组学基础模型。它基于Transformer-MoE架构，通过定向注意力机制使组学间通信遵循中心法则的信息流方向（DNA→RNA→蛋白质），并通过掩码层次组学重建进行预训练。在癌症表征学习、生存预测和转移预测等任务中表现优异，证明领域特定的归纳偏置能提升多组学基础模型的鲁棒性和可迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有注意力机制允许多组学间无限制的双向交互，但生命的基本逻辑是方向性的（中心法则）。这种忽视方向性的设计可能限制模型在异质癌症、下游任务和不完整模态场景中的迁移能力。

Method: 1) 基于Transformer-MoE架构，使用定向注意力偏置组间通信朝向中心法则信息流；2) 采用掩码层次组学重建进行预训练，引导模型学习符合中心法则的交互。

Result: 在癌症表征学习、生存预测和转移预测等多个下游任务中表现优异；消融实验表明性能提升源于中心法则引导的定向注意力与基于重建的预训练之间的协同效应。

Conclusion: 领域特定的归纳偏置能提升多组学基础模型的鲁棒性和可迁移性，为多组学表示学习中的注意力机制设计提供了新见解。

Abstract: Attention mechanisms have been widely utilized in modern deep learning, and many existing multi-omics models inherit their conventional use to allow unrestricted bidirectional interactions. However, the fundamental logic of life is directional. Existing designs often overlook the directionality suggested by the central dogma, potentially limiting transfer across heterogeneous cancers, downstream tasks, and incomplete modality settings.In this work, we present DoGMA, a central-dogma-guided foundation model for pan-cancer multi-omics analysis, arguing that robust transfer requires representations with domain-specific inductive bias. Concretely, we build it on a Transformer-MoE architecture where directed attention biases inter-omics communication toward central-dogma information flow. We further pretrain our model with masked hierarchical omics reconstruction to guide it toward learning central-dogma-consistent interactions. Across diverse downstream tasks, including cancer representation learning, survival prediction, and metastasis prediction, DoGMA consistently demonstrates strong predictive performance. Ablations and analyses further suggest that the performance gains arise from the synergy between central-dogma-guided directed attention and reconstruction-based pretraining, which together promote more biologically consistent cross-omics information exchange. Overall, DoGMA demonstrates that domain-specific inductive biases can improve the robustness and transferability of multi-omics foundation models, offering new insights into the design of attention mechanisms for multi-omics representation learning.

</details>


### [458] [A Hybrid Nested Harness for Decoupling Structure and Parameters in LLM-Driven Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08156)
*Víctor Gallego*

Main category: cs.LG
