TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合嵌套搜索框架，将LLM驱动的外层结构搜索（生成带数值空位的结构草图）与内层数值优化器（如CMA-ES、梯度法或MCMC）相结合，解决纯LLM进化算法在连续参数优化上低效的问题。在三个科学领域（元优化器、代码策略、近似贝叶斯推断）中验证了该框架优于纯LLM搜索和纯数值优化基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM作为进化算法中的单一算子同时更新结构组件和连续参数时，LLM擅长前者但低效于后者，导致大量token浪费在离散跳跃和试错循环中。需要一种框架来分离这两种优化任务，发挥各自优势。

Method: 采用混合嵌套搜索：外层循环由LLM提出带数值空位的结构草图（sketch），内层由数值优化器调整草图参数。外层和内层求解器均可插拔，任何文本优化器可与零阶优化器（CMA-ES）、梯度方法或MCMC采样器组合。

Result: 在三个科学领域（闭式测试函数的元优化器、系统研究和社会困境的代码策略、近似贝叶斯推断）中，混合优化器均优于纯LLM驱动的搜索和纯数值优化基线。

Conclusion: 混合嵌套搜索有效解决了LLM进化算法中结构搜索与参数优化耦合导致的效率问题，且框架具有良好的可插拔性和广泛适用性。

Abstract: In evolutionary algorithms powered by language models, the LLM acts as a single operator that simultaneously updates structural components (like control flow) and continuous parameters. While LLMs can be good at the first, they are not efficient at the second, wasting tokens taking discrete jumps inside a trial and error loop. We resolve this by formalizing a hybrid nested search, in which an outer loop has the LLM propose a structural sketch, with numeric gaps, and an inner numerical optimizer tunes the sketch. Both the outer and inner solvers are pluggable: any text-based optimizer can be combined with a zero-order optimizer (CMA-ES), gradient-based routines, or MCMC samplers. We validate our framework across three scientific domains: (i) meta-optimizers on closed-form test functions, (ii) code-based policies for systems research and social dilemmas; and (iii) approximate Bayesian inference tasks. Across all three, the hybrid optimizer is superior to both vanilla LLM-driven search and pure numerical optimization baselines. Code at: https://github.com/vicgalle/hybrid-nested-search

</details>


### [459] [Predicting blood clot growth from sparse post-onset measurements with latent neural differential equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08165)
*Lennon J. Shikhman,Ying Qian,He Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于潜在神经微分方程的框架，从稀疏测量数据中推断凝血模型未知参数并预测血栓形成进展。通过与六种基线方法对比，SNODE在参数推断和血栓生长预测方面表现最佳，为个性化血栓建模提供了有前景的基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 血液凝固的计算模型有助于理解血栓形成，但临床应用中许多模型输入难以测量且患者特定数据稀疏，限制了其实际应用。需要一种能从稀疏数据中推断未知参数并预测血栓进展的方法。

Method: 基于潜在神经微分方程（latent neural differential equations）构建计算框架，包括随机神经ODE（SNODE）和随机神经泛函微分方程（SNFDE）。利用四个已知生化输入（纤维蛋白原、因子IX、VIII和V）及稀疏的早期血块尺寸观测，推断组织因子参数并预测后续血栓生长。与五种基线方法（潜在神经过程、单调概率深度集成、经验轨迹检索、PCA-ridge高斯后验、Gompertz曲线检索）进行比较。

Result: SNODE在推断未知输入和预测未来血块生长轨迹方面性能最佳。SNFDE性能相近，且一致优于其他非微分模型。预测精度随观测数据增多而提高，更长预测时域则增加不确定性并降低精度。

Conclusion: 潜在神经微分方程能有效结合参数推断与血块生长预测，从稀疏测量中获得良好结果，为个性化血栓建模提供了有前景的基础。

Abstract: Computational models of blood clotting improve understanding of thrombus formation, but their clinical application remains limited because many model inputs are difficult to measure and patient-specific data are often sparse. We present a computational framework based on latent neural differential equations that infers unknown model parameters from sparse measurements and forecasts thrombosis progression. We demonstrate the framework using data generated from a multiphysics blood-clotting model in which clot growth is governed by the coagulation cascade and diffusion. Four known biochemical inputs (fibrinogen and factors IX, VIII, and V), together with sparse early clot-size observations, are used to infer the tissue-factor parameter and predict subsequent clot growth. We compare seven probabilistic methods: stochastic neural ordinary differential equations (SNODE), stochastic neural functional differential equations (SNFDE), a latent neural-process baseline, a monotone probabilistic deep ensemble, empirical trajectory retrieval, PCA-ridge Gaussian posterior, and Gompertz-curve retrieval. SNODE achieved the best performance in inferring the unknown input and forecasting future clot-growth trajectories. SNFDE performed similarly and consistently outperformed the other non-differential models. Prediction accuracy improved as more observations became available, whereas longer forecasting horizons increased uncertainty and decreased accuracy. Latent neural differential equations thus effectively combine parameter inference and clot-growth forecasting from sparse measurements, providing a promising foundation for personalized thrombosis modeling.

</details>


### [460] [Biologically Informed Representation Learning for Robust Cross-Center Generalization of MALDI-TOF Mass Spectrometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08182)
*Alejandro L. García-Navarro,Carlos Sevilla-Salcedo,Belén Rodríguez-Sánchez,Vanessa Gómez-Verdejo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DALMA是一个概率表示学习框架，通过联合建模采集特定变异和生物监督信息，学习可迁移的生物结构化潜在表征，实现MALDI-TOF质谱数据在跨机构、跨中心的零样本微生物鉴定和抗菌素耐药性预测，并在多中心基准测试中达到最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习模型在MALDI-TOF质谱的临床微生物学任务中表现优异，但跨机构部署受限于域偏移问题——采集设备的差异导致模型捕获技术伪影而非可迁移的生物信息。现有表示学习方法主要通过统计域对齐处理此问题，却忽略了微生物学数据集中天然存在的生物监督信息，导致迁移能力有限。

Method: DALMA采用概率表示学习框架，联合建模采集特定变异性和生物监督信息。核心包括：(1)结合域特定重建与生物引导的表示学习；(2)学习生物结构化的潜在表征；(3)推理时无需机构特定组件，支持对未见过的临床站点的零样本部署；(4)利用潜在空间的新颖性估计实现可靠的择性预测。

Result: 在包含七个数据集、来自三个国家的多中心基准上评估，DALMA在两个保留临床中心的零样本微生物鉴定中持续达到最先进性能，学习到的表示也能有效迁移到抗菌素耐药性预测任务。潜在空间新颖性估计能够在未见域偏移下实现可靠的择性预测。

Conclusion: 生物信息引导的表示学习为临床微生物学中稳健且可迁移的机器学习提供了有效策略，证明了利用生物监督信息而非仅依赖统计对齐能够显著提升跨机构泛化能力。

Abstract: Machine learning models for MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry have shown considerable promise for clinical microbiology tasks such as microbial identification and antimicrobial resistance prediction. However, their deployment across institutions remains limited by domain shift, as acquisition-specific variability often leads models to capture technical artifacts rather than transferable biological information. Existing representation learning approaches primarily address this problem through statistical domain alignment while largely overlooking the biological supervision naturally available in microbiology datasets. We introduce DALMA, a probabilistic representation learning framework that jointly models acquisition-specific variability and biological supervision to learn biologically structured latent representations. By combining domain-specific reconstruction with biologically guided representation learning, DALMA learns transferable representations that generalize across heterogeneous clinical centers without requiring institution-specific components at inference, enabling zero-shot deployment on previously unseen sites. We evaluate DALMA on a multi-center benchmark comprising seven datasets from three countries. DALMA consistently achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot microbial identification across two held-out clinical centers, while the learned representations also transfer effectively to antimicrobial resistance prediction. Furthermore, latent-space novelty estimation enables reliable selective prediction under previously unseen domain shifts. These results demonstrate that biologically informed representation learning provides an effective strategy for robust and transferable ML in clinical microbiology.

</details>


### [461] [FreSH: Frequency-Segmented Hierarchical Multi-Expert Framework for Multivariate Time Series Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08207)
*Pingping Liu,Muyao Wang,Zijian Zhang,Tongshun Zhang,Hao Miao,Guorui Xie,Qingliang Li,Qiuzhan Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FreSH是一个面向多变量时间序列分类（MTSC）的频率分段层次化多专家框架，通过自适应多尺度分析、局部专家特化与全局上下文建模相结合，配合自适应融合策略和鲁棒优化目标，在30个UEA基准数据集和真实振动数据上实现了超越现有最优方法的分类精度，同时大幅降低了模型规模和计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多变量时间序列分类方法难以在多尺度上有效捕捉复杂时间模式，尤其是在类别不平衡和真实世界约束条件下，难以在细粒度表示学习与计算效率之间取得良好平衡。

Method: FreSH框架包含三个关键组件：(1) 频率分段层次化多专家架构，对时间信号进行自适应多尺度分析，不同方面由互补协同的方式建模；(2) 局部特化与全局上下文建模相结合，在不引入过多计算开销的情况下获得强表示能力；(3) 自适应融合策略动态突出输入中最具信息量的成分，并引入更鲁棒的优化目标以提升在困难样本和不同类别分布下的学习稳定性。

Result: 在30个UEA基准数据集和真实世界振动数据上的大量实验表明，FreSH在分类准确率上一致性地优于现有最先进方法，同时显著减少了模型大小并提升了效率。

Conclusion: FreSH证明了频率分段层次化多专家框架能够有效解决MTSC中的多尺度表示学习与效率平衡问题，为多变量时间序列分类提供了一个兼顾性能与实用性的新范式。

Abstract: Multivariate Time Series Classification (MTSC) demands models that can effectively capture complex temporal patterns across multiple scales while remaining computationally efficient. However, existing approaches generally struggle to reconcile fine-grained representation learning, especially under class imbalance and real-world constraints. In this paper, we present FreSH, a Frequency-Segmented Hierarchical Multi-Expert Framework designed to address these challenges. FreSH introduces a new perspective for MTSC by enabling adaptive, multi-scale analysis of temporal signals, allowing different aspects of the data to be modeled in a complementary and coordinated manner. By combining localized specialization with holistic context modeling, FreSH achieves strong representational capacity without incurring excessive computational overhead. An adaptive fusion strategy further enhances flexibility, enabling the model to dynamically emphasize the most informative components of the input. In addition, we incorporate a more robust optimization objective that improves learning stability across varying sample difficulties and class distributions. Extensive evaluations on 30 UEA benchmark datasets and real-world vibration data demonstrate that FreSH consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in classification accuracy, while substantially reducing model size and efficiency.

</details>


### [462] [Control-Diverse Reinforcement Fine-Tuning: Decoupling the Shared Control Bottleneck of RL Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08224)
*Binwen Tan,Jingchao Wang,Dengzhe Hou,Lingyu Jiang,Zeyuan Wu,Yunhan Shen,Fangzhou Lin,Kazunori Yamada,Atsushi Koike*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将"激活"与"控制"分离的视角来分析LLM强化学习后训练。通过借鉴代谢控制分析定义后训练控制系数，构建控制矩阵，揭示了共享激活与任务特化控制可以共存的现象（共享控制瓶颈与激活-控制缺口）。基于此提出CD-RFT正则化方法，在数学、代码、逻辑多任务上超越GRPO，控制解耦能力可迁移到Llama-3.2-3B。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的可解释性研究将RL后训练的成功归因于更强且更多样化的电路激活，但基准分数只反映模型是否提升，无法揭示内部变化及有限能力如何在任务间分配。作者质疑"激活为中心"的解释，认为激活的电路未必控制后训练带来的奖励增益，需要将激活与控制分离来理解。

Method: 1) 借鉴代谢控制分析定义Post-training Control Coefficient衡量组件对奖励增益的控制度，按任务族组织成控制矩阵，并与激活幅度矩阵配对。2) 定义Shared Control Bottleneck（跨任务控制集中度）与Activation-Control Gap（激活与控制集中度差异）。3) 提出CD-RFT：在后训练损失中加入共享控制瓶颈正则化。4) 为解决精确正则化梯度需二阶自动微分与flash attention不兼容的问题，推导一阶代理梯度（最坏开销低于8%）。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-7B上，CD-RFT实现最大控制解耦，并在数学、代码、逻辑任务上超越匹配的GRPO。无KL变体在pass@1上领先，带KL惩罚变体在大k的pass@k覆盖上领先（而KL本身会损害该指标）。控制解耦与能力增益可迁移到Llama-3.2-3B。

Conclusion: 共享控制瓶颈既是机制诊断工具也是训练正则器。激活高度共享可以与任务特定控制共存；小的激活-控制缺口则表明控制崩溃到共享方向、失去任务特异性。控制解耦与能力提升在不同模型上具有迁移性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning post-training unlocks complex reasoning in LLMs. Yet benchmark scores reveal only whether a model improved, not what changed inside it, nor how it splits finite capability across tasks. A representative interpretability line attributes the success of RL fine-tuning to stronger and more diverse circuit activation. We challenge this activation-centered account by separating activation from control: an activated circuit need not control the post-training reward gain. Adapting Metabolic Control Analysis, we define the Post-training Control Coefficient to measure component control over reward gain and arrange these coefficients by task family into a control matrix, paired with an activation-magnitude matrix. We call cross-task control concentration the Shared Control Bottleneck and the difference between activation and control concentration the Activation-Control Gap. This reveals that highly shared activations can coexist with task-specific control, while a small gap indicates that control has collapsed onto a shared direction and lost task specificity. To reduce this collapse, we regularize the post-training loss with the Shared Control Bottleneck and propose Control-Diverse Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (CD-RFT). The exact regularizer gradient requires second-order automatic differentiation incompatible with flash attention, so we derive a first-order proxy with worst-case overhead below eight percent. On Qwen2.5-7B, CD-RFT achieves the largest control decoupling and improves multi-task capability over matched GRPO across mathematics, code, and logic. The no-KL variant leads on pass@1, and the KL-penalized variant leads on large-k pass@k coverage that KL otherwise degrades. Together, these results show that the Shared Control Bottleneck is both a mechanistic diagnostic and a training regularizer, and that control decoupling and capability gains transfer to Llama-3.2-3B.

</details>


### [463] [SAGE: SLO-Aware Adaptive Retrieval for Production RAG Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08237)
*Muhammad Faizan Raza,Shuo,Yang,Satish Mahadevan Srinivasan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SAGE，一种基于学习的SLO感知自适应检索策略，能根据查询难度动态选择检索段落数量k，在满足延迟SLO的同时最小化质量损失。在Natural Questions上实现95%的SLO合规率（对比静态基线30%），降低36%的P95延迟和51%的检索成本，仅损失2个百分点EM准确率，且策略可跨数据集和LLM家族泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产环境的RAG系统需要在严格的尾部延迟SLO和基础设施成本约束下运行，但标准检索管线使用固定的检索预算，无法适应查询难度差异——简单查询过度检索，困难查询检索不足，迫使运营者在答案质量与SLO合规之间做出权衡。

Method: SAGE使用从初始检索结果中提取的轻量级特征（如分数分布、排名间隙、词汇信号），通过离线模仿学习训练，从近似最优延迟-质量权衡的oracle中学习，在推理时动态为每个查询选择检索段落数量k，无需额外LLM调用且开销极低。

Result: 在5秒P95延迟SLO下，SAGE在Natural Questions上达到95%的SLO合规率（对比静态k=20基线的30%），P95延迟降低36%，检索成本降低51%，EM仅损失2个百分点。单个策略可泛化到HotpotQA、UnSeenTimeQA及四个LLM家族（Llama、Qwen、Mistral、Gemma），一致获得45-52个百分点的SLO提升且无质量退化。

Conclusion: SAGE证明了通过学习自适应检索策略可以在不牺牲答案质量的前提下大幅提升SLO合规率并降低检索成本，且具有良好的跨数据集和跨模型泛化能力，为生产环境RAG系统的延迟-质量权衡提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems in production operate under strict service level objectives (SLOs) on tail latency and infrastructure cost. However, standard retrieval pipelines rely on fixed retrieval budgets that ignore query difficulty, over-retrieving for easy queries and under-serving hard ones, forcing operators to trade answer quality against SLO compliance. This paper proposes SAGE, a learned SLO-aware adaptive retrieval policy that dynamically selects the number of passages k per query. SAGE uses lightweight features derived from initial retrieval (e.g., score distributions, rank gaps, lexical signals) and is trained offline via imitation learning from an oracle that approximates optimal latency-quality trade-offs. At inference, it adds no LLM calls and minimal overhead. On Natural Questions, under a 5s P95 latency SLO, SAGE achieves 95% SLO compliance versus 30% for the best static baseline (k=20), reduces P95 latency by 36% and retrieval cost by 51% with only 2 percentage points Exact Match (EM) loss. A single policy trained on Natural Questions generalizes across HotpotQA, UnSeenTimeQA, and four LLM families (Llama, Qwen, Mistral, Gemma), consistently yielding +45-52 point SLO improvements without quality degradation.

</details>


### [464] [The Replay Gap: Static Evaluation of Model Switching in LLM Agents Scores the Wrong World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08239)
*Ashritha Gonuguntla*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过分支回滚（branching rollouts）实验证明，现有的基于日志回放（replay）的评估方式不适合用于多步Agent路由器——代理路由器的交换（swap）会导致轨迹在实际回滚时大幅偏离原始记录，回放评估严重失准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM路由器被越来越多地用于多步Agent内部，按步选择最便宜且足够的模型。然而，现有的Agent路由器评估仍沿用单轮路由器的做法：回放已记录的轨迹，用另一模型的记录输出替换，假设轨迹其余部分不受影响。作者想验证这一假设是否成立。

Method: 在受控点分支（fork）SWE-bench Agent轨迹：重建环境，用不同模型继续每条分支，并与同模型对照组（隔离采样与回放噪声）比较。共进行6组配对运行（约900次回滚），测量归一化编辑距离、首个分支后动作分歧率、有效状态比例、结果翻转等指标，并对比回放评估器（log-stitching）的预测与真实回滚结果。

Result: 交换组超出匹配对照底线0.25-0.66归一化编辑距离（多重校正后CI排除零），重写61-94%的分支后动作；74-77%的早期交换在分支后首个动作即分歧（对照组仅6-35%），仅3%的回放状态有效。分歧随分支深度双向递减。5次结果翻转全部出现在交换组（升级挽救未解决实例，降级丢失唯一解决），359个对照分支零翻转。回放评估器误判所有成功相关的输出调用，预测补丁与现实的相似度仅0.00-0.11。噪声审计发现：温度0的"确定性"依赖配置（FP8服务对照在90%以上分支分歧，AWQ服务几乎相同）；预算紧张时更强模型更易耗尽步骤未提交。

Conclusion: 回放式基准测试对Agent路由评估的是错误的世界。作者发布评估工具与全部轨迹，呼吁采用真正的分支回滚方式评估Agent路由器。

Abstract: LLM routers promise efficiency by matching each request to the cheapest adequate model, and are increasingly applied per step inside multi-step agents. Yet agentic routers are evaluated like single-turn routers: by replaying logged trajectories and substituting another model's recorded outputs, assuming the rest of the trajectory is unaffected. We test this assumption with branching rollouts: we fork live SWE-bench agent trajectories at controlled points, rebuild the environment, continue each fork with a different model, and compare against same-model control forks that isolate sampling and replay noise. Across six paired runs (~900 rollouts), swaps exceed their matched control floors by +0.25 to +0.66 normalized edit distance (multiplicity-corrected CIs exclude zero), rewriting 61-94% of post-fork actions; 74-77% of early swaps diverge at the first post-fork action, versus 6-35% of controls, leaving only 3% of replayed states valid. Divergence decreases with fork depth in both directions. All five outcome flips we observe occur in swap arms, upgrades rescuing unsolved instances and a downgrade losing the sole solve, and zero occur across 359 control forks. Scoring these same swaps with a log-stitching replay evaluator, replay mispredicts every success-relevant outcome call and predicts patches with 0.00-0.11 similarity to reality. Auditing the noise floor, temperature-0 "determinism" is configuration-dependent: FP8-served controls diverge on over 90% of forks while AWQ-served ones remain near-identical; and under tight budgets the stronger model more often exhausts its steps without submitting. Replay-based benchmarks score the wrong world for agentic routing; we release our harness and all trajectories.

</details>


### [465] [Learning from Environmental Feedback: Credit Assignment across Multiple Timescales for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08255)
*Yifu Huo,Shunjie Xing,Chenglong Wang,Peinan Feng,Qiaozhi He,Yan Ding,Anxiang Ma,Yuxin Gao,Tongran Liu,Tong Xiao,Jingbo Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出EFCA（基于环境反馈的信用分配）方法，通过多时间尺度的信用分配机制解决agentic强化学习中奖励稀疏和延迟的问题。EFCA利用环境交互中自然产生的两种过程信号（短期反馈信号和中期状态历史信号）来补充长期结果信号，并通过回报重加权机制整合，在ALFWorld和WebShop基准上显著提升任务成功率和质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agentic强化学习在真实环境中面临奖励稀疏、延迟的问题。现有信用分配方法忽视了环境交互过程中自然产生的丰富过程信息（如交互历史），而这些信息可以为识别单个动作的贡献提供有价值的监督信号。

Method: 提出EFCA多时间尺度信用分配方法，包含两个环境接地过程信号：(1) 短期反馈信号——捕捉当前动作的即时效果；(2) 中期状态历史信号——从近期交互中识别无效模式。两种信号直接从环境反馈中提取，并通过回报重加权机制（return reweighting）与长期结果信号整合。

Result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop两个基准上的实验表明，EFCA在任务成功率和任务质量上均持续优于强基线方法，验证了环境接地多时间尺度信用分配对长时程agentic强化学习的有效性。

Conclusion: 环境交互中自然产生的过程信息（反馈和历史）能够为信用分配提供有价值的监督，多时间尺度的环境接地信用分配策略是解决长时程agentic RL中奖励稀疏和延迟问题的有效途径。

Abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) often suffers from delayed and sparse rewards in real-world environments. A promising solution to this challenge is credit assignment, which aims to decompose trajectory-level rewards and provide more fine-grained supervision for intermediate decisions. However, existing credit assignment approaches ignore the rich process information naturally generated during environment interaction, e.g., interaction history. We argue that such information provides valuable supervision for identifying the contribution of individual actions. To this end, we propose Environmental Feedback-based Credit Assignment (EFCA), a multi-timescale credit assignment approach for long-horizon agentic RL. EFCA complements the long-term outcome signal with two environment-grounded process signals: a short-term feedback signal that captures the immediate effect of the current action and a medium-term state-history signal that identifies ineffective patterns from recent interactions. Both signals are directly extracted from environment feedback and integrated through a return reweighting mechanism. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop demonstrate that EFCA consistently improves both task success and task quality over strong baselines, highlighting the effectiveness of environment-grounded multi-timescale credit assignment for long-horizon agentic RL.

</details>


### [466] [Opportunity Is Not Realizability: Selection-Valid Diagnostics for Multi-LLM Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08265)
*Ibne Farabi Shihab,Abu Sa-Adat Mohamed Moon-Im Al Ahsan,Md Najmus Swaqeeb*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文批判了"Oracle路由"这一诊断工具的缺陷：在相同样本上测试最佳固定模型会使配对推断失效，且全信息oracle看到了任何可部署路由器都看不到的结果。作者分离了三个估计量（结果oracle机会、由声明信号带来的贝叶斯最优增益、学习型路由器的留出增益），并证明了具有选择有效性的置信区间，这些区间能经受住选择最佳固定模型或最佳路由器家族成员的考验，还提出了信号信息夹逼界和子模互补覆盖的(1-1/e)贪心保证。在六个家族八个检查点四个基准上的实验表明，选择有效区间在每个任务上都证明了9.7-30.7分的总体oracle缺口，但最强的可部署提示路由器只恢复了其中的7.5-14.4%，且十一个测试策略中最佳策略的联合区间下限全为零。可实现的oracle机会份额很小且可被验证：强路由器确实胜过最佳固定模型，但大部分缺口仍然存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Oracle路由作为衡量语言模型池可以通过逐查询选择获得多少收益的诊断工具存在两个根本缺陷：其一，在相同示例上选择最佳固定模型进行测试会破坏配对推断的统计有效性；其二，全信息oracle能观察到部署路由器无法观察到的结果，导致评估过于乐观。因此需要更严谨的统计框架来准确量化oracle机会及其可实现份额。

Method: 作者定义并分离了三个不同的估计量：结果oracle机会（全信息下的理论上限）、由声明的前答案信号带来的贝叶斯最优增益（介于全信息和现实之间的信息水平）、以及学习型路由器的留出增益（实际可部署性能）。提出了三种统计工具：选择有效的置信区间（能经受选择最佳固定模型或最佳路由器家族成员的选择偏差）、信号信息夹逼界（用于界定可观测信号与oracle之间的信息差距）、以及基于子模互补覆盖的(1-1/e)贪心算法来构建紧凑的模型池。

Result: 在六个模型家族、八个检查点、四个基准的实验上：选择有效区间认证了每个任务上9.7-30.7分的总体oracle缺口；最强的可部署提示路由器仅能恢复其中7.5-14.4%；对十一个已测试策略中的最佳策略进行的联合区间推断，其下限在所有任务上均为零。这表明虽然强路由器确实优于最佳固定模型，但oracle机会的大部分在实际部署中无法实现，且这是一个可被统计验证的结论。

Conclusion: oracle机会的可实现份额是小的且可被统计学证明的。通过严谨的选择有效推断，作者不仅纠正了现有oracle路由诊断的统计缺陷，还给出了可靠的量化方法，说明即使是最好的可部署路由器也只能捕获oracle收益的一小部分，大部分增益仅存在于全信息理想情境下。

Abstract: Oracle routing measures how much a pool of language models could gain from per-query selection, but the diagnostic has two flaws: testing against a best fixed model selected on the same examples invalidates paired inference, and a full-information oracle sees outcomes no deployable router observes. We separate three estimands (outcome-oracle opportunity, the Bayes-optimal gain from a declared pre-answer signal, and the held-out gain of a learned router) and prove selection-valid confidence intervals that survive choosing the best fixed model or the best member of a router family, a signal-information sandwich, and a $(1-1/e)$ greedy guarantee for building compact pools from submodular complementary coverage. On eight checkpoints from six families over four benchmarks, selection-valid intervals certify a population oracle gap of $9.7$--$30.7$ points on every task, yet the strongest deployable prompt router recovers only $7.5$--$14.4\%$ of it, and the simultaneous interval for the best of eleven tested policies has lower limit zero throughout. The realizable share of oracle opportunity is small and certifiable: strong routers beat the best fixed model, and most of the gap remains.

</details>


### [467] [Stateful CARS: Exact Cross-History Reuse for Policy-Constrained LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08282)
*Ibne Farabi Shihab,Md Najmus Swaqeeb,Abu Sa-Adat Mohamed Moon-Im Al Ahsan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Stateful CARS方法，研究在具有状态约束的工具使用语言模型智能体中，如何通过复用无效性证书实现精确条件采样。方法冻结一个合理的状态-延续模式库，并通过精确残差Doob变换从提议分布中采样，同时给出可检查的未来有效性互模拟条件，证明了模式合理性、自适应精确性等性质。实验表明在可枚举工作流中解析律与有效条件分布匹配精度达10^-16，但与官方CARS相比无系统优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具使用的语言模型智能体面临的约束会随观察和先前行为而改变其含义，从模型分布中精确采样受硬状态验证器约束的样本是一个重要问题，需要重用跨历史无效性证书以提高效率。

Method: Stateful CARS在每次尝试中冻结一个合理的状态-延续模式库，移除所有包含匹配抽象状态处认证延续的轨迹，并通过精确残差Doob变换从提议分布中采样。证明了模式合理性、自适应精确性、i.i.d.输出、几乎必然终止、单调接受和压缩不变性。

Result: 在可枚举工作流上，解析律与有效条件分布匹配到10^-16（有效性概率6×10^-8时），而状态感知局部解码偏差可达0.97。匹配比较为负：观测键控官方CARS在采样步数上更便宜（root/Stateful比值0.942），Qwen比较无效（0.99）。跨历史迁移仅在内部匹配键消融中受益（1.27×）。

Conclusion: 证据支持精确模式诱导条件化的有效性，但该方法并未展现出相对于CARS的系统性系统优势。

Abstract: Tool-using language-model agents face constraints whose meaning changes with observations and prior actions. We study exact sampling from the model distribution conditioned on a hard stateful validator while reusing invalidity certificates across histories. Stateful CARS freezes a bank of sound state--continuation schemas within each attempt and removes every trajectory containing a certified continuation at a matching abstract state. An exact residual Doob transform samples from the resulting proposal. We give a checkable future-validity bisimulation condition, prove schema soundness, adaptive exactness, i.i.d.\ outputs, almost-sure termination, monotone acceptance, and compression invariance, and characterize computation by the number of reachable full-history product states. This number can be exponential for a history-dependent language model; the evaluated method therefore makes no generic finite-trie scalability claim. On enumerable workflows, its analytic law matches the valid conditional to $10^{-16}$ at validity probability $6\times10^{-8}$, whereas state-aware local decoding can be $0.97$ away. A matched comparison is negative: observation-keyed official CARS is cheaper in sampler steps (root/Stateful ratio $0.942$ $[0.934,0.951]$), and the Qwen comparison is null ($0.99$ $[0.90,1.08]$). Cross-history transfer helps only in an internal matched-key ablation ($1.27\times$). Thus the evidence supports exact schema-induced conditioning, not a systems advantage over CARS.

</details>


### [468] [A Controlled Study of Feature-Based Knowledge Distillation Across Student Designs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08294)
*Abhinand Balachandran,Praveen Prashant*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了特征级知识蒸馏方法在不同学生网络上的影响差异。在CIFAR-100上以ResNet-50为教师，对比了多种学生架构（宽度控制的CustomResNet家族和MobileNetV2），发现logit蒸馏稳定提升所有学生，而Attention Transfer和FitNets的效果因学生规模和架构而异，且固定辅助系数在不同学生上产生不同的梯度尺度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知识蒸馏中特征对齐方法（如AT、FitNets）虽被广泛使用，但其额外约束对不同规模和架构的学生网络影响可能不同，现有研究缺乏对这一效应的系统性探究。

Method: 在CIFAR-100上使用ResNet-50教师，构建宽度可控的CustomResNet学生家族及MobileNetV2跨架构对比。每种特征方法均与匹配的logit-KD基线（相同教师、优化器、训练计划和随机种子）进行对照，并在多个随机种子上重复主要比较。

Result: Logit KD对所有测试学生均有提升。Attention Transfer在CustomResNet家族内平均效果为负，但对MobileNetV2为正，且与网络宽度无明确关联。FitNets在所有15组配对实验中均低于logit KD，且在等深度宽度扫描中，较宽学生的差距更大（但不同深度的w=48学生不遵循此趋势）。固定辅助系数在不同学生上产生不同的梯度尺度。

Conclusion: 特征级蒸馏方法的效果高度依赖学生网络的具体规模和架构，不能假设同一种特征方法对所有学生都有同等益处。固定的辅助系数无法提供统一的训练条件，提示需要根据学生特性调整蒸馏策略。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation trains a smaller student to match the outputs of a larger teacher. Feature-based methods also align intermediate representations, but this extra constraint may affect students differently. We study this question on CIFAR-100 using a ResNet-50 teacher, a width-controlled CustomResNet family and MobileNetV2 as a cross-design comparison. For each student, we evaluate each feature method against a matched logit-KD run using the same teacher, optimizer settings, training schedule and seed. We repeat the main comparisons across multiple seeds.
  Logit KD improved every tested student over its scratch baseline. Attention Transfer showed no clear relationship with size inside the CustomResNet family, but its average effect was negative for that family and positive for MobileNetV2. FitNets was below logit KD in all 15 paired runs. Within the constant-depth width sweep, its gap increased for wider students, although the different-depth w=48 student did not follow this trend. Finally, the same auxiliary coefficient produced different gradient scales across students, showing that a fixed coefficient does not create a uniform training condition.

</details>


### [469] [Machine-Learning-Based Diagnostic Framework for Passive Ultrasonic Detection of Railway Wheel Defects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08301)
*Aashish Shaju,Steve Southward,Mehdi Ahmadian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究开发了一种基于机器学习的铁路车轮缺陷多类别诊断框架，利用被动式气耦合超声声发射信号，通过统计特征选择和随机森林分类器，在九种健康状态下实现了约0.66的平衡准确率和0.65的Macro-F1分数，证明了非接触式车轮缺陷分类的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 铁路车轮缺陷的可靠识别对安全和维护至关重要，需要开发非接触式的自动诊断方法来替代传统检测方式，以实现更高效的缺陷分类与现场部署。

Method: 采集11个全尺寸铁路轮对（代表9种健康状态）的被动式气耦合超声声发射信号；使用时域和频域特征，通过Kruskal-Wallis统计检验和互信息分析进行特征筛选；使用筛选后的特征训练随机森林分类器，并通过分层5折交叉验证评估模型性能。

Result: 模型在9个类别上实现了约0.66的平衡准确率和0.65的Macro-F1分数。衰减率、峰度、偏度和包络低频功率是最具影响力的特征，紧凑的特征子集保留了大部分分类性能。

Conclusion: 研究证明了将被动超声传感、统计特征选择和监督机器学习相结合用于非接触式铁路车轮缺陷分类的可行性，为未来可现场部署的检测系统奠定了基础。

Abstract: Reliable identification of railway wheel defects is important for safety and maintenance. This study develops a machine-learning-based diagnostic framework for multi-class defect identification using passive air-coupled ultrasonic acoustic emission signals. Data were collected from eleven full-scale railway wheelsets representing nine health states. Time- and frequency-domain features were evaluated using Kruskal-Wallis statistical testing and mutual-information analysis to identify the most discriminative indicators. A Random Forest classifier was then trained using the selected features with stratified 5-fold cross-validation. The model achieved a balanced accuracy of approximately 0.66 and a Macro-F1 score of 0.65 across the nine classes. Decay rate, kurtosis, skewness, and envelope low-frequency power emerged as the most influential features, while a compact subset of features retained most of the classification performance. The results demonstrate the feasibility of combining passive ultrasonic sensing, statistical feature selection, and supervised machine learning for non-contact railway wheel defect classification and provide a foundation for future field-deployable inspection systems.

</details>


### [470] [The Neural Division of Labor: Biologically-Inspired Modular Architectures for Robust Neuromorphic Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08317)
*Maksim Bazhenov,Serafim Grubas,Vakhtang Putkaradze*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出可分解脉冲神经网络（D-SNN），通过将分类路径结构性地隔离为独立专家模块，消除全局突触纠缠，在MNIST等基准上以少一个数量级的参数达到与稠密网络相当的性能，同时降低放电率和突触操作，并天然具备抗灾难性遗忘和决策可审计性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物神经系统通过区室化架构实现高效性和鲁棒性，而现代人工神经网络依赖全局纠缠结构，导致决策逻辑不透明且易发生灾难性遗忘，亟需一种仿生的模块化架构来克服这些缺陷。

Method: 构建可分解脉冲神经网络（D-SNN），将分类通路结构性地隔离为相互独立的专家模块，消除全局突触纠缠；采用受生物启发的推-拉（push-pull）损失函数进行优化。

Result: 在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和CIFAR-10/100上达到与全稠密网络相当的准确率，但参数量减少一个数量级，放电率和突触操作降低数个数量级；物理切断专家间连接可提供对灾难性遗忘的天然防护，同时产生可审计的神经信号以增强决策透明度。

Conclusion: 这种仿生、可验证的模块化架构为在资源受限的边缘环境中部署确定性神经形态智能建立了高效基础。

Abstract: Biological neural systems achieve high efficiency and robustness through compartmentalized architectures. In contrast, modern artificial neural networks rely on globally entangled structures, which obscure decision logic and suffer from catastrophic forgetting. Here, we report a Decomposable Spiking Neural Network (D-SNN) that eliminates global synaptic entanglement by structurally isolating classification pathways into independent experts. Optimized via a bio-inspired push-pull loss function, the D-SNN achieves competitive accuracies on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10/100 benchmarks. This modular approach matches the performance of fully dense networks while utilizing an order of magnitude fewer parameters. In addition, our networks operate with up to several orders of magnitude lower firing rates and fewer synaptic operations. Furthermore, physically severing connections between experts provides inherent protection against catastrophic forgetting during sequential learning. Crucially, these isolated pathways generate auditable neural signals, increasing decision transparency. This biomimetic, verifiable architecture establishes an efficient foundation for deploying deterministic neuromorphic intelligence in resource-constrained edge environments.

</details>


### [471] [Spatial Heterogeneity-Aware Multi-Hazard Susceptibility and Risk Mapping at Regional Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08321)
*Aswathi Mundayatt,Siddharth Anil,Hitanshu Seth,Jaya Sreevalsan-Nair*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究开发了一个空间异质性感知框架，用于绘制印度喀拉拉邦和尼泊尔的洪水-滑坡易感性与相对风险图。研究比较了邻近门控跨带训练（S1）和生态门控区域约束训练（S2）两种策略，S1在精度指标上表现更优，而S2保留了更多区域生态差异。两种策略均复现了低地易涝、高地易滑坡的空间格局，建议将两种方法整合使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 洪水和滑坡经常同时发生，但它们与环境控制因素的关系存在显著的空间异质性。以往研究缺乏考虑这种空间异质性的框架，需要开发能够捕捉和利用不同区域环境差异的方法来更准确地绘制洪水-滑坡易感性和风险图。

Method: 采用15km×15km网格单元结合区域特定情境区，比较两种训练策略：S1（邻近门控跨带训练）允许地理邻近模型跨情境边界分配，S2（生态门控区域约束训练）限制模型开发与分配在同一区域。对每种灾害使用策略特定的预测变量集构建随机森林模型，在空间留出测试样本上评估。将易感性表面与CRITIC加权的暴露度和脆弱性指数整合，生成九级双变量相对风险图。

Result: S1在两个地区和两种灾害的所有精度指标上均优于S2。最大的差异出现在尼泊尔洪水易感性中，AUC-ROC从S2的0.728提升到S1的0.886，PR-AUC从0.512提升到0.823。S2在尼泊尔两种灾害中产生更低的Brier分数，并保留了预测因子选择、SHAP排名和响应模式中的区域特定差异。双变量风险图一致性在喀拉拉邦为0.521，尼泊尔为0.711，所有比较中配置差异超过数量差异。易感性-风险对应度低于0.350。

Conclusion: 跨区域学习增强了区域判别能力，而区域约束学习保留了环境差异，两种策略各有优势，应将其整合以更好地支持洪水和滑坡灾害的风险评估与管理。

Abstract: Floods and landslides often co-occur, but their relationships with environmental controls vary spatially. This study develops a spatial heterogeneity-aware framework for flood-landslide susceptibility and relative-risk mapping in Kerala, India, and Nepal. It combines 15 km x 15 km grid cells with region-specific contextual zones and compares proximity-gated cross-zone training (S1) and ecology-gated zone-constrained training (S2). S1 permits geographically nearby models to be assigned across contextual boundaries, whereas S2 restricts model development and assignment to the same zone. Random Forest models for each hazard use strategy-specific predictor sets and are evaluated on spatially held-out test samples. Susceptibility surfaces are integrated with CRITIC-weighted exposure and vulnerability indices to produce hazard-specific and nine-class bivariate relative-risk maps. S1 achieved higher mean accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, AUC-ROC, and PR-AUC for both hazards and regions. The largest difference occurred for Nepal flood susceptibility, where AUC-ROC increased from 0.728 under S2 to 0.886 under S1 and PR-AUC from 0.512 to 0.823. S2 produced lower Brier scores for both Nepal hazards and retained zone-specific differences in predictor selection, SHAP rankings, and response patterns, particularly in Kerala. Both strategies reproduced flood-prone lowland and landslide-prone upland patterns but differed in susceptibility and risk classes. Bivariate risk-map agreement was 0.521 in Kerala and 0.711 in Nepal, with allocation disagreement exceeding quantity disagreement in all S1-S2 comparisons. Susceptibility-to-risk correspondence remained below 0.350, showing that exposure and vulnerability changed priority locations. Overall, cross-zone learning strengthens regional discrimination, while zone-constrained learning preserves environmental differences, supporting their integration.

</details>


### [472] [Correlation flow governs learning at criticality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08350)
*Andrea Combette,Nelly Pustelnik,Antoine Venaille*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文结合平均场理论与随机矩阵理论，建立了深度神经网络中相关传播与神经正切核（NTK）之间的直接联系。研究表明，在无限宽、无限深网络的顺序极限下，相关传播仅在权重-偏置方差平面上的单一临界点成立。在此临界点，端到端雅可比矩阵随深度代数衰减，由此证明NTK在无限深度下与输出相关精确成比例。此外，正交初始化抑制了高斯初始化下的主要有限尺寸修正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络的初始化决定了信息和梯度能否在网络深度中传播，但一直缺乏统一理论将这些属性与学习动力学联系起来。现有研究表明需要区分相关传播（信息传播）与学习动力学（NTK驱动的训练），但两者之间的关系尚未被揭示。

Method: 结合平均场理论（用于分析相关传播）与随机矩阵理论（用于分析NTK/Jacobian谱），在无限宽、无限深网络的顺序极限下建立理论框架。通过分析端到端雅可比矩阵的代数衰减行为，证明NTK与输出相关在无限深度下的比例关系，并比较高斯初始化和正交初始化两种系综。

Result: 1) 相关传播仅在权重-偏置方差平面的单一临界点可达无限深度；2) 在该临界点，端到端雅可比矩阵随深度代数衰减；3) 由此证明NTK在无限深度下精确正比于输出相关；4) 正交初始化显著抑制高斯初始化下的有限尺寸修正；5) 理论预测在有限宽、有限深网络上得到定量验证。

Conclusion: 临界点处的正交初始化在控制深度学习渐近动力学中发挥核心作用。这个将信息传播与学习动力学联系起来的等价关系此前尚未被发现，为理解深度网络初始化的作用提供了统一的理论基础。

Abstract: The initialisation of deep neural networks determines whether information and gradients can propagate across depth, yet a unified theory connecting these properties to learning dynamics remains elusive. Combining mean-field theory and random matrix theory, we establish a direct link between correlation propagation and the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) that governs learning in the sequential limit of infinitely wide, infinitely deep networks. Correlation propagation to infinite depth is possible only at a single critical point in the weight-bias variance plane. At this point, we show that the end-to-end Jacobian vanishes algebraically with depth, and use this to prove that the NTK becomes exactly proportional to the output correlation at infinite depth. This equivalence between information propagation and learning dynamics had not yet been noticed. We further show that orthogonal initialisation suppresses the leading finite-size corrections present under Gaussian initialisation, clarifying the respective roles of the two initialisation ensembles in this limit. These theoretical predictions are validated quantitatively on finite-width, finite-depth networks. Together, these results demonstrate that orthogonal initialisation at criticality plays a central role in controlling the asymptotic dynamics of deep learning.

</details>


### [473] [Unimodality-Promoting Regularized Learning for Ordinal Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08359)
*Ryoya Yamasaki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对序数回归中的单峰性促进正则化学习（UPRL）方法进行研究，发现现有UPRL方法在使预测条件概率分布更接近单峰的同时，还会导致分布尺度变大（更平滑、置信度更低），从而引入尺度相关偏差。作者提出一种更严格体现UPRL思想且能避免尺度偏差的新方法，并通过实验验证了单峰性促进确实能提升预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 序数回归中，真实数据的条件概率分布（CPD）在大范围内呈单峰特性。以前工作的UPRL方法旨在利用这一特性提升预测性能，但本文发现这些方法在促进单峰性的同时，会不必要地增大预测分布的尺度（即更平滑、更不自信），引入尺度相关偏差。需要开发更精确反映UPRL思想的方法。

Method: 通过理论分析揭示以往UPRL方法会同时导致预测CPD更接近单峰和尺度变大（偏差来源）。在此基础上，提出一种新的UPRL方法，更严格地体现单峰性促进的核心思想，同时规避尺度相关偏差。

Result: 实验对比验证了新的UPRL方法在单峰性促进方面确实能改善预测性能。同时发现，所提方法在小规模数据或较大训练集上优于以往UPRL方法，并通过分析将这一观察归因于是否存在意外的尺度相关偏差。

Conclusion: 单峰性促进对序数回归预测性能的提升是有实际贡献的，但必须避免尺度相关偏差的干扰。新提出的UPRL方法在更严格体现单峰性思想的同时有效规避了偏差，为序数回归的正则化学习提供了更优方案。

Abstract: Ordinal regression, also called ordinal classification, is classification of ordinal data, in which the underlying target variable is categorical and considered to have a natural ordinal relation. Previous works have indicated that, in many real-world ordinal data, the conditional probability distribution (CPD) of the target variable given a value of the explanatory variable would be unimodal in a large domain of the explanatory variable and close to be unimodal even in a remaining domain. Therefore, unimodality-promoting regularized learning (UPRL), which promotes a predicted CPD closer to be unimodal with the aim of decreasing a prediction variance without inducing much bias for ordinal data of the unimodality, is promising to improve the prediction performance especially with small-size training data. In this study, we show that previous UPRL methods promote a predicted CPD to not only become closer to be unimodal but also have a larger scale (in other words, be smoother or less-confident). Therefore, we develop a novel method that more strictly reflects the idea of UPRL and evades a scale-related bias, and verify through experimental comparison that the unimodality-promotion indeed contributes to improve the prediction performance. Additionally, while our proposed UPRL method could perform better for smaller-scale data or with larger-size training data compared to a previous UPRL method, our analysis explains this experimental observation in terms of the presence or absence of an unexpected scale-related bias.

</details>


### [474] [Rethinking Learning-Based Influence Maximization: Simple Neural Surrogates and Native Discrete Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08406)
*Yiqiao Liao,Parinaz Naghizadeh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SIMBA是一个与扩散模型无关的影响力最大化框架，摒弃了复杂的神经架构和连续优化，改用轻量级神经网络代理与直接离散搜索相结合，大幅降低求解时间的同时提升影响力传播和数据效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于学习的影响力最大化框架过度依赖复杂的神经架构和种子表示的连续优化，导致计算开销大且效率低下。作者质疑这一范式，希望将计算从复杂的表示学习转移到有效的离散搜索上，以更轻量的方式解决影响力最大化问题。

Method: SIMBA包含三个核心组件：1) 均匀锚定的节点嵌入，消除初始化噪声并鼓励基于图拓扑和扩散模式的学习；2) 浅层两层图神经网络代理，用于预测最终感染状态；3) 批量多交换模拟退火算法，无需梯度或连续松弛即可探索组合种子空间。整体采用扩散模型无关的框架，以轻量代理配合直接离散搜索。

Result: SIMBA大幅缩短了求解时间（time-to-solution），同时取得了更优的影响力传播效果和更高的数据效率。

Conclusion: 该研究证明了在影响力最大化任务中，从复杂表示学习转向有效离散搜索是一种可行且优越的范式，代码已开源。

Abstract: Existing learning-based influence maximization frameworks rely heavily on complex neural architectures and continuous optimization over seed representations. We challenge this paradigm with SIMBA, a diffusion-model-agnostic framework pairing a lightweight neural surrogate with direct discrete search. SIMBA introduces three key components: 1) uniformly anchored node embeddings that eliminate initialization noise and encourage learning driven by graph topology and diffusion pattern, 2) a shallow two-layer graph neural network surrogate predicting final infection states, and 3) batched multi-swap simulated annealing that explores combinatorial seed space without gradients or continuous relaxation. By shifting compute from complex representation learning to effective discrete search, SIMBA drastically cuts time-to-solution while achieving superior influence spread and data efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/yl489/rethink-IM.

</details>


### [475] [Optimal Learning Under Tsybakov Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08416)
*Steve Hanneke,Hongao Wang,Mingyue Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文解决了Tsybakov噪声下PAC学习误差保证的著名开放问题，将上界改进到与最佳已知下界匹配，从而建立了最优误差保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PAC学习是基础学习模型，而Tsybakov噪声模型允许标签噪声（尤其靠近决策边界的点噪声更大）。[MN06]给出的上下界之间存在对数因子的差距，这一差距已悬而未决二十年，本文旨在弥合这一差距。

Method: 提出一种自适应划分实例空间的学习算法，将空间划分为大致对应不同噪声水平的区域，并在每个区域返回满足特定误差约束的概念类假设。该技术与最近非可实现学习领域的进展（如[HLZ24]和[Han25]）共享概念基础。

Result: 将上界改进到与最佳已知下界匹配，建立了在Tsybakov噪声下学习的最优误差保证。

Conclusion: 这项工作解决了Tsybakov噪声下PAC学习误差保证长达二十年的开放问题，确立了最优的误差上界。

Abstract: Probably Approximately Correct (PAC) learning [Val84] is a fundamental learning model that has been extensively investigated. In this model, $\mathcal{H} \subseteq \{0,1\}^{\mathcal{X}}$ is a concept class, and $h^*\in\mathcal{H}$ is the target concept to be learned. Having access to i.i.d. labeled examples from a distribution $\mathcal{D}$ over $\mathcal{X}\times\{0,1\}$, which admits $h^*$ as the best concept in $\mathcal{H}$, the goal is to design a learning algorithm that outputs a hypothesis having low error competitive to $h^{*}$ with high probability.
  This model was initially studied under the realizable setting, which assumes that $h^*$ has no error. A natural relaxation is to allow label noise, that is, the true label can be flipped with probability $η\in(0,1/2)$. In reality, certain labels might be extremely noisy, especially for those points near the decision boundary. Hence, it is natural to allow very noisy points, though only rarely. This is quantified by a noise model introduced by [MT99] and [Tsy04], now known as Tsybakov noise. For learning general concept classes, [MN06] gave the general upper and lower bounds for error guarantees under Tsybakov noise. However, their upper and lower bounds differ by a logarithmic factor. Resolving this gap has remained a well-known open question for the past twenty years.
  In this work, we resolve this open question by improving the upper bound to match the best known lower bound, thus establishing the optimal error guarantee for learning under Tsybakov noise. Our learning algorithm operates by adaptively partitioning the instance space into regions, roughly corresponding to different noise levels, and returning a hypothesis in the concept class satisfying a specific error constraint for each region. Our technique shares a conceptual foundation with several recent advances in non-realizable learning, such as [HLZ24] and [Han25].

</details>


### [476] [FSTC-Encoder: Feature--Spatial--Temporal Correlation Learning for Generalizable RF Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08439)
*Jing Wang,Zhu Wang,Changlong Cheng,Yifan Guo,Yin Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FSTC-Encoder通过特征、空间和时间三个维度的相关性建模，统一了异质RF感知的表征学习。采用结构感知特征编码、基于集合的空间编码和分层时间编码，在保持同一骨干架构的前提下仅调整特征配置和任务头，即可适应不同RF模态和设备。在Widar3.0、CSI-Bench和XRF55等基准上实现了92.15%的平均准确率，并在跨RF学习中缩小了跨模态性能差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异质RF感知在特征结构、空间布局和时间尺度上存在显著差异，导致现有模型难以在不同设备、环境和RF模态间复用，缺乏统一的表征学习方法。

Method: 提出FSTC-Encoder，包含三个核心组件：(1)结构感知特征编码以适应不同信号结构；(2)基于集合的空间编码以聚合可变观测；(3)分层时间编码以联合捕获局部变化和长程依赖。整个框架保持统一的空间-时间骨干架构，仅需调整特征配置和任务头。

Result: 在Widar3.0、CSI-Bench和XRF55上达到92.15%的平均准确率；在四个额外感知任务中三项排名第一；在WiFi、毫米波雷达和RFID上表现一致强劲；通过跨RF学习将跨模态性能差距从18.85%降至12.93%。

Conclusion: FSTC-Encoder证明了统一RF表征学习框架的可行性，实现了高领域鲁棒性、任务泛化性和模态可扩展性，为RF感知模型的跨设备、跨环境和跨模态复用提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Heterogeneous RF sensing differs substantially in feature structure, spatial layout, and temporal scale, making existing models difficult to reuse across devices, environments, and RF modalities. We propose FSTC-Encoder, which unifies heterogeneous RF representation learning through feature, spatial, and temporal correlation modeling. Structure-aware feature encoding accommodates different signal structures, set-based spatial encoding aggregates variable observations, and hierarchical temporal encoding jointly captures local variations and long-range dependencies. Across sensing tasks and modalities, FSTC-Encoder retains the same spatial--temporal backbone architecture while varying only the feature configuration and task head. Across Widar3.0, CSI-Bench, and XRF55, FSTC-Encoder achieves 92.15% mean Accuracy under multi-factor cross-domain protocols, ranks first on three of four additional sensing tasks, remains consistently strong across WiFi, millimeter-wave radar, and RFID, and reduces the cross-modality performance gap from 18.85% to 12.93% through cross-RF learning. These results demonstrate that FSTC-Encoder achieves high domain robustness, task generality, and modality extensibility.

</details>


### [477] [MGMCL: Multi-Granularity Manifold Contrastive Learning With Neural ODEs for Cross-Subject EEG Emotion Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08440)
*Xiang Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MGMCL框架，将跨被试EEG情绪识别重构为SPD黎曼流形上的连续表示学习，通过多粒度流形对比学习、神经ODE建模连续情绪动态、Gromov-Wasserstein流形对齐实现跨被试泛化，并在三个公开数据集上取得最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有跨被试EEG情绪识别面临两个关键挑战：1）个体间差异大导致跨被试泛化困难；2）离散化的情绪标签范式忽略了情绪本身的连续性和语义结构。现有方法在欧氏空间中仅关注边缘分布对齐，无法保留情绪语义结构。

Method: 1）将情绪识别重构为SPD黎曼流形上的连续表示学习；2）提出多粒度流形对比学习（实例级、情绪级、轨迹级）保留语义排序；3）利用流形上的神经ODE建模连续情绪动态；4）采用Gromov-Wasserstein流形对齐实现跨被试泛化；5）通过弱监督学习实现从离散标签预测连续的VA维度和支配度（VAD）。

Result: 在SEED上达到91.23%准确率，SEED-IV上73.82%，DEAP上76.38%，分别较先前最优方法提升1.89%、1.66%和1.28%。

Conclusion: 将EEG情绪识别从欧氏空间离散分类范式转变为黎曼流形上的连续表示学习，通过多粒度对比学习和流形对齐有效提升了跨被试情绪识别的泛化能力，同时支持连续的VAD情绪预测。

Abstract: Cross-subject electroencephalogram (EEG)-based emotion recognition remains challenging due to substantial inter-individual variability and discrete formulation that overlooks affective continuity. Existing methods operate in Euclidean space and focus on marginal distribution alignment, failing to preserve the semantic structure of emotions across subjects. This article proposes MGMCL, reconceptualizing emotion recognition as learning continuous representations on symmetric positive definite (SPD) Riemannian manifolds. The frame?work introduces multi-granularity manifold contrastive learning at instance, emotion, and trajectory levels while preserving semantic ordering. Neural ordinary differential equations on manifolds model continuous emotion dynamics. Cross-subject generalization employs Gromov-Wasserstein manifold alignment. Weakly-supervised learning enables continuous valence-arousal-dominance prediction from discrete labels. Extensive experiments on three public datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance: 91.23% accuracy on SEED, 73.82% on SEED-IV, and 76.38% on DEAP, achieving consistent improvements of 1.89%, 1.66%, and 1.28% over previous best methods, respectively.

</details>


### [478] [Out-of-Distribution Federated Distillation with Domain-Aware Proxy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08525)
*Jiahao Xiao,Jiangming Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种域感知代理选择框架（DPS-FD），用于联邦蒸馏（FD）场景下解决分布偏移（Out-of-Distribution）问题。通过更智能地选择代理数据，该方法在有无代理数据的OOD标准基准上分别达到82.9%和80.6%的平均准确率，优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦蒸馏（FD）虽然通过知识蒸馏在代理数据上交换软预测，实现了比联邦学习更高效的通信并支持异构模型协作，但基于分布内（In-Distribution）数据训练的FD模型难以适应分布外（OOD）场景。现有FD方法在OOD下性能下降，缺乏对代理数据的域感知选择策略。

Method: 提出一个域感知代理选择框架（Domain-Aware Proxy Selection framework, DPS-FD），用于在OOD场景下更好地选择和利用代理数据。该框架根据域信息智能挑选合适的代理数据，以缓解分布偏移带来的负面影响，在有无代理数据两种情形下均能有效适配。

Result: 在标准基准上，所提方法在有无代理数据的OOD场景下分别比现有方法平均提升82.9%和80.6%。代码和数据已公开。

Conclusion: 域感知代理选择框架有效解决了联邦蒸馏在OOD场景下的分布偏移挑战，无论是否有代理数据都能显著提升模型性能。这项工作为FD在真实异构、分布偏移环境下的应用提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Federated Learning is a distributed machine learning paradigm that trains a global model by aggregating local clients without sharing private data of each client. Federated Distillation (FD) builds upon this paradigm by leveraging knowledge distillation to exchange soft predictions on proxy data instead of model parameters, enabling more efficient communication and supporting heterogeneous model collaboration. However, FD models trained on In-Distribution data are hardly adapted to Out-of-Distribution (OOD) scenarios. In this paper, we propose a domain-aware proxy selection framework to better adopt proxy data for OOD problems. The experimental results show that the proposed models effectively address the challenges of distribution shifts under OOD with and without proxy data by achieving average 82.9\% and 80.6\% over existing works on standard benchmarks. The codes and data are released in https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DPS-FD-8596.

</details>


### [479] [Task-to-Model Optimization for Enterprise LLM Coding Assistants: A Data-Driven Framework for Cost-Optimal Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08528)
*Srinivasan Manoharan,Junhua Zhao,Fangbo Tu,Haifeng Wu,Jian Wan,Maliah Rajan M,Ashwin Hegde,Mithun Sasidharan,Kalyan Chakravarthi Podamekala*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出任务到模型优化（T2MO），一种用于企业AI编码助手的模型选择优化方法。该方法通过九阶段流水线（遥测、分类、难度分级、基准构建、候选评估、最优混合推导、预测、分阶段部署、持续治理），以"每完成任务的成本"为目标函数（而非朴素token成本），显式纳入失败升级成本，并推导路由边界与替代模型所需的最小通过率。决策采用两级层级结构，通过流量加权节省瀑布进行候选排序，支持从静态策略逐步过渡到智能路由器的生产部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业级AI编码助手推理成本高昂，且朴素的最小化token成本策略在纳入重试、升级和开发者等待时间后往往无法降低端到端总成本。现有方法缺乏数据驱动的、面向生产环境的模型选择优化框架。

Method: 提出T2MO框架，核心包括：(1) 将每个开发者会话视为可被发现、分类、难度分级、基准测试和路由的任务；(2) 以"每完成任务的期望成本"为优化目标，显式定价失败升级；(3) 推导路由边界——更便宜的模型在特定单元格上值得部署所需的最小通过率；(4) 两级决策层级（任务类别×难度层级）；(5) 交通权重节省瀑布流，按实际美元影响对替代候选排序；(6) 九阶段流水线覆盖从遥测到持续治理的完整生命周期。

Result: 理论结果表明，在升级机制下，期望完成成本目标弱支配token成本最小化目标。框架提供了路由边界公式、流量加权的节省瀑布流排序方法，以及从静态策略到影子模式分类器、验证级联、最终智能路由器的分阶段演进路径，适用于生产环境部署。

Conclusion: T2MO提供了一个可部署的、数据驱动的模型选择优化方法论，将成本优化从token维度转向任务完成维度，为生产级AI编码助手的模型路由提供了理论框架、优化协议与治理闭环，并呼吁未来进行实证研究加以验证。

Abstract: Enterprise AI coding assistants incur substantial inference spend, and naive token-cost minimization often fails to reduce end-to-end cost once retries, escalations, and developer wait time are included. We present Task-to-Model Optimization (T2MO), a data-driven methodology for optimizing model selection in production coding workflows. We treat each developer session as a task that can be discovered, classified, graded for difficulty, benchmarked in a production-like harness, and routed to the cheapest model able to complete it within quality and latency constraints. The framework is a nine-stage pipeline spanning telemetry instrumentation, taxonomy discovery, difficulty grading, benchmark construction, candidate evaluation, optimal mix derivation, forecasting and version planning, staged routing deployment, and continuous governance. Unlike token-centric routing rules, our objective is cost per completed task, with failure escalation priced in explicitly. We show that this expected-completion-cost objective weakly dominates token-cost minimization under escalation, and we derive the routing boundary, the minimum pass rate a cheaper model must reach on a given cell to be worth deploying. Decisions are organized as a two-level hierarchy of task category difficulty tier, and per-cell displacement opportunities are aggregated into a traffic-weighted savings waterfall that ranks replacement candidates by realized dollar impact. The framework supports developer guidance, spend forecasting, and a staged transition from static policies to shadow-mode classifiers, verified cascades, and ultimately an intelligent router. We describe the methodology, optimization objective, evaluation protocol, and governance loop in a form suitable for production deployment and future empirical study.

</details>


### [480] [Can Graph Learning Learn Circuits?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08536)
*Chester Tan,Moritz Lampert,Courtney Maynard,Ankit Ramakrishnan,Tina Eliassi-Rad,Ingo Scholtes*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出图电路学习（GCL）框架，将电路定位问题重新定义为图机器学习问题。GCL通过图神经网络（GNN）跨多个模型-任务对进行监督式训练，并可泛化到未见过的案例。在16个原始InterpBench案例上，最佳配置的中位数边缘AUROC达到0.902，接近EAP-IG的0.910，但低于ACDC的0.959。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有的电路定位方法大多针对每个模型-任务对独立进行定位，无法跨任务泛化，也缺乏将电路定位视为图学习问题的统一视角。作者希望利用GNN来建模计算图中通路之间的交互，从而实现可迁移的电路定位。

Method: （1）将电路定位构建为图机器学习问题，图的边代表计算通路；（2）提出GCL框架，在多个模型-任务对上训练GNN，并应用于未见案例；（3）扩充InterpBench基准，加入源自TracrBench程序的新案例以提供足够训练数据；（4）评估14种GCL配置，并适配PGExplainer方法作为对比。

Result: 最佳GCL配置在16个原始InterpBench案例上的中位数边缘AUROC为0.902（IQR [0.861, 0.942]），接近EAP-IG的0.910但低于ACDC的0.959。移除所有消息传递边后下降到0.825。适配的PGExplainer方法达到0.858。

Conclusion: 初步结果表明图机器学习为电路定位提供了自然且有潜力的新视角，尽管当前性能尚未超越最先进方法，但该方法具备跨任务泛化能力。作者希望这一视角能促进图机器学习与可解释性两个社区之间的更紧密交流。

Abstract: Circuit localization is a mechanistic interpretability task whose goal is to identify a sparse subgraph of a transformer's computation graph sufficient to reproduce a particular behavior. Most established methods localize circuits independently for each model--task pair. We instead frame circuit localization as a graph machine learning problem in which the edges of a computation graph represent computational pathways, and graph neural networks (GNNs) model interactions among these pathways. We introduce Graph Circuit Learning (GCL), a supervised, amortized framework that trains a GNN across multiple model--task pairs and applies it to unseen cases. To provide sufficient data, we augment the InterpBench benchmark with additional cases derived from the TracrBench programs. Of the 14 evaluated GCL configurations, the highest scored a median edge AUROC of $0.902$ (interquartile interval $[0.861, 0.942]$) on the 16 original held-out InterpBench cases. This is close to the published InterpBench median of $0.910$ for EAP-IG while remaining below ACDC's $0.959$. Removing all message-passing edges reduces the median to $0.825$. We also adapt PGExplainer, a GNN explainability method, to circuit localization, obtaining a median edge AUROC of $0.858$ on the same cases. These preliminary results suggest that graph machine learning offers a natural and potentially powerful perspective on circuit localization, and we hope this perspective encourages closer exchange between the two communities.

</details>


### [481] [When Skills Meet Safety: Benchmarking and Characterizing the Adaptive Jailbreak Robustness of Skill-Merged LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08542)
*Yu Ma,Hongli Shi,Jing Li,Xinran Xu,Weiwei Hou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SkillSafe-Bench基准，揭示模型合并后的静态安全评估具有误导性。通过固定有害提示测试，安全合并模型看起来安全，但在自适应攻击下可被攻破。在六个开源基座模型上，静态安全性无法预测攻击鲁棒性，安全Qwen和Gemma合并模型在语义模板攻击下60-76%被越狱，而Llama和Phi-4保持鲁棒。此外提出SubSafe-Merge方法通过投影消除任务向量与安全子空间的重叠来保持能力的同时移除安全侵蚀。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究对模型合并的安全成本评估几乎都依赖静态拒绝测试（固定有害提示测试合规性），但安全对齐是"浅层"的，集中在生成的前几个token中。这导致静态拒绝看似干净，实际自适应攻击仍可攻破，静态评估严重低估了合并模型的安全风险。

Method: 1) 提出SkillSafe-Bench基准，在六个开源基座模型（五个家族、两个规模）上，以保守的双法官AND规则评估技能合并模型在静态拒绝、自适应越狱鲁棒性和能力保持三方面的表现；2) 使用语义模板攻击进行自适应越狱评估；3) 通过数据无关的几何信号（任务向量与安全子空间的重叠）刻画同配方abliteration式安全侵蚀；4) 提出SubSafe-Merge方法，通过投影去除该重叠以在保持能力的同时消除安全侵蚀。

Result: 静态安全性不能预测攻击鲁棒性：在脆弱基座（Qwen两个规模和Gemma）上，看似安全的合并模型在语义模板攻击下60-76%被越狱，而Llama和Phi-4保持稳健。合并的静态影响具有基座条件性。SubSafe-Merge通过投影去除任务向量与安全子空间的重叠，在保持能力的同时消除安全侵蚀。

Conclusion: 对合并LLM的自适应评估是必要的：最需要评估的模型在静态筛查下看起来是安全的。模型合并的安全评估必须超越静态拒绝测试，采用自适应攻击评估，并可通过几何方法预判和缓解安全侵蚀。

Abstract: Model merging has become the default way to give an aligned language model new skills without retraining: a practitioner folds task vectors from math, code, or domain specialists into a safety-aligned base using task arithmetic, TIES, or DARE. This convenience is known to carry a safety cost, but almost all of that evidence rests on static refusal tests: fixed harmful prompts scored for compliance. We argue this is misleading. Because safety alignment is "shallow," concentrated in the first few generated tokens, a merged model's static refusal can stay clean while a real adaptive attack still breaks it. We introduce SkillSafe-Bench, a controlled benchmark that scores skill-merged models on static refusal, adaptive jailbreak robustness, and capability retention under a conservative two-judge AND rule. Across six open-weight bases (five families, two scales), static safety does not predict robustness to attack: under a semantic template attack, safe-looking merges on the fragile bases (both Qwen scales and Gemma) are jailbroken 60-76% of the time while others (Llama, Phi-4) stay robust. We further show the static effect of merging is base-conditional, characterize same-recipe abliteration-style safety erosion through a data-free geometric signal (the overlap of a task vector with a safety subspace), and outline SubSafe-Merge, which projects this overlap away to remove that erosion at held capability. Adaptive evaluation is not optional for merged LLMs: the models that most need it look safe under static screening.

</details>


### [482] [Neural Message Passing on Structural Interaction Graphs for Fully-Inductive Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08567)
*Omer Yom Tov,Avigdor Gal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SIGIL是一个图基础模型框架，通过将任意属性图映射到统一维度表示空间，解决图神经网络跨图泛化时的特征空间异构问题（维度、语义、结构差异）。它构建结构交互图，用关系消息传递网络将各特征维度嵌入共享空间，并具备排列等变性，可统一并推广知识图谱基础模型等现有范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构建图基础模型的核心障碍是输入异构性（特征维度、语义和结构的差异），这限制了图神经网络泛化到具有未见特征空间的新图上的能力。现有方法难以解决跨图特征空间迁移的挑战。

Method: SIGIL将任意属性图提升（lift）为结构交互图（structural interaction graph），其中节点是输入特征维度，加权类型化边编码跨图连接多阶的的特征对齐。随后用关系消息传递网络将每个特征维度嵌入共享空间，把原始任意维度的节点特征转化为可迁移到任意下游图的表示。通过构造保证对节点、特征维度和标签的排列等变性。

Result: 当输入特征是离散关系的一热指示符时，SIGIL恢复并严格推广了现有知识图谱推理基础模型。单个SIGIL模型在单张图上预训练后，即可实现强全归纳（fully-inductive）链路预测，并可用于实现现有知识图谱基础模型。

Conclusion: SIGIL在单一框架下统一了图基础模型设计中的多种现有范式，为跨异构特征空间的图模型泛化提供了统一的解决方案。

Abstract: A central obstacle in building graph foundation models is the input heterogeneity in terms of feature space dimensionality, semantics, and structure. Such heterogeneity limits the capability of graph neural networks to generalize to new graphs with unseen feature spaces. We address the transferability challenge with SIGIL, a framework that maps any attributed graph to a unified representation space of fixed dimension. Given a graph, SIGIL lifts it to a structural interaction graph, where nodes are the input feature dimensions and weighted, typed edges encode feature alignment across multiple orders of the graph's connectivity. A relational message-passing network embeds each feature dimension into a shared space, transforming the original node features, of arbitrary dimensionality, into representations transferable to any downstream graph. By construction, SIGIL is equivariant to permutations of nodes, feature dimensions, and labels. Additionally, when the input features are one-hot indicators of discrete relations, SIGIL recovers and strictly generalizes existing foundation models for knowledge graph reasoning. A single SIGIL model, pretrained on one graph, delivers strong fully-inductive link prediction. Also, SIGIL can be used to implement existing knowledge graph foundation models. As such, SIGIL unifies several existing regimes in graph foundation model design under a single framework

</details>


### [483] [Robust Reputation-Driven Crowdsourced Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08574)
*Mouhamed Amine Bouchiha,Gregory Blanc*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出R2CFL框架，一个鲁棒的声誉驱动众包联邦学习框架，通过引入鲁棒声誉模型与最近邻混合防御机制（R2-NNM），将声誉演化与聚合时的更新过滤联系起来，有效防御能够逐渐积累信任的隐蔽攻击者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有众包联邦学习（CrowdFL）中的声誉驱动激励机制虽能提升参与者可靠性，但缺乏对隐蔽对抗者（能规避标准检测机制的攻击者）鲁棒性的量化评估，这是一个研究空白。

Method: 提出R2CFL框架，核心包含两部分：一是鲁棒声誉模型，二是最近邻混合（R2-NNM）防御机制。该机制将声誉演化与聚合时的更新过滤相耦合，防止隐蔽攻击者逐步积累信任并影响未来任务。

Result: 实验表明R2-NNM在对自适应攻击者的防御上匹配或超越最先进的拜占庭鲁棒和后门防御机制；与现有检测-过滤防御结合时，声誉模型能忠实反映底层防御的统计鲁棒性，产生与真实正负例特征密切对应的声誉分数。

Conclusion: R2CFL通过声誉与防御的联动设计，有效弥补了现有CrowdFL框架对隐蔽攻击鲁棒性量化的不足，为众包联邦学习的可信参与提供了更可靠的保障。

Abstract: Crowdsourced Federated Learning (CrowdFL) extends traditional federated learning by enabling open and heterogeneous participation through a crowdsourcing paradigm. In this setting, reputation-driven incentive mechanisms are commonly employed to guide worker selection and enhance trustworthiness. While such approaches improve participant reliability, existing frameworks largely overlook the quantification of their robustness against stealthy adversaries, particularly those capable of evading standard detection mechanisms. To fill this gap, this paper proposes R2CFL, a robust reputation-driven CrowdFL framework. R2CFL introduces a robust reputation model coupled with a nearest neighbor mixing (R2-NNM) defense mechanism that links reputation evolution with the filtering of updates during aggregation. The proposed mechanism prevents stealthy attackers from gradually accumulating trust and influencing future tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that R2-NNM matches or surpasses state-of-the-art Byzantine-robust and backdoor defense mechanisms against adaptive attackers. Furthermore, when integrated with existing detect-and-filter defenses, the proposed reputation model faithfully captures the statistical robustness of the underlying defense by producing reputation scores that closely reflect its true positive and false positive characteristics.

</details>


### [484] [Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning via Agent-Specific Preference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08604)
*Ni Mu,Yao Luan,Yiqin Yang,Qing-Shan Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MAGPIE框架，通过为每个异构智能体建立独立的偏好模型和奖励函数，解决了多智能体强化学习中全局奖励设计困难的问题，并在理论上证明该方法收敛于纳什均衡策略，实验验证其性能与精心设计的奖励基线相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体强化学习（MARL）依赖精心设计的全局奖励函数，但在异构智能体系统中，单一标量目标难以捕捉多样化行为，且精确的奖励工程在实际中往往不可行。

Method: 1) 每个智能体由专属专家通过偏好信号独立评估，无需全局评估；2) 从偏好数据构建每个智能体的专属奖励模型；3) 通过单调聚合机制将局部偏好结合为连贯的全局目标；4) 理论上证明优化分散偏好收敛于纳什均衡策略，且优化聚合奖励模型等价于训练纳什均衡策略。

Result: 在基准多智能体任务和序列生产线任务上的大量实验中，MAGPIE达到了与奖励工程化基线相当的性能，展示了其在精确奖励工程不可行场景下促进策略学习的潜力。

Conclusion: MAGPIE通过智能体专属偏好建模，有效回避了全局奖励设计的困难，为异构多智能体系统中的策略学习提供了理论保证和实用解决方案。

Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is a powerful framework for solving complex collaborative tasks, but it relies heavily on well-defined global reward functions. Designing such rewards is challenging, especially in systems with heterogeneous agents, where a single scalar objective may fail to capture diverse behaviors. In this paper, we introduce Multi-AGent Preference-Integrated lEarning (MAGPIE), which addresses these challenges through agent-specific preference modeling. Each agent is evaluated by a dedicated expert through preference signals, eliminating the need for global evaluation. We theoretically prove that optimizing these decentralized preferences converges to a Nash equilibrium policy. To integrate local preferences into a coherent global objective, we construct agent-specific reward models from preference data and combine them via a monotonic aggregation mechanism. We further prove that optimizing this aggregate reward model is equivalent to training the Nash equilibrium policy. Extensive experiments on benchmark multi-agent tasks and a sequential production line task show that MAGPIE achieves performance comparable to reward-engineered baselines, demonstrating its potential to facilitate policy learning in scenarios where precise reward engineering is impractical.

</details>


### [485] [Domain-Aware Pruning: Sparsity and Domain Generalization via Regularized Probabilistic Masking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08624)
*Parham Sazdar,Mostafa Tavassolipour,Reshad Hosseini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出领域感知剪枝（DAP）框架，通过将网络压缩建模为连续概率掩码优化问题，以稀疏性为机制隐式提升模型对未见领域的泛化能力。DAP学习参数保留概率p∈[0,1]，并通过正则化目标惩罚领域敏感权重，从而识别出领域不变子网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 领域泛化（DG）和神经网络剪枝传统上被视为两个独立目标，分别关注OOD鲁棒性和模型效率。本文旨在弥合这一鸿沟，探索利用网络稀疏性作为隐式机制来增强对未见领域的泛化能力，实现效率与鲁棒性的统一。

Method: DAP框架的核心创新在于：1) 摒弃传统的二元掩码优化，改为学习连续参数保留概率p∈[0,1]，将压缩问题转化为连续概率掩码优化；2) 引入正则化目标，在掩码训练过程中主动惩罚领域敏感权重的保留；3) 识别并提取领域不变子网络。

Result: 在五个DG基准数据集上的实验表明，DAP在实现显著稀疏性的同时，其OOD性能一致地匹配或超越稠密模型。此外，DAP还天然提供了更强的对抗扰动鲁棒性，并产生高度可解释的模型，保留的权重可靠地封装了最领域不变且任务关键的表示。

Conclusion: DAP是一个算法无关的框架，能与现有DG流程无缝集成，无需事后微调。它证明了剪枝与领域泛化可以协同优化，同时带来额外收益：对抗鲁棒性和模型可解释性。

Abstract: Domain generalization (DG) and neural network pruning are conventionally treated as distinct objectives, targeting out-of-distribution (OOD) robustness and model efficiency, respectively. In this work, we bridge this gap by introducing Domain-Aware Pruning (DAP), a framework that leverages network sparsity as a mechanism to implicitly enhance generalization to unseen domains. Diverging from standard binary mask optimization, DAP learns a continuous parameter retention probability $p \in [0, 1]$, framing network compression as a continuous probabilistic masking problem. By introducing a regularization objective that actively penalizes the retention of domain-sensitive weights during the mask training, DAP identifies a domain-invariant subnetwork. Empirical results across five DG benchmark datasets demonstrate that DAP achieves significant sparsity while consistently matching or exceeding the OOD performance of its dense counterparts. Crucially, DAP is an algorithm-agnostic framework that integrates seamlessly with existing DG pipelines without necessitating post-hoc fine-tuning. Beyond efficiency and generalization, we show that DAP natively provides increased robustness to adversarial perturbations and yields highly interpretable models, where the retained weights reliably encapsulate the most domain-invariant and task-critical representations.

</details>


### [486] [Path-dependent Discrete Amortized Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08644)
*Tiago da Silva,Esmeralda S. Whitammer,Salem Lahlou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种路径相关的离散摊销推理方法（path-dependent discrete amortized inference），通过引入可学习的潜变量动力学系统来放宽传统马尔可夫假设，使策略可以依赖完整的过去轨迹而非仅当前状态，从而解决离散组合对象采样中马尔可夫假设导致的信号传播受阻和状态别名化问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近年来研究表明，从未归一化后验分布中采样组合离散对象可以通过学习确定性马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）高效完成。然而，马尔可夫假设存在两个缺陷：一是训练过程中会阻碍信号传播；二是由于状态别名化（state aliasing）问题，会严重降低所学采样器的表达能力。

Method: 提出将MDP提升为带有可学习潜变量动力学系统（learnable latent dynamical system）的框架，使得底层策略不仅依赖当前状态，还能依赖完整的过去轨迹。作者将这种新方法称为路径相关离散摊销推理，并证明可以将现有的离散摊销采样器学习算法推广到该设定中。

Result: 在标准基准问题的实验中，该方法相较于先前技术通常能实现更快的学习收敛速度和更好的状态空间探索能力。

Conclusion: 通过打破马尔可夫假设、引入路径依赖的潜状态动力学，该方法有效缓解了传统离散摊销采样中的局限，在收敛速度与探索能力上均取得了改进。

Abstract: We consider the problem of sampling compositional and discrete objects from a given unnormalized posterior distribution. Notably, recent studies have shown that this problem can be efficiently solved by learning a deterministic Markov Decision Process (MDP) that progressively builds each object in proportion to the posterior. In this work, however, we demonstrate that the Markovian assumption can both hamper signal propagation during training and catastrophically reduce the learned sampler's expressivity due to state aliasing. To address these issues, we propose lifting the MDP with a learnable latent dynamical system that allows the underlying policy to depend on the entire past trajectory---and not only on the current state. In view of this, we refer to the resulting method as path-dependent discrete amortized inference. Importantly, we provably extend existing learning algorithms for discrete amortized samplers to our setting. In experiments on standard benchmark problems, we also show that our approach often leads to faster learning convergence and improved state space exploration relatively to prior techniques.

</details>


### [487] [Multi-Relational Knowledge Graph Enhanced Embedding for Trajectory-User Linking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08646)
*Zhifeng Chu,Bin Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MakeTUL是首个将知识图谱表示学习引入轨迹-用户链接（TUL）任务的方法，通过构建多关系移动知识图谱，联合约束异构移动语义嵌入，并结合高阶共现模式与双分支分类层，实现对匿名轨迹用户的精准识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TUL方法存在三个问题：一是独立学习POI、时间和语义特征，未能充分利用轨迹间共享的结构知识；二是将结构与序列信息在分类前压缩，导致信息损失；三是缺乏对异构移动语义的联合建模。

Method: MakeTUL构建多关系移动知识图谱，将访问时间、POI类别和转移速度组织为类型化关系，使异构移动语义联合约束嵌入学习；利用轨迹集合中的高阶共现模式增强POI表示，提供结构先验知识；通过轨迹序列学习模块捕捉有序移动模式；采用双分支分类层在决策层面融合全局结构证据与序列证据。

Result: MakeTUL通过知识图谱增强嵌入和双分支分类设计，有效解决了稀疏和重叠轨迹下的用户链接问题，优于现有方法。

Conclusion: MakeTUL验证了多关系知识图谱在TUL任务中的有效性，为利用异构移动语义和结构先验知识提升轨迹用户识别性能提供了新思路。

Abstract: Trajectory-User Linking (TUL) aims to identify the owner of an anonymous trajectory from a set of candidate users, providing a basis for user mobility analysis and personalized location-aware services. Existing methods often learn Point of Interest (POI), temporal, and semantic features independently, make limited use of structural knowledge shared across trajectories, and compress structural and sequential information before classification. To address these issues, we propose Multi-Relational Knowledge Graph Enhanced Embedding for Trajectory-User Linking (MakeTUL), which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first attempt to introduce knowledge graph representation learning into TUL. MakeTUL organizes visit-time, POI-category, and transfer-speed information as typed relations in a multi-relational mobility knowledge graph, allowing heterogeneous mobility semantics to jointly constrain the learned embeddings. The resulting POI representations are further enriched with high-order co-occurrence patterns extracted from the trajectory collection, providing structural prior knowledge for sparse and overlapping trajectories. By integrating these prior-enhanced representations with temporal, category, and transfer information, the trajectory sequence learning module captures ordered mobility patterns, while a dual-branch classification layer preserves and combines global structural evidence and sequential evidence at the decision level.

</details>


### [488] [LegoLM: Structured Weight Sharing for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08652)
*Joseph Bingham*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LegoLM提出了一种结构化权重共享压缩框架，通过识别并解决两种失效模式（分布不匹配和异常值主导），实现了无需数据的LLM压缩，在Mistral-7B上达到4.41X压缩比且仅+0.03%困惑度退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全局权重共享在大语言模型压缩中表现不佳，但缺乏系统性研究解释其失败原因以及如何修复。作者旨在揭示权重共享失效的根本机制，并提出有效的解决方案。

Method: 1) 识别两种失效模式：分布不匹配（维度d<=2的向量块因异质权重尺度导致随d线性增长的惩罚）和异常值主导（约1/K的标量权重超出Lloyd-Max决策阈值无法表示）。2) 提出三种数据无关的适应机制：标量块编码消除d线性失配、百分位选择性替换保留异常值原样、边界层保护覆盖首尾transformer块。

Result: 在Mistral-7B上达到4.41X压缩比仅+0.03% PPL退化（优于PTQ-8bit）；在GPT-2 small和Mistral-7B上分别实现+0.03%和-0.02%的PPL变化；K=64/p=99%时在5.12X压缩下保持LAMBADA和HellaSwag准确率。发现异常值主导随模型规模增长（K=128时GPT-2 small仅+23%退化而Mistral-7B达+1,134,279%退化）。

Conclusion: 选择性替换是主导机制，将其加入逐层K-means即可获得近无损质量；异常值问题随模型规模加剧，LegoLM的三重适应方案能有效应对大规模模型的压缩挑战。

Abstract: We present \LegoLM{}, a structured weight-sharing compression framework for large language models grounded in a systematic study of why global weight sharing fails and how to fix it. We identify two distinct failure modes. Distributional mismatch: for vector blocks of dimension d <= 2, transformer layers with heterogeneous weight scales impose a scale-mismatch penalty that grows linearly with d and cannot be resolved by increasing K, producing perplexity in the millions.Outlier dominance: for scalar blocks, a fraction ~1/K of weights lies beyond the outermost Lloyd-Max decision threshold and cannot be represented by any centroid; their misrepresentation accumulates across layers, causing catastrophic quality loss. \LegoLM{} resolves both failure modes via three data-free adaptations: 1 scalar-block encoding to eliminate the $d$-linear mismatch component, 2 percentile-selective replacement that identifies and preserves outlier weights verbatim, and 3 boundary-layer protection for the first and last transformer blocks. Across GPT-2 small (124M) and Mistral-7B, \LegoLM{} achieves +0.03% PPL degradation at 4.41X compression on Mistral-7B - outperforming PTQ-8bit in both quality and compression ratio - and -0.02% at 2.67X. Downstream evaluation on LAMBADA and HellaSwag confirms that \LegoLM{} at K=64, p=99% preserves accuracy within noise at 5.12 X compression, exceeding PTQ-8bit's compression ratio while matching its accuracy. We further discover that outlier dominance grows with model scale: full replacement at K=128 degrades GPT-2 small by only +23% but catastrophically degrades Mistral-7B by +1,134,279%, while selective replacement at p=99% rescues both models to under +15%. A controlled ablation confirms that selective replacement is the dominant mechanism: adding it to per-layer K-means also yields near-lossless quality, matching \LegoLM{} within 0.02%.

</details>


### [489] [Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08673)
*Emma Graham*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究探讨强化学习中任务相似性与灾难性遗忘之间的关系，采用基于图任务的Q学习进行实验，发现任务相似性与遗忘之间存在复杂动态，但未发现任务相似性独立影响遗忘的统计显著性证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾难性遗忘是持续学习中的重大障碍，阻碍模型在连续学习多个任务时保持先前任务的性能。理解新任务相似性如何影响先前任务性能，对于设计更有效的持续学习算法至关重要。

Method: 采用可解释的强化学习方法（Q-learning）在基于图的任务上进行实验，以最小化到达目标的步数为目标。通过训练新任务后评估先前学习任务的性能，考察不同相对复杂度水平下任务相似性与遗忘的关系。

Result: 实验发现任务相似性与遗忘之间存在复杂动态，遗忘严重程度在不同任务相似度和复杂度下出现显著波动，暗示遗忘受任务相似性和复杂度的相互影响。但观察到高变异性与不均匀的任务相似性分布，未发现任务相似性独立影响遗忘的统计显著性证据。

Conclusion: 任务相似性与灾难性遗忘之间的关系仍不明确，需要进一步研究以全面理解二者之间可能存在的相互作用。当前结果表明这种关系较为复杂，可能受多重因素共同影响。

Abstract: This work explores the relationship between task similarity and catastrophic forgetting in reinforcement learning. Catastrophic forgetting, the phenomenon in machine learning of losing the ability to effectively perform on previous tasks, is a significant impediment to continual learning. This study aims to understand the extent to which the similarity of a new task influences the performance on the previous task. Interpretable reinforcement learning, specifically Q-learning, is employed on graph-based tasks with the objective of minimising the number of steps to reach a goal. The study investigates the performance on a previously learned task after training on a new task, for tasks of varying relative levels of complexity. The experimental results reveal a complex dynamic between task similarity and forgetting, with significant fluctuations in forgetting severity observed across degrees of task similarities and task complexities, and are suggestive of an interdependence of forgetting on the similarity and complexity of tasks. The observations were accompanied by observations of high degrees of variability in forgetting and an uneven distribution of task similarity measures. The relationship between these variables remains unclear and no evidence of statistical significance that task similarity has an effect, independently, on forgetting is found in continual reinforcement learning. Further research is warranted to gain a comprehensive understanding of the potential interplay between task similarity and catastrophic forgetting.

</details>


### [490] [Backward Compatibility in Tree-Based Explanations and Enhanced CART Algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08674)
*Hirofumi Suzuki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BCLTX损失指标和CART-BCTX算法，用于抑制决策树模型更新前后解释（树结构）变化的问题，在10个真实数据集上实现了预测性能与解释稳定性的良好权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习模型更新时，解释的变化会对下游决策产生负面影响。决策树因其高透明度常用于风险敏感场景，但现有研究仅关注基于特征贡献的解释，无法处理基于树结构的解释变化问题。

Method: 提出BCLTX（树解释中的向后兼容损失），用于度量并抑制决策树更新前后解释的变化；在此基础上设计CART-BCTX，一种轻量级算法，对CART进行改进以在BCLTX约束下进行决策树更新。

Result: 在10个真实数据集（涵盖分类和回归任务）上的实验表明，CART-BCTX在预测性能与BCLTX值之间取得了良好权衡，且计算时间与CART相当，不随任务类型变化。

Conclusion: CART-BCTX能够在不显著牺牲预测性能且保持计算效率的前提下，有效抑制决策树更新前后解释的变化，为风险敏感场景中的可解释模型更新提供了可行方案。

Abstract: In the operation of machine learning models, model update is a fundamental process that requires careful consideration of its impact on downstream decision-making. Particularly when operating explainable models, changes in explanations resulting from model updates can lead to detrimental outcomes for users. Decision trees, due to their high transparency, are frequently employed in risk-sensitive decision-making and serve as a prominent example in which the aforementioned issue is evident. However, existing research addressing similar issues has focused on explanations based on feature contributions, and thus cannot handle explanations derived from tree structures. Therefore, this paper proposes the Backward Compatibility Loss in Tree-based eXplanations (BCLTX), a loss metric that suppresses changes in decision tree explanations before and after updates. Furthermore, we design CART with Backward Compatibility in Tree-based eXplanations (CART-BCTX), a lightweight algorithm that improves upon CART for the decision tree update problem under BCLTX. Experimental results using 10 real-world datasets, including both classification and regression tasks, show that CART-BCTX achieves favorable trade-offs between prediction performances and BCLTX values, with comparable computation times to CART, regardless of the task.

</details>


### [491] [Efficient Test-Time Scaling for LLM-based Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08675)
*Xuan-May Le,Minh-Tuan Tran,Ling Luo,Uwe Aickelin,Dinh Phung,Trung Le*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SCALER框架，一种从粗到细的时间序列预测方法。它先用轻量级Transformer建模长期形状（趋势和季节性），生成粗粒度的未来动态表示，再以此作为紧凑指导，让LLM通过迭代的粗到细残差token细化进行测试时缩放。相比现有的基于LLM的预测方法，SCALER显著降低了推理计算开销，同时在长期、短期和零样本预测上均优于强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期时间序列预测受益于保留全局结构（如趋势和季节性）。现有的LLM预测器通常通过测试时缩放（如迭代细化）提高准确性，但这类方法计算成本高昂，且随着预测范围延长越来越容易出现全局形状不匹配的问题。

Method: SCALER采用粗到细两阶段框架：(1) 第一阶段使用轻量级Transformer专门建模长期形状，预测未来动态的粗粒度表示；(2) 第二阶段以预测的形状作为紧凑指导，引导LLM通过迭代的粗到细残差token细化进行测试时缩放。该设计减少了每一步处理的token数量，降低了对冗长描述提示的依赖，同时采用固定步数的细化避免了昂贵的基于奖励模型的选择过程。

Result: 实验结果表明，SCALER在长期、短期和零样本预测任务上均优于强预测基线，同时显著降低了LLM进行时间序列预测时的推理成本。

Conclusion: 通过显式的未来形状预测来指导细化过程，SCALER实现了准确性与计算效率之间的良好平衡，为LLM在时间序列预测中的实际应用提供了更可行的方案。

Abstract: Long-term time series forecasting benefits from preserving global structure such as trends and seasonality. Recent LLM-based forecasters often improve accuracy through test-time scaling (e.g., iterative refinement), but these methods are computationally expensive and increasingly prone to global-shape mismatch as the prediction horizon extends. We propose SCALER, a coarse-to-fine forecasting framework that first employs a lightweight Transformer tailored to long-term shape modeling to predict a coarse representation of future dynamics. This predicted shape then serves as a compact guide for an LLM to perform test-time scaling via iterative coarse-to-fine residual token refinement, while processing substantially fewer tokens at each step. By guiding refinement with an explicit future-shape prediction, SCALER reduces reliance on long description prompts, and its fixed-step refinement avoids costly reward-model-based selection, further lowering computational overhead. Experimental results demonstrate that SCALER outperforms strong forecasting baselines in long-term, short-term and zero-shot forecasting while significantly reducing the inference cost associated with scaled LLM for time series forecasting. Code: https://github.com/xuanmay2701/SCALER.

</details>


### [492] [RippleKV: Cross-Layer KV Cache Allocation via Perturbation Propagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08684)
*Dongjie Xu,Kai Qian,Julius,Weijie Shi,Yuxuan Sun,Minghua Tang,Fenglei Jin,Hanchi Dong,Jiajie Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RippleKV提出了一种基于扰动传播敏感度分析的KV缓存层间分配方法，通过注入范数自适应扰动并测量输出KL散度来评估各层对最终预测的影响，从而优化长上下文LLM推理中的缓存预算分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文LLM推理受KV缓存内存瓶颈限制，但现有的缓存预算分配方法依赖代理指标（如层深度、注意力统计或表示变化），这些指标无法真正衡量各层扰动如何传播到最终输出，可能导致敏感层分配不足而容忍层分配过多。

Method: RippleKV独立地向每层的value cache注入范数自适应扰动，在小型校准集上测量模型输出处的KL散度，取平均得到与模型特异的敏感度剖面。然后将敏感度得分归一化并应用指数映射转换为层预算乘数，通过比率参数控制层间分配差异，最后归一化以保持总KV缓存预算不变。

Result: 在LongBench基准上的实验结果表明，在匹配的缓存预算下，RippleKV在评估的KV缓存压缩方法中取得了最高的平均性能。

Conclusion: RippleKV通过直接测量扰动对输出的传播影响而非依赖启发式代理指标，实现了更优的KV缓存层间分配，且敏感度剖面不随深度单调变化，验证了基于输出敏感度分配缓存的有效性。

Abstract: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by KV cache memory, yet distributing a limited cache budget across layers remains challenging. Existing methods rely on proxies such as layer depth, attention statistics, or representation change. These proxies do not measure how perturbations at each layer propagate to the output and may therefore cause sensitive layers to be underallocated while tolerant layers are overallocated.
