Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LEED（局部嵌入演化距离）作为新的局部度量指标，用于量化图神经网络中的过平滑现象，并通过节点级分析指导虚拟节点选择以缓解过挤压问题，从而提升GNN性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN面临过平滑和过挤压两大根本局限，现有度量如Dirichlet能量只能提供全局特征，缺乏节点级分辨率，无法揭示异质性的过平滑模式，也难以指导架构改进。

Method: 提出LEED度量，通过追踪各层间单个节点嵌入的演化来在节点级量化过平滑。利用LEED生成节点重要性分数（嵌入驱动的中心性度量），并以其作为唯一准则指导局部虚拟节点的构建以缓解过挤压。

Result: 实验表明LEED比Dirichlet能量提供更具信息量的诊断并保持全局评价能力，且实现更有效的虚拟节点集成，在多个数据集上提升GNN性能。

Conclusion: LEED作为局部度量弥补了全局能量指标的不足，提供的节点级诊断和虚拟节点选择策略可有效改善GNN在过平滑与过挤压问题上的表现。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) suffer from two fundamental limitations: over-smoothing, where node representations become indistinguishable with depth, and over-squashing, where long-range information is compressed through limited message-passing channels. Existing metrics such as Dirichlet energy provide global characterizations of over-smoothing but lack the resolution to analyze node-level behavior and guide architectural improvements. In this paper, we propose LEED (Local Embedding Evolution Distance), a novel local metric that quantifies over-smoothing by tracking the evolution of individual node embeddings across layers. By operating at the node level, LEED enables fine-grained analysis of representation dynamics during training, revealing heterogeneous over-smoothing patterns that are invisible to global energy-based measures. This locality induces informative node importance scores, interpreted as embedding-driven centrality measures. We leverage LEED to design a more efficient strategy for virtual node selection. Unlike existing approaches that depend on multiple heuristic centrality measures, our method uses LEED as a unique criterion to guide the construction of Local Virtual Nodes to mitigate over-squashing. Experiments show that LEED provides more informative diagnostics than Dirichlet energy while preserving global evaluation, and enables more effective virtual node integration, improving GNN performance across datasets.

</details>


### [562] [Bayesian Symbolic Regression with Entropic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09617)
*Oussama Boussif,Mohammed Mahfoud,Younesse Kaddar,Moksh Jain,Sida Li,Damiano Fornasiere,Xiaoyin Chen,Yoshua Bengio,Esmeralda S. Whitammer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ERRLESS，一种基于最大熵强化学习的符号回归后验抽样方法，通过学习神经策略逐步构建表达式语法树，从而从后验分布中采样表达式，实现不确定性量化和自然先验约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统符号回归只搜索单个最优表达式，无法捕捉关于表达式的不确定性。自然科学研究中数据有限且有噪声，贝叶斯视角能够提供不确定性量化和先验约束，但现有后验采样方法（如SMC）在可扩展性上存在局限。

Method: ERRLESS使用最大熵强化学习训练一个神经策略，该策略通过逐步构建抽象语法树来顺序生成表达式。在训练收敛时，策略能够从后验分布中采样表达式；在测试时，通过策略的rollout进行采样。

Result: 在Feynman基准测试上取得了有竞争力的结果，同时生成简短且可解释的表达式；后验预测均值相比SMC基线获得更高的决定系数（R²），验证了贝叶斯视角在符号回归中的优势。

Conclusion: ERRLESS通过强化学习实现了可扩展的贝叶斯符号回归，在保持表达式简洁可解释的同时提升了预测性能，证明了贝叶斯方法能够在符号回归中带来实质性收益。

Abstract: Symbolic regression is the problem of finding an algebraic expression describing a stochastic dependence of a target variable on a set of inputs. Unlike forms of regression that fit parameters assuming a fixed model structure, symbolic regression is a search problem over the space of expressions, represented, for example, as abstract syntax trees using a library of operators. Symbolic regression is typically used in settings with limited, noisy data in the natural sciences. However, searching for a single best-fitting expression fails to capture the epistemic uncertainty about the expression, which motivates a Bayesian perspective that enables uncertainty quantification and specification of natural priors to constrain the search space. In this work, we propose ERRLESS (Entropy-Regularized Reinforcement Learning for Expression Structure Sampling), a scalable approach for sampling from the posterior distribution over expressions given data using maximum-entropy reinforcement learning. ERRLESS learns a neural policy that constructs expressions sequentially by building up their abstract syntax trees. At convergence, the policy samples expressions from the posterior. At test time, expressions can be sampled by rollouts of this policy. We demonstrate that ERRLESS achieves competitive results on the Feynman benchmark while producing short and interpretable expressions. Additionally, we demonstrate that the mean of the posterior predictive approximated by ERRLESS achieves a high coefficient of determination ($R^2$) compared to an SMC baseline, highlighting the benefits of the Bayesian perspective in symbolic regression.

</details>


### [563] [Satellite Trajectory Optimization via Proximal Policy Optimization for Space Debris Avoidance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09628)
*Logan Luna,Juan Ortiz Couder,Raul Alejandro Vargas-Acosta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于强化学习（PPO）的自主碰撞规避策略，并配套开源高保真天体动力学模拟器用于训练与评估。在1000个确定性GEO场景中，该智能体达到97.5%的规避成功率，显著优于基于规则（20.7%）和基于脉冲delta-v规划（27.5%）的传统控制器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着巨型星座的发射，LEO和GEO轨道的拥堵日益加剧，碎片碰撞事件频发，碰撞告警与风险愈发常见。现有的手动或基于规则的碰撞规避方法难以扩展应对这种日益恶化的动态环境，亟需可扩展的自主规避方案。

Method: 采用近端策略优化（PPO）训练强化学习策略用于自主碰撞规避；设计并开源高保真天体动力学模拟器，包含牛顿二体动力学、日/月三体摄动、燃料依赖推力及可配置碎片场；使用课程学习（curriculum learning）和塑形奖励（鼓励生存、足够的预计最近距离、节省delta-v）进行训练；评估采用完全确定性流水线（共享种子、逐episode日志、遥测导出）。

Result: 在1000个确定性GEO场景中，智能体实现97.5%的碰撞规避成功率，大幅超越基于规则的基线（20.7%）和脉冲delta-v规划基线（27.5%）。

Conclusion: 强化学习结合高保真模拟器可有效解决轨道碰撞规避问题，性能远超传统方法，且该方法已作为公开框架发布，为空间碎片环境下的自主轨迹规避提供了可复现的解决方案。

Abstract: Collision avoidance systems are commonly used to avoid fragmentation events occurring in Low-Earth Orbit (LEO) and Geosynchronous Equatorial Orbit (GEO). However, these events have been growing in frequency as orbital congestion worsens with the launch of megaconstellations. Consequently, conjunction alerts and collision risks are becoming increasingly common. Current practices, which are commonly manual or rule-based, have difficulty scaling to these worsening dynamic environments. To address this intensifying situation, we propose a reinforcement-learning policy for autonomous collision avoidance, trained via Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) along with an open-source, high-fidelity astrodynamics simulator for training and evaluation. In 1,000 deterministic GEO episodes, our agent achieves a 97.5% collision avoidance success rate, outperforming traditional controllers such as a rule-based baseline (20.7% success) and an impulsive delta-v planner baseline (27.5% success). To achieve these results, we designed a simulator to train and evaluate our agent, using real-world and simulated debris. We simulate Newtonian two-body dynamics using Sun/Moon third-body perturbations, fuel-dependent thrust, and configurable debris fields. The agent is trained with curriculum learning and shaped rewards oriented toward encouraging survival, adequate projected miss distance, and delta-v conservation. Finally, our evaluation consisted of a fully deterministic pipeline, including shared seeds, per-episode logs, and telemetry exports. Our work is a publicly available framework at https://purl.org/sat-trajectory-avoidance

</details>


### [564] [Deep Learning Imputation of Missing Radius of Maximum Winds (Rmax) Values in Tropical Cyclone Best-Track Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09683)
*Swastik Agrawal,Nishkal Hundia,Ziyue Liu,Michelle Bensi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究评估了多种数据驱动方法（1DCNN、LSTM及传统机器学习）用于热带气旋最大风速半径（Rmax）缺失值插补，发现包含R34物理输入和时序建模能显著提升性能，但迁移学习因合成数据与观测数据分布差异而无效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概率性沿海灾害评估需要准确的热带气旋参数，但数据集中常常缺失最大风速半径（Rmax）记录，这是联合概率分析方法中的关键变量，缺失将影响灾害评估的准确性。

Method: 评估三类数据驱动方法：1DCNN、LSTM和传统机器学习模型。采用物理信息输入增强、时序建模以及迁移学习策略，使用合成RAFT和STORM数据集进行预训练，用观测IBTrACS数据进行微调。

Result: 包含R34风速半径可显著提升所有模型的性能；时序模型在样本量少约一个数量级的情况下仍比非时序模型获得更高的平均相关性；时序优势在缺乏R34时更为明显；迁移学习并未提升性能，源于合成数据集与IBTrACS的Rmax分布存在差异。

Conclusion: 时序深度学习在重建不完整热带气旋记录方面具有潜力，研究强调了物理信息输入、观测数据可用性及分布一致性在沿海灾害评估中的重要性。

Abstract: Probabilistic coastal hazard assessments require accurate characterization of tropical cyclone (TC) parameters, yet datasets often contain missing records for the radius of maximum winds (Rmax), a key variable in Joint Probability Method analyses. This study evaluates data-driven approaches for Rmax imputation, including one-dimensional Convolutional Neural Networks (1DCNNs), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, and conventional machine learning models. We examine physics-informed input augmentation, temporal modeling, and transfer learning using synthetic RAFT and STORM datasets for pre-training and observational IBTrACS data for fine-tuning. Including the radius of 34-knot winds (R34) substantially improves performance across all model types. Temporal models achieve higher average correlations than non-temporal models despite using approximately an order of magnitude fewer samples, indicating better preservation of relative Rmax variability across storms. This advantage is more pronounced when R34 is unavailable, suggesting temporal information can partially compensate for missing storm-size predictors. Transfer learning does not improve performance, likely because synthetic datasets have lower and less variable Rmax distributions than IBTrACS. These findings demonstrate the potential of temporal deep learning for reconstructing incomplete TC records and highlight the importance of physics-informed inputs, observational data availability, and distributional consistency in coastal hazard assessment.

</details>


### [565] [FedOrbit: Adaptive Personalized Federated Learning for Non-IID LEO Satellite Constellations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09687)
*Satwat Bashir,Tasos Dagiuklas,Muddesar Iqbal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FedOrbit，一种针对LEO卫星星座联邦学习的框架，通过轨道级连续训练、类别感知分层聚合、质量加权特征聚合及基于轨道间类别相似度的自适应特征分解，在六个设置中五个取得最高精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LEO卫星星座中的联邦学习受轨道几何影响，存在非IID数据和地面站可见性不规则的问题。全局聚合在轨道级类别分布不相交时表现差，而强个性化在分布重叠时过度，需要一个平衡的方案。

Method: FedOrbit结合四种技术：1) 轨道级连续训练（在星间链路上进行）；2) 类别感知的分层聚合；3) 带返回率阻尼的质量加权特征聚合；4) 基于轨道间类别相似度的自适应特征分解。

Result: 在三个遥感基准和两个非IID划分下，FedOrbit在六个设置中五个达到最高精度，第六个仅差0.9个百分点。相比最强基线，Dirichlet划分下提升16.1个百分点，病理性划分下提升8.6个百分点，且在六个设置中五个取得最小的轨道内精度离散度。

Conclusion: FedOrbit有效解决了LEO卫星联邦学习中的非IID数据和可见性不均问题，在精度和轨道间一致性上均优于现有方法。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) in Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite constellations is affected by non-IID data and irregular ground-station visibility, both driven by orbital geometry. Global aggregation performs poorly when orbit-level class distributions are disjoint, while strong personalisation can be excessive when these distributions overlap. We present FedOrbit, which combines continuous orbit-level training over inter-satellite links, class-aware hierarchical aggregation, quality-weighted feature aggregation with return-rate dampening, and adaptive feature decomposition based on inter-orbit class similarity. Across three remote-sensing benchmarks and two non-IID partitions, FedOrbit achieves the highest accuracy in five of six settings and is within $0.9$ percentage points of the best result in the sixth. The gains over the strongest baseline reach $16.1$ percentage points under Dirichlet partitioning and $8.6$ under pathological partitioning, with the smallest per-orbit accuracy spread in five of six settings.

</details>


### [566] [Confusion-Geometry Rebalancing for Long-Tailed Adversarial Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09688)
*Mengnan Zhao,Geyong Min,Lihe Zhang,Tianhang Zheng,Jie Cui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CGRm（Confusion Geometry Rebalancing method），一种用于长尾分布下对抗训练的可插拔框架。该方法利用有向鲁棒错误作为训练信号，通过周期性鲁棒评估推导源类损失权重、类级鲁棒系数和有向混淆几何图，并结合反馈加权鲁棒优化与图引导的边际校正，提升脆弱类别的鲁棒性并锐化导致长尾性能下降的关键决策边界，在长尾基准上取得一致的鲁棒性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长尾分布下的对抗训练面临双重不平衡：类别不平衡使训练目标偏向头部类别，而对抗内层最大化可能进一步放大这种偏差。现有方法通过校正类别先验或调整类别级鲁棒监督来缓解问题，但将每个类别孤立处理，未能识别哪些决策边界导致长尾性能崩塌。

Method: CGRm是一个可插拔框架，核心包含：1）利用周期性鲁棒评估推导出源类损失权重、类级鲁棒系数和有向混淆几何图；2）将反馈加权鲁棒优化与图引导的边际校正相结合；3）通过识别类别间的混淆几何结构，针对性提升脆弱类别的鲁棒性并锐化关键决策边界。

Result: 在长尾基准数据集上的实验表明，CGRm相比现有方法取得了一致的鲁棒性能提升，消融实验验证了各组件（损失权重、鲁棒系数、混淆几何图）各自的贡献。

Conclusion: CGRm通过显式建模类别间的混淆几何关系而非孤立处理各类别，有效解决了长尾对抗训练中的双重不平衡问题，为长尾鲁棒学习提供了一种新的、有效的可插拔解决方案。

Abstract: Adversarial training under long tailed distributions suffers from a dual imbalance: the class imbalance skews the training objective toward head classes, and the adversarial inner maximization may further amplify this bias. Existing methods mitigate this issue by correcting class priors or adapting class wise robust supervision, yet they treat each class in isolation and fail to identify which boundaries drive long tailed collapse. We propose a Confusion Geometry Rebalancing method (CGRm) for long tail adversarial training, a plug in framework that leverages directed robust errors as training signals. CGRm leverages periodic robust evaluations to derive source class loss weights, class wise robust coefficients, and a directed confusion geometry graph. The method then couples feedback weighted robust optimization with graph guided margin correction, thereby boosting the robustness of vulnerable classes and sharpening the critical boundaries that drive long tailed performance degradation. Experiments on long tailed benchmarks show that CGRm achieves consistent robust performance gains over existing methods, with ablations validating the contribution of each component. We provide the code in the supplement.

</details>


### [567] [Recurrent Neural Networks Beyond Time: Learning from Multiple Ordered Projections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09690)
*Vagan Terziyan,Artur Terziian,Oleksandra Vitko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出有序结构依赖假说（OSDH），认为同一观测的多种合法排序可揭示单一序列组织无法获取的互补结构依赖。基于独立结构专家原则（ISEP），作者提出结构演化RNN（SE-RNNs），通过多个投影特定的RNN独立训练后融合其表示。在三个不同结构复杂度的合成数据集上验证了该方法在存在隐藏结构依赖时的一致性优势，且该框架可扩展至RNN以外的架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RNN常与时间数据绑定，但循环计算本质上操作于有序序列而非时间本身。作者观察到同一观测可能存在多种合法排序，单一顺序组织可能遗漏互补的结构依赖信息，因此希望利用多个排序来揭示更丰富的结构。

Method: 提出OSDH假说和ISEP原则，具体实现为SE-RNNs：使用多个投影特定的传统RNN作为结构专家，每个专家独立训练，再通过专门的融合模型整合其学习到的表示，保持底层循环计算不变。

Result: 在三个合成数据集上（结构复杂度显著不同）的实验表明，当存在隐藏结构依赖时，SE-RNNs从多个有序投影中持续获益；在较简单数据集上仍具竞争力。

Conclusion: OSDH独立于底层序列处理模型，框架可自然扩展到其他架构。结果表明这是一种利用互补有序表示解决多样结构化学习问题的一般计算视角。

Abstract: Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) are widely used for sequence learning, yet their application is commonly associated with temporal data, although recurrent computation fundamentally operates on ordered sequences rather than on time itself. Building on this observation, we introduce the Ordered Structural Dependency Hypothesis (OSDH), which proposes that multiple admissible orderings of the same observations may reveal complementary structural dependencies inaccessible through a single sequential organization. To operationalize this hypothesis, we propose the Independent Structural Expert Principle (ISEP), whereby projection-specific sequence models are trained independently before their learned representations are integrated through a dedicated fusion model. As a concrete realization, we present Structural Evolution RNNs (SE-RNNs), which employ conventional RNNs as projection-specific structural experts while preserving the underlying recurrent computation unchanged. Proof-of-concept experiments on three synthetic datasets with substantially different levels of structural complexity demonstrate that the proposed architecture consistently benefits from multiple ordered projections when hidden structural dependencies are present, while remaining competitive on simpler datasets. Since OSDH is independent of the underlying sequence-processing model, the proposed framework naturally extends beyond recurrent networks and may be instantiated using alternative architectures. The results suggest a general computational perspective for exploiting complementary ordered representations across diverse structured learning problems.

</details>


### [568] [Evaluating Generative Time-Series Models on Data with Point Masses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09692)
*Jian Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出生成式时间序列模型在基准测试中常被用于含有大量单一值（如零值）的数据集，但标准评估协议可能严重扭曲真实数据中的原子结构，导致结论被颠倒。作者提供了三个贡献：揭示滚动起始协议导致的评估窗口失真问题；给出一个CRPS保持不变的对照组来量化时间耦合的贡献；并通过匹配协议对七个模型进行基准测试，发现自回归hurdle模型在多数数据集上优于条件流模型，同时揭示模型排序在不同occurrence统计量下不一致的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多生成式时间序列模型的基准数据集将大量概率质量集中在单一值上（如无降雨、无订单），但标准评估协议可能在这些数据上产生严重偏差——评估窗口的原子结构可能与真实数据集完全不同，甚至反转研究结论。作者希望通过仔细评估揭示这些问题并提供更可靠的评估方法。

Method: 作者采用三项方法：(1) 分析标准滚动起始协议在零膨胀数据上的评估窗口失真问题；(2) 构造一个CRPS理论上不变的对照组，通过破坏时间耦合来量化其对统计量的贡献；(3) 在五个种子、匹配协议下对七个模型（包括自回归hurdle和条件流等）进行系统基准测试，并比较五种不同occurrence统计量下的模型排序。

Result: 研究发现：(1) 数据集与评估窗口的零值比例差异巨大（42%对13%，47%对5%），且这足以反转研究结论；(2) 自回归hurdle模型在六个数据集中的五个上击败条件流模型，优势最高达153倍；(3) 条件流模型的occurrence统计量在不同训练种子间变化高达62%；(4) 五种occurrence统计量下模型排序不一致，且不共享构造的统计量之间一致性最差。

Conclusion: 作者警告标准评估协议在零膨胀时间序列数据上可能产生严重误导，强调需要在评估中仔细匹配数据的原子结构，并指出模型在occurrence统计量上的表现具有显著的不稳定性和评估指标依赖性，呼吁社区采用更严谨的评估方法。

Abstract: Many of the series that generative time-series models are benchmarked on place a large probability mass on a single value --- it does not rain, no ride is requested, no part is ordered. We report what happens when such data is evaluated carefully. First, the standard rolling-origin protocol can score a model on a window whose atom structure bears no resemblance to the dataset: on one benchmark the dataset is $42\%$ zeros and the evaluation windows are $13\%$, on another $47\%$ against $5\%$. This is not a cosmetic problem --- it reversed one of our own conclusions, turning the strongest occurrence model in our study into what looked like a cautionary tale. Second, we give a control in which CRPS is invariant \emph{by construction} while the temporal coupling is destroyed, which measures exactly how much that coupling contributes to a chosen statistic. Third, benchmarking seven models on a matched protocol over five seeds, an autoregressive hurdle beats a conditional flow on five of six datasets, by up to a factor of $153$, while the flow's own occurrence statistics vary by up to $62\%$ across training seeds and every baseline is deterministic. Finally, the model ordering is not the same under five different occurrence statistics, and the two that do not share a construction agree with each other least.

</details>


### [569] [PET/CT Radiogenomic Mutation Prediction in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Using Multi-Label Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09721)
*Mona Furukawa,Sai Hyne,Daniel R. McGowan,Bartłomiej W. Papież*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究首次系统性地探索了基于PET/CT影像组学的多标签深度学习在非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）基因突变预测中的应用，发现多标签联合学习的效果取决于具体的基因突变组合（如KRAS/TP53联合预测有提升，而EGFR/TP53无提升），提示突变特异性建模策略可能更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肺癌是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一。虽然靶向治疗改善了非小细胞肺癌患者的预后，但当前依赖组织活检进行突变检测，这是一种具有多种局限性的侵入性操作。因此需要探索非侵入性的影像学方法来预测基因突变状态。

Method: 基于PET/CT影像组学数据，采用深度学习模型预测EGFR、TP53和KRAS基因突变。进一步评估成对多标签学习是否优于传统的单基因分类方法，并在一个新颖的英国放射基因组学队列上进行实验验证。

Result: KRAS和TP53的联合预测将AUC从0.58提升至0.64（KRAS）、从0.69提升至0.71（TP53）。对于EGFR/KRAS组合，仅EGFR从联合学习中获益，而EGFR/TP53组合无改善。

Conclusion: 多标签学习的有效性取决于所建模的特定基因突变组合，建议对PET/CT放射基因组学预测采用突变特异性建模策略。

Abstract: Lung cancer remains one of the leading causes of cancer- related mortality worldwide. Although targeted therapies have improved outcomes for patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), they rely on mutation profiling through tissue biopsy, an invasive procedure with several limitations. This study investigates PET/CT-based radio- genomic prediction of epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR), tumour protein 53 (TP53), and Kirsten rat sarcoma viral oncogene (KRAS) mutations using deep learning. We further evaluate whether pairwise multi-label learning improves mutation prediction compared with conventional single-gene classification. To the best of our knowledge, this is among the first studies to systematically investigate multi-label learning for PET/CT radiogenomic mutation prediction in NSCLC. Experiments were conducted on a novel UK-based radiogenomics cohort. Joint pre- diction of KRAS and TP53 improved AUC from 0.58 to 0.64 for KRAS and from 0.69 to 0.71 for TP53. For the EGFR/KRAS pair, only EGFR benefited from joint learning, while no improvement was observed for the EGFR/TP53 pair. These findings demonstrate that the effectiveness of multi-label learning depends on the specific combination of gene mutations being modelled, suggesting that mutation-specific modelling strategies may be preferable for PET/CT radiogenomic prediction.

</details>


### [570] [Rethinking Factor Sharing in Federated LoRA: A Rank-Aware Adaptive Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09742)
*Xinyi Xu,Bingnan Xiao,Shuang Qin,Gang Feng,Tony Q. S. Quek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FedAS-LoRA，一种联邦学习中的自适应LoRA因子共享策略选择方法。通过最小二乘代理分析，揭示了共享A（输入侧）与共享B（输出侧）两种策略的投影残差差异，并提出RSS度量指标在训练前预选最优共享侧，实验验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA在联邦学习中通常涉及A和B两个低秩因子的共享策略选择（共享A还是共享B），但现有工作缺乏对两种策略优劣的理论分析和统一选择框架。本文希望通过理论分析揭示两种策略的本质差异，并提供训练前的自适应选择方法。

Method: 1. 利用最小二乘代理模型从理论上分析Share-A/Local-B和Share-B/Local-A两种策略，揭示前者要求客户端更新共享秩r输入侧子空间，后者要求共享秩r输出侧子空间，导致不同的投影残差。2. 提出Rank-Aware Shared-Subspace Sufficiency (RSS)度量，利用冻结LLM骨干提取的表示来评估共享秩r输入子空间对本地数据分布的充分性，从而在训练前选择最优共享侧。3. 基于此提出FedAS-LoRA联邦学习框架。

Result: 实验覆盖不同任务、数据分布、LoRA秩和参与率设置，验证了RSS度量的有效性和FedAS-LoRA在联邦微调性能上的优越性。

Conclusion: LoRA因子共享策略的选择应基于最小投影残差原则，FedAS-LoRA通过训练前的RSS度量自适应选择共享侧，在联邦LoRA微调中取得了更优性能。

Abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) represents large language model (LLM) updates with two compact matrix factors, i.e., $A$ and $B$, providing an efficient way to fine-tune large models in federated learning paradigm. Inspired by the asymmetric roles of the LoRA factors, we study whether $A$ should be shared across clients while $B$ remains client-specific (Share-A/Local-B), or whether $B$ should instead be shared while $A$ remains client-specific (Share-B/Local-A). With a least-squares surrogate, we reveal that Share-A/Local-B requires the client-specific LoRA update matrices to use a common rank-$r$ input-side space, whereas Share-B/Local-A requires a common rank-$r$ output-side space. The two strategies therefore incur different projection residuals, indicating that the preferred strategy is the one with the smaller aggregate residual across clients. With this insight, we propose Federated Adaptive Factor Sharing Low-Rank Adaptation (FedAS-LoRA), which selects the sharing side before training to enhance fine-tuning performance. To enable adaptive factor selection before training, we design a Rank-Aware Shared-Subspace Sufficiency (RSS) metric, which effectively assesses whether a shared rank-$r$ input subspace is sufficient for the local data distributions using representations extracted from a frozen LLM backbone. Experiments across different tasks, data distributions, LoRA ranks, and participation settings confirm the effectiveness of RSS and the superior performance of FedAS-LoRA.

</details>


### [571] [MoNo: Multiscale Optimal Transport Neural Operator for Solving PDEs on General Geometries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09764)
*Zijiang Yang,Xiaomeng Wu,Dongmei Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MoNo多尺度最优传输神经算子，通过CoTAP（跨尺度最优传输分配与投影）机制解决潜在token分配不平衡问题，实现稳定平衡的隐空间构建，在一般几何上高效求解PDE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于Transformer的神经算子在将观测点投影到潜在token时，学习式投影机制无法保证稳定且平衡的分配，导致部分token过度分配而其他token利用率不足；这种不平衡在多尺度层次架构中会不断继承和放大，最终导致深层空间的token坍塌，限制了层次化架构的设计。

Method: 提出MoNo（多尺度最优传输神经算子），其核心是CoTAP（跨尺度最优传输分配与投影），将相邻隐空间之间的跨空间分配建模为熵正则化的最优传输问题，从而构建平衡的双向投影和稳定的隐空间；CoTAP确保多隐空间间的稳定信息传递，支持一般几何上的多尺度架构，有效学习长程物理交互。

Result: 大量实验表明，MoNo在预测性能和计算效率两方面均优于现有最先进的神经算子。

Conclusion: 通过最优传输理论构建稳定平衡的隐空间，为解决PDE的神经算子提供了更高效、更稳定的多尺度架构方案。

Abstract: Transformer-based neural operators have achieved substantial progress in solving Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) by projecting spatial observations into compact latent tokens and learning physical interactions in latent spaces. However, we reveal that existing learnable projection mechanisms cannot ensure stable and balanced assignments from observation points to latent tokens, causing some latent tokens to be over-assigned while others remain underutilized. This limitation further restricts the design of hierarchical architectures, as assignment imbalance is continuously inherited and amplified across latent spaces, eventually causing severe token collapse in deeper spaces. To address these issues, we propose MoNo (Multiscale Optimal Transport Neural Operator), a progressive multiscale neural operator that efficiently solves PDEs on general geometries through stable latent-space construction. At its core is CoTAP (Cross-scale Optimal Transport Assignment and Projection), a novel latent-space construction method that formulates cross-space assignment between adjacent spaces as an entropy-regularized optimal transport problem, thereby constructing balanced bidirectional projections and stable latent spaces. CoTAP also ensures stable information transfer across multiple latent spaces, further enabling multiscale architectures on general geometries, which in turn support more efficient learning of long-range physical interactions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MoNo outperforms existing state-of-the-art neural operators in both prediction performance and computational efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/ZijiangY1116/MoNo.

</details>


### [572] [ReliableNet: A Chance-Constrained Approach to Trustworthy Classification in Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09768)
*Ange-Clément Akazan,Ineza Remy Mugenga,Abebe Geletu,Jean Medard Ngnotchouye,Issa Karambal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ReliableNet，一种直接约束"自信且错误"(JCW)联合概率的分类方法，通过机会约束ERM和保守光滑内逼近，在多项基准上成为唯一在所有数据集和种子下满足JCW风险预算的方法，并在分布偏移下表现最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自信但错误的预测是最严重的安全隐患之一，因为它会在模型出错时绕过弃权(abstention)和人工审查机制。现有方法如经验风险最小化(ERM)、校准、不确定性估计、共形风险控制和选择性预测都只针对相关但不同的可靠性属性，无法直接在训练过程中约束这一联合失败事件。

Method: 将问题形式化为机会约束ERM问题，约束JCW概率低于用户指定的风险预算α。采用保守光滑内逼近方法，其总体可行性蕴含原始JCW约束的满足，从而在训练中直接控制这一联合失败事件。

Result: 在四个表格数据集和两个图像数据集上，ReliableNet是唯一在所有数据集和每个随机种子下都通过JCW预算认证的方法，优于ERM、事后校准、共形风险控制和选择性预测等基线。在人口统计、模糊性、虚假相关、新类别和协变量偏移下，取得了最低的经验JCW，同时在准确率、覆盖率、校准和选择性预测等方面保持竞争力。

Conclusion: ReliableNet为可信分类提供了一种有原则的方法，能够直接训练模型以满足联合自信-错误的可靠性约束，在分布内和分布外场景下均优于现有基准方法。

Abstract: A prediction that is both confident and wrong is a critical reliability failure because it can bypass abstention and human review precisely when the model is mistaken. Empirical risk minimization (ERM) controls average loss but not this failure directly, while calibration, uncertainty estimation, conformal risk control, and selective prediction methods target related reliability properties rather than bounding the joint failure event during training. We propose ReliableNet, which constrains the Joint Confident-Wrong (JCW) probability, the probability that a prediction is simultaneously confident and incorrect, below a user-specified risk budget $α\in(0,1)$. We formulate this as a chance-constrained ERM problem, use a conservative smooth inner approximation whose population feasibility implies the original JCW constraint. Across four tabular and two image datasets, ReliableNet is the only method certified within the JCW budget for every dataset and seed in distribution, when compared against baselines spanning ERM, post-hoc calibration, conformal risk control, and selective prediction. Under demographic, ambiguity, spurious-correlation, novel-class, and covariate shifts, it achieves the lowest empirical JCW among the compared methods while remaining very competitive in accuracy, coverage, calibration, and selective prediction. Risk-coverage results further indicate that ReliableNet achieves better selective ranking than the benchmark methods on most datasets. Overall, ReliableNet provides a principled approach to trustworthy classification.

</details>


### [573] [Distill Skills into Weights, Not Prompts: Abstract Skills as Privileged Signals for On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09826)
*Yubo Jiang,Fengying Xie,Zhiguo Jiang,Haopeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SKALD（技能锚定潜在蒸馏）框架，针对组相对奖励在均匀正确/错误组中失效的问题（占实验63-68%），利用同一模型的两种上下文视图进行在线自蒸馏，在五个数学基准上相比GRPO显著提升avg@8。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可验证奖励的强化学习在rollout组均匀正确或均匀错误时（占63-68%），无法产生组相对信号，导致奖励信号信息量不足，模型难以获得有效监督。

Method: SKALD使用Qwen3-Base的两种上下文视图：仅问题的学生和基于抽象技能卡的教师。学生在自己的前缀上训练，将技能优势迁移到共享参数而无测试时特权输入。采用退火指数倾斜目标以稳定上下文分布失配，通过经验门控仅在验证rollout估计教师正优势时激活蒸馏。

Result: 在五个数学基准上，SKALD在0.6B/1.7B/4B规模下较GRPO分别提升avg@8 +2.46/+4.85/+12.01。1.7B下仅零方差蒸馏恢复84.7%完整增益，且超过FLOP匹配GRPO +4.06，超过上下文技能暴露 +3.77。

Conclusion: 抽象技能在组相对奖励无信息时提供密集监督，SKALD有效解决了这一监督稀疏问题，且在不同规模下均表现稳定。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards yields no group-relative signal when rollout groups are uniformly correct or uniformly wrong, which account for 63.0-68.0% of groups in our experiments. We propose SKALD (Skill-Anchored Latent Distillation), an on-policy self-distillation framework that uses two context views of the same Qwen3-Base model: a question-only student and a teacher conditioned on an abstract, explicit-answer-filtered skill card. The student is trained on its own prefixes, transferring the skill-induced advantage into shared parameters without privileged input at test time. To stabilize context-induced distribution mismatch, SKALD employs an annealed exponentially tilted objective that downweights teacher-preferred tokens with very low student likelihood; as the tilt vanishes, it converges to teacher cross-entropy and recovers the forward-KL student gradient. An empirical gate activates distillation only when verified rollouts estimate a positive teacher advantage. Across five held-out mathematics benchmarks, SKALD improves overall avg@8 over GRPO by +2.46, +4.85, and +12.01 at 0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B, respectively. At 1.7B, zero-variance-only distillation recovers 84.7% of the full gain, while SKALD remains +4.06 above FLOP-matched GRPO and exceeds contextual skill exposure by +3.77. These results show that abstract skills provide dense supervision where group-relative rewards become uninformative.

</details>


### [574] [Multi-Agent AI Safety as an Institutional Design Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09828)
*Abdullah X*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文是POLIS研究项目的首篇论文，通过5,280个冻结实验集系统研究了AI机构中哪些部分（规则本身、权威状态、受阻后路径）产生安全性及其机制，发现相同的最终违规率可能隐藏截然不同的机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI代理日益工作在定义了任务委派、信息流动、行动执行和资源使用的系统机构中，已有研究表明部署规则能改变集体行为，但尚不清楚AI机构中哪些组成部分对安全性起关键作用以及其作用机制。

Method: 构建包含5,280个冻结实验的研究套件：主委派实验覆盖四种模型家族，高冲突诊断额外添加三种模型端点。在匹配的结构化工作流中，让模型接触不同的规则表述、守卫咨询不同的权威状态，同时变化即时合规回退的吸引力并允许受阻工作流继续。还设计资源分配实验测试揭示数值上限对请求的影响。

Result: 详细的宪法提示产生0/384违规；溯源感知的可执行守卫同样0/384违规，但阻止51/384次违规尝试，其中44次后来安全完成。局部状态守卫在普通变换改变可见策略而权威来源不变时失败集中；洗钱场景中该守卫在22/96情况下允许违规，溯源执行则0/96（p=4.77x10^-7）。资源分配实验中揭示数值上限改变了代理请求行为。

Conclusion: 规则本身只是AI机构的一部分。系统信任的权威状态至关重要，受阻后可用的路径同样关键。相同的最终违规率可能对应完全不同的机制，需要区分理解机构各组成部分的安全贡献。

Abstract: AI agents increasingly work inside systems that govern how they delegate tasks, move information, execute actions, and use shared resources. Recent work already shows that deployment rules can change collective behavior. Here we ask which parts of an AI institution produce safety and how they do it. This is the first paper from POLIS, an ongoing research programme studying algorithmic institutions for multi-agent systems. We report a frozen 5,280-episode study suite. The main pre-specified delegation experiment spans four model families; a targeted high-conflict diagnostic adds three additional model endpoints. In matched structured workflows, the model sees different rule formulations and guards consult different authority states. We also vary the attractiveness of the immediate compliant internal/self fallback and allow blocked workflows to continue. A detailed constitutional prompt produces 0/384 realized violations. A provenance-aware executable guard also produces 0/384, although it blocks prohibited attempts in 51/384 episodes; 44/51 of those episodes later complete safely. The local-state guard's failures concentrate in scenarios where an ordinary transformation changes visible policy while originating authority stays fixed. In matched laundering scenarios, that guard admits violations in 22/96 episodes and provenance enforcement in 0/96 (p = 4.77 x 10^-7). A separate resource-allocation experiment shows that revealing the numerical value of an otherwise identical cap changes agent requests. In these structured workflows, the same final violation rate can hide very different mechanisms. The rule itself is only part of the institution. The authority state the system trusts matters, and so does the path available after a block.

</details>


### [575] [Deep Multimodal Wearable Sensor Fusion for Detection of Body-Focused Repetitive Behaviors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09830)
*Samaneh Rezaeimanesh,Mohsen Behradfar,Mohammad Fili,Guiping Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出并评估了一种多模态深度学习框架，用于从腕戴式传感器数据中检测和分类身体聚焦重复行为（如拔毛发、抓皮肤）。该框架结合CNN与门控循环单元，搭配模态特定自编码器与晚期融合分类器，在二元检测中达到F1=0.985、AUC=0.997，在九类分类中宏平均F1=0.700、AUC=0.963，优于单模态基线。可解释性分析表明飞行时间与惯性模态贡献最大，错误分类主要由手势解剖区域驱动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 身体聚焦重复行为（如拔毛发、抓皮肤）是与强迫症和焦虑障碍相关的强迫性运动行为，但其早期客观检测非常困难，因为动作细微且与普通非病理手势重叠。现有方法缺乏对这类行为的自动、客观和连续的识别能力，亟需一种多模态传感与深度学习方法来解决这一临床监测难题。

Method: 利用Child Mind Institute收集的Helios腕戴设备数据，融合惯性测量单元、热电堆传感器和飞行时间传感器的信号（分别捕获运动学、热学和接近度信息）。构建了由卷积神经网络与门控循环单元组合的框架，配合模态特定的自编码器和晚期融合分类器，以利用时序与空间动态特征。采用Shapley加法解释进行事后可解释性分析，并使用层次聚类分析误分类模式。

Result: 二元检测任务中取得F1分数0.985、AUC 0.997；九类分类方案（区分每种个体行为与一个统一的非目标类别）中宏平均F1为0.700、AUC为0.963，均优于单模态基线。可解释性分析显示飞行时间与惯性模态主导判别能力，层次聚类表明误分类主要由手势的解剖区域驱动。

Conclusion: 多模态传感器融合能够实现对身体聚焦重复行为的准确、客观和连续监测，为实时、可穿戴辅助的心理健康诊断和个性化干预奠定了基础，在生物医学研究和临床护理中具有广阔应用前景。

Abstract: Body-focused repetitive behaviors, such as hair pulling and skin picking, are compulsive motor actions commonly associated with obsessive-compulsive and anxiety disorders. Their early, objective detection remains difficult because the movements are subtle and overlap with ordinary, non-pathological gestures. We developed and evaluated a multimodal deep learning framework to detect and classify these behaviors from wrist-worn sensor data. The data, collected by the Child Mind Institute using the Helios wrist-worn device, combine inertial measurement units, thermopile sensors, and time-of-flight sensors, capturing kinematic, thermal, and proximity information. The framework combined a convolutional neural network with a gated recurrent unit, alongside modality-specific autoencoders and a late-fusion classifier, to exploit temporal and spatial dynamics. It achieved an F1 score of 0.985 and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.997 for binary detection, distinguishing these behaviors from other activities, and a macro-averaged F1 score of 0.700 with an area under the curve of 0.963 across a nine-class scheme that distinguished each individual behavior from a single grouped Non-Target class, improving over single-modality baselines. Post-hoc interpretability based on Shapley additive explanations showed that the time-of-flight and inertial modalities dominated discriminative power by capturing spatial proximity and dynamic movement, while hierarchical clustering indicated that misclassifications were driven primarily by the anatomical region of the gesture. These findings demonstrate that multimodal sensor fusion enables accurate, objective, and continuous behavioral monitoring. This work establishes a foundation for real-time, wearable-assisted mental health diagnostics and personalized interventions in biomedical research and clinical care.

</details>


### [576] [Real-Time Climate Risk Assessment for Supply Chain Resilience: A Data-Driven Nowcasting Framework for Colombian Agriculture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09846)
*Hernan J. Silva-Sosa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向哥伦比亚农业供应链的实时气候风险评估方法论框架，将短期气候预报（数据驱动临近预报）与供应链风险建模相结合，构建早期预警系统架构，并通过原型实现验证其可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 哥伦比亚气候多变（降水不均、温度波动、极端事件频发），对农业生产和物流造成直接影响，特别是对于时间敏感的作物。现有研究缺乏将气候临近预报与供应链决策相整合的系统性方法，需要建立更有效的早期预警体系来增强供应链韧性。

Method: 该方法整合了基于历史气象观测的短期气候预报与供应链风险建模，建立了概念性早期预警系统架构。通过风险映射、阈值分类和面向利益相关者的风险信号来实现气候预报与供应链决策的整合。在受控计算环境中使用官方统计和再分析产品的历史气象与农业时间序列构建了原型系统，不依赖卫星图像或计算机视觉组件。

Result: 基于合成数据和历史数据的实验表明，短期降水临近预报可转化为农业供应链的可操作风险指标，支持库存、采购和运输方面的前瞻性决策。

Conclusion: 该框架证明了将气候临近预报转化为供应链风险指标的可行性，为农业供应链提供了早期预警和前瞻性决策支持的工具基础。

Abstract: This paper presents a methodological framework for real-time climate risk assessment using data-driven nowcasting techniques to enhance supply chain resilience in Colombian agricultural contexts. Climate variability in Colombia, characterized by irregular rainfall, temperature fluctuations, and recurrent extreme events, has a direct impact on agricultural production and logistics, particularly for time sensitive crops. The proposed approach integrates short term climate forecasting based on historical meteorological observations with supply chain risk modeling to establish a conceptual early warning system architecture. A prototype implementation developed in a controlled computational environment demonstrates the feasibility of the framework using historical meteorological and agricultural time series derived from official statistics and reanalysis products, without reliance on satellite imagery or computer vision components. The methodology addresses the integration of climate nowcasting with supply chain decision making through explicit risk mapping, threshold-based categorization, and stakeholder-oriented risk signals. Results from synthetic and historical data experiments indicate that short term precipitation nowcasts can be translated into actionable risk indicators for agricultural supply chains, supporting anticipatory decisions related to inventory, sourcing, and transport.

</details>


### [577] [Fairness in Link Prediction Beyond Demographic Parity: A Reproducibility Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09899)
*Valentijn Oldenburg,Floris de Kam,Stef de Wildt,Jarno Nilson Balk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文复现了Mattos等人(2025)关于公平排名链接预测的研究，验证了ΔDP无法检测暴露偏差，而提出的NDKL指标和MORAL后处理方法能有效检测和缓解该偏差，并通过多种设置评估了其鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 民主均等指标ΔDP作为常用的公平性度量，忽略了链接在排名中的位置，无法检测系统性的排名暴露偏差。本文旨在复现并验证这一主张，同时评估新的排名感知指标和相关后处理方法的有效性。

Method: 1) 复现ΔDP无法检测排名暴露偏差的实验；2) 验证排名感知的NDKL指标能检测到这些偏差；3) 复现MORAL后处理方法的效果；4) 使用合成同质化设置、分类敏感属性以及额外的公平性和效用指标（如AWRF）评估鲁棒性。

Result: 实验结果证实ΔDP在存在系统排名不公平时仍可能显示总体均等，而NDKL能有效检测这些隐藏偏差。MORAL方法在保持竞争力效用的同时改善了基于暴露的公平性，且在多种设置和数据集中表现一致。

Conclusion: 暴露感知的公平性指标能够揭示ΔDP所掩盖的偏差，MORAL方法在不显著牺牲效用的情况下减少这些偏差，研究发布了可复现的实现代码。

Abstract: In fair ranked link prediction, demographic parity ($Δ_\mathrm{DP}$) is a common fairness metric. Yet, Mattos et al. (2025) argue that it fails to detect exposure bias because it ignores where links appear in the ranking. In this study, we reproduce this claim by showing that $Δ_\mathrm{DP}$ can indicate aggregate parity even when some subgroup-pair links are systematically ranked lower than others. The proposed rank-aware Normalized Discounted KL-divergence (NDKL), however, does detect such disparities. We also reproduce the effectiveness of MORAL, a post-processing method that improves exposure-based fairness while maintaining competitive utility. Beyond reproduction, we assess robustness using synthetic homophily settings, categorical sensitive attributes, and additional fairness and utility metrics, including subgroup-pair-adapted Attention-Weighted Rank Fairness (AWRF). Overall, our results show that exposure-based metrics uncover biases hidden by $Δ_\mathrm{DP}$ and that MORAL reduces these biases with minimal utility loss across diverse settings and datasets. We release a corrected, reproducible implementation at https://github.com/Floris93100/reproducing-MORAL.

</details>


<div id='econ.EM'></div>

# econ.EM [[Back]](#toc)

### [578] [A framework for assessing value and heterogeneity, illustrated using an early model of population screening with a multi-cancer early detection test](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07601)
*N Kunst,S Dias,K Payne,S Palmer,MO Soares*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个框架来评估医疗干预的经济价值，通过分解价值构成并考察异质性，并将其应用于英格兰多癌种早期检测（MCED）检测的早期卫生经济学模型。结果显示每人0.135 QALYs的headroom价值，其中早期癌症识别是主要贡献者，结直肠癌、肺癌和卵巢癌贡献了50%的价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MCED检测等新兴医疗技术的价值既包含早期检测带来的收益，也包含假阳性、过度诊断等潜在危害；同时价值在不同个体、不同癌症类型和分期之间存在异质性。理解这些价值构成和异质性对于评估整体价值和优先安排未来研究至关重要。

Method: 作者改编了现有的决策分析模型，模拟英格兰无症状人群中每年一次Galleri筛查，以QALY衡量结局（英格兰NHS视角，2024年）。将headroom价值（假设检测无成本）分解为关键组成部分：癌症识别（诊断前和诊断后）、假阳性、过度诊断和错误分类，并进一步按癌症类型对诊断后价值进行分解以探索异质性。

Result: 总体headroom价值估计为每人0.135 QALYs。早期癌症识别是主要贡献者，主要由健康获益驱动而非成本节省。结直肠癌、肺癌和卵巢癌是最大贡献者，占总价值的50%。这些结果在多种情景分析中保持稳健。

Conclusion: 价值分解可以指导决策：通过阐明价值驱动因素、评估总体估计的合理性、探索异质性以及优先安排未来模型和证据开发活动。

Abstract: Introduction: We present a framework to assess the economic value of healthcare interventions by disaggregating value and examining heterogeneity. We applied it to an early health-economic model of population screening in England with a multi-cancer early detection (MCED) test. Value for such technologies often includes benefits, such as those associated with earlier detection, alongside potential harms from, for example, false positives or overdiagnosis. Value also varies between individuals, including across cancer types and stages. Understanding these components and heterogeneity is crucial for assessing overall value and prioritising future research. Methods: We adapted an existing decision-analytic model to simulate annual Galleri screening in an asymptomatic population, measuring outcomes in Quality Adjusted Life Years (QALYs) from an English NHS perspective (year of 2024). We disaggregate headroom value (assuming no cost to the test) into key components: cancer identification (pre- and post-diagnosis), false positives, overdiagnosis, and misclassification. Post diagnosis value was further disaggregated by cancer type to explore heterogeneity. Results: Our analysis predicts an overall estimated headroom value of 0.135 QALYs per individual. Early cancer identification was a major contributor, driven by health gains rather than cost savings. Cancers of the colon/rectum, lung and ovary were the largest contributors, accounting for 50% of overall value. These results remained robust across scenario analyses. Conclusion: The value disaggregation can guide decision making by clarifying value drivers, assessing plausibility of overall estimates, exploring heterogeneity, and prioritising future model and evidence development activities.

</details>


### [579] [Partial Homogeneity in Staggered Difference-in-Differences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08047)
*Parush Arora,Rohan Wagle*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Dirichlet Process混合先验的分层贝叶斯方法，在交错双重差分(DiD)设计中自动选择Cohort-Time效应(CATT)的分组方式，在完全灵活估计（无偏但低效）和完全池化TWFE估计（高效但有偏）之间取得平衡，兼顾了估计精度与偏差控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在交错DiD设计中，处理效应是每个队列-时间单元的CATT集合，而非单一数值。完全灵活估计每个CATT虽然无偏但效率低（当部分效应实际上相等时），而将全部池化为单一TWFE系数虽然高效，但在存在真实异质性时会带来偏差。需要在两者之间做出合理选择。

Method: 将CATT的分组选择问题转化为一个分区选择问题，对CATT施加Dirichlet Process(DP)混合先验。该模型倾向于简约分组但不确定分组数量；使用collapsed Gibbs sampler进行推断，得到点估计、边际化未知分区的可信区间以及每对CATT的共聚类概率。在误差方差固定且对分区施加成对惩罚时，MAP分区可以简化为ℓ0惩罚回归，从而将贝叶斯框架与homogeneity-pursuit文献联系起来。

Result: 校准模拟表明：该方法相比完全灵活估计器将队列-时间效应的采样方差降低26-52%，且不引入池化估计器的偏差（前提是不同效应之间的差异足够大以致可被识别）；后验通过对未知分区取平均实现了接近名义水平的置信区间覆盖率。两个应用中，一个恢复了精度提升的部分同质性结构（效应确实异质），另一个报告完全池化即足够（效应确实同质）。

Conclusion: 该DP混合先验方法能自适应地在完全灵活与完全池化之间选择适当的分组结构，在保持无偏性的同时显著提升估计效率，并通过边际化未知分区提供可靠的推断，为交错DiD中的异质性处理效应估计提供了一个实用的中间路径。

Abstract: In staggered difference-in-differences (DiD) designs, units enter treatment at different calendar times, so the treatment effect is not a single number but a set of Cohort-Average Treatment effects on the Treated (CATTs), one per cohort-time cell. Estimating every CATT as its own parameter, as the standard fully flexible estimator does, is unbiased but inefficient when some of these effects are in fact equal, whereas pooling them all into a single two-way fixed effects (TWFE) coefficient is efficient but, whenever the heterogeneity is genuine, biased for the individual effects. We frame the choice between these extremes as a partition-selection problem on the cohort-time cells and address it with a Dirichlet Process (DP) mixture prior on the CATTs. The model favors parsimonious groupings without fixing their number, and a collapsed Gibbs sampler delivers point estimates, credible intervals that marginalize the unknown partition, and co-clustering probabilities for every pair of CATTs. With the error variance held fixed and a pairwise penalty placed on the partition, a maximum a posteriori (MAP) partition reduces to an $\ell_0$-penalized regression, connecting the Bayesian formulation to the homogeneity-pursuit literature. In a calibrated simulation, the model cuts the sampling variance of the cohort-time effects by 26--52\% relative to the fully flexible estimator, without the pooled estimator's bias, provided the distinct effects are separated enough to be recovered, and the posterior delivers near-nominal confidence-interval coverage by averaging over the unknown partition. In two applications the method recovers a precision-improving partial-homogeneity structure in one, where the cohort-time effects are genuinely heterogeneous, and reports that full pooling is adequate in the other, where they are not.

</details>


### [580] [Beyond the Grid: Cost, Carbon, and Capital Requirements of On-Site Power Technologies for AI Data Centers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08170)
*Eliseo Curcio*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文评估九种现场供电技术相对于并网供电的经济性，发现没有任何技术能胜过电网：燃气联合循环现场发电约114 USD/MWh，而电网仅92 USD/MWh；四小时储能在物理上仅能覆盖年能耗的18%且边际碳排更脏；绿氢即使全球投入1万亿美元，其供电成本仍为电网的1.9-2.3倍。作者提出"投资倒置"概念：转换硬件的学习曲线毫无意义，因为免费硬件仍无法超越电网；并网平价在任何预算下都不可购买。现场供电本质是"接入权与深度"产品，当前多数投资瞄准了错误的目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据中心选址决策现在由并网排队(interconnection queues)而非电价决定，但标准平准化成本(LCOE)对比方法存在缺陷：它假设固定负荷曲线、冻结电网电价却同时建模会移动该电价的负荷，并引用设施无法购买的母线成本。作者旨在用更真实的方法评估现场发电是否值得投资。

Method: 对九种现场供应技术进行完整场地级(complete-site basis)评估，对比一个电网价格内生于数据中心负荷的交付式电网。保留备用电费、实测GPU训练负荷、交付燃料价格、生产路径碳排放以及法定45V和48E激励机制的精确核算。并引入"投资倒置"(investment inversion)方法将结果转化为资本术语，检验学习曲线与全球部署规模对成本的影响。

Result: 电网无可匹敌：燃气联合循环现场发电47 USD/MWh但完整场地能耗实际约114 USD/MWh，高于电网的92 USD/MWh；四小时储能在物理上限制于年能耗18%左右，且边际充电排放比电网更脏；电网电价制氢在成本与碳排上双双失败。全球电解槽部署于现场低于20 USD/MWh的电力时，PEM氢供电价格约为电网的2.2倍（3000亿美元投入）和1.9倍（1万亿美元投入），氢发动机对应2.7倍和2.3倍，碳减排约85%（6.8倍）。任何预算下都无法购得并网平价。

Conclusion: 现场供电不应被视作成本竞争产品，而是"接入权与深度"产品（access and depth product），即解决电网排队造成的接入瓶颈和供电深度问题。当前大多数投资目标瞄准了错误的方向——追求成本平价而非接入价值。

Abstract: Interconnection queues, not electricity prices, now govern where data centers can be built, and the standard levelized-cost comparison answers a question no developer faces: it assumes a load profile, freezes the grid price while modeling the demand that moves it, and quotes busbar costs a facility cannot buy. This paper evaluates nine on-site supply technologies against a delivered grid whose price is endogenous to projected data-center demand, on a complete-site basis that retains standby charges, with measured GPU training load, delivered fuel prices, production-pathway carbon, and statutory 45V and 48E incentive mechanics. Nothing beats the wire: gas combined cycle produces at 47 USD/MWh but costs about 114 USD per megawatt-hour of complete site energy against a 92 USD grid; four-hour storage is physically capped near 18 percent of annual energy and, charged at the margin, dirtier than the grid; hydrogen from grid-priced power fails on cost and carbon together. An investment inversion converts these findings into capital terms: conversion-hardware learning buys nothing, because free hardware still exceeds the grid for every low-carbon arm, while global electrolyser deployment on sited sub-20 USD/MWh power brings PEM hydrogen power to about 2.2 times the grid at 300 billion USD and 1.9 times at 1 trillion USD (2.7 and 2.3 for the hydrogen engine), with a carbon reduction of roughly 85 percent (6.8-fold) against grid-power production. Grid parity is not purchasable at any budget. On-site supply is an access and depth product; most current investment targets the wrong term.

</details>


### [581] [Stationary Errors and Quantile Regression in Short Panels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08750)
*Shakeeb Khan,Elie Tamer*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文研究具有无限制个体效应和时间平稳扰动项的线性面板模型。作者首先证明平稳性在分位数模型中是一个强约束：在线性条件分位数设定下，若残差分布跨期相等，斜率系数必须在分位数指数上恒定。随后提出一个固定T的估计器，通过每期的横截面分位数回归，利用平稳性使投影系数对角块与非对角块之差来识别共同斜率，并采用两步最小距离估计。该估计量在固定T下根n一致且渐近正态，允许个体内跨期无限制依赖，且不估计个体效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在面板分位数回归中，允许斜率随分位数变化是常见的灵活设定。然而，如果在模型中同时假设扰动项具有平稳性（这在面板分析中是常见的简化假设），则这种灵活性可能被破坏。作者希望澄清平稳性假设在分位数模型中的含义，并在此约束下提供有效的估计方法。

Method: 作者首先从理论上证明在平稳扰动假设下，分位数依赖的斜率系数实际上被限制为常数。然后提出固定T的估计策略：对每个时期分别运行以完整回归历史为解释变量的横截面分位数回归；平稳性使复合个体效应与扰动的分位数投影跨期相同，对角块与非对角块之差即可识别共同斜率（T>=2）。所有约束通过两步最小距离估计组合，并辅以解析协方差估计、聚类bootstrap和过度识别检验。

Result: 该估计量在固定T条件下具有根n一致性和渐近正态性，允许个体内跨期任意依赖，无需估计个体效应。提供了相容的解析协方差估计量、聚类bootstrap方法及平稳性隐含投影约束的过度识别检验。广泛的蒙特卡洛实验表明在不同设计下估计表现良好。

Conclusion: 论文阐明平稳性假设在分位数面板模型中的强约束性质——它迫使斜率系数跨分位数恒定，从而识别的是共同位置系数而非分位数特定斜率效应。在此基础上，提出的两步最小距离估计方法为这一受约束模型提供了实用且理论上完善的推断工具。

Abstract: This paper studies a linear panel model with an unrestricted individual effect and a time- stationary idiosyncratic disturbance. We first show that stationarity is a strong restriction in a quantile model. In a linear conditional quantile specification with quantile-dependent slopes, equality of the conditional residual distributions across periods generically forces the slope coefficient to be constant over the quantile index. Thus, a stationary-error model identifies a common location coefficient rather than a collection of quantile-specific slope effects. We then develop a fixed-T estimator of this common coefficient. For each period, we run a cross- sectional quantile regression of the outcome on the full history of regressors. Stationarity makes the quantile projection of the composite individual effect and disturbance common across the period-specific regressions. Differences between diagonal and off-diagonal blocks of the resulting projection coefficients therefore identify the common slope whenever T>=2. We combine all such restrictions by a two-step minimum-distance estimator. The estimator is root-n-consistent and asymptotically normal with fixed T, permits unrestricted dependence across periods within an individual, and does not estimate the individual effects. We provide a consistent analytic covariance estimator, a cluster bootstrap, and an overidentification test of the projection restrictions implied by stationarity. Extensive Monte Carlo experiments show adequate performance under various designs.

</details>


### [582] [Asymptotics for Treatment Choice with Partial Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09027)
*José Luis Montiel Olea,Chen Qiu,Jörg Stoye*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的渐近框架，用于在部分识别导致的基础不确定性与数据采样噪声叠加时，推导近似最优的治疗分配方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在实证研究中，治疗分配决策面临两类不确定性：一是采样噪声（样本量有限），二是因部分识别（partial identification）导致的基础不确定性。现有方法难以同时处理这两种不确定性叠加的情形，缺乏统一的渐近理论框架来推导近似最优的分配策略。

Method: 作者将简化型参数围绕其“最不利配置”（least-favorable configuration）进行重新中心化，并考虑漂移参数序列，使采样不确定性和部分识别程度同时递减。由此将极限决策问题刻画为一个带有合适极限识别集的正常位置漂移模型（normal location shift model）。

Result: 该方法被应用于三类问题：1）含有污染结果的治疗选择问题；2）部分识别消费者剩余下的稳健福利分析；3）为政策采纳而聚合实验估计值的问题。

Conclusion: 该渐近框架为在部分识别环境下进行近似最优的统计决策提供了统一的理论基础，能够同时处理采样噪声与基础不确定性的复合效应。

Abstract: We provide a new asymptotic framework to derive approximately optimal treatment assignments when sampling noise from data is compounded by fundamental uncertainty due to partial identification. We recenter the reduced-form parameter around its \emph{least-favorable} configuration and consider drifting parameter sequences that yield both diminishing levels of sampling uncertainty and of partial identification. We characterize the limiting decision problem as a normal location shift model with a suitable limiting identified set. We apply our results to treatment choice problems with contaminated outcomes, to robust welfare analyses with partially identified consumer surplus, and to the problem of aggregating experimental estimates for policy adoption.

</details>


### [583] [A Comparison of High-Dimensional Variable Selection Procedures for Electricity Spot Price Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09213)
*Charisios Grivas,Mikkel Mandrup,Orimar Sauri*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文研究了电力现货价格预测中的变量选择问题，比较了六种变量选择方法，包括LASSO、Elastic Net和新型的Boosting Multiple Testing (BMT)方法。基于六个区域电力市场的大量数据，研究发现BMT方法在预测精度上与LASSO和Elastic Net相当，但使用的变量数量不足其十分之一，提供了更可解释且计算效率更高的替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维变量选择方法（如LASSO和Elastic Net）在电力价格预测中虽然预测性能强，但倾向于选择过参数化的模型，导致可解释性下降。作者希望探究是否存在一种方法既能保持预测精度，又能实现更精简的模型选择。

Method: 在六个区域电力市场的大规模数据集上，系统评估了六种变量选择程序，包括LASSO、Elastic Net、多种筛选方法以及新提出的BMT方法，从样本外预测精度和模型简约性两个维度进行比较评估。

Result: LASSO和Elastic Net在预测精度上表现相当且优于大多数筛选方法，但BMT方法能达到与其相当的预测性能，同时使用的变量数量不足其十分之一，在可解释性和计算效率上具有显著优势。

Conclusion: 正则化方法通常伴随的过参数化问题并非获得预测精度的必要代价，BMT方法为电力价格预测提供了一种更可解释、计算效率更高的替代方案，为研究者和实践者提供了新的选择。

Abstract: The paper considers the problem of variable selection for forecasting electricity spot prices. High-dimensional methods such as LASSO and Elastic Net are widely used for this purpose, and while they exhibit strong predictive performance, their tendency to select over-parameterized models raises questions about interpretability. We evaluate the performance of six variable selection procedures, includingthe recently proposed Boosting Multiple Testing (BMT) method, using an extensive dataset from six regional electricity markets. We assess their performance in terms of both out-of-sample forecasting ac-curacy and model parsimony. We find that, although LASSO and Elastic Net achieve similar accuracy and outperform most screening alternatives, BMT matches their forecasting performance while using less than one-tenth as many variables. Our results reveal that BMT offers researchers and practitioners a substantially more interpretable and computationally efficient alternative to shrinkage methods, without any loss of forecasting accuracy. These findings suggest that the over-parameterization typically associated with regularization methods is not a necessary price for predictive accuracy in electricity price forecasting.

</details>


### [584] [Asymmetries in Peer Effects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09219)
*Aristide Houndetoungan,Mathieu Lambotte*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文提出一个非对称同伴效应的结构模型，其中个体对表现优于或劣于自身的同伴产生不同的遵从激励。模型具有唯一均衡，可通过简单矩条件识别和估计。应用于多类学生结果后发现显著的同伴效应非对称性，并在预算约束下研究针对性干预，证明忽略非对称性会导致低效的治疗分配和显著福利损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有同伴效应模型通常假设个体对表现更好或更差的同伴做出相似反应，但现实中偏离群体行为会带来社会成本，这种成本可能因同伴相对表现不同而异。作者希望捕捉这种非对称性并评估其政策含义。

Method: 构建非对称同伴效应的结构模型，其中遵从激励取决于个体相对每个同伴的表现位置（高于或低于）。证明模型存在唯一均衡，并通过简单矩条件实现参数识别与估计。将方法应用于多个学生结果数据，并进行预算约束下的目标干预分析。

Result: 在多类学生结果中发现同伴效应存在强非对称性的证据。当忽略这些非对称性时，目标干预的治疗分配变得低效，导致社会福利显著损失，福利水平降至与无社会互动基准相当的程度。

Conclusion: 同伴效应的非对称性具有重要的政策相关性。在设计针对性干预时需要显式考虑个体相对同伴的表现位置，否则忽视非对称性将使干预效果大打折扣，甚至抵消社会互动带来的潜在收益。

Abstract: Individuals are often influenced by their peers because deviating from prevailing behavior entails social costs. However, existing peer effects models typically assume that individuals respond similarly to peers who perform better or worse than they do. This paper introduces a novel structural model of asymmetric peer effects in which conformity incentives depend on whether individuals perform below or above each of their peers. We establish that the model admits a unique equilibrium and show that its parameters can be identified and estimated through simple moment conditions. Applying our method to several student outcomes, we uncover strong evidence of asymmetries in peer effects. We then demonstrate that these asymmetries are highly policy-relevant by studying targeted interventions under budget constraints. Ignoring asymmetries leads to inefficient treatment allocation and substantial welfare losses, reducing welfare to levels comparable to those in a benchmark without social interactions.

</details>


### [585] [Generalized AKM: Flexible Controls and Interactions in Wage Decompositions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09686)
*Francesco Del Prato,Yaroslav Korobka,Paolo Zacchia*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文提出广义AKM（Generalized AKM）框架，允许未知平滑协变量函数和分组非线性交互作用，同时保留原始方差分解成分。在葡萄牙雇主-雇员数据中，加入控制变量后各方差成分下降，且发现控制变量的选择比进入方式对厂商方差和排序的影响更大，而工人方差对基函数更敏感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准AKM分解强制使用已知的线性协变量调整，但现实中工资与观测特征的关系可能是非线性的，且不同群体间存在交互效应。这种刚性假设可能导致方差分解结果产生偏误，因此需要更灵活的框架来准确归因工资离散度。

Method: 提出Generalized AKM框架，允许：1）未知平滑协变量函数；2）组特定的非线性交互作用；同时保持原始AKM方差成分的分解结构。理论上证明了在异方差误差和大量固定效应下的相合性和渐近正态性，并刻画了二次型所需的更强光滑性条件。

Result: 在葡萄牙数据中，加入工人和企业输入控制后，偏差校正的工人效应方差从0.551降至0.474（占总工资方差比例），企业效应方差从0.144降至0.121，排序效应从0.080降至0.047。在三种分组非线性基下，企业效应方差稳定在0.114-0.117，排序稳定在0.041-0.042，而工人效应方差在0.474-0.491之间波动。

Conclusion: 控制变量的选择（哪些协变量进入）比其进入的灵活性（如何进入）对企业效应方差和排序的影响更大；而工人效应方差对基函数选择更敏感。这为实证研究中AKM类分解的控制变量设定提供了重要指导。

Abstract: How much wage dispersion is attributed to workers, firms, and their sorting depends on how wages are adjusted for observed characteristics. Standard AKM decompositions impose a known linear adjustment. We develop Generalized AKM, a framework that permits an unknown smooth covariate function and group-specific nonlinear interactions while preserving the original variance components. We prove consistency and asymptotic normality with heteroskedastic errors and many fixed effects, and characterize the stronger smoothness required for quadratic forms. In Portuguese employer-employee data, adding worker and firm-input controls lowers the bias-corrected worker-effect variance from $0.551$ to $0.474$ of total wage variance, firm-effect variance from $0.144$ to $0.121$, and sorting from $0.080$ to $0.047$. Across three group-specific nonlinear bases, firm-effect variance remains between $0.114$ and $0.117$ and sorting between $0.041$ and $0.042$, while worker-effect variance ranges from $0.474$to $0.491$. Which controls enter matters more for firm variance and sorting than how flexibly they enter; worker variance remains more sensitive to the basis.

</details>


### [586] [Optimal Experimental Design and Estimation when Potential Outcomes are Bounded](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09812)
*Peter Hull*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文研究在潜在结果已知有界（如二值结果）的情况下，有限总体平均处理效应的随机化实验最优设计与分析。在仿射估计量类别中，独立随机分配结合以支持中点为中心的回归（无截距）最小化最坏情形均方误差（MSE），这与传统平衡完全随机化加差分均值估计的常规做法形成对比。扩展至任意估计量时，独立随机分配仍保持最优，而一般非线性最优估计量可显著降低最坏情形MSE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统随机化实验设计通常推荐平衡完全随机化与差分均值估计，但此类设计假设潜在结果无界或依赖于正态近似。当潜在结果已知有界（如二值变量）时，实现处理份额的随机性本身携带信息，这一特性被传统设计所忽视。作者旨在重新审视在这种情况下最优的分配机制与估计方法。

Method: 在有限总体框架下，对所有分配机制和一类广泛的仿射估计量，推导最坏情形MSE的最小化解。证明独立随机分配配合无截距的、"以支持中点为中心的"新回归形式为最优。随后将结论推广到任意估计量的一般情形，推导一般非线性最优估计量，并与完全随机化（含整样本与配对）等基准设计进行最坏情形MSE比较。

Result: 最坏情形MSE由独立随机分配和'支持中点中心化结果对再中心化处理'的无截距回归最小化。相对完全整样本随机化的最坏情形增益渐近可忽略，但相对配对完全随机化加配对固定效应回归，增益可达一阶（后者最坏MSE翻倍）。对任意估计量的一般情形，独立随机分配依旧最优，一般非线性最优估计量能带来有意义的MSE改进。

Conclusion: 当潜在结果有界时，随机化实验的最优设计应放弃平衡完全随机化，转而采用独立随机分配，并配合适当中心化的无截距回归（或更一般的非线性估计量）。处理份额的随机性在此情形下是信息而非噪声。配对设计被证明远非最优。

Abstract: I study the optimal design and analysis of randomized experiments for estimating finite-population average treatment effects when potential outcomes are known to be bounded, as with binary outcomes. Among all assignment mechanisms and a broad class of affine estimators, worst-case mean-squared error (MSE) is minimized by independent random assignment and an unconventional regression of the support-midpoint-centered outcome on the recentered treatment, with no intercept. This contrasts with the usual prescription of balanced complete randomization and difference-in-means estimation: when outcomes are bounded, randomness in the realized treatment share is informative. The worst-case gain over full-sample complete randomization is asymptotically small, but gains can be first-order relative to other designs: complete within-pair randomization and pair-fixed-effect regression have twice the worst-case MSE. I extend the result to allow for arbitrary estimators. Independent random assignment remains optimal, and the generally-nonlinear optimal estimator can meaningfully reduce worst-case MSE.

</details>


### [587] [Bias-robust causal inference for panel data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09837)
*Angelos Alexopoulos*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对面板数据观测研究中偏差稳健的因果推断方法。该方法将偏差感知极小极大方法（原用于因子模型面板中的回归系数估计）适配到因果目标——处理组的平均效应估计上。估计器用加权未处理残差修正反事实插补，并给出包含剩余误差显式容差的置信区间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统面板数据因果推断方法通过插补未处理结果来估计处理效应，但反事实插补误差会直接传导至处理效应估计中，而常规标准误又忽略了这一误差来源，导致推断结果不可靠，尤其是在因子秩被低估时问题尤为严重。

Method: 将偏差感知极小极大方法从回归系数估计扩展到因果推断目标（处理组的平均效应）。估计器通过加权未处理残差来修正插补的反事实结果，并显式地在区间估计中纳入剩余反事实误差的容差，以处理不同单元和时期可能变化的处理效应。

Result: 模拟实验表明，所提方法在因子秩被低估时能维持名义覆盖率，而广义合成控制法等替代方法几乎无法维持覆盖率。代价是置信区间更宽。在真实数据应用中，即使反事实误差达到设计安慰剂通常表现水平的两倍，估计效应仍保持显著。

Conclusion: 该方法通过显式计入反事实插补误差，提供了更稳健的因果推断区间，在因子结构设定错误时仍能保证名义覆盖，为处理面板数据因果推断中的反事实不确定性提供了可靠的解决方案。

Abstract: We develop a bias-robust causal inference method for observational panel data settings. Such methods typically impute untreated outcomes, so counterfactual error passes straight into the estimated treatment effect while conventional standard errors ignore it. We adapt bias-aware minimax methods, developed for estimating regression coefficients in factor-model panels, to a causal target: the average effect on the treated, which has to be imputed and may vary across units and periods. The estimator corrects the imputed counterfactual with weighted untreated residuals and reports intervals with an explicit allowance for the error that remains. In simulations the proposed method holds nominal coverage where alternatives such as the generalized synthetic control have almost none, especially when the factor rank is underfitted, at the cost of wider intervals. By applying the developed methodology to real data the estimated effect remains significant for counterfactual errors nearly twice the size that the design's placebos typically exhibit.

</details>

### [588] [Marginally Useful: Formalizing the Information Gap in Conformal Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07479)
*Peter Cotton*

Main category: q-fin.ST

TL;DR: 本文提出"残差-信息缺口"（residual-information gap）这一概念，用于分解保形预测（conformal prediction）覆盖保证与预测质量之间的差距。对于单形状残差预测系统，相对于oracle的对数评分遗憾恰好等于残差R与输入X之间的互信息I(R;X)。保形化只能重新调整覆盖水平，但无法改变这一信息缺口，因为它取决于预测器形状类别而非校准过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 保形预测提供的有限样本、无分布假设的边际覆盖保证是真实的，但常常被误读为预测质量的证据。作者希望将"覆盖保证"与"预测质量"这两个概念严格区分开来，揭示保形化本质上是校准过程，其保证与预测器的内在质量（信息含量）无关。

Method: 提出一个数学分解框架——残差-信息缺口。对于一个单形状残差预测系统，证明对数评分遗憾（相对于oracle）恰好等于残差与输入之间的互信息I(R;X)。该量是预测器形状类别的属性，不受校准影响。同时证明任何忽略X的重新校准都无法减少该缺口。

Result: 推导出残差-信息缺口与互信息之间的精确等式；证明保形化无法改变这一缺口；将常见的保形预测注意事项（边际覆盖非条件覆盖、有效性不敏感于尖锐度、需要可交换性假设）作为该分解的自然推论呈现。

Conclusion: 保形预测的覆盖保证是真实的，但它不等同于预测质量。预测质量的核心限制在于残差-信息缺口，这是预测器形状类别的固有属性，保形校准无法弥补。这为理解保形预测的能力边界提供了理论基础。

Abstract: Conformal prediction gives finite-sample, distribution-free marginal coverage for a set. The guarantee is real, and it is often misread as evidence of forecast quality. We separate the two with one decomposition, which we call the residual-information gap: for a single-shape residual predictive system, the log-score regret relative to the oracle is exactly the mutual information $I(R;X)$ between the residual and the input. Conformalization re-levels coverage but cannot touch this quantity, because it is a property of the predictor's shape class and not of calibration; no recalibration that ignores $X$ reduces it. The familiar cautions about conformal prediction follow as context: marginal coverage is not conditional, validity is insensitive to sharpness, and the guarantee needs exchangeability.

</details>


### [589] [Scaling laws of Stablecoin Transactions: Evidence from USDT and USDC on the Ethereum blockchain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09378)
*Kundan Mukhia,Sabat Rai,Vivek Shrivastav,Imran Ansari,Md. Nurujjaman*

Main category: q-fin.ST

TL;DR: 本研究首次系统分析了稳定币（USDT和USDC）在以太坊区块链上的约3.7亿笔交易数据，基于EOA与SC的交互关系将交易分为四类，发现所有类别的交易价值分布均呈现幂律重尾标度行为，并识别出两个不同的标度区域：涉及EOA的交易指数约1.45-1.60，SC-SC交易指数约1.72-1.73。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稳定币已成为数字资产生态系统中的重要组成部分，但对其交易活动的统计特性研究甚少，尤其是交易的标度行为（scaling behavior）此前从未被探索过。

Method: 收集2024年6月至2026年2月间六个时期约3.7亿笔USDT和USDC以太坊链上交易，按EOA/SC交互将交易分为四类（EOA-EOA、EOA-SC、SC-EOA、SC-SC），采用最大似然估计拟合幂律指数，并进行敏感性分析和反事实分析检验结果的稳健性。

Result: 所有稳定币、所有时期和所有交易类别的交易价值分布均呈现重尾标度；两类明显的标度区域：涉及EOA的指数集中在1.45-1.60，SC-SC交易指数约为1.72-1.73；反事实分析显示类别权重变化仅能解释总指数时间变异的约10%-35%。

Conclusion: 稳定币交易活动普遍存在幂律尾部行为，但指数取决于交易是否由EOA或SC驱动，这揭示了区块链金融系统中交易异质性的重要特征，为后续标度行为和交易异质性研究奠定了基础。

Abstract: Stablecoins have rapidly emerged as an important class of digital assets and a component of the digital financial ecosystem. Despite their growing importance, the statistical properties of stablecoin transaction activity remain largely unexplored. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to investigate scaling behavior in stablecoin transaction data, focusing on USDT and USDC. We analyze approximately 370 million USDT and USDC transactions recorded on the Ethereum blockchain across six periods spanning June 2024 to February 2026. Based on interactions between Externally Owned Accounts (EOAs) and Smart Contracts (SCs), we classify transactions into four categories: EOA-EOA, EOA-SC, SC-EOA, and SC-SC. Using maximum-likelihood estimation of power-law exponents, we find that transaction value distributions exhibit heavy-tailed scaling for both stablecoins across all periods and interaction categories. We identify two distinct scaling regimes: EOA-involved categories cluster around 1.45-1.60, whereas SC-SC transactions exhibit higher exponents of approximately 1.72-1.73. Sensitivity analysis confirms that this separation is robust across periods, stablecoins, and fitting sample sizes. Counterfactual analysis shows that changes in category weights alone cannot explain the observed variation in the overall exponent. Across different sample sizes, the counterfactual path accounts for only about 10%-35% of the total temporal range observed in the actual data. Overall, our results indicate two broadly differentiated scaling regimes in the tail of stablecoin transaction values. Power-law tail behavior is observed throughout stablecoin transaction activity, but the exponent depends on whether transactions are driven by EOAs or SCs. These findings provide a basis for further research on scaling behavior and transaction heterogeneity in blockchain-based financial systems.

</details>


### [590] [Lower spectrum of financial correlation matrices: a new perspective on market synchronization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09641)
*Rosanna Grassi,Caterina Pastorino,Pierpaolo Uberti*

Main category: q-fin.ST

TL;DR: 本文研究了金融相关矩阵谱下端的信宿含量，证明最小特征值同样包含关于市场有效结构的相关信息，并通过真实数据实验在描述性和预测性场景中验证了该方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统金融分析中，主成分分析（PCA）和随机矩阵理论（RMT）通常关注最大特征值作为主导市场因素和同步化模式的指标，而忽略了谱下端的潜在信息。本文旨在补充这一视角，证明最小特征值也能反映金融市场的有效结构。

Method: 作者提出了一个方法论框架，利用金融相关矩阵谱下端的特征值来提取市场同步化信息。该方法作为PCA和RMT经典应用（关注最大特征值）的互补工具，并通过全面的真实数据实验在描述性和预测性两种场景下验证其性能。

Result: 通过真实数据实验，该方法在描述性和预测性设置下均展示了有效性，表明最小特征值确实包含关于金融市场有效结构的相关信息，能够作为最大特征值分析的有力补充。

Conclusion: 论文表明金融相关矩阵的全部谱结构都蕴含市场信息，不仅仅是最大特征值。将谱下端的特征信息纳入分析框架，可以更全面地理解金融市场的同步化和有效结构，为市场分析提供了新的方法论视角。

Abstract: In this paper we investigate the information content of the lower part of the spectrum of financial correlation matrices, as a source of information on market synchronization. In a financial context, a classical application of Principal Component Analysis and Random Matrix Theory identifies the largest eigenvalues as indicators of dominant market factors and synchronization patterns. We complement this perspective by showing that the smallest eigenvalues also contain relevant information about the effective structure of financial markets. The paper presents the methodological proposal and validates its effectiveness through comprehensive real data experiments in both descriptive and predictive settings.

</details>


<div id='eess.SY'></div>

# eess.SY [[Back]](#toc)

### [591] [Design and Analysis of a Programmable Ramp Generator for Frequency Synthesizers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07680)
*Pranjal Mahajan,Hrishikesh Milind Gawas,Ishan Acharyya,Umesh Khetan,Navya Valmeekam,Mohd Wajid,Hemant Kumar Meena,Abhishek Srivastava*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种全数字可编程斜坡生成器(PRG)，用于可重构频率斜坡合成器，适用于FMCW雷达、扩频时钟发生和测试测量等应用。通过创新的模块化架构（相位累加器+Delta-Sigma调制器驱动多模分频器），实现了对斜坡斜率、带宽和时长的独立数字控制，并首次联合分析了三个关键的电路级约束（MMD八度边界行为、分频器同步时序和DSM步进时长限制），提出了一套将应用规格映射到硬件参数的系统化设计方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前的相关工作虽然展示了啁啾（chirp）合成能力，但尚未对保证PRG可靠运行的电路级约束进行联合分析，导致缺乏系统化的设计指导。

Method: 提出模块化架构（相位累加器频率扫描生成器+DSM驱动MMD），识别并分析了三个关键电路级约束，并据此开发了将应用级规格直接映射到硬件参数的系统化算法。

Result: 在TSMC 65nm CMOS工艺上实现了一个16位PRG，跨18种斜坡轮廓完成验证；在Xilinx Spartan-7 FPGA上进行硬件原型验证，确认了实时运行能力。

Conclusion: 通过联合分析电路约束并建立设计空间，本文提供了一种系统化的PRG设计方法，填补了先前工作在电路级约束分析上的空白，并验证了该方法的可行性和硬件实用性。

Abstract: This paper presents a fully digital Programmable Ramp Generator (PRG) for reconfigurable frequency-ramp synthesizers used in Frequency-Modulated Continuous-Wave radar, spread-spectrum clock generation, and test and measurement applications. A novel modular architecture is proposed, integrating a phase-accumulator-based frequency sweep generator and Delta-Sigma Modulator (DSM) that drives a Multi-Modulus Divider (MMD), giving independent digital control over ramp slope, bandwidth, and duration. While prior works demonstrate chirp synthesis, the circuit-level constraints governing reliable PRG operation have not been jointly analyzed. This work identifies and analyzes three such constraints: (a) MMD octave-boundary behavior under dynamic updates, (b) divider-synchronous timing, and (c) DSM limits on step duration and achievable slope. Together, these constraints define the PRG design space, enabling a systematic algorithm that maps application-level specifications directly to hardware parameters. Following this methodology, a 16-bit PRG implemented in TSMC 65 nm CMOS is verified across 18 ramp profiles and hardware prototyping on a Xilinx Spartan-7 FPGA confirms real-time operation.

</details>


### [592] [Lost Opportunity Costs Under Ramp Stress: A Comparison of Ramp-Product Dispatch and Look-Ahead Economic Dispatch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07739)
*Aidan Looney,Qian Zhang,Le Xie*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究斜坡产品结算（RP-LMP）是否像前瞻经济调度（LA-LMP）一样有效地补偿吸收跨期斜坡稀缺性的发电机组。通过比较两种方法引起的损失机会成本（LOC），并在10机组系统和修改的RTS-GMLC系统上进行滚动时域仿真，发现RP-LMP下的总LOC高于LA-LMP。主要贡献是对斜坡产品结算进行发电机级别的关键评估，识别哪些机组在RP-LMP下留下未补偿的跨期机会成本，以及该负担在LA-LMP下如何变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电力市场中斜坡稀缺性（ramp scarcity）的定价与结算机制对发电机组的经济补偿至关重要。需要评估斜坡产品结算（RP-LMP）是否与前瞻经济调度（look-ahead dispatch）同样有效地补偿机组吸收跨期斜坡约束所产生的机会成本。

Method: 通过比较各结算方式引起的损失机会成本（LOC）来评估。采用滚动时域仿真（rolling-horizon simulations），在10发电机测试系统和修改的RTS-GMLC系统上进行实验，对比RP-LMP、LA-LMP和TLMP三种结算方式，并针对确定性斜坡压力案例进行分析。

Result: 在确定性斜坡压力案例中，RP-LMP下的总LOC高于LA-LMP。RP-LMP的LOC集中在反复受斜坡约束绑定的机组上，而LA-LMP主要缓解这些机组并留下较小的残余LOC于其他机组。多日测试在较大系统完美预测下保持此排序，但在预测误差下该排序不一定成立。

Conclusion: 斜坡产品结算在补偿跨期斜坡稀缺性方面不如前瞻经济调度有效，其机会成本补偿集中于重复受斜坡约束的机组。LA-LMP能更均衡地缓解这些补偿负担。但预测误差可能改变两者的相对表现。

Abstract: This paper studies whether ramp-product settlement compensates generators that absorb intertemporal ramp scarcity as effectively as look-ahead economic dispatch. We evaluate this question by comparing the lost opportunity cost (LOC) induced by each approach. Using rolling-horizon simulations on a 10-generator system and a modified RTS-GMLC system, we compare ramp-product settlement (RP-LMP), look-ahead settlement (LA-LMP), and temporal locational marginal pricing (TLMP). In the featured deterministic ramp stressed cases, aggregate LOC is higher under RP-LMP than under LA-LMP. The main contribution is a generator-level critical assessment for ramp-product settlement: we identify which units are left with uncompensated intertemporal opportunity cost under RP-LMP and how that burden changes under LA-LMP. RP-LMP LOC is concentrated on units with repeated ramp-binding exposure, while LA-LMP mainly relieves those same units and leaves smaller residual LOC on other units. Multi-day tests preserve this ordering under perfect foresight in the larger test system, but show that it need not hold under forecast error.

</details>


### [593] [Information-Aware Model Predictive Control for Satellite Inspection Missions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07765)
*Sarah E. Clees,Sean Phillips,Christopher Petersen*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合双控制与协方差控制思想、将估计协方差嵌入模型预测控制(MPC)目标函数的航天器自主巡检框架，能够同时满足安全与输入约束，并主动降低目标特征点估计的不确定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统制导与控制方法通常将估计与控制解耦，导致生成的轨迹不能显式优化传感几何构型，无法在巡检过程中最大化信息获取效率。

Method: 构建MPC框架，将基于线性卡尔曼滤波的估计协方差动态嵌入控制目标中；测量模型依赖于服务航天器与目标的相对几何；采用Hill-Clohessy-Wiltshire相对运动方程建模，并施加控制输入、相对距离及终端最大协方差约束。

Result: 数值仿真表明该框架能生成可行的巡检轨迹，在满足输入和安全约束的同时显著降低目标兴趣点估计协方差；初始条件网格分析揭示了轨迹可行性与价值函数对初始条件和约束激活情形的依赖关系。

Conclusion: 该框架克服了传统估计与控制解耦的局限，实现了传感几何与轨迹生成的联合优化，为自主航天器巡检提供了更优的感知-控制一体化方案。

Abstract: Autonomous spacecraft inspection requires trajectories that satisfy safety and control constraints while enabling the collection of informative measurements about a target spacecraft. Traditional guidance and control methods typically decouple estimation from control, resulting in trajectories that do not explicitly optimize sensing geometry. This work presents a model predictive control (MPC) framework that incorporates estimation covariance in the control objective using a formulation inspired by dual control and covariance steering. The estimation covariance evolves according to a linear Kalman filter, and the measurement model depends on the relative geometry between the agent spacecraft and the target. By embedding the covariance dynamics within the MPC problem, the resulting trajectories account for measurement quality, actively reduce uncertainty, and improve observability in the estimated features of the target. The problem is formulated using relative motion dynamics via the Hill-Clohessy-Wiltshire equations with constraints on control input, relative distance, and terminal maximum covariance. Numerical simulations demonstrate that the proposed framework generates feasible inspection trajectories that actively reduce estimation covariance of points of interest on a target while satisfying input and safety constraints of the agent. A mesh analysis of initial conditions further illustrates how feasibility and the value function of the trajectory depend on the initial conditions and constraint activity.

</details>


### [594] [Generalized Nyquist Criterion Limitations and Misconceptions for Frequency Domain Stability Analysis of Inverter-based Resources Integrated Power Grids](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07785)
*Hassan Yazdani,Saeed Lotfifard*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文通过理论和数值研究证明了广义奈奎斯特准则(GNC)在评估基于逆变器资源(IBR)的多输入多输出(MIMO)系统小信号稳定性方面存在局限性。GNC不仅在标称稳定性分析中带来不必要的计算负担和分析复杂度，而且在鲁棒稳定性分析中不可靠，可能产生误导性结果。为克服这些局限，论文开发了一种模型不确定性增强的IBR集成电网表示方法，采用μ分析进行MIMO鲁棒稳定性评估，该模型显式捕获了参数变化、未建模动力学和测量误差等不确定性源的结构特征和空间分布，并将三相(abc)系统中的不确定性系统性地变换到dq0坐标系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 广义奈奎斯特准则(GNC)虽然是分析MIMO系统稳定性的常用工具，但在应用于IBR集成电网时存在显著局限性：计算负担大、分析复杂度高，且在鲁棒稳定性分析中可能产生误导结果。这促使研究者探索更可靠的MIMO鲁棒稳定性评估方法。

Method: 论文开发了一个模型不确定性增强的IBR集成电力网络表示方法，该模型显式捕获各类不确定性源（参数变化、未建模动力学、测量误差）的结构特征和空间分布，并将这些自然存在于物理三相(abc)系统中的不确定性系统性地变换到dq0坐标系中，以便使用μ分析进行MIMO鲁棒稳定性评估。

Result: 通过理论和数值研究证明了GNC在评估MIMO IBR系统小信号稳定性和鲁棒稳定性方面的局限性与不可靠性，并展示了所提出的不确定性增强模型结合μ分析能够为IBR集成电网提供正确的MIMO鲁棒稳定性评估。

Conclusion: GNC不适用于MIMO IBR系统的鲁棒稳定性分析，而基于μ分析并结合模型不确定性增强表示的方法为IBR集成电网的MIMO鲁棒稳定性评估提供了更可靠、更合适的替代方案。

Abstract: This paper presents theoretical and numerical studies demonstrating the limitations of the Generalized Nyquist Criterion (GNC) in assessing the small-signal stability of inverter-based resources (IBRs) modeled as multi-input, multi-output (MIMO) systems. GNC leads to unnecessary computational burden and increased analytical complexity for nominal stability analysis. The paper demonstrates that the GNC framework is not reliable for robust-stability analysis and may lead to misleading results when applied to MIMO IBR systems. To demonstrate these limitations and enable a proper MIMO robust stability assessment of IBRs using mu-analysis, the paper develops a model-uncertainty-augmented representation of an IBR-integrated power grid. The proposed model explicitly captures the structural characteristics and spatial distribution of various uncertainty sources, such as parametric variations, unmodeled dynamics, and measurement errors. Since these uncertainties naturally occur in the physical three-phase (abc) systems, they are systematically transformed into the dq0 frame within the developed model.

</details>


### [595] [Parameter-Dependent LMI Synthesis for Semi-Global Differential ISS Trajectory Tracking of Nonholonomic Mobile Robots Under Multiplicative Wheel Slip](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08049)
*Mohammad Sabouri*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于参数依赖线性矩阵不等式（LMI）的框架，用于解决可变地形上遭受严重乘性轮滑移的非完整移动机器人轨迹跟踪问题。该框架通过采样凸公式结合网格到连续残差认证，同时建立半全局微分输入-状态稳定性、指数衰减率、区域极点配置和有界增益反馈代理。核心贡献是对Kanayama误差坐标中乘性滑移引起的加性扰动的显式上界推导，搭建了物理滑移机制与凸综合范式之间的桥梁。在数值验证中，该控制器在100次蒙特卡洛运行中实现了完整的轨迹包络内保持，峰值跟踪误差相比固定增益LMI基线降低12%，相比手动基线降低49%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非完整移动机器人在可变地形上运行时遭受严重的乘性轮滑移，这导致传统固定增益控制器性能退化甚至不可行。现有方法缺乏将物理滑移机制与凸优化综合框架结合的显式理论桥梁，亟需一个既能保证稳定性又能在严重滑移条件下维持跟踪性能的控制框架。

Method: 构建参数依赖LMI框架，采用采样凸公式并辅以网格到连续残差认证；推导乘性滑移在Kanayama误差坐标中诱导的加性扰动显式上界；辅助增益矩阵和逆存储度量在参考速度中仿射参数化，存储度量通过逐点矩阵求逆继承非线性依赖；通过级联分析（变分收缩、前向不变性、滑移扰动界、耗散轨迹重构）建立稳定性。

Result: 在100次蒙特卡洛运行中实现完整轨迹包络内保持；在可变地形场景下，峰值跟踪误差相比固定增益LMI基线降低12%，相比手动基线降低49%；恒定增益基线的指数衰减率不可行。测试涵盖6条参考轨迹、6类扰动、60秒可变地形测试（6个严重滑移区块，双向滑移率高达±50%）及两个几何构型，并补充了高斯传感器噪声、复合压力测试和嵌入式平台计算可行性研究。

Conclusion: 所提出的参数依赖LMI框架有效解决了严重乘性滑移下非完整移动机器人的轨迹跟踪问题，兼具理论保证（半全局稳定性、指数收敛、极点配置）和实用性能（抗扰动、有界增益、嵌入式可行），在极端滑移条件下显著优于现有基线方法。

Abstract: This paper presents a parameter-dependent linear matrix inequality (LMI) framework for trajectory tracking of nonholonomic mobile robots subject to severe multiplicative wheel slip on variable-terrain surfaces. The sampled convex formulation, augmented with grid-to-continuum residual certification, simultaneously establishes semi-global differential input-to-state stability, a prescribed exponential decay rate, regional pole placement, and a gain-bounded feedback proxy for actuator-limited operation. A central contribution is an explicit upper bound on the additive disturbance induced by bounded multiplicative slip in the Kanayama error coordinates, bridging the physical slip mechanism and the convex synthesis paradigm. The auxiliary gain matrix and inverse storage metric are parameterized affinely in the reference velocities, while the storage metric inherits nonlinear dependence through pointwise matrix inversion. Stability is established via a cascade analysis combining variational contraction, forward invariance, slip-induced disturbance bounds, and dissipation-based trajectory reconstruction. Numerical validation compares three controllers across six reference trajectories, six disturbance classes, and a 60-second variable-terrain test featuring six severe slip patches with bidirectional slip ratios reaching +/-50%, replicated on two geometries. Supplementary studies address Gaussian sensor noise, compound stress-testing, and embedded-platform computational feasibility. Across 100 Monte-Carlo runs the proposed controller achieves complete trajectory containment within the certified envelope. On the variable-terrain scenario, peak tracking error is reduced by 12% against the fixed-gain LMI baseline and 49% against the manual baseline, with the constant-gain baseline infeasible at the prescribed decay rate.

</details>


### [596] [Hierarchical Multi-Task Federated Learning in VANETs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08111)
*M. Saeid HaghighiFard,Sinem Coleri*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了AERO-HMTFL框架，一种基于自编码器的可靠性优化分层多任务联邦学习框架，用于动态多跳集群VANETs，通过三权重聚类、分裂模型架构和可靠性感知聚合，在异构任务和非IID数据条件下提升学习性能和通信效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
